name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.ordinaryScale_isWeightedHomogeneous
statement:
theorem ordinaryScale_isWeightedHomogeneous {w : ι → ℕ} {q : ℕ}
    (lam : R) (p : MvPolynomial ι R)
    (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w q) :
    (ordinaryScale lam p).IsWeightedHomogeneous w q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro d hd
  rw [ordinaryScale, MvPolynomial.coeff_sum] at hd
  obtain ⟨e, he, hne⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hd
  rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial] at hne
  split_ifs at hne with h
  · subst e
    have hc : p.coeff d ≠ 0 := by
      intro hc
      simp [hc] at hne
    exact hp hc
  · contradiction

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.polynomialScale_isWeightedHomogeneous
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro d hd
  rw [polynomialScale, MvPolynomial.coeff_sum] at hd
  obtain ⟨e, he, hne⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_zero_of_sum_ne_zero hd
  rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial] at hne
  split_ifs at hne with h
  · subst e
    have hc : p.coeff d ≠ 0 := by
      intro hc
      simp [hc] at hne
    exact hp hc
  · contradiction

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.ordinaryScale_zero_eq_linearPart
statement:
theorem ordinaryScale_zero_eq_linearPart
    (p : MvPolynomial ι R)
    (hconstant : ∀ d ∈ p.support, ordinaryDegree d ≠ 0) :
    ordinaryScale (0 : R) p = linearPart p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [ordinaryScale, linearPart, Finset.sum_filter]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d hd
  by_cases hone : ordinaryDegree d = 1
  · simp [ordinaryScaleFactor, hone]
  · have hzero : ordinaryDegree d ≠ 0 := hconstant d hd
    have htwo : 2 ≤ ordinaryDegree d := by omega
    simp [hone, ordinaryScaleFactor_zero_of_two_le d htwo]

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.ordinaryDegree_ne_zero_of_homogeneous
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hd0 : d = 0 := (Finsupp.degree_eq_zero_iff d).mp hzero
  have hweight := hp (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hd)
  rw [hd0, map_zero] at hweight
  exact hq hweight.symm

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.ordinaryScale_zero_of_homogeneous
proof:
:=
  ordinaryScale_zero_eq_linearPart p
    (ordinaryDegree_ne_zero_of_homogeneous p hp hq)

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.polynomialScale_at_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem polynomialScale_at_one (p : MvPolynomial ι R) :
    specializeParameter 1 (polynomialScale p) = p
proof:
:= by
  rw [specializeParameter_polynomialScale, ordinaryScale_one]

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.polynomialScale_at_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [specializeParameter_polynomialScale]
  exact ordinaryScale_zero_of_homogeneous p hp hq

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.eval_ordinaryScale
statement:
theorem eval_ordinaryScale (lam : R) (p : MvPolynomial ι R) (a : ι → R) :
    MvPolynomial.eval a (ordinaryScale lam p) =
      ∑ d ∈ p.support,
        (ordinaryScaleFactor lam d * p.coeff d) *
          d.prod (fun i e ↦ a i ^ e)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [ordinaryScale, MvPolynomial.eval_sum, MvPolynomial.eval_monomial]

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.coeff_ordinaryScale
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_ordinaryScale :
    (ordinaryScale lam p).coeff d = ordinaryScaleFactor lam d * p.coeff d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [ordinaryScale, MvPolynomial.coeff_sum, MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial]
  by_cases hd : d ∈ p.support
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single d (fun b _ hb ↦ if_neg hb) (fun h ↦ absurd hd h), if_pos rfl]
  · rw [MvPolynomial.notMem_support_iff.mp hd, mul_zero]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun b hb ↦ if_neg ?_
    exact fun h ↦ hd (h ▸ hb)

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.coeff_polynomialScale
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_polynomialScale :
    (polynomialScale p).coeff d =
      Polynomial.X ^ (ordinaryDegree d - 1) * Polynomial.C (p.coeff d)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [polynomialScale, MvPolynomial.coeff_sum, MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial]
  by_cases hd : d ∈ p.support
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single d (fun b _ hb ↦ if_neg hb) (fun h ↦ absurd hd h), if_pos rfl]
  · rw [MvPolynomial.notMem_support_iff.mp hd, map_zero, mul_zero]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun b hb ↦ if_neg ?_
    exact fun h ↦ hd (h ▸ hb)

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.coeff_linearPart
statement:
@[simp] theorem coeff_linearPart :
    (linearPart p).coeff d = if ordinaryDegree d = 1 then p.coeff d else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [linearPart, MvPolynomial.coeff_sum, MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial]
  by_cases hdeg : ordinaryDegree d = 1
  · rw [if_pos hdeg]
    by_cases hd : d ∈ p.support
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single d (fun b _ hb ↦ if_neg hb)
        (fun h ↦ absurd (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hd, hdeg⟩) h), if_pos rfl]
    · rw [MvPolynomial.notMem_support_iff.mp hd]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun b hb ↦ if_neg ?_
      exact fun h ↦ hd (h ▸ (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).1)
  · rw [if_neg hdeg]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun b hb ↦ if_neg ?_
    exact fun h ↦ hdeg (h ▸ (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).2)

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.ordinaryScale_ext
statement:
theorem ordinaryScale_ext {r r' : MvPolynomial ι R}
    (h : ∀ d, r.coeff d = r'.coeff d) : r = r'
proof:
:=
  MvPolynomial.ext _ _ h

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.ordinaryScale_monomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem ordinaryScale_monomial :
    ordinaryScale lam (MvPolynomial.monomial d a)
      = MvPolynomial.monomial d (ordinaryScaleFactor lam d * a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine MvPolynomial.ext _ _ fun e ↦ ?_
  rw [coeff_ordinaryScale, MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial, MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial]
  by_cases h : d = e
  · subst h; simp
  · simp [h]

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.polynomialScale_monomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialScale_monomial :
    polynomialScale (MvPolynomial.monomial d a)
      = MvPolynomial.monomial d
          (Polynomial.X ^ (ordinaryDegree d - 1) * Polynomial.C a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine MvPolynomial.ext _ _ fun e ↦ ?_
  rw [coeff_polynomialScale, MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial, MvPolynomial.coeff_monomial]
  by_cases h : d = e
  · subst h; simp
  · simp [h]

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.ordinaryScale_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem ordinaryScale_add :
    ordinaryScale lam (p + q) = ordinaryScale lam p + ordinaryScale lam q
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.ext _ _ fun e ↦ ?_
  simp [mul_add]

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.polynomialScale_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialScale_add :
    polynomialScale (p + q) = polynomialScale p + polynomialScale q
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.ext _ _ fun e ↦ ?_
  simp [mul_add]

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.ordinaryScale_zero_poly
statement:
@[simp] theorem ordinaryScale_zero_poly :
    ordinaryScale lam (0 : MvPolynomial ι R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.ext _ _ fun e ↦ ?_
  simp

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.polynomialScale_zero_poly
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialScale_zero_poly :
    polynomialScale (0 : MvPolynomial ι R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.ext _ _ fun e ↦ ?_
  simp

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.ordinaryScale_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem ordinaryScale_smul (c : R) :
    ordinaryScale lam (c • p) = c • ordinaryScale lam p
proof:
:= by
  refine MvPolynomial.ext _ _ fun e ↦ ?_
  simp only [MvPolynomial.coeff_smul, coeff_ordinaryScale, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.ordinaryScaleHom_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem ordinaryScaleHom_apply :
    ordinaryScaleHom lam p = ordinaryScale lam p
proof: := rfl

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.polynomialScaleHom_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialScaleHom_apply :
    polynomialScaleHom p = polynomialScale p
proof: := rfl

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.support_ordinaryScale_subset
statement:
theorem support_ordinaryScale_subset :
    (ordinaryScale lam p).support ⊆ p.support
proof:
:= by
  intro d hd
  by_contra h
  rw [MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff, coeff_ordinaryScale,
    MvPolynomial.notMem_support_iff.mp h, mul_zero] at hd
  exact hd rfl

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.PolynomialPair.polynomialFamily_forward_specialize
statement:
@[simp]
theorem polynomialFamily_forward_specialize (F : PolynomialPair ι R) (lam : R) (i : ι) :
    specializeParameter lam (F.polynomialFamily.forward i) = (F.scale lam).forward i
proof:
:=
  specializeParameter_polynomialScale lam (F.forward i)

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.PolynomialPair.polynomialFamily_inverse_specialize
statement:
@[simp]
theorem polynomialFamily_inverse_specialize (F : PolynomialPair ι R) (lam : R) (i : ι) :
    specializeParameter lam (F.polynomialFamily.inverse i) = (F.scale lam).inverse i
proof:
:=
  specializeParameter_polynomialScale lam (F.inverse i)

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.PolynomialPair.polynomialFamily_forward_at_zero
statement:
theorem polynomialFamily_forward_at_zero (F : PolynomialPair ι R) (w : ι → ℕ+)
    (hF : ∀ i, (F.forward i).IsWeightedHomogeneous (fun j ↦ (w j : ℕ)) (w i : ℕ))
    (i : ι) :
    specializeParameter 0 (F.polynomialFamily.forward i) = linearPart (F.forward i)
proof:
:=
  polynomialScale_at_zero (F.forward i) (hF i) (w i).ne_zero

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.PolynomialPair.polynomialFamily_inverse_at_zero
statement:
theorem polynomialFamily_inverse_at_zero (F : PolynomialPair ι R) (w : ι → ℕ+)
    (hF : ∀ i, (F.inverse i).IsWeightedHomogeneous (fun j ↦ (w j : ℕ)) (w i : ℕ))
    (i : ι) :
    specializeParameter 0 (F.polynomialFamily.inverse i) = linearPart (F.inverse i)
proof:
:=
  polynomialScale_at_zero (F.inverse i) (hF i) (w i).ne_zero

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.WeightedPolynomialEquiv.scaleFamily_forward_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem scaleFamily_forward_apply (G : WeightedPolynomialEquiv (K := K) w) (lam : K) (i : ι) :

proof: := rfl

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.WeightedPolynomialEquiv.scaleFamily_inverse_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem scaleFamily_inverse_apply (G : WeightedPolynomialEquiv (K := K) w) (lam : K) (i : ι) :
    (scaleFamily G lam).inverse i = ordinaryScale lam (G.inverse i)
proof: := rfl

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.WeightedPolynomialEquiv.scaleFamily_forward_homogeneous
statement:
theorem scaleFamily_forward_homogeneous (G : WeightedPolynomialEquiv (K := K) w)
    (lam : K) (i : ι) :
    ((scaleFamily G lam).forward i).IsWeightedHomogeneous
      (fun j ↦ (w j : ℕ)) (w i)
proof:
:=
  ordinaryScale_isWeightedHomogeneous lam (G.forward i) (G.forward_homogeneous i)

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.WeightedPolynomialEquiv.scaleFamily_inverse_homogeneous
statement:
theorem scaleFamily_inverse_homogeneous (G : WeightedPolynomialEquiv (K := K) w)
    (lam : K) (i : ι) :
    ((scaleFamily G lam).inverse i).IsWeightedHomogeneous
      (fun j ↦ (w j : ℕ)) (w i)

  ordinaryScale_isWeightedHomogeneous lam (G.inverse i) (G.inverse_homogeneous i)

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.WeightedPolynomialEquiv.scaleFamily_forward_at_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem scaleFamily_forward_at_one (G : WeightedPolynomialEquiv (K := K) w) (i : ι) :
    (scaleFamily G 1).forward i = G.forward i
proof:
:= by
  simp [scaleFamily, ordinaryScale_one]

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.WeightedPolynomialEquiv.scaleFamily_inverse_at_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem scaleFamily_inverse_at_one (G : WeightedPolynomialEquiv (K := K) w) (i : ι) :

proof:
:= by

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.WeightedPolynomialEquiv.scaleFamily_forward_at_zero
statement:
theorem scaleFamily_forward_at_zero (G : WeightedPolynomialEquiv (K := K) w)
    (i : ι) :
    (scaleFamily G 0).forward i = linearPart (G.forward i)
proof:
:= by
  change ordinaryScale (0 : K) (G.forward i) = _
  exact ordinaryScale_zero_of_homogeneous (G.forward i) (G.forward_homogeneous i)
    (w i).ne_zero

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.WeightedPolynomialEquiv.scaleFamily_inverse_at_zero

theorem scaleFamily_inverse_at_zero (G : WeightedPolynomialEquiv (K := K) w)

    (scaleFamily G 0).inverse i = linearPart (G.inverse i)
proof:

  exact ordinaryScale_zero_of_homogeneous (G.inverse i) (G.inverse_homogeneous i)
    (w i).ne_zero

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.WeightedPolynomialEquiv.scaleFamily_evalForward
statement:
theorem scaleFamily_evalForward (G : WeightedPolynomialEquiv (K := K) w)
    (lam : K) (a : ι → K) (i : ι) :
    (scaleFamily G lam).evalForward a i =
      ∑ d ∈ (G.forward i).support,
        (ordinaryScaleFactor lam d * (G.forward i).coeff d) *
          d.prod (fun j e ↦ a j ^ e)
proof:
:= by
  exact eval_ordinaryScale lam (G.forward i) a

name: MiyaokaMori.JetTransition.WeightedPolynomialEquiv.scaleFamily_evalInverse
statement:
theorem scaleFamily_evalInverse (G : WeightedPolynomialEquiv (K := K) w)
    (lam : K) (a : ι → K) (i : ι) :
    (scaleFamily G lam).evalInverse a i =
      ∑ d ∈ (G.inverse i).support,
        (ordinaryScaleFactor lam d * (G.inverse i).coeff d) *
          d.prod (fun j e ↦ a j ^ e)
proof:
:= by
  exact eval_ordinaryScale lam (G.inverse i) a

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.homogenize_and_remove_common_factor
statement:
theorem homogenize_and_remove_common_factor {K : Type u} [Field K] {N r₀ : ℕ}
    (P : Fin (N + 1) → Polynomial K)
    (hdeg : ∀ ℓ, (P ℓ).natDegree ≤ r₀) (hne : ∃ ℓ, P ℓ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (m dD : ℕ) (Q : Fin (N + 1) → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K)
      (D : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K),
      m + dD = r₀ ∧ m ≤ r₀ ∧
      (∀ ℓ, (Q ℓ).IsHomogeneous m) ∧ D.IsHomogeneous dD ∧ D ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ x : Fin 2 → K, x ≠ 0 → ∃ ℓ, MvPolynomial.eval x (Q ℓ) ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ ℓ, (P ℓ).homogenize r₀ = D * Q ℓ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2) := Equiv.swap 0 1
  let m := maxDegree (reduced P)
  let d := (commonFactor P).natDegree
  let e := r₀ - (d + m)
  let D₀ : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K :=
    MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ e * homog (commonFactor P) d
  let Q : Fin (N + 1) → MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K :=
    fun ℓ ↦ MvPolynomial.rename s (homogeneousCoordinates P ℓ)
  let D : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) K := MvPolynomial.rename s D₀
  have hsum : d + m ≤ r₀ :=
    (maxDegree_factorization P hne).le.trans (maxDegree_le P hdeg)
  have htotal : m + (e + d) = r₀ := calc
    m + (e + d) = e + (d + m) := by ac_rfl
    _ = r₀ := Nat.sub_add_cancel hsum
  have hswap : (s : Fin 2 → Fin 2) ∘ s = id := by
    funext i
    exact Equiv.swap_apply_self 0 1 i
  have hrename (p : Polynomial K) (r : ℕ) :
      MvPolynomial.rename s (homog p r) = p.homogenize r := by
    change MvPolynomial.rename s (MvPolynomial.rename s (p.homogenize r)) = _
    rw [MvPolynomial.rename_rename, hswap, MvPolynomial.rename_id_apply]
  have hg : homog (commonFactor P) d ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply commonFactor_ne_zero P hne
    apply Polynomial.eq_zero_of_homogenize_eq_zero (n := d) le_rfl
    exact (MvPolynomial.rename_eq_zero_iff_of_injective _ s.injective).mp hz
  have hD₀ : D₀ ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero e (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero (0 : Fin 2))) hg
  refine ⟨m, e + d, Q, D, htotal, maxDegree_reduced_le P hne hdeg, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro ℓ
    exact (isHomogeneous_homogeneousCoordinates P ℓ).rename_isHomogeneous
  · exact ((MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_X_pow (0 : Fin 2) e).mul
      (isHomogeneous_homog (commonFactor P) d)).rename_isHomogeneous
  · exact fun hz ↦ hD₀ ((MvPolynomial.rename_eq_zero_iff_of_injective _ s.injective).mp hz)
  · intro x hx
    have hpair : x 1 ≠ 0 ∨ x 0 ≠ 0 := by
      by_cases h₁ : x 1 = 0
      · right
        intro h₀
        apply hx
        funext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp [h₀, h₁]
      · exact Or.inl h₁
    obtain ⟨ℓ, hℓ⟩ := exists_homogeneousCoordinates_eval₂_ne_zero P hne
      (RingHom.id K) (x 1) (x 0) hpair
    refine ⟨ℓ, ?_⟩
    change MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.rename s (homogeneousCoordinates P ℓ)) ≠ 0
    rw [MvPolynomial.eval_rename]
    have hcoordinates : x ∘ s = ![x 1, x 0] := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [s]
    rw [hcoordinates]
    simpa only [MvPolynomial.eval₂_id] using hℓ
  · intro ℓ
    have h := congrArg (MvPolynomial.rename s)
      (homogenize_original_factorization P hne hdeg ℓ)
    rw [hrename] at h
    change (P ℓ).homogenize r₀ = MvPolynomial.rename s D₀ *
      MvPolynomial.rename s (homogeneousCoordinates P ℓ)
    simpa only [D₀, e, d, m, map_mul] using h

name: weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.X_mem

:= by

name: weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.val_fromZero
statement:
theorem weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.val_fromZero (k : Type u) [Field k] {σ : Type u}
    [DecidableEq σ] (w : σ → ℕ) (i₀ : σ)
    (z : MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w 0) :
    (HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w)
        (Submonoid.powers (MvPolynomial.X i₀)) z).val =
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ k) (Localization.Away (MvPolynomial.X i₀ : MvPolynomial σ k)) z.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap]
  rfl

name: weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forward_fromZero
statement:
theorem weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forward_fromZero (k : Type u) [Field k] {σ : Type u}
    [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (w : σ → ℕ) (i₀ : σ)
    (z : MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w 0) :
    weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forward k w i₀
        (HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w)
          (Submonoid.powers (MvPolynomial.X i₀)) z) =
      weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.dehom k i₀ z.1
proof:
:= by
  unfold weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forward
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply,
    weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.val_fromZero]
  unfold Localization.awayLift
  rw [IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]

name: weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forward_mk
statement:
theorem weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forward_mk (k : Type u) [Field k] {σ : Type u}
    [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (w : σ → ℕ) (i₀ : σ) (h1 : w i₀ = 1) (n : ℕ)
    (a : MvPolynomial σ k) (ha : a ∈ MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w (n • 1)) :
    weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forward k w i₀
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk _ (weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.X_mem k w i₀ h1) n a ha) =
      weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.dehom k i₀ a
proof:
:= by
  unfold weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forward Localization.awayLift IsLocalization.Away.lift
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply,
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_eq_mk'_apply, IsLocalization.lift_mk'_spec]
  simp

name: weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forward_commutes
proof:
:= MvPolynomial.weightedGradedAlgebra (R := k) w
    letI : Algebra k (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w)
        (MvPolynomial.X i₀)) :=
      ((algebraMap (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w 0)
          (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w)
            (MvPolynomial.X i₀))).comp
        (algebraMap k (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w 0))).toAlgebra
    ∀ r : k, weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forward k w i₀
        (algebraMap k (HomogeneousLocalization.Away
          (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w) (MvPolynomial.X i₀)) r) =
      algebraMap k (MvPolynomial {j // j ≠ i₀} k) r := by
  intro r
  refine (weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forward_fromZero k w i₀
    (algebraMap k (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w 0) r)).trans ?_
  simp [weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.dehom, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]

name: weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forwardAlg_apply
statement:
theorem weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forwardAlg_apply (k : Type u) [Field k] {σ : Type u}
    [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (w : σ → ℕ) (i₀ : σ)
    (x : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w)
      (MvPolynomial.X i₀)) :
    weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forwardAlg k w i₀ x = weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forward k w i₀ x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.X_mem_smul
statement:
theorem weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.X_mem_smul (k : Type u) [Field k] {σ : Type u}
    (w : σ → ℕ) (j : σ) :
    (MvPolynomial.X j : MvPolynomial σ k) ∈
      MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w (w j • 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_one, MvPolynomial.mem_weightedHomogeneousSubmodule]
  exact MvPolynomial.isWeightedHomogeneous_X k w j

name: weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.backward_X
statement:
theorem weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.backward_X (k : Type u) [Field k] {σ : Type u}
    [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (w : σ → ℕ) (i₀ : σ) (h1 : w i₀ = 1) (j : {j // j ≠ i₀}) :
    weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.backward k w i₀ h1 (MvPolynomial.X j) =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk _ (weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.X_mem k w i₀ h1) (w j.1)
        (MvPolynomial.X j.1) (weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.X_mem_smul k w j.1)
proof:
:=
  MvPolynomial.aeval_X _ _

name: weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.backward_C
statement:
theorem weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.backward_C (k : Type u) [Field k] {σ : Type u}
    [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (w : σ → ℕ) (i₀ : σ) (h1 : w i₀ = 1) (c : k) :
    weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.backward k w i₀ h1 (MvPolynomial.C c) =
      HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w)
        (Submonoid.powers (MvPolynomial.X i₀))
        (algebraMap k (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w 0) c)
proof:
:=
  MvPolynomial.aeval_C _ _

name: weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.val_backward_dehom
statement:
theorem weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.val_backward_dehom (k : Type u) [Field k] {σ : Type u}
    [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (w : σ → ℕ) (i₀ : σ) (h1 : w i₀ = 1) (p : MvPolynomial σ k) :
    (weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.backward k w i₀ h1 (weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.dehom k i₀ p)).val =
      weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.awayScale k w i₀ p
proof:
:= by
  have h : (algebraMap _ (Localization.Away (MvPolynomial.X i₀ : MvPolynomial σ k))).comp
      ((weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.backward k w i₀ h1).toRingHom.comp
        (weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.dehom k i₀)) =
      (weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.awayScale k w i₀).toRingHom := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro c
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
        weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.dehom_C, weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.backward_C,
        HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply, weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.val_fromZero,
        weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.awayScale, MvPolynomial.aeval_C]
      simp [MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq,
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k (MvPolynomial σ k)
          (Localization.Away (MvPolynomial.X i₀ : MvPolynomial σ k))]
    · intro j
      by_cases hj : j = i₀
      · subst hj
        simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
          weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.dehom_X_self, map_one,
          weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.awayScale, MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
        have hden : (⟨MvPolynomial.X j ^ w j, Submonoid.pow_mem _ (Submonoid.mem_powers _) _⟩ :
            Submonoid.powers (MvPolynomial.X j : MvPolynomial σ k)) =
            ⟨MvPolynomial.X j, Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩ :=
          Subtype.ext (show MvPolynomial.X j ^ w j = MvPolynomial.X j by rw [h1, pow_one])
        rw [hden]
        exact (Localization.mk_self (⟨MvPolynomial.X j, Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩ :
          Submonoid.powers (MvPolynomial.X j : MvPolynomial σ k))).symm
      · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
          weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.dehom_X_of_ne k i₀ hj, weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.backward_X,
          HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
          weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.awayScale, MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
  exact RingHom.congr_fun h p

name: weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.mk_X_pow_zero
statement:
theorem weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.mk_X_pow_zero (k : Type u) [Field k] {σ : Type u}
    [DecidableEq σ] (i₀ : σ) (x : MvPolynomial σ k)
    (h : MvPolynomial.X i₀ ^ 0 ∈ Submonoid.powers (MvPolynomial.X i₀ : MvPolynomial σ k)) :
    Localization.mk x ⟨MvPolynomial.X i₀ ^ 0, h⟩ =
      algebraMap _ (Localization.Away (MvPolynomial.X i₀ : MvPolynomial σ k)) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap]
  congr 1

name: weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.awayScale_monomial
statement:
theorem weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.awayScale_monomial (k : Type u) [Field k] {σ : Type u}
    [DecidableEq σ] (w : σ → ℕ) (i₀ : σ) (α : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : k) :
    weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.awayScale k w i₀ (MvPolynomial.monomial α c) =
      Localization.mk (MvPolynomial.monomial α c)
        ⟨MvPolynomial.X i₀ ^ Finsupp.weight w α, Submonoid.pow_mem _ (Submonoid.mem_powers _) _⟩
proof:
:= by
  induction α using Finsupp.induction with
  | zero =>
    simp only [map_zero]
    rw [weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.mk_X_pow_zero]
    simp [weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.awayScale, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k (MvPolynomial σ k)
        (Localization.Away (MvPolynomial.X i₀ : MvPolynomial σ k)),
      MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
  | single_add a b f _ _ ih =>
    rw [MvPolynomial.monomial_single_add, map_mul, map_pow, ih]
    simp only [weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.awayScale, MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
    rw [Localization.mk_pow, Localization.mk_mul]
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext (by
      show (MvPolynomial.X i₀ ^ w a) ^ b * MvPolynomial.X i₀ ^ Finsupp.weight w f =
        MvPolynomial.X i₀ ^ Finsupp.weight w (Finsupp.single a b + f)
      rw [map_add, Finsupp.weight_single, smul_eq_mul, pow_add, mul_comm b, pow_mul])

name: weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.awayScale_of_isWeightedHomogeneous
statement:
theorem weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.awayScale_of_isWeightedHomogeneous (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {σ : Type u} [DecidableEq σ] (w : σ → ℕ) (i₀ : σ) {p : MvPolynomial σ k} {n : ℕ}
    (hp : p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) :
    weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.awayScale k w i₀ p =
      Localization.mk p ⟨MvPolynomial.X i₀ ^ n, Submonoid.pow_mem _ (Submonoid.mem_powers _) _⟩
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [p.as_sum]
  conv_rhs => rw [p.as_sum]
  rw [map_sum, Localization.mk_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun α hα => ?_
  have hd : Finsupp.weight w α = n := hp (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hα)
  subst hd
  exact weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.awayScale_monomial k w i₀ α _

name: weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forward_comp_backward'
statement:
theorem weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forward_comp_backward' (k : Type u) [Field k] {σ : Type u}
    [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (w : σ → ℕ) (i₀ : σ) (h1 : w i₀ = 1) :
    (weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forwardAlg k w i₀).comp
        (weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.backward k w i₀ h1) =
      AlgHom.id k (MvPolynomial {j // j ≠ i₀} k)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.algHom_ext
  intro j
  rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply, weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.backward_X,
    weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forwardAlg_apply, weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forward_mk k w i₀ h1,
    weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.dehom_X_of_ne k i₀ j.2]

name: weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.backward_comp_forward'
statement:
theorem weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.backward_comp_forward' (k : Type u) [Field k] {σ : Type u}
    [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (w : σ → ℕ) (i₀ : σ) (h1 : w i₀ = 1) :
    (weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.backward k w i₀ h1).comp
        (weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forwardAlg k w i₀) =
      AlgHom.id k (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w)
        (MvPolynomial.X i₀))
proof:
:= by
  refine AlgHom.ext fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨n, a, ha, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective _
    (weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.X_mem k w i₀ h1) x
  rw [AlgHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.id_apply, weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forwardAlg_apply,
    weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forward_mk k w i₀ h1]
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.val_backward_dehom, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
    weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.awayScale_of_isWeightedHomogeneous k w i₀ (n := n)
      ((MvPolynomial.mem_weightedHomogeneousSubmodule _ _ _ _).mp (by simpa using ha))]

name: weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forward_comp_backward
proof:
:= MvPolynomial.weightedGradedAlgebra (R := k) w
    letI : Algebra k (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w)
        (MvPolynomial.X i₀)) :=
      ((algebraMap (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w 0)
          (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w)
            (MvPolynomial.X i₀))).comp
        (algebraMap k (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w 0))).toAlgebra
    (weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forwardAlg k w i₀).comp
        (weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.backward k w i₀ h1) =
      AlgHom.id k (MvPolynomial {j // j ≠ i₀} k) :=
  weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forward_comp_backward' k w i₀ h1

name: weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.backward_comp_forward
proof:
:= MvPolynomial.weightedGradedAlgebra (R := k) w
    letI : Algebra k (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w)
        (MvPolynomial.X i₀)) :=
      ((algebraMap (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w 0)
          (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w)
            (MvPolynomial.X i₀))).comp
        (algebraMap k (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w 0))).toAlgebra
    (weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.backward k w i₀ h1).comp
        (weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.forwardAlg k w i₀) =
      AlgHom.id k (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w)
        (MvPolynomial.X i₀)) :=
  weightedAwayDegreeOneEquiv.backward_comp_forward' k w i₀ h1

name: Algebra.Extension.ker_self
statement: theorem ker_self : (Algebra.Extension.self R R).ker = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  ext x

name: Algebra.Extension.subsingleton_cotangent_self
statement: theorem subsingleton_cotangent_self : Subsingleton (Algebra.Extension.self R R).Cotangent
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x y => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Cotangent.mk_surjective x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := Cotangent.mk_surjective y
  have hx : x = 0 := Subtype.ext (by simpa [ker_self] using x.2)
  have hy : y = 0 := Subtype.ext (by simpa [ker_self] using y.2)
  rw [hx, hy]

name: Algebra.Extension.cotangentEquivCotangentSpaceOfSelf_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem cotangentEquivCotangentSpaceOfSelf_apply (x : P.Cotangent) :
    cotangentEquivCotangentSpaceOfSelf P x = P.cotangentComplex x
proof: := rfl

name: Algebra.Extension.exists_basis_ker_cotangent_of_basis_cotangentSpace
statement:
theorem exists_basis_ker_cotangent_of_basis_cotangentSpace {ι : Type*}
    (b : Module.Basis ι R P.CotangentSpace) :
    ∃ (h : ι → P.Ring) (hmem : ∀ i, h i ∈ P.ker),
      ∃ b' : Module.Basis ι (P.Ring ⧸ P.ker) P.ker.Cotangent,
        ∀ i, b' i = Ideal.toCotangent _ ⟨h i, hmem i⟩
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b₁ : Module.Basis ι R P.Cotangent := b.map (cotangentEquivCotangentSpaceOfSelf P).symm
  choose y hy using fun i => Cotangent.mk_surjective (b₁ i)
  refine ⟨fun i => (y i).1, fun i => (y i).2, ?_⟩
  let e : P.Ring ⧸ P.ker ≃+* R := RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective P.algebraMap_surjective
  let E : P.Cotangent ≃ₗ[R] P.ker.Cotangent :=
    (Algebra.Extension.cotangentEquivCotangentKer (P := P)).restrictScalars R
  have hcompat : ∀ (c : R) (x : P.ker.Cotangent), e.symm c • x = c • x := by
    intro c x
    have h1 : e.symm c = Ideal.Quotient.mk P.ker (algebraMap R P.Ring c) := by
      have := RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective_symm_apply P.algebraMap_surjective
        (algebraMap R P.Ring c)
      rwa [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply, Algebra.algebraMap_self_apply] at this
    rw [h1, ← Ideal.Quotient.algebraMap_eq, algebraMap_smul, algebraMap_smul]
  refine ⟨(b₁.map E).mapCoeffs e.symm hcompat, fun i => ?_⟩
  rw [Module.Basis.mapCoeffs_apply, Module.Basis.map_apply]
  show (b₁ i).val = _
  rw [← hy i, Cotangent.val_mk]

name: Module.Invertible.of_localization_free_rank_one
statement:
theorem Module.Invertible.of_localization_free_rank_one {A M : Type u} [CommRing A] [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module A M] [Module.FinitePresentation A M]
    (h : ∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime],
      Nonempty (LocalizedModule p.primeCompl M ≃ₗ[Localization.AtPrime p] Localization.AtPrime p)) :
    Module.Invertible A M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  
  let loc : ∀ (P : Ideal A) [P.IsMaximal],
      Module.Dual A M ⊗[A] M →ₗ[A]
        Module.Dual (Localization.AtPrime P) (LocalizedModule P.primeCompl M)
          ⊗[Localization.AtPrime P] LocalizedModule P.primeCompl M :=
    fun P _ =>
      ((IsLocalization.moduleTensorEquiv P.primeCompl (Localization.AtPrime P)
          (Module.Dual (Localization.AtPrime P) (LocalizedModule P.primeCompl M))
          (LocalizedModule P.primeCompl M)).symm.restrictScalars A).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map
          (IsLocalizedModule.mapExtendScalars P.primeCompl
            (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap P.primeCompl M)
            (Algebra.linearMap A (Localization.AtPrime P)) (Localization.AtPrime P))
          (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap P.primeCompl M)
  have hloc : ∀ (P : Ideal A) [P.IsMaximal], IsLocalizedModule P.primeCompl (loc P) :=
    fun P _ => inferInstance
  refine bijective_of_isLocalized_maximal _ loc _
    (fun P _ => Algebra.linearMap A (Localization.AtPrime P)) (contractLeft A M) ?_
  intro P _
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := h P
  have : Module.Invertible (Localization.AtPrime P) (LocalizedModule P.primeCompl M) :=
    Module.Invertible.congr e.symm
  have key : IsLocalizedModule.map P.primeCompl (loc P) (Algebra.linearMap A (Localization.AtPrime P))
      (contractLeft A M) =
      (contractLeft (Localization.AtPrime P) (LocalizedModule P.primeCompl M)).restrictScalars A := by
    apply IsLocalizedModule.linearMap_ext P.primeCompl (loc P)
      (Algebra.linearMap A (Localization.AtPrime P))
    rw [IsLocalizedModule.map_comp]
    apply TensorProduct.ext'
    intro φ m
    simp only [loc, IsLocalization.moduleTensorEquiv, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
      TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.restrictScalars_apply,
      LinearMap.coe_restrictScalars, contractLeft_apply,
      Algebra.linearMap_apply]
    rw [show ∀ (x : Module.Dual (Localization.AtPrime P) (LocalizedModule P.primeCompl M))
        (y : LocalizedModule P.primeCompl M),
        (TensorProduct.equivOfCompatibleSMul A (Localization.AtPrime P) (Localization.AtPrime P)
          (Module.Dual (Localization.AtPrime P) (LocalizedModule P.primeCompl M))
          (LocalizedModule P.primeCompl M)).symm (x ⊗ₜ[A] y) = x ⊗ₜ[Localization.AtPrime P] y
        from fun _ _ => rfl]
    rw [contractLeft_apply, IsLocalizedModule.mapExtendScalars_apply_apply]
    exact (IsLocalizedModule.map_apply P.primeCompl (LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap P.primeCompl M)
      (Algebra.linearMap A (Localization.AtPrime P)) φ m).symm
  rw [key]
  exact Module.Invertible.bijective

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.PolynomialTupleHomogenization.isHomogeneous_homog
statement: theorem isHomogeneous_homog (p : R[X]) (d : ℕ) : (homog p d).IsHomogeneous d
proof:
:=
  (Polynomial.isHomogeneous_homogenize p).rename_isHomogeneous

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.PolynomialTupleHomogenization.eval₂_homog
statement:
theorem eval₂_homog (p : R[X]) (d : ℕ) (φ : R →+* S) (u v : S) :
    MvPolynomial.eval₂ φ ![u, v] (homog p d) =
      MvPolynomial.eval₂ φ ![v, u] (p.homogenize d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [homog, MvPolynomial.eval₂_rename]
  have hswap : (![u, v] : Fin 2 → S) ∘ Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1 = ![v, u] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp
  rw [hswap]

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.PolynomialTupleHomogenization.eval₂_homog_one
statement:
theorem eval₂_homog_one (p : R[X]) {d : ℕ} (hdegree : p.natDegree ≤ d)
    (φ : R →+* S) (t : S) :
    MvPolynomial.eval₂ φ ![1, t] (homog p d) = p.eval₂ φ t
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval₂_homog]
  exact Polynomial.eval₂_homogenize_of_eq_one hdegree φ ![t, 1] (by simp)

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.PolynomialTupleHomogenization.eval₂_homog_zero
statement:
theorem eval₂_homog_zero (p : R[X]) (d : ℕ) (φ : R →+* S) (v : S) :
    MvPolynomial.eval₂ φ ![0, v] (homog p d) = φ (p.coeff d) * v ^ d
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval₂_homog, Polynomial.homogenize, MvPolynomial.eval₂_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (d, 0)]
  · simp [MvPolynomial.eval₂_monomial, Finsupp.prod_fintype, Fin.prod_univ_two]
  · intro a ha hne
    have ha_sum : a.1 + a.2 = d := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp ha
    have ha₂ : a.2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      apply hne
      exact Prod.ext (by simpa [hz] using ha_sum) hz
    simp [MvPolynomial.eval₂_monomial, Finsupp.prod_fintype, Fin.prod_univ_two, ha₂]
  · simp

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.PolynomialTupleHomogenization.homog_mul
proof:
:= by
  simp only [homog, Polynomial.homogenize_mul p q hp hq, map_mul]

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.PolynomialTupleHomogenization.homog_add_degree
statement:
theorem homog_add_degree (p : R[X]) {d : ℕ} (hdegree : p.natDegree ≤ d) (e : ℕ) :
    homog p (e + d) = MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ e * homog p d
proof:
:= by
  have hmul := homog_mul (1 : R[X]) p (m := e) (n := d) (by simp) hdegree
  simpa [homog, Polynomial.homogenize_one] using hmul

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.PolynomialTupleHomogenization.homog_of_le_degree
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Nat.sub_add_cancel hdr] using homog_add_degree p hdegree (r - d)

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.PolynomialTupleHomogenization.homog_mul_padded
statement:
theorem homog_mul_padded (p q : R[X]) {m n r : ℕ}
    (hp : p.natDegree ≤ m) (hq : q.natDegree ≤ n) (hmnr : m + n ≤ r) :
    homog (p * q) r =
      MvPolynomial.X 0 ^ (r - (m + n)) * homog p m * homog q n
proof:
:= by
  rw [homog_of_le_degree (p * q) (Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le.trans (Nat.add_le_add hp hq))
    hmnr, homog_mul p q hp hq, mul_assoc]

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.PolynomialTupleHomogenization.eval₂_homog_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem eval₂_homog_of_ne_zero (p : k[X]) {d : ℕ} (hdegree : p.natDegree ≤ d)
    (φ : k →+* L) (u v : L) (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    MvPolynomial.eval₂ φ ![u, v] (homog p d) = p.eval₂ φ (v / u) * u ^ d
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval₂_homog, MvPolynomial.eval₂_eq_eval_map, ← Polynomial.homogenize_map]
  rw [Polynomial.eval_homogenize (Polynomial.natDegree_map_le.trans hdegree) _ (by simpa)]
  simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one,
    Polynomial.eval_map]

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.PolynomialTupleHomogenization.exists_eval₂_ne_zero_of_bezout
statement:
theorem exists_eval₂_ne_zero_of_bezout {N : ℕ} (Q : Fin (N + 1) → k[X])
    (hbezout : ∃ B : Fin (N + 1) → k[X], ∑ i, Q i * B i = 1)
    (φ : k →+* L) (t : L) : ∃ i, (Q i).eval₂ φ t ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra! hzero
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := hbezout
  have heval := congrArg (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom φ t) hB
  simp only [map_sum, map_mul, Polynomial.coe_eval₂RingHom, hzero, zero_mul,
    Finset.sum_const_zero, map_one] at heval
  exact zero_ne_one heval

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.PolynomialTupleHomogenization.exists_homog_eval₂_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_homog_eval₂_ne_zero {N d : ℕ} (Q : Fin (N + 1) → k[X])
    (hdegree : ∀ i, (Q i).natDegree ≤ d)
    (hbezout : ∃ B : Fin (N + 1) → k[X], ∑ i, Q i * B i = 1)
    (htop : ∃ j, (Q j).coeff d ≠ 0) (φ : k →+* L)
    (u v : L) (huv : u ≠ 0 ∨ v ≠ 0) :
    ∃ i, MvPolynomial.eval₂ φ ![u, v] (homog (Q i) d) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hu : u = 0
  · subst u
    have hv : v ≠ 0 := huv.resolve_left (not_ne_iff.mpr rfl)
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := htop
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    rw [eval₂_homog_zero]
    exact mul_ne_zero (by simpa only [map_zero] using φ.injective.ne hi) (pow_ne_zero _ hv)
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_eval₂_ne_zero_of_bezout Q hbezout φ (v / u)
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    rw [eval₂_homog_of_ne_zero _ (hdegree i) φ u v hu]
    exact mul_ne_zero hi (pow_ne_zero _ hu)

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.RuledSurfaceAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial_ι_isWeightedHomogeneous
statement:
theorem equivMvPolynomial_ι_isWeightedHomogeneous (v : M) :
    (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M v)).IsWeightedHomogeneous
      (fun _ : κ => 1) 1
proof:
:= by
  set w' : κ → ℕ := fun _ => 1 with hw'
  have hv : v ∈ Submodule.span R (Set.range b) := by rw [b.span_eq]; exact Submodule.mem_top
  have hle : Submodule.span R (Set.range b) ≤
      (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule R w' 1).comap
        ((SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b).toLinearMap ∘ₗ SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M) := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    show (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M (b i))).IsWeightedHomogeneous w' 1
    rw [SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial_ι_apply]
    exact MvPolynomial.isWeightedHomogeneous_X R w' i
  exact (MvPolynomial.mem_weightedHomogeneousSubmodule R w' 1 _).mp (hle hv)

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.RuledSurfaceAlgebra.mem_symmetricPiece_iff_isWeightedHomogeneous
statement:
theorem mem_symmetricPiece_iff_isWeightedHomogeneous (m : ℕ) (a : SymmetricAlgebra R M) :
    a ∈ symmetricPiece R M m ↔
      (SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b a).IsWeightedHomogeneous (fun _ : κ => 1) m
proof:
:= by
  set w' : κ → ℕ := fun _ => 1 with hw'
  set e := SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b with he
  constructor
  · intro ha
    change a ∈ (LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M)) ^ m at ha
    induction ha using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
    | algebraMap r =>
      rw [AlgEquiv.commutes, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
      exact MvPolynomial.isWeightedHomogeneous_C w' r
    | add x y n _ _ ihx ihy =>
      rw [map_add]; exact ihx.add ihy
    | mem_mul x hx n y _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hx
      rw [map_mul]
      have := (equivMvPolynomial_ι_isWeightedHomogeneous b v).mul ih
      rwa [add_comm] at this
  · intro ha
    suffices key : ∀ (p : MvPolynomial κ R), p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w' m →
        e.symm p ∈ symmetricPiece R M m by
      have := key (e a) ha
      rwa [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at this
    intro p hp
    induction hp using MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous.induction_on with
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    | add p q _ _ ihp ihq => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ ihp ihq
    | monomial d c hd =>
      rw [MvPolynomial.monomial_eq, map_mul, ← MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq, AlgEquiv.commutes,
        ← Algebra.smul_def]
      refine Submodule.smul_mem _ c ?_
      rw [Finsupp.prod, map_prod]
      simp only [map_pow]
      have hd' : m = ∑ p ∈ d.support, d p • w' p := by
        rw [← hd, Finsupp.weight_apply, Finsupp.sum]
      rw [hd']
      refine SetLike.prod_pow_mem_graded (symmetricPiece R M) w'
        (fun p => e.symm (MvPolynomial.X p)) (fun p => d p) ?_
      intro i _
      rw [he, SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial_symm_X]
      exact symmetric_ι_mem R M (b i)

name: Polynomial.coeff_prod_X_comp_sum_X
statement:
theorem Polynomial.coeff_prod_X_comp_sum_X {d : ℕ} (P : Polynomial ℚ) (hP : P.natDegree ≤ d) :
    MvPolynomial.coeff (∑ i : Fin d, Finsupp.single i 1)
        (Polynomial.aeval (∑ i : Fin d, MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℚ) P)
      = (Nat.factorial d : ℚ) * P.coeff d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let m : Fin d →₀ ℕ := ∑ i : Fin d, Finsupp.single i 1
  have hm_apply (i : Fin d) : m i = 1 := by simp [m]
  have hm_support : m.support = Finset.univ := by
    ext i
    simp [Finsupp.mem_support_iff, hm_apply i]
  have hm_sum : m.sum (fun _ n => n) = d := by
    rw [Finsupp.sum, hm_support]
    simp [hm_apply]
  have hm_sum_id : m.sum (fun _ => id) = d := by
    rw [Finsupp.sum, hm_support]
    simp [hm_apply]
  have hm_mult : m.multinomial = Nat.factorial d := by
    rw [Finsupp.multinomial, hm_sum_id, Finsupp.prod, hm_support]
    simp [hm_apply]
  change MvPolynomial.coeff m
      (Polynomial.aeval (∑ i : Fin d, MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℚ) P) = _
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, Polynomial.eval₂_eq_sum]
  rw [Polynomial.sum, MvPolynomial.coeff_sum]
  simp only [MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq, MvPolynomial.coeff_C_mul,
    MvPolynomial.coeff_sum_X_pow_of_fintype, hm_sum, hm_mult]
  by_cases hd : P.coeff d = 0
  · simp [hd]
  · simp [Polynomial.mem_support_iff, hd, mul_comm]

name: ProjBundleFiberDegreeOne.killLast_X_castSucc
statement: theorem killLast_X_castSucc (j : Fin (m + 1)) : killLast K m (X j.castSucc) = X j
proof:
:= by
  simp [killLast]

name: ProjBundleFiberDegreeOne.killLast_X_last
statement: theorem killLast_X_last : killLast K m (X (Fin.last (m + 1))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [killLast]

name: ProjBundleFiberDegreeOne.killLast_includeVars
statement:
theorem killLast_includeVars (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (m + 1)) K) :
    killLast K m (includeVars K m p) = p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [killLast, includeVars, aeval_rename]
  have : (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => MvPolynomial (Fin (m + 1)) K) X 0 ∘ Fin.castSucc) = X := by
    funext j; simp
  rw [this]; exact aeval_X_left_apply p

name: ProjBundleFiberDegreeOne.killLast_surjective
statement: theorem killLast_surjective : Function.Surjective (killLast K m)
proof:
:=
  fun p => ⟨includeVars K m p, killLast_includeVars K m p⟩

name: ProjBundleFiberDegreeOne.includeVars_mem
proof:
:= by
  change p.IsHomogeneous n at hp
  exact hp.rename_isHomogeneous

name: ProjBundleFiberDegreeOne.killLast_mem
proof:
:= by
  change p.IsHomogeneous n at hp
  change MvPolynomial.IsHomogeneous (aeval (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => MvPolynomial (Fin (m + 1)) K) X 0) p) n
  have h := hp.aeval (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => MvPolynomial (Fin (m + 1)) K) X 0) (n := 1) fun i => by
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · simp only [Fin.snoc_last]; exact isHomogeneous_zero _ _ _
    · simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]; exact isHomogeneous_X K j
  simpa only [one_mul] using h

name: ProjBundleFiberDegreeOne.hyperplaneGradedHom_apply
statement:
theorem hyperplaneGradedHom_apply (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (m + 2)) K) :
    hyperplaneGradedHom K m p = killLast K m p
proof: := rfl

name: ProjBundleFiberDegreeOne.hyperplaneGradedHom_X_castSucc
statement:
theorem hyperplaneGradedHom_X_castSucc (j : Fin (m + 1)) :
    hyperplaneGradedHom K m (X j.castSucc) = X j
proof: := killLast_X_castSucc K m j

name: ProjBundleFiberDegreeOne.hyperplaneGradedHom_X_last
statement: theorem hyperplaneGradedHom_X_last : hyperplaneGradedHom K m (X (Fin.last (m + 1))) = 0
proof:
:=
  killLast_X_last K m

name: ProjBundleFiberDegreeOne.hyperplaneGradedHom_surjective_degree
statement:
theorem hyperplaneGradedHom_surjective_degree :
    ∀ n, 0 < n → ∀ y ∈ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.projectiveGrading K m n,
      ∃ x ∈ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.projectiveGrading K (m + 1) n, hyperplaneGradedHom K m x = y
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ y hy => ⟨includeVars K m y, includeVars_mem K m hy, killLast_includeVars K m y⟩

name: ProjBundleFiberDegreeOne.irrelevant_le_map_hyperplaneGradedHom
statement:
theorem irrelevant_le_map_hyperplaneGradedHom :
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.projectiveGrading K m)₊ ≤ (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.projectiveGrading K (m + 1))₊.map (hyperplaneGradedHom K m)
proof:
:= by
  apply (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le _).mpr
  intro n hn p hp
  change p ∈ Ideal.map (hyperplaneGradedHom K m).toRingHom
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.projectiveGrading K (m + 1))).toIdeal
  rw [← killLast_includeVars K m p]
  exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _
    (HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem _ hn (includeVars_mem K m hp))

name: ProjBundleFiberDegreeOne.X_last_dvd_sub_includeVars_killLast
statement:
theorem X_last_dvd_sub_includeVars_killLast (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (m + 2)) K) :
    X (Fin.last (m + 1)) ∣ p - includeVars K m (killLast K m p)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a => simp [killLast, includeVars]
  | add p q hp hq =>
    have := dvd_add hp hq
    rw [map_add, map_add]
    convert this using 1; ring
  | mul_X p i hp =>
    have h2 : X (Fin.last (m + 1)) ∣ X i - includeVars K m (killLast K m (X i)) := by
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · rw [killLast_X_last, map_zero, sub_zero]
      · rw [killLast_X_castSucc]; simp [includeVars]
    rw [map_mul, map_mul]
    have : p * X i - includeVars K m (killLast K m p) * includeVars K m (killLast K m (X i)) =
        (p - includeVars K m (killLast K m p)) * X i +
          includeVars K m (killLast K m p) * (X i - includeVars K m (killLast K m (X i))) := by ring
    rw [this]
    exact dvd_add (hp.mul_right _) (dvd_mul_of_dvd_right h2 _)

name: ProjBundleFiberDegreeOne.X_last_dvd_of_killLast_eq_zero
statement:
theorem X_last_dvd_of_killLast_eq_zero {p : MvPolynomial (Fin (m + 2)) K} (hp : killLast K m p = 0) :
    X (Fin.last (m + 1)) ∣ p
proof:
:= by
  have := X_last_dvd_sub_includeVars_killLast K m p
  rwa [hp, map_zero, sub_zero] at this

name: ProjBundleFiberDegreeOne.exists_homogeneous_eq_X_last_mul
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨p.divMonomial (Finsupp.single (Fin.last (m + 1)) 1), ?_, ?_⟩
  · change p.IsHomogeneous n at hp
    intro d hd
    rw [coeff_divMonomial] at hd
    have := hp hd
    rw [map_add, Finsupp.weight_single, Pi.one_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at this
    omega
  · have h0 := X_dvd_iff_modMonomial_eq_zero.mp hdvd
    have := divMonomial_add_modMonomial_single p (Fin.last (m + 1))
    rw [h0, add_zero] at this
    exact this.symm

name: ProjBundleFiberDegreeOne.X_mem_one
statement: theorem X_mem_one (i : Fin (m + 2)) : X i ∈ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.projectiveGrading K (m + 1) 1
proof:
:=
  isHomogeneous_X K i

name: ProjBundleFiberDegreeOne.awayMap_coordFraction
statement:
theorem awayMap_coordFraction (i : Fin (m + 2)) :
    Away.map (hyperplaneGradedHom K m) (X i) (coordFraction K m i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordFraction, Away.map_mk]
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [Away.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero, hyperplaneGradedHom_X_last]
  exact Localization.mk_zero _

name: ProjBundleFiberDegreeOne.ker_awayMap_eq
statement:
theorem ker_awayMap_eq (i : Fin (m + 2)) :
    RingHom.ker (Away.map (hyperplaneGradedHom K m) (X i)) = Ideal.span {coordFraction K m i}
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨n, a, ha, rfl⟩ := Away.mk_surjective _ (X_mem_one K m i) z
    rw [RingHom.mem_ker, Away.map_mk] at hz
    have hz' := congrArg HomogeneousLocalization.val hz
    rw [Away.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero, Localization.mk_eq_mk',
      IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff] at hz'
    obtain ⟨⟨c, k, rfl⟩, hc⟩ := hz'
    simp only at hc
    
    have hker : killLast K m (X i ^ (k + 1) * a) = 0 := by
      rw [map_mul, map_pow, pow_succ, mul_assoc, mul_comm (killLast K m (X i)), ← mul_assoc]
      simp only [hyperplaneGradedHom_apply] at hc
      rw [hc, zero_mul]
    have hmem : X i ^ (k + 1) * a ∈ AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.projectiveGrading K (m + 1) (n + (k + 1)) := by
      have h1 := SetLike.mul_mem_graded (SetLike.pow_mem_graded (k + 1) (X_mem_one K m i)) ha
      have e : (k + 1) • 1 + n • 1 = n + (k + 1) := by simp [add_comm]
      rw [e] at h1
      exact h1
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hEq⟩ := exists_homogeneous_eq_X_last_mul K m hmem (X_last_dvd_of_killLast_eq_zero K m hker)
    have e : n + (k + 1) - 1 = n + k := by omega
    rw [e] at hq
    refine Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr ⟨Away.mk _ (X_mem_one K m i) (n + k) q (by simpa using hq), ?_⟩
    apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
    rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, coordFraction, Away.val_mk, Away.val_mk, Away.val_mk,
      Localization.mk_mul, Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff]
    apply Localization.r_of_eq
    change X i ^ 1 * X i ^ (n + k) * a = X i ^ n * (X (Fin.last (m + 1)) * q)
    rw [← hEq]; ring
  · rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact awayMap_coordFraction K m i

name: Finset.map_prod_add_of_map_mul_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem Finset.map_prod_add_of_map_mul_mul_eq_zero {R M : Type*} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M]
    {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (hs : s.Nonempty) (φ : R →+ M) (H : R) (a : ι → R)
    (ha : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j → ∀ y : R, φ (a i * a j * y) = 0) :
    φ (∏ j ∈ s, (H + a j)) = φ (H ^ s.card) + ∑ j ∈ s, φ (H ^ (s.card - 1) * a j)
proof:
:= by
  clear hs
  revert φ H a ha
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      intro φ H a ha
      simp
  | @insert x t hx ih =>
      intro φ H a ha
      have ha_t : ∀ i ∈ t, ∀ j ∈ t, i ≠ j → ∀ y : R, φ (a i * a j * y) = 0 := by
        intro i hi j hj hij y
        exact ha i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj) hij y
      let ψH : R →+ M :=
        { toFun := fun y => φ (H * y)
          map_zero' := by simp
          map_add' := by
            intro y z
            rw [mul_add, φ.map_add] }
      let ψa : R →+ M :=
        { toFun := fun y => φ (a x * y)
          map_zero' := by simp
          map_add' := by
            intro y z
            rw [mul_add, φ.map_add] }
      have haH : ∀ i ∈ t, ∀ j ∈ t, i ≠ j → ∀ y : R,
          ψH (a i * a j * y) = 0 := by
        intro i hi j hj hij y
        dsimp [ψH]
        simpa [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using
          ha i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj) hij (H * y)
      have haa : ∀ i ∈ t, ∀ j ∈ t, i ≠ j → ∀ y : R,
          ψa (a i * a j * y) = 0 := by
        intro i hi j hj hij y
        dsimp [ψa]
        simpa [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using
          ha i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj) hij (a x * y)
      have hH := ih ψH H a haH
      have hA := ih ψa H a haa
      have hcross : ∀ j ∈ t, ψa (H ^ (t.card - 1) * a j) = 0 := by
        intro j hj
        dsimp [ψa]
        simpa [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm] using
          ha x (Finset.mem_insert_self x t) j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj) (by
            intro h
            subst h
            exact hx hj) (H ^ (t.card - 1))
      rw [Finset.prod_insert hx]
      rw [add_mul, φ.map_add]
      rw [show φ (H * ∏ j ∈ t, (H + a j)) = ψH (∏ j ∈ t, (H + a j)) by rfl]
      rw [show φ (a x * ∏ j ∈ t, (H + a j)) = ψa (∏ j ∈ t, (H + a j)) by rfl]
      rw [hH, hA]
      simp only [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hx]
      simp only [Finset.sum_insert hx]
      have hcardexp : t.card + 1 - 1 = t.card := by omega
      have hpowH : ψH (H ^ t.card) = φ (H ^ (t.card + 1)) := by
        dsimp [ψH]
        rw [pow_succ']
      have hpowA : ψa (H ^ t.card) = φ (H ^ t.card * a x) := by
        dsimp [ψa]
        rw [mul_comm]
      have hsumH : (∑ j ∈ t, ψH (H ^ (t.card - 1) * a j)) =
          ∑ j ∈ t, φ (H ^ t.card * a j) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        dsimp [ψH]
        have hjcard : 0 < t.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨j, hj⟩
        rw [← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ' H (t.card - 1), Nat.sub_add_cancel hjcard]
      have hsumA : (∑ j ∈ t, ψa (H ^ (t.card - 1) * a j)) = 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro j hj
        exact hcross j hj
      rw [hpowH, hpowA, hsumH, hsumA, hcardexp]
      abel

name: SymmetricAlgebra.ModuleSplitting.exists_generator
statement:
theorem exists_generator (hbij : Function.Bijective (algebraMap R C))
    (hev : Function.Bijective fun n : N => φ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M (D.s n))) :
    ∃ l : N, φ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M (D.s l)) = 1 ∧ ∀ n : N, ∃ r : R, n = r • l
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl₀⟩ := hev.2 1
  have hl : φ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M (D.s l)) = 1 := hl₀
  refine ⟨l, hl, fun n => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hbij.2 (φ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M (D.s n)))
  refine ⟨r, hev.1 ?_⟩
  show φ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M (D.s n)) = φ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M (D.s (r • l)))
  rw [LinearMap.map_smul, LinearMap.map_smul, map_smul, hl, Algebra.smul_def, mul_one, hr]

name: SymmetricAlgebra.ModuleSplitting.eq_zero_of_mem_symmetricPiece_of_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_symmetricPiece_of_eq_zero (hbij : Function.Bijective (algebraMap R C))
    (hev : Function.Bijective fun n : N => φ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M (D.s n)))
    {k : ℕ} {b : SymmetricAlgebra R N} (hb : b ∈ MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.RuledSurfaceAlgebra.symmetricPiece R N k)
    (h : φ (D.ofPolyCoeff b) = 0) : b = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, hgen⟩ := exists_generator D φ hbij hev
  have hform : ∃ c : R, b = algebraMap R _ c * (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R N l) ^ k := by
    clear h
    change b ∈ (LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R N)) ^ k at hb
    induction hb using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
    | algebraMap r => exact ⟨r, by rw [pow_zero, mul_one]⟩
    | add x y i _ _ hx hy =>
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨c', rfl⟩ := hy
      exact ⟨c + c', by rw [map_add, add_mul]⟩
    | mem_mul m hm i x _ hx =>
      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hm
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hgen m
      refine ⟨r * c, ?_⟩
      rw [LinearMap.map_smul, map_mul, pow_succ, Algebra.smul_def]
      ring
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hform
  have hE : φ (D.ofPolyCoeff (algebraMap R _ c * (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R N l) ^ k)) = algebraMap R C c := by
    rw [map_mul, map_pow, AlgHom.commutes, ofPolyCoeff_ι, map_mul, map_pow, AlgHom.commutes, hl, one_pow, mul_one]
  rw [hE] at h
  have hc : c = 0 := hbij.1 (h.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  rw [hc, map_zero, zero_mul]

name: SymmetricAlgebra.ModuleSplitting.mem_span_ι_T_of_mem_symmetricPiece_of_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mem_span_ι_T_of_mem_symmetricPiece_of_eq_zero (hbij : Function.Bijective (algebraMap R C))
    (hev : Function.Bijective fun n : N => φ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M (D.s n)))
    (hT : φ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M D.T) = 0)
    {k : ℕ} {a : SymmetricAlgebra R M} (ha : a ∈ MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.RuledSurfaceAlgebra.symmetricPiece R M k)
    (h : φ a = 0) : a ∈ Ideal.span {SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M D.T}
proof:
:= by
  set p := D.toPoly a with hp
  have hhom : IsHomogPoly k p := D.toPoly_mem_of_mem_symmetricPiece ha
  have ha' : D.ofPoly p = a :=
    congrArg (fun F : SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R M => F a) D.ofPoly_toPoly
  have hφ : φ (D.ofPoly p) = φ (D.ofPolyCoeff (p.coeff 0)) := by
    rw [ofPoly_apply]
    have h1 := Polynomial.hom_eval₂ p (D.ofPolyCoeff : SymmetricAlgebra R N →+* SymmetricAlgebra R M)
      (φ : SymmetricAlgebra R M →+* C) (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M D.T)
    have h2 : (φ : SymmetricAlgebra R M →+* C) (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M D.T) = 0 := hT
    rw [h2, Polynomial.eval₂_at_zero] at h1
    exact h1
  have h0 : p.coeff 0 = 0 :=
    D.eq_zero_of_mem_symmetricPiece_of_eq_zero φ hbij hev (hhom 0).1 (by rw [← hφ, ha']; exact h)
  have hpX : p = Polynomial.X * p.divX := by
    have := Polynomial.X_mul_divX_add p
    rw [h0, map_zero, add_zero] at this
    exact this.symm
  rw [← ha', hpX, map_mul, ofPoly_X]
  exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr (Dvd.intro _ rfl)

name: SymmetricAlgebra.ModuleSplitting.exists_ι_s_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_ι_s_eq_one (hev : Function.Bijective fun n : N => φ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M (D.s n))) :
    ∃ n : N, φ (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M (D.s n)) = 1

name: MvPolynomial.HomogeneousAwayX.X_mem
statement:
lemma X_mem :
    (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ R) ∈ MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule σ R 1
proof:
:=
  MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_X R i

name: MvPolynomial.HomogeneousAwayX.dehomogenize_X_self
statement: @[simp] lemma dehomogenize_X_self : dehomogenize R i (MvPolynomial.X i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [dehomogenize]

name: MvPolynomial.HomogeneousAwayX.dehomogenize_X_of_ne
statement:
lemma dehomogenize_X_of_ne {j : σ} (h : j ≠ i) :
    dehomogenize R i (MvPolynomial.X j) = MvPolynomial.X ⟨j, h⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [dehomogenize, h]

name: MvPolynomial.HomogeneousAwayX.dehomogenize_C
statement:
@[simp] lemma dehomogenize_C (c : R) :
    dehomogenize R i (MvPolynomial.C c) = MvPolynomial.C c
proof:
:= by
  simp [dehomogenize, MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]

name: MvPolynomial.HomogeneousAwayX.chartToPoly_mk
statement:
lemma chartToPoly_mk (n : ℕ) (a : MvPolynomial σ R)
    (ha : a ∈ MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule σ R (n • 1)) :
    chartToPoly R i (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk _ (X_mem R i) n a ha) =
      dehomogenize R i a
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartToPoly IsLocalization.Away.lift
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply,
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_eq_mk'_apply, IsLocalization.lift_mk'_spec]
  simp

name: MvPolynomial.HomogeneousAwayX.mk_X_pow_zero
statement:
lemma mk_X_pow_zero (x : MvPolynomial σ R)
    (h : MvPolynomial.X i ^ 0 ∈ Submonoid.powers (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ R)) :
    Localization.mk x ⟨MvPolynomial.X i ^ 0, h⟩ =
      algebraMap _ (Localization.Away (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ R)) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap]
  congr 1

name: MvPolynomial.HomogeneousAwayX.mk_X_pow_one
statement:
lemma mk_X_pow_one (x : MvPolynomial σ R)
    (h : MvPolynomial.X i ^ 1 ∈ Submonoid.powers (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ R)) :
    Localization.mk x ⟨MvPolynomial.X i ^ 1, h⟩ =
      Localization.mk x ⟨MvPolynomial.X i, Submonoid.mem_powers _⟩
proof:
:= by
  congr 1
  exact Subtype.ext (pow_one _)

name: MvPolynomial.HomogeneousAwayX.polyToChart_X
statement:
lemma polyToChart_X (j : {j : σ // j ≠ i}) :
    polyToChart R i (MvPolynomial.X j) =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk _ (X_mem R i) 1 (MvPolynomial.X j.1)
        (by simpa using MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_X R j.1)
proof:
:=
  MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X' _ _ _

name: MvPolynomial.HomogeneousAwayX.polyToChart_C
statement:
lemma polyToChart_C (c : R) :
    polyToChart R i (MvPolynomial.C c) =
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule σ R 0) _
        (algebraMap R (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule σ R 0) c)
proof:
:=
  MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C _ _ _

name: MvPolynomial.HomogeneousAwayX.algebraMap_zero_eq_mk
statement:
lemma algebraMap_zero_eq_mk (z : MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule σ R 0) :
    algebraMap (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule σ R 0)
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule σ R) (MvPolynomial.X i)) z =
      HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk _ (X_mem R i) 0 z.1 (by simpa using z.2)
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, mk_X_pow_zero, ← Localization.mk_one_eq_algebraMap]
  rfl

name: MvPolynomial.HomogeneousAwayX.chartToPoly_comp_polyToChart
statement:
lemma chartToPoly_comp_polyToChart :
    (chartToPoly R i).comp (polyToChart R i) = RingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro c
    rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply, polyToChart_C, algebraMap_zero_eq_mk, chartToPoly_mk]
    simp [MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
  · intro j
    rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply, polyToChart_X, chartToPoly_mk,
      dehomogenize_X_of_ne R i j.2]

name: MvPolynomial.HomogeneousAwayX.val_polyToChart_dehomogenize
statement:
lemma val_polyToChart_dehomogenize (p : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    (polyToChart R i (dehomogenize R i p)).val = awayScale R i p
proof:
:= by
  have h : (algebraMap _ (Localization.Away (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ R))).comp
      ((polyToChart R i).comp (dehomogenize R i).toRingHom) = (awayScale R i).toRingHom := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro c
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, dehomogenize_C,
        polyToChart_C, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply, algebraMap_zero_eq_mk,
        HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, awayScale, MvPolynomial.aeval_C, mk_X_pow_zero]
      simp [MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq,
        IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (MvPolynomial σ R)
          (Localization.Away (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ R))]
    · intro j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst hj
        simp [awayScale]
      · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
          dehomogenize_X_of_ne R i hj, polyToChart_X, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply,
          HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, awayScale, MvPolynomial.aeval_X, mk_X_pow_one]
  exact RingHom.congr_fun h p

name: MvPolynomial.HomogeneousAwayX.awayScale_monomial
statement:
lemma awayScale_monomial (α : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : R) :
    awayScale R i (MvPolynomial.monomial α c) =
      Localization.mk (MvPolynomial.monomial α c)
        ⟨MvPolynomial.X i ^ α.degree, Submonoid.pow_mem _ (Submonoid.mem_powers _) _⟩
proof:
:= by
  induction α using Finsupp.induction with
  | zero =>
    simp only [map_zero]
    rw [mk_X_pow_zero]
    simp [awayScale, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply R (MvPolynomial σ R)
        (Localization.Away (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ R)),
      MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]
  | single_add a b f _ _ ih =>
    rw [MvPolynomial.monomial_single_add, map_mul, map_pow, ih]
    simp only [awayScale, MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
    rw [Localization.mk_pow, Localization.mk_mul]
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext (by simp [pow_add])

name: MvPolynomial.HomogeneousAwayX.awayScale_of_isHomogeneous
statement:
lemma awayScale_of_isHomogeneous {p : MvPolynomial σ R} {n : ℕ} (hp : p.IsHomogeneous n) :
    awayScale R i p =
      Localization.mk p ⟨MvPolynomial.X i ^ n, Submonoid.pow_mem _ (Submonoid.mem_powers _) _⟩
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [p.as_sum]
  conv_rhs => rw [p.as_sum]
  rw [map_sum, Localization.mk_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun α hα => ?_
  have hd : α.degree = n := by
    rw [Finsupp.degree_eq_weight_one]
    exact hp (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hα)
  subst hd
  exact awayScale_monomial R i α _

name: MvPolynomial.HomogeneousAwayX.polyToChart_comp_chartToPoly
statement:
lemma polyToChart_comp_chartToPoly :
    (polyToChart R i).comp (chartToPoly R i) = RingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  refine RingHom.ext fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨n, a, ha, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective _ (X_mem R i) x
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply, chartToPoly_mk]
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [val_polyToChart_dehomogenize, HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk,
    awayScale_of_isHomogeneous R i (n := n)
      ((MvPolynomial.mem_homogeneousSubmodule _ _).mp (by simpa using ha))]

name: WeightedSym.directSumBasis_apply
statement:
theorem directSumBasis_apply (q : ι) (i : κ q) :
    directSumBasis b ⟨q, i⟩ = DirectSum.lof R ι W q (b q i)
proof:
:= by
  show (DFinsupp.basis b) ⟨q, i⟩ = DirectSum.lof R ι W q (b q i)
  rw [DFinsupp.basis, Module.Basis.coe_ofRepr]
  simp only [LinearEquiv.trans_symm, LinearEquiv.symm_symm, LinearEquiv.trans_apply]
  rw [DirectSum.lof_eq_of]
  show (DFinsupp.mapRange.linearEquiv fun i => (b i).repr).symm
      (sigmaFinsuppLequivDFinsupp R (Finsupp.single ⟨q, i⟩ 1)) = DFinsupp.single q (b q i)
  rw [DFinsupp.mapRange.linearEquiv_symm]
  show DFinsupp.mapRange (fun i => (b i).repr.symm) (fun i => map_zero _)
      (sigmaFinsuppEquivDFinsupp (Finsupp.single ⟨q, i⟩ 1)) = DFinsupp.single q (b q i)
  rw [sigmaFinsuppEquivDFinsupp_single, DFinsupp.mapRange_single, Module.Basis.repr_symm_single_one]

name: WeightedSym.equivMvPolynomial_gen_basis
statement:
theorem equivMvPolynomial_gen_basis (q : ι) (i : κ q) :
    equivMvPolynomial b (gen R W q (b q i)) = MvPolynomial.X ⟨q, i⟩
proof:
:= by
  show equivMvPolynomial b (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R (⨁ p, W p) (DirectSum.lof R ι W q (b q i))) = _
  rw [← directSumBasis_apply b q i]
  exact SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial_ι_apply (directSumBasis b) ⟨q, i⟩

name: WeightedSym.equivMvPolynomial_symm_X
statement:
theorem equivMvPolynomial_symm_X (q : ι) (i : κ q) :
    (equivMvPolynomial b).symm (MvPolynomial.X ⟨q, i⟩) = gen R W q (b q i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← equivMvPolynomial_gen_basis b q i, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: WeightedSym.mem_piece_iff_isWeightedHomogeneous
statement:
theorem mem_piece_iff_isWeightedHomogeneous (w : ι → ℕ) (m : ℕ) (a : SymmetricAlgebra R (⨁ q, W q)) :
    a ∈ piece R W w m ↔
      (equivMvPolynomial b a).IsWeightedHomogeneous (fun p : Σ q, κ q => w p.1) m
proof:
:= by
  set w' : (Σ q, κ q) → ℕ := fun p => w p.1 with hw'
  set e := equivMvPolynomial b with he
  constructor
  · 
    intro ha
    let Q : ℕ → Submodule R (SymmetricAlgebra R (⨁ q, W q)) := fun n =>
      (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule R w' n).comap e.toLinearMap
    have hQ : ∀ n x, x ∈ Q n ↔ (e x).IsWeightedHomogeneous w' n := fun n x =>
      MvPolynomial.mem_weightedHomogeneousSubmodule R w' n (e x)
    have h1 : (1 : SymmetricAlgebra R (⨁ q, W q)) ∈ Q 0 := by
      rw [hQ, map_one]; exact MvPolynomial.isWeightedHomogeneous_one R w'
    have hmul : ∀ i j, Q i * Q j ≤ Q (i + j) := fun i j =>
      Submodule.mul_le.mpr fun x hx y hy => by
        rw [hQ] at hx hy ⊢; rw [map_mul]; exact hx.mul hy
    have hgen : ∀ q, genSpan R W q ≤ Q (w q) := by
      intro q
      have hspan : genSpan R W q = Submodule.span R (Set.range fun i : κ q => gen R W q (b q i)) := by
        rw [genSpan, LinearMap.range_eq_map, ← (b q).span_eq, Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
        rfl
      rw [hspan, Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      show gen R W q (b q i) ∈ Q (w q)
      rw [hQ, equivMvPolynomial_gen_basis]
      exact MvPolynomial.isWeightedHomogeneous_X R w' ⟨q, i⟩
    exact (hQ m a).mp (piece_le_of_gen h1 hmul hgen m ha)
  · 
    intro ha
    suffices key : ∀ (p : MvPolynomial (Σ q, κ q) R), p.IsWeightedHomogeneous w' m →
        e.symm p ∈ piece R W w m by
      have := key (e a) ha
      rwa [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at this
    intro p hp
    induction hp using MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous.induction_on with
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    | add p q _ _ ihp ihq => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ ihp ihq
    | monomial d c hd =>
      rw [MvPolynomial.monomial_eq, map_mul, ← MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq, AlgEquiv.commutes,
        ← Algebra.smul_def]
      refine Submodule.smul_mem _ c ?_
      rw [Finsupp.prod, map_prod]
      simp only [map_pow]
      have hd' : m = ∑ p ∈ d.support, d p • w p.1 := by
        rw [← hd, Finsupp.weight_apply, Finsupp.sum]
      rw [hd']
      refine SetLike.prod_pow_mem_graded (piece R W w) (fun p : Σ q, κ q => w p.1)
        (fun p => e.symm (MvPolynomial.X p)) (fun p => d p) ?_
      rintro ⟨q, i⟩ -
      rw [equivMvPolynomial_symm_X]
      exact gen_mem_piece w q (b q i)

name: MvPolynomial.module_finite_integralClosure_of_finiteType_isDomain
statement:
theorem MvPolynomial.module_finite_integralClosure_of_finiteType_isDomain
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (hk : Field.PolynomialRingsN2 k) (d : ℕ)
    (D : Type u) [CommRing D] [IsDomain D] [Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) D]
    [FaithfulSMul (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) D] [Algebra.FiniteType (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) D] :
    Module.Finite (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) ↥(integralClosure (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) D)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P := MvPolynomial (Fin d) k with hPdef
  let K := FractionRing D
  have hDK : Function.Injective (algebraMap D K) := IsFractionRing.injective D K
  have hPD : Function.Injective (algebraMap P D) := FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective P D
  haveI : FaithfulSMul P K := by
    rw [faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq P D K]
    exact hDK.comp hPD
  letI := FractionRing.liftAlgebra P K
  haveI := FractionRing.isScalarTower_liftAlgebra P K
  let F := FractionRing P
  
  let T : Subalgebra F K := Algebra.adjoin F (Set.range (algebraMap D K))
  have hT : Algebra.FiniteType F ↥T := by
    rw [← Subalgebra.fg_iff_finiteType]
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Algebra.FiniteType.out (R := P) (A := D)
    refine ⟨s.image (algebraMap D K), ?_⟩
    apply le_antisymm
    · refine Algebra.adjoin_mono ?_
      intro y hy
      rw [Finset.coe_image] at hy
      obtain ⟨x, _, rfl⟩ := hy
      exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
    · apply Algebra.adjoin_le
      rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
      have hx : x ∈ Algebra.adjoin P (s : Set D) := by rw [hs]; trivial
      have : algebraMap D K x ∈ (Algebra.adjoin P (s : Set D)).map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom P D K) :=
        ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      rw [AlgHom.map_adjoin] at this
      have hle : Algebra.adjoin P ((IsScalarTower.toAlgHom P D K) '' (s : Set D)) ≤
          (Algebra.adjoin F ((s.image (algebraMap D K) : Finset K) : Set K)).restrictScalars P := by
        apply Algebra.adjoin_le
        intro y hy
        rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Subalgebra.mem_restrictScalars]
        apply Algebra.subset_adjoin
        rw [Finset.coe_image]
        exact hy
      exact hle this
  
  let G : Subalgebra F K := integralClosure F K ⊓ T
  haveI hGalg : Algebra.IsAlgebraic F ↥G := by
    rw [← Subalgebra.isAlgebraic_iff]
    intro x hx
    exact (show IsIntegral F x from hx.1).isAlgebraic
  let G' : IntermediateField F K := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.toIntermediateField G
  have hG'T : G'.toSubalgebra ≤ T := inf_le_right
  haveI : Module.Finite F ↥G' :=
    finite_of_algHom_finiteType_of_isJacobsonRing (Subalgebra.inclusion hG'T)
  haveI : Module.Finite P ↥(integralClosure P ↥G') := hk d F ↥G'
  
  let ψ : ↥(integralClosure P D) →ₗ[P] ↥(integralClosure P ↥G') :=
    { toFun := fun x =>
        ⟨⟨algebraMap D K x.1, ⟨((x.2 : IsIntegral P x.1).map
            (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom P D K)).tower_top, Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨x.1, rfl⟩⟩⟩,
          (IntermediateField.coe_isIntegral_iff (R := P)).mp
            ((x.2 : IsIntegral P x.1).map (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom P D K))⟩
      map_add' := fun x y => Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext (map_add (algebraMap D K) x.1 y.1))
      map_smul' := fun a x =>
        Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext (map_smul (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom P D K) a x.1)) }
  have hψ : Function.Injective ψ := by
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro x hx
    have h1 := congrArg (fun z => ((z : ↥(integralClosure P ↥G')) : ↥G').1) hx
    simp only [ψ] at h1
    ext
    exact hDK (by simpa using h1)
  exact Module.Finite.of_injective ψ hψ

name: Algebra.module_finite_integralClosure_of_finiteType_isDomain
statement:
theorem Algebra.module_finite_integralClosure_of_finiteType_isDomain
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (hk : Field.PolynomialRingsN2 k)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra.FiniteType k A]
    (D : Type u) [CommRing D] [IsDomain D] [Algebra A D] [Algebra.FiniteType A D] :
    Module.Finite A ↥(integralClosure A D)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing A := Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing k A
  
  let f : A →+* D := algebraMap A D
  let A' := A ⧸ RingHom.ker f
  haveI : (RingHom.ker f).IsPrime := RingHom.ker_isPrime f
  haveI : IsDomain A' := Ideal.Quotient.isDomain _
  let f' : A' →+* D := RingHom.kerLift f
  have hf' : Function.Injective f' := RingHom.kerLift_injective f
  letI : Algebra A' D := f'.toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower A A' D := .of_algebraMap_eq fun a => (RingHom.kerLift_mk f a).symm
  haveI : Algebra.FiniteType A' D := Algebra.FiniteType.of_restrictScalars_finiteType A A' D
  
  obtain ⟨d, g, hinj, hgfin⟩ := exists_finite_inj_algHom_of_fg k A'
  have hgfin' : (g.toRingHom).Finite := hgfin
  have hinj' : Function.Injective (g.toRingHom) := hinj
  algebraize [g.toRingHom, f'.comp g.toRingHom]
  haveI : FaithfulSMul (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) D :=
    (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective _ D).mpr (hf'.comp hinj')
  haveI : Algebra.FiniteType (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) D :=
    Algebra.FiniteType.trans (Module.Finite.finiteType A' (R := MvPolynomial (Fin d) k)) inferInstance
  have h3 : Module.Finite (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k)
      ↥(integralClosure (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) D) :=
    MvPolynomial.module_finite_integralClosure_of_finiteType_isDomain k hk d D
  
  have h2 : Module.Finite A' ↥(integralClosure A' D) := by
    have hmod : Module.Finite (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) ↥(integralClosure A' D) := by
      refine Module.Finite.of_surjective
        ({ toFun := fun x =>
              (⟨x.1, (show IsIntegral (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) x.1 from x.2).tower_top⟩ :
                ↥(integralClosure A' D))
           map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
           map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl } :
          ↥(integralClosure (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) D) →ₗ[MvPolynomial (Fin d) k]
            ↥(integralClosure A' D)) ?_
      rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
      exact ⟨⟨x, isIntegral_trans x hx⟩, rfl⟩
    exact Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) A' _
  
  haveI : Module.Finite A ↥(integralClosure A' D) := Module.Finite.trans A' _
  refine Module.Finite.of_injective
    ({ toFun := fun x =>
        (⟨x.1, (show IsIntegral A x.1 from x.2).tower_top⟩ : ↥(integralClosure A' D))
       map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl
       map_smul' := fun _ _ => rfl } :
      ↥(integralClosure A D) →ₗ[A] ↥(integralClosure A' D)) ?_
  intro x y h
  ext
  exact congrArg (fun z : ↥(integralClosure A' D) => z.1) h

name: Algebra.finite_integralClosure_of_finiteType_over_field_of_polynomialRingsN2
statement:
theorem Algebra.finite_integralClosure_of_finiteType_over_field_of_polynomialRingsN2
    {k A C : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A]
    [CommRing C] [Algebra k A] [Algebra A C] [Algebra.FiniteType k A] [Algebra.FiniteType A C]
    [IsReduced C] (hk : Field.PolynomialRingsN2 k) : Module.Finite A (integralClosure A C)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing A := Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing k A
  letI : Algebra k C := ((algebraMap A C).comp (algebraMap k A)).toAlgebra
  haveI : IsScalarTower k A C := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
  haveI : Algebra.FiniteType k C := Algebra.FiniteType.trans ‹Algebra.FiniteType k A› ‹_›
  haveI : IsNoetherianRing C := Algebra.FiniteType.isNoetherianRing k C
  haveI : Finite (minimalPrimes C) := (minimalPrimes.finite_of_isNoetherianRing C).to_subtype
  haveI : ∀ q : minimalPrimes C, (q.1).IsPrime := fun q => q.2.1.1
  haveI : ∀ q : minimalPrimes C, IsDomain (C ⧸ q.1) := fun q => Ideal.Quotient.isDomain _
  haveI : ∀ q : minimalPrimes C, Module.Finite A ↥(integralClosure A (C ⧸ q.1)) := fun q =>
    Algebra.module_finite_integralClosure_of_finiteType_isDomain k hk A (C ⧸ q.1)
  let Φ : ↥(integralClosure A C) →ₗ[A] ∀ q : minimalPrimes C, ↥(integralClosure A (C ⧸ q.1)) :=
    { toFun := fun x q => ⟨Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ A q.1 x.1,
        (show IsIntegral A x.1 from x.2).map (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ A q.1)⟩
      map_add' := fun x y => by funext q; ext; simp
      map_smul' := fun a x => by funext q; ext; simp }
  have hΦ : Function.Injective Φ := by
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro x hx
    ext
    have h1 : ∀ q : minimalPrimes C, x.1 ∈ q.1 := fun q => by
      have := congrArg Subtype.val (congrFun hx q)
      simpa [Φ, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem] using this
    have h2 : x.1 ∈ nilradical C := by
      rw [show nilradical C = sInf (minimalPrimes C) from
        (Ideal.sInf_minimalPrimes (I := (⊥ : Ideal C))).symm, Ideal.mem_sInf]
      intro q hq
      exact h1 ⟨q, hq⟩
    rw [nilradical_eq_zero] at h2
    simpa using h2
  exact Module.Finite.of_injective Φ hΦ

name: Algebra.finite_integralClosure_of_finiteType_over_field
statement:
theorem Algebra.finite_integralClosure_of_finiteType_over_field {k A C : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A]
    [CommRing C] [Algebra k A] [Algebra A C] [Algebra.FiniteType k A] [Algebra.FiniteType A C]
    [IsReduced C] : Module.Finite A (integralClosure A C)
proof:
:=
  Algebra.finite_integralClosure_of_finiteType_over_field_of_polynomialRingsN2
    (Field.polynomialRingsN2 k)

name: Algebra.finite_integralClosure_of_finiteType_over_field_of_charZero
statement:
theorem Algebra.finite_integralClosure_of_finiteType_over_field_of_charZero
    {k A C : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k] [CommRing A]
    [CommRing C] [Algebra k A] [Algebra A C] [Algebra.FiniteType k A] [Algebra.FiniteType A C]
    [IsReduced C] : Module.Finite A (integralClosure A C)
proof:
:=
  Algebra.finite_integralClosure_of_finiteType_over_field_of_polynomialRingsN2
    (Field.polynomialRingsN2_of_charZero k)

name: GradedAlgebra.monomialPiece_apply
statement: theorem monomialPiece_apply (i : ι) (z : 𝒜 i) : monomialPiece 𝒜 ψ M i z = ψ z * M i
proof: := rfl

name: GradedAlgebra.monomialHom_of_mem
statement:
theorem monomialHom_of_mem {i : ι} {z : A} (hz : z ∈ 𝒜 i) :
    monomialHom 𝒜 ψ M hM0 hMadd z = ψ z * M i
proof:
:= by
  unfold monomialHom
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply]
  have h : (DirectSum.decomposeRingEquiv 𝒜).toRingHom z = DirectSum.of (fun i => ↥(𝒜 i)) i ⟨z, hz⟩ :=
    DirectSum.decompose_of_mem 𝒜 hz
  rw [h, DirectSum.toSemiring_of]
  rfl

name: IsLocalizedModule.directSum
statement:
theorem IsLocalizedModule.directSum {R : Type u} [CommSemiring R] (S : Submonoid R)
    {ι : Type v} [DecidableEq ι] {M N : ι → Type w}
    [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (M i)] [∀ i, Module R (M i)]
    [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (N i)] [∀ i, Module R (N i)]
    (f : ∀ i, M i →ₗ[R] N i) [∀ i, IsLocalizedModule S (f i)] :
    IsLocalizedModule S (DirectSum.lmap f) where
  map_units s
proof:
:= by
    have hu : ∀ i, IsUnit (algebraMap R (Module.End R (N i)) (s : R)) :=
      fun i => IsLocalizedModule.map_units (f i) s
    set g : ∀ i, N i →ₗ[R] N i := fun i => (↑(hu i).unit⁻¹ : Module.End R (N i)) with hgdef
