      herbrand φ ψ = ((Module.length R M).toNat : ℤ) - ((Module.length R N).toNat : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : Module.length R (H φ ψ) ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top hM (length_H_le φ ψ)
  have h1 : Module.length R (H ψ φ) ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top hN (length_H_le ψ φ)
  refine ⟨⟨h0, h1⟩, ?_⟩
  have e := congrArg ENat.toNat (length_add_length_H φ ψ hφψ hψφ)
  rw [ENat.toNat_add hM h1, ENat.toNat_add hN h0] at e
  unfold herbrand
  omega

name: PeriodicComplex.herbrand_eq_zero_of_length_ne_top
statement:
theorem herbrand_eq_zero_of_length_ne_top (φ ψ : M →ₗ[R] M) (hφψ : φ ∘ₗ ψ = 0)
    (hψφ : ψ ∘ₗ φ = 0) (hM : Module.length R M ≠ ⊤) :
    FiniteCohomology φ ψ ∧ herbrand φ ψ = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, e⟩ := herbrand_eq_of_length_ne_top φ ψ hφψ hψφ hM hM
  exact ⟨h, by rw [e, sub_self]⟩

name: PeriodicComplex.length_H_zero_left
statement:
theorem length_H_zero_left (ψ : N →ₗ[R] M) :
    Module.length R (H (0 : M →ₗ[R] N) ψ) = Module.length R (M ⧸ LinearMap.range ψ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [length_H, LinearMap.ker_zero, relLength_top]

name: PeriodicComplex.length_H_zero_right
statement:
theorem length_H_zero_right (ψ : N →ₗ[R] M) :
    Module.length R (H ψ (0 : M →ₗ[R] N)) = Module.length R (LinearMap.ker ψ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [length_H, LinearMap.range_zero, relLength_bot]

name: PeriodicComplex.herbrand_zero_left
statement:
theorem herbrand_zero_left (ψ : N →ₗ[R] M) :
    herbrand (0 : M →ₗ[R] N) ψ = ((Module.length R (M ⧸ LinearMap.range ψ)).toNat : ℤ) -
      ((Module.length R (LinearMap.ker ψ)).toNat : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold herbrand
  rw [length_H_zero_left, length_H_zero_right]

name: PeriodicComplex.finiteCohomology_zero_left_iff
statement:
theorem finiteCohomology_zero_left_iff (ψ : N →ₗ[R] M) :
    FiniteCohomology (0 : M →ₗ[R] N) ψ ↔
      Module.length R (M ⧸ LinearMap.range ψ) ≠ ⊤ ∧ Module.length R (LinearMap.ker ψ) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  unfold FiniteCohomology
  rw [length_H_zero_left, length_H_zero_right]

name: PeriodicComplex.ShortExact.of_submodule
statement:
theorem ShortExact.of_submodule (φ : M →ₗ[R] N) (ψ : N →ₗ[R] M) (hφψ : φ ∘ₗ ψ = 0)
    (hψφ : ψ ∘ₗ φ = 0) (P : Submodule R M) (Q : Submodule R N)
    (hφ : P ≤ Q.comap φ) (hψ : Q ≤ P.comap ψ) :
    ShortExact (φ.restrict hφ) (ψ.restrict hψ) φ ψ (P.mapQ Q φ hφ) (Q.mapQ P ψ hψ)
      P.subtype Q.subtype P.mkQ Q.mkQ where
  i_inj
proof:
:= Submodule.subtype_injective _
  j_inj := Submodule.subtype_injective _
  p_surj := Submodule.mkQ_surjective _
  q_surj := Submodule.mkQ_surjective _
  exact_M := LinearMap.exact_subtype_mkQ P
  exact_N := LinearMap.exact_subtype_mkQ Q
  comm_φi := rfl
  comm_ψj := rfl
  comm_φp := rfl
  comm_ψq := rfl
  φψ := hφψ
  ψφ := hψφ

name: PeriodicComplex.ker_le_comap_of_comm
statement:
theorem ker_le_comap_of_comm (hφ : g ∘ₗ φ = φ' ∘ₗ f) :
    LinearMap.ker f ≤ (LinearMap.ker g).comap φ
proof:
:= fun x hx => by
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  have e : g (φ x) = φ' (f x) := LinearMap.congr_fun hφ x
  rw [e, LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hx, map_zero]

name: PeriodicComplex.range_le_comap_of_comm
statement:
theorem range_le_comap_of_comm (hφ : g ∘ₗ φ = φ' ∘ₗ f) :
    LinearMap.range f ≤ (LinearMap.range g).comap φ'
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨φ x, LinearMap.congr_fun hφ x⟩

name: PeriodicComplex.ShortExact.of_ker_range
statement:
theorem ShortExact.of_ker_range (hφψ : φ ∘ₗ ψ = 0) (hψφ : ψ ∘ₗ φ = 0)
    (hφ : g ∘ₗ φ = φ' ∘ₗ f) (hψ : f ∘ₗ ψ = ψ' ∘ₗ g) :
    ShortExact (φ.restrict (ker_le_comap_of_comm φ φ' f g hφ))
      (ψ.restrict (ker_le_comap_of_comm ψ ψ' g f hψ)) φ ψ
      (φ'.restrict (range_le_comap_of_comm φ φ' f g hφ))
      (ψ'.restrict (range_le_comap_of_comm ψ ψ' g f hψ))
      (LinearMap.ker f).subtype (LinearMap.ker g).subtype f.rangeRestrict g.rangeRestrict where
  i_inj
proof:
:= Submodule.subtype_injective _
  j_inj := Submodule.subtype_injective _
  p_surj := f.surjective_rangeRestrict
  q_surj := g.surjective_rangeRestrict
  exact_M := by rw [LinearMap.exact_iff, LinearMap.ker_rangeRestrict, Submodule.range_subtype]
  exact_N := by rw [LinearMap.exact_iff, LinearMap.ker_rangeRestrict, Submodule.range_subtype]
  comm_φi := rfl
  comm_ψj := rfl
  comm_φp := by
    ext x
    exact (LinearMap.congr_fun hφ x).symm
  comm_ψq := by
    ext x
    exact (LinearMap.congr_fun hψ x).symm
  φψ := hφψ
  ψφ := hψφ

name: PeriodicComplex.herbrand_of_map
statement:
theorem herbrand_of_map (hφψ : φ ∘ₗ ψ = 0) (hψφ : ψ ∘ₗ φ = 0) (hφψ' : φ' ∘ₗ ψ' = 0)
    (hψφ' : ψ' ∘ₗ φ' = 0) (hφ : g ∘ₗ φ = φ' ∘ₗ f) (hψ : f ∘ₗ ψ = ψ' ∘ₗ g)
    (hKf : Module.length R (LinearMap.ker f) ≠ ⊤) (hKg : Module.length R (LinearMap.ker g) ≠ ⊤)
    (hCf : Module.length R (M' ⧸ LinearMap.range f) ≠ ⊤)
    (hCg : Module.length R (N' ⧸ LinearMap.range g) ≠ ⊤) :
    (FiniteCohomology φ ψ ↔ FiniteCohomology φ' ψ') ∧
      (FiniteCohomology φ ψ → herbrand φ' ψ' = herbrand φ ψ -
        (((Module.length R (LinearMap.ker f)).toNat : ℤ) - (Module.length R (LinearMap.ker g)).toNat) +
        (((Module.length R (M' ⧸ LinearMap.range f)).toNat : ℤ) -
          (Module.length R (N' ⧸ LinearMap.range g)).toNat))
proof:
:= by
  have S1 := ShortExact.of_ker_range φ ψ φ' ψ' f g hφψ hψφ hφ hψ
  have S2 := ShortExact.of_submodule φ' ψ' hφψ' hψφ' (LinearMap.range f) (LinearMap.range g)
    (range_le_comap_of_comm φ φ' f g hφ) (range_le_comap_of_comm ψ ψ' g f hψ)
  obtain ⟨hK, eK⟩ := herbrand_eq_of_length_ne_top
    (φ.restrict (ker_le_comap_of_comm φ φ' f g hφ)) (ψ.restrict (ker_le_comap_of_comm ψ ψ' g f hψ))
    (by ext x; exact LinearMap.congr_fun hφψ x) (by ext x; exact LinearMap.congr_fun hψφ x) hKf hKg
  obtain ⟨hC, eC⟩ := herbrand_eq_of_length_ne_top
    ((LinearMap.range f).mapQ (LinearMap.range g) φ' (range_le_comap_of_comm φ φ' f g hφ))
    ((LinearMap.range g).mapQ (LinearMap.range f) ψ' (range_le_comap_of_comm ψ ψ' g f hψ))
    (by
      apply Submodule.linearMap_qext
      ext x
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.mapQ_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply]
      have e : φ' (ψ' x) = 0 := LinearMap.congr_fun hφψ' x
      rw [e, Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero])
    (by
      apply Submodule.linearMap_qext
      ext x
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.mapQ_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply]
      have e : ψ' (φ' x) = 0 := LinearMap.congr_fun hψφ' x
      rw [e, Submodule.Quotient.mk_zero]) hCf hCg
  refine ⟨⟨fun h => S2.finite₂ (S1.finite₃ hK h) hC, fun h => S1.finite₂ hK (S2.finite₁ h hC)⟩,
    fun h => ?_⟩
  have hI := S1.finite₃ hK h
  have e1 := S1.herbrand_add hK hI
  have e2 := S2.herbrand_add hI hC
  rw [e2, eC, e1, eK]
  ring

name: PeriodicComplex.herbrand_eq_of_map
statement:
theorem herbrand_eq_of_map (φ ψ : M →ₗ[R] M) (φ' ψ' : M' →ₗ[R] M') (f : M →ₗ[R] M')
    (hφψ : φ ∘ₗ ψ = 0) (hψφ : ψ ∘ₗ φ = 0) (hφψ' : φ' ∘ₗ ψ' = 0)
    (hψφ' : ψ' ∘ₗ φ' = 0) (hφ : f ∘ₗ φ = φ' ∘ₗ f) (hψ : f ∘ₗ ψ = ψ' ∘ₗ f)
    (hKf : Module.length R (LinearMap.ker f) ≠ ⊤)
    (hCf : Module.length R (M' ⧸ LinearMap.range f) ≠ ⊤) :
    (FiniteCohomology φ ψ ↔ FiniteCohomology φ' ψ') ∧
      (FiniteCohomology φ ψ → herbrand φ' ψ' = herbrand φ ψ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := herbrand_of_map φ ψ φ' ψ' f f hφψ hψφ hφψ' hψφ' hφ hψ hKf hKf hCf hCf
  refine ⟨h1, fun h => ?_⟩
  rw [h2 h]; ring

name: Module.inertiaLengthSum_eq_add_of_exact
statement:
theorem inertiaLengthSum_eq_add_of_exact {N M P : Type u} [AddCommGroup N] [Module B N]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [AddCommGroup P] [Module B P] (f : N →ₗ[B] M) (g : M →ₗ[B] P)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hg : Function.Surjective g) (hex : Function.Exact f g) :
    inertiaLengthSum A B M = inertiaLengthSum A B N + inertiaLengthSum A B P
proof:
:= by
  unfold inertiaLengthSum
  rw [← finsum_add_distrib (Set.toFinite _) (Set.toFinite _)]
  refine finsum_congr fun m => ?_
  rw [length_localizedModule_eq_add_of_exact m.asIdeal.primeCompl f g hf hg hex, mul_add]

name: Module.inertiaLengthSum_congr
statement:
theorem inertiaLengthSum_congr {M P : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M] [AddCommGroup P]
    [Module B P] (e : M ≃ₗ[B] P) : inertiaLengthSum A B M = inertiaLengthSum A B P
proof:
:= by
  unfold inertiaLengthSum
  refine finsum_congr fun m => ?_
  rw [length_localizedModule_congr m.asIdeal.primeCompl e]

name: Module.inertiaLengthSum_quotient
statement:
theorem inertiaLengthSum_quotient (I : Ideal B) [hI : I.IsMaximal] :
    inertiaLengthSum A B (B ⧸ I) =
      ((Ideal.inertiaDeg' (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) I : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  unfold inertiaLengthSum
  rw [finsum_eq_single _ (⟨I, hI⟩ : MaximalSpectrum B)]
  · have := length_localizedModule_quotient_self I
    rw [this, mul_one]
  · intro m hm
    have hne : I ≠ m.asIdeal := fun h => hm (by ext1; exact h.symm)
    have : m.asIdeal.IsMaximal := m.isMaximal
    rw [length_localizedModule_quotient_of_ne I m.asIdeal hne, mul_zero]

name: Module.length_quotient_eq_inertiaDeg
statement:
theorem length_quotient_eq_inertiaDeg (I : Ideal B) [hI : I.IsMaximal]
    [hlo : I.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)]
    (hfin : Ideal.inertiaDeg' (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) I ≠ 0) :
    Module.length A (B ⧸ I) =
      ((Ideal.inertiaDeg' (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) I : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.inertiaDeg'_algebraMap] at hfin ⊢
  let _ : Field (A ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) := Ideal.Quotient.field _
  have hfd : Module.Finite (A ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) (B ⧸ I) :=
    Module.finite_of_finrank_pos (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hfin)
  rw [Module.length_eq_of_surjective (S := A) (R := A ⧸ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (M := B ⧸ I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective, Module.length_eq_finrank]

name: Module.length_eq_inertiaLengthSum
statement:
theorem length_eq_inertiaLengthSum {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module B M]
    (hB : ∀ m : MaximalSpectrum B, m.asIdeal.LiesOver (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A))
    (hfin : ∀ m : MaximalSpectrum B, Ideal.inertiaDeg' (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) m.asIdeal ≠ 0)
    (hM : IsFiniteLength B M) :
    ∀ [Module A M] [IsScalarTower A B M], Module.length A M = inertiaLengthSum A B M
proof:
:= by
  induction hM with
  | @of_subsingleton M _ _ _ =>
    intro _ _
    rw [Module.length_eq_zero]
    unfold inertiaLengthSum
    symm
    refine finsum_eq_zero_of_forall_eq_zero fun m => ?_
    have h0 : Module.length B M = 0 := Module.length_eq_zero
    have : Module.length (Localization.AtPrime m.asIdeal)
        (LocalizedModule m.asIdeal.primeCompl M) = 0 :=
      le_antisymm ((length_localizedModule_le _).trans h0.le) (by simp)
    rw [this, mul_zero]
  | @of_simple_quotient M _ _ N hs _ ih =>
    intro _ _
    have hex : Function.Exact N.subtype N.mkQ := LinearMap.exact_subtype_mkQ N
    rw [Module.length_eq_add_of_exact (N.subtype.restrictScalars A) (N.mkQ.restrictScalars A)
      (Submodule.subtype_injective N) (Submodule.mkQ_surjective N) hex,
      inertiaLengthSum_eq_add_of_exact N.subtype N.mkQ (Submodule.subtype_injective N)
        (Submodule.mkQ_surjective N) hex, ih]
    congr 1
    obtain ⟨I, hI, ⟨e⟩⟩ := isSimpleModule_iff_quot_maximal.mp hs
    have := hB ⟨I, hI⟩
    rw [(e.restrictScalars A).length_eq, inertiaLengthSum_congr e, inertiaLengthSum_quotient,
      length_quotient_eq_inertiaDeg I (hfin ⟨I, hI⟩)]

name: IsLocalRing.exists_maximalIdeal_pow_le_of_length_ne_top
statement:
theorem IsLocalRing.exists_maximalIdeal_pow_le_of_length_ne_top {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (J : Ideal A) (h : Module.length A (A ⧸ J) ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A ^ n ≤ J
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hJ : J = ⊤
  · exact ⟨0, by simp [hJ]⟩
  have hfl : IsFiniteLength A (A ⧸ J) := Module.length_ne_top_iff.mp h
  obtain ⟨-, hart⟩ := isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp hfl
  have : IsArtinianRing (A ⧸ J) := isArtinian_of_tower A hart
  have : Nontrivial (A ⧸ J) := Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr hJ
  have : IsLocalRing (A ⧸ J) :=
    IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := IsArtinianRing.isNilpotent_jacobson_bot (R := A ⧸ J)
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  rw [IsLocalRing.jacobson_eq_maximalIdeal ⊥ bot_ne_top,
    ← IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk J) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective,
    ← Ideal.map_pow, Ideal.zero_eq_bot, Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_le_ker, Ideal.mk_ker] at hn
  exact hn

name: MiyaokaMori.CoherentDevissage.exists_ne_zero_maximalIdeal_smul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_ne_zero_maximalIdeal_smul_eq_zero {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Nontrivial M] [IsArtinian R M] :
    ∃ m : M, m ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R, a • m = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : IsAtomic (Submodule R M) :=
    isAtomic_of_orderBot_wellFounded_lt (wellFounded_lt (α := Submodule R M))
  have : Nontrivial (Submodule R M) := ⟨⟨⊥, ⊤, bot_ne_top⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := IsAtomic.exists_atom (α := Submodule R M)
  have hsimple : IsSimpleModule R S := isSimpleModule_iff_isAtom.mpr hS
  have hmax : (Module.annihilator R S).IsMaximal := IsSimpleModule.annihilator_isMaximal
  have hann : Module.annihilator R S = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hmax
  obtain ⟨m, hmS, hm0⟩ := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff S).mp hS.1
  refine ⟨m, hm0, fun a ha => ?_⟩
  have ha' : a ∈ Module.annihilator R S := hann ▸ ha
  have := Module.mem_annihilator.mp ha' ⟨m, hmS⟩
  exact congrArg Subtype.val this

name: MiyaokaMori.CoherentDevissage.exists_injective_linearMap_of_length_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_injective_linearMap_of_length_eq_one {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    {G M : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] [Module R G] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (hlen : Module.length R G = 1) [Nontrivial M] (hM : Module.length R M ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ f : G →ₗ[R] M, Function.Injective f
proof:
:= by
  have hsimple : IsSimpleModule R G := Module.length_eq_one_iff.mp hlen
  have hfl : IsFiniteLength R M := Module.length_ne_top_iff.mp hM
  have hart : IsArtinian R M := (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian.mp hfl).2
  obtain ⟨m, hm0, hmkill⟩ := exists_ne_zero_maximalIdeal_smul_eq_zero (R := R) (M := M)
  have : Nontrivial G := IsSimpleModule.nontrivial R G
  obtain ⟨g, hg0⟩ := exists_ne (0 : G)
  
  set φg : R →ₗ[R] G := LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R G g with hφg
  set φm : R →ₗ[R] M := LinearMap.toSpanSingleton R M m with hφm
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective φg := IsSimpleModule.toSpanSingleton_surjective R hg0
  have hkerg : LinearMap.ker φg = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R :=
    IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal (IsSimpleModule.ker_toSpanSingleton_isMaximal R hg0)
  have hkerm : LinearMap.ker φm = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R := by
    symm
    apply (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal R).eq_of_le
    · intro htop
      have h1 : (1 : R) ∈ LinearMap.ker φm := by rw [htop]; trivial
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, hφm, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply, one_smul] at h1
      exact hm0 h1
    · intro a ha
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, hφm, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply]
      exact hmkill a ha
  have hker : LinearMap.ker φg = LinearMap.ker φm := hkerg.trans hkerm.symm
  let e : (R ⧸ LinearMap.ker φg) ≃ₗ[R] G := LinearMap.quotKerEquivOfSurjective φg hsurj
  let ψ : (R ⧸ LinearMap.ker φg) →ₗ[R] M := (LinearMap.ker φg).liftQ φm (le_of_eq hker)
  have hψ : Function.Injective ψ := by
    rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot]
    exact Submodule.ker_liftQ_eq_bot' _ φm hker
  exact ⟨ψ ∘ₗ e.symm.toLinearMap, hψ.comp e.symm.injective⟩

name: Module.length_ne_top_of_forall_exists_smul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem Module.length_ne_top_of_forall_exists_smul_eq_zero {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] (N : Type u) [AddCommGroup N] [Module A N] [Module.Finite A N]
    (h : ∀ q : Ideal A, q.IsPrime → q ≠ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A → ∀ m : N, ∃ s : A, s ∉ q ∧ s • m = 0) :
    Module.length A N ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set I : Ideal A := Module.annihilator A N with hI
  let : Module (A ⧸ I) N := Module.quotientAnnihilator
  have : IsScalarTower A (A ⧸ I) N := Module.IsTorsionBySet.isScalarTower _
  
  
  have hdim : Ring.KrullDimLE 0 (A ⧸ I) := by
    rw [Ring.krullDimLE_zero_iff]
    intro J hJ
    have hP : (J.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).IsPrime := Ideal.comap_isPrime _ J
    have hIP : I ≤ J.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) := by
      intro x hx
      show Ideal.Quotient.mk I x ∈ J
      rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hx]
      exact J.zero_mem
    have hPm : J.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A := by
      by_contra hne
      have hmem : (⟨_, hP⟩ : PrimeSpectrum A) ∈ Module.support A N :=
        Module.mem_support_iff_of_finite.mpr hIP
      have hnot : (⟨_, hP⟩ : PrimeSpectrum A) ∉ Module.support A N :=
        Module.notMem_support_iff'.mpr (h _ hP hne)
      exact hnot hmem
    have hmax : (J.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).IsMaximal := by
      rw [hPm]; exact IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal A
    rcases Ideal.map_eq_top_or_isMaximal_of_surjective (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)
        Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective hmax with htop | hmax'
    · rw [Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective] at htop
      exact absurd htop hJ.ne_top
    · rwa [Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective] at hmax'
  
  have : IsArtinianRing (A ⧸ I) := IsNoetherianRing.isArtinianRing_of_krullDimLE_zero
  have : Module.Finite (A ⧸ I) N := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite A (A ⧸ I) N
  have : IsArtinian (A ⧸ I) N := inferInstance
  
  have : IsArtinian A N :=
    ((Module.isTorsionBySet_annihilator A N).semilinearMap.isArtinian_iff_of_bijective
      Function.bijective_id).mpr this
  have : IsNoetherian A N := inferInstance
  exact Module.length_ne_top

name: PeriodicComplex.relLength_eq_zero_of_le
statement: theorem relLength_eq_zero_of_le {A B : Submodule R M} (h : B ≤ A) : relLength A B = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold relLength
  rw [Submodule.submoduleOf_eq_top.mpr h]
  exact Module.length_eq_zero

name: PeriodicComplex.relLength_anti_left
statement:
theorem relLength_anti_left {A A' : Submodule R M} (h : A ≤ A') (B : Submodule R M) :
    relLength A' B ≤ relLength A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [← relLength_congr_inf A, ← relLength_congr_inf A',
    relLength_add (inf_le_inf_right B h) inf_le_right]
  exact le_add_self

name: PeriodicComplex.Powers.ker_mono
statement: theorem ker_mono {i j : ℕ} (h : i ≤ j) : LinearMap.ker (t ^ i) ≤ LinearMap.ker (t ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le h
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hx ⊢
  rw [add_comm, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, hx, map_zero]

name: PeriodicComplex.Powers.ker_inf_range
statement:
theorem ker_inf_range (i j m : ℕ) (hm : m = i + j) :
    LinearMap.ker (t ^ i) ⊓ LinearMap.range (t ^ j) = (LinearMap.ker (t ^ m)).map (t ^ j)
proof:
:= by
  subst hm
  ext x
  simp only [Submodule.mem_inf, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.mem_range, Submodule.mem_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, y, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨y, by rw [pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply, hx], rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨by rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_add, hy], y, rfl⟩

name: PeriodicComplex.Powers.exists_A
statement:
theorem exists_A (i k j : ℕ) :
    ∃ s : ℕ∞, A t (i + k) j = A t k j + s ∧ A t i (j + k) = s + A t i k
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨relLength (LinearMap.ker (t ^ i) ⊓ LinearMap.range (t ^ (j + k)))
    (LinearMap.ker (t ^ i) ⊓ LinearMap.range (t ^ k)), ?_, ?_⟩
  · set X := LinearMap.range (t ^ j) ⊓ LinearMap.ker (t ^ (i + k)) with hX
    have hk : LinearMap.ker (t ^ k) ≤ LinearMap.ker (t ^ (i + k)) := ker_mono t (Nat.le_add_left k i)
    unfold A
    rw [← relLength_congr_inf, ← hX,
      relLength_add (le_sup_left : X ≤ X ⊔ LinearMap.ker (t ^ k)) (sup_le inf_le_right hk)]
    congr 1
    · rw [relLength_sup_left, ← relLength_congr_inf, hX, inf_assoc, inf_eq_right.mpr hk,
        relLength_congr_inf]
    · rw [← relLength_map (t ^ k) (sup_le inf_le_right hk) (inf_le_of_left_le le_sup_right),
        Submodule.map_sup, ← ker_inf_range t i k (i + k) rfl]
      congr 1
      have e1 : (LinearMap.ker (t ^ k)).map (t ^ k) = ⊥ :=
        eq_bot_iff.mpr (by
          rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
          exact (Submodule.mem_bot R).mpr (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hy))
      rw [e1, sup_bot_eq, inf_comm (LinearMap.range (t ^ j)), ker_inf_range t (i + k) j (i + k + j) rfl,
        ← Submodule.map_comp, ker_inf_range t i (j + k) (i + k + j) (by ring)]
      congr 1
      rw [← Module.End.mul_eq_comp, ← pow_add, add_comm]
  · unfold A
    rw [← relLength_congr_inf (LinearMap.range (t ^ (j + k))),
      ← relLength_congr_inf (LinearMap.range (t ^ k)),
      inf_comm (LinearMap.range (t ^ (j + k))) (LinearMap.ker (t ^ i)),
      inf_comm (LinearMap.range (t ^ k)) (LinearMap.ker (t ^ i))]
    refine relLength_add (inf_le_inf_left _ ?_) inf_le_left
    rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(t ^ j) y, by rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_add, add_comm]⟩

name: PeriodicComplex.Powers.A_zero_left
statement: theorem A_zero_left (j : ℕ) : A t 0 j = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold A
  refine relLength_eq_zero_of_le ?_
  rw [pow_zero]
  intro x hx
  have : x = 0 := hx
  rw [this]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: PeriodicComplex.Powers.A_zero_right
statement: theorem A_zero_right (i : ℕ) : A t i 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold A
  refine relLength_eq_zero_of_le ?_
  rw [pow_zero]
  intro x _
  exact ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: PeriodicComplex.Powers.A_one_comm
statement: theorem A_one_comm (i : ℕ) : A t i 1 = A t 1 i
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => rw [A_zero_left, A_zero_right]
  | succ i ih =>
    obtain ⟨s, h1, h2⟩ := exists_A t 1 i 1
    rw [add_comm 1 i] at h1 h2
    rw [h1, h2, ih, add_comm]

name: PeriodicComplex.Powers.A_one_le
statement: theorem A_one_le (n j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ n) : A t 1 j ≤ A t 1 n
proof:
:= by
  unfold A
  refine relLength_anti_left ?_ _
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hj
  rintro _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨(t ^ k) y, by rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_add]⟩

name: PeriodicComplex.Powers.step
statement:
theorem step (n : ℕ) (hfin : A t 1 (n - 1) ≠ ⊤) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n) (hai : A t i (n - i) ≠ ⊤) :
    A t (i + 1) (n - (i + 1)) ≠ ⊤ ∧
      ((A t (i + 1) (n - (i + 1))).toNat : ℤ) - (A t i (n - i)).toNat =
        ((A t 1 (n - 1 - i)).toNat : ℤ) - (A t 1 i).toNat
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, h1, h2⟩ := exists_A t i 1 (n - (i + 1))
  have e : n - (i + 1) + 1 = n - i := by omega
  rw [e, A_one_comm] at h2
  have hc : A t 1 (n - (i + 1)) ≠ ⊤ :=
    ne_top_of_le_ne_top hfin (A_one_le t (n - 1) _ (by omega))
  have hs : s ≠ ⊤ := fun hs => hai (by rw [h2, hs, top_add])
  have hb : A t 1 i ≠ ⊤ := fun hb => hai (by rw [h2, hb, add_top])
  refine ⟨by rw [h1]; exact WithTop.add_ne_top.mpr ⟨hc, hs⟩, ?_⟩
  have e' : n - 1 - i = n - (i + 1) := by omega
  rw [h1, h2, e', ENat.toNat_add hc hs, ENat.toNat_add hs hb]
  push_cast
  ring

name: PeriodicComplex.Powers.finite_and_diff
statement:
theorem finite_and_diff (n : ℕ) (hfin : A t 1 (n - 1) ≠ ⊤) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n) :
    A t i (n - i) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => rw [A_zero_left]; exact ENat.zero_ne_top
  | succ i ih => exact (step n hfin i (by omega) (ih (by omega))).1

name: PeriodicComplex.Powers.symm_aux
statement:
theorem symm_aux (n : ℕ) (hfin : A t 1 (n - 1) ≠ ⊤) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n) :
    ((A t i (n - i)).toNat : ℤ) - (A t (n - i) (n - (n - i))).toNat =
      ((A t 0 (n - 0)).toNat : ℤ) - (A t (n - 0) (n - (n - 0))).toNat
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ i ih =>
    have h1 := (step n hfin i (by omega) (finite_and_diff n hfin i (by omega))).2
    have h2 := (step n hfin (n - (i + 1)) (by omega)
      (finite_and_diff n hfin (n - (i + 1)) (by omega))).2
    have e1 : n - (i + 1) + 1 = n - i := by omega
    have e2 : n - 1 - (n - (i + 1)) = i := by omega
    have e3 : n - 1 - i = n - (i + 1) := by omega
    rw [e1, e2] at h2
    rw [e3] at h1
    have := ih (by omega)
    omega

name: PeriodicComplex.herbrand_pow_eq_zero
statement:
theorem herbrand_pow_eq_zero (t : Module.End R M) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hfin : Module.length R (H t (t ^ (n - 1))) ≠ ⊤) (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n) :
    FiniteCohomology (t ^ i) (t ^ (n - i)) ∧ herbrand (t ^ i) (t ^ (n - i)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hfin' : A t 1 (n - 1) ≠ ⊤ := by
    unfold A; rw [pow_one]; exact hfin
  have h0 : Module.length R (H (t ^ i) (t ^ (n - i))) = A t i (n - i) := rfl
  have h1 : Module.length R (H (t ^ (n - i)) (t ^ i)) = A t (n - i) (n - (n - i)) := by
    have : n - (n - i) = i := by omega
    rw [this]; rfl
  have hA0 : A t 0 (n - 0) = 0 := A_zero_left t _
  have hAn : A t (n - 0) (n - (n - 0)) = 0 := by
    have : n - (n - 0) = 0 := by omega
    rw [this]; exact A_zero_right t _
  have key := symm_aux n hfin' i hi
  rw [hA0, hAn] at key
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [h0]; exact finite_and_diff n hfin' i hi
  · rw [h1]
    have := finite_and_diff n hfin' (n - i) (by omega)
    exact this
  · unfold herbrand
    rw [h0, h1]
    simpa using key

name: Ideal.mem_reesGrading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_reesGrading_iff (n : ℕ) (f : reesAlgebra J) :
    f ∈ J.reesGrading n ↔ ∃ r ∈ J ^ n, Polynomial.monomial n r = (f : A[X])
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
    refine ⟨r, ?_, hr⟩
    have hf : (f : A[X]) ∈ reesAlgebra J := f.2
    have hr' : Polynomial.monomial n r = (f : A[X]) := hr
    rw [← hr'] at hf
    exact reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mp hf
  · rintro ⟨r, -, hr⟩
    exact ⟨r, hr⟩

name: Ideal.coe_reesX
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_reesX (a : A) (ha : a ∈ J) :
    ((J.reesX a ha : reesAlgebra J) : A[X]) = Polynomial.monomial 1 a
proof: := rfl

name: Ideal.reesX_mem
statement: theorem reesX_mem (a : A) (ha : a ∈ J) : J.reesX a ha ∈ J.reesGrading 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨a, rfl⟩

name: Ideal.algebraMap_mem_reesGrading_zero
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mem_reesGrading_zero (r : A) :
    algebraMap A (reesAlgebra J) r ∈ J.reesGrading 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨r, by simp [Polynomial.monomial_zero_left]⟩

name: Ideal.reesEvalOne_apply
statement:
theorem reesEvalOne_apply (f : reesAlgebra J) :
    J.reesEvalOne f = Polynomial.eval (1 : A) (f : A[X])
proof: := rfl

name: Ideal.reesEvalOne_reesX
statement: @[simp] theorem reesEvalOne_reesX (a : A) (ha : a ∈ J) : J.reesEvalOne (J.reesX a ha) = a
proof:
:= by
  simp [reesEvalOne_apply, Polynomial.eval_monomial]

name: Ideal.reesEvalOne_algebraMap
statement: @[simp] theorem reesEvalOne_algebraMap (r : A) : J.reesEvalOne (algebraMap A (reesAlgebra J) r) = r
proof:
:= by
  simp [reesEvalOne_apply]

name: Ideal.reesEvalOne_of_mem
statement:
theorem reesEvalOne_of_mem {n : ℕ} {f : reesAlgebra J} (hf : f ∈ J.reesGrading n) :
    Polynomial.monomial n (J.reesEvalOne f) = (f : A[X])
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, -, hr⟩ := (J.mem_reesGrading_iff n f).mp hf
  rw [reesEvalOne_apply, ← hr, Polynomial.eval_monomial, one_pow, mul_one]

name: Ideal.reesEvalOne_mem_pow
statement:
theorem reesEvalOne_mem_pow {n : ℕ} {f : reesAlgebra J} (hf : f ∈ J.reesGrading n) :
    J.reesEvalOne f ∈ J ^ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hr'⟩ := (J.mem_reesGrading_iff n f).mp hf
  rw [reesEvalOne_apply, ← hr', Polynomial.eval_monomial, one_pow, mul_one]
  exact hr

name: Ideal.coe_powersPow
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_powersPow (a : A) (n : ℕ) : ((powersPow a n : Submonoid.powers a) : A) = a ^ n
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Ideal.powersPow_zero
statement: theorem powersPow_zero (a : A) : powersPow a 0 = 1
proof: := Subtype.ext (pow_zero a)

name: Ideal.powersPow_succ
statement:
theorem powersPow_succ (a : A) (n : ℕ) :
    powersPow a (n + 1) = ⟨a, Submonoid.mem_powers a⟩ * powersPow a n
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (by simp [pow_succ'])

name: Ideal.powers_reesX_le_comap
statement:
theorem powers_reesX_le_comap :
    Submonoid.powers (J.reesX a ha) ≤ (Submonoid.powers a).comap J.reesEvalOne
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨n, by simp [map_pow]⟩

name: Ideal.reesAwayToLocalization_mk
statement:
theorem reesAwayToLocalization_mk (n : ℕ) (x : reesAlgebra J) (hx : x ∈ J.reesGrading (n • 1)) :
    J.reesAwayToLocalization a ha
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk J.reesGrading (J.reesX_mem a ha) n x hx) =
      IsLocalization.mk' (Localization.Away a) (J.reesEvalOne x) (powersPow a n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reesAwayToLocalization, RingHom.comp_apply, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply,
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_eq_mk', IsLocalization.map_mk']
  exact congrArg _ (Subtype.ext (by simp [map_pow]))

name: Ideal.reesAwayToLocalization_fromZeroRingHom
statement:
theorem reesAwayToLocalization_fromZeroRingHom (x : J.reesGrading 0) :
    J.reesAwayToLocalization a ha (HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom _ _ x) =
      algebraMap A (Localization.Away a) (J.reesEvalOne x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reesAwayToLocalization, RingHom.comp_apply, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply]
  change (IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers (J.reesX a ha)) (T := Submonoid.powers a)
      (S := Localization.Away (J.reesX a ha)) (Localization.Away a) J.reesEvalOne
      (J.powers_reesX_le_comap a ha)) (Localization.mk (x : reesAlgebra J) 1) = _
  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk', IsLocalization.map_mk', IsLocalization.mk'_eq_iff_eq_mul]
  simp

name: Ideal.mk'_mem_affineBlowup_of_mem
statement:
theorem mk'_mem_affineBlowup_of_mem (b : A) (hb : b ∈ J) :
    IsLocalization.mk' (Localization.Away a) b ⟨a, Submonoid.mem_powers a⟩ ∈ J.affineBlowup a
proof:
:= by
  refine Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨b, hb, ?_⟩
  rw [IsLocalization.mk'_eq_mul_mk'_one]
  rfl

name: Ideal.mk'_mem_affineBlowup
statement:
theorem mk'_mem_affineBlowup (n : ℕ) (b : A) (hb : b ∈ J ^ n) :
    IsLocalization.mk' (Localization.Away a) b (powersPow a n) ∈ J.affineBlowup a
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing b with
  | zero =>
    rw [powersPow_zero, IsLocalization.mk'_one]
    exact Subalgebra.algebraMap_mem _ b
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ'] at hb
    refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hb ?_ ?_
    · intro c hc d hd
      rw [powersPow_succ, IsLocalization.mk'_mul]
      exact Subalgebra.mul_mem _ (Ideal.mk'_mem_affineBlowup_of_mem J a c hc) (ih d hd)
    · intro x y hx hy
      rw [IsLocalization.mk'_eq_mul_mk'_one, map_add, add_mul, ← IsLocalization.mk'_eq_mul_mk'_one,
        ← IsLocalization.mk'_eq_mul_mk'_one]
      exact Subalgebra.add_mem _ hx hy

name: Ideal.reesAwayToLocalization_mem
statement:
theorem reesAwayToLocalization_mem (y : HomogeneousLocalization.Away J.reesGrading (J.reesX a ha)) :
    J.reesAwayToLocalization a ha y ∈ J.affineBlowup a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, x, hx, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective _ (J.reesX_mem a ha) y
  rw [reesAwayToLocalization_mk]
  have hb := J.reesEvalOne_mem_pow hx
  rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at hb
  exact Ideal.mk'_mem_affineBlowup J a n _ hb

name: Ideal.reesAwayToLocalization_injective
statement:
theorem reesAwayToLocalization_injective :
    Function.Injective (J.reesAwayToLocalization a ha)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨n, x, hx, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective _ (J.reesX_mem a ha) y
  rw [reesAwayToLocalization_mk, IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff] at hy
  obtain ⟨⟨_, k, rfl⟩, hk⟩ := hy
  change a ^ k * J.reesEvalOne x = 0 at hk
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero, Localization.mk_eq_mk',
    IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff]
  refine ⟨⟨(J.reesX a ha) ^ k, ⟨k, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  change (J.reesX a ha) ^ k * x = 0
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, Subalgebra.coe_pow, coe_reesX, ← J.reesEvalOne_of_mem hx,
    Polynomial.monomial_pow, Polynomial.monomial_mul_monomial, hk, Polynomial.monomial_zero_right,
    ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]

name: Ideal.reesAwayToLocalization_surjective
statement:
theorem reesAwayToLocalization_surjective (z : Localization.Away a) (hz : z ∈ J.affineBlowup a) :
    ∃ y, J.reesAwayToLocalization a ha y = z
proof:
:= by
  refine Algebra.adjoin_induction (p := fun z _ => ∃ y, J.reesAwayToLocalization a ha y = z)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hz
  · rintro _ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk J.reesGrading (J.reesX_mem a ha) 1 (J.reesX b hb)
      (by simpa using J.reesX_mem b hb), ?_⟩
    rw [reesAwayToLocalization_mk, reesEvalOne_reesX, IsLocalization.mk'_eq_mul_mk'_one]
    congr 1
    exact congrArg _ (Subtype.ext (pow_one a))
  · intro r
    refine ⟨HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk J.reesGrading (J.reesX_mem a ha) 0
      (algebraMap A (reesAlgebra J) r) (by simpa using J.algebraMap_mem_reesGrading_zero r), ?_⟩
    rw [reesAwayToLocalization_mk, reesEvalOne_algebraMap, powersPow_zero, IsLocalization.mk'_one]
  · rintro x y - - ⟨x', rfl⟩ ⟨y', rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x' + y', map_add _ _ _⟩
  · rintro x y - - ⟨x', rfl⟩ ⟨y', rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x' * y', map_mul _ _ _⟩

name: Ideal.coe_reesAwayToAffineBlowup
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_reesAwayToAffineBlowup (y : HomogeneousLocalization.Away J.reesGrading (J.reesX a ha)) :
    ((J.reesAwayToAffineBlowup a ha y : J.affineBlowup a) : Localization.Away a) =
      J.reesAwayToLocalization a ha y
proof: := rfl

name: Ideal.reesAwayToAffineBlowup_bijective
statement: theorem reesAwayToAffineBlowup_bijective : Function.Bijective (J.reesAwayToAffineBlowup a ha)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x y h => J.reesAwayToLocalization_injective a ha (congrArg Subtype.val h), ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := J.reesAwayToLocalization_surjective a ha z hz
  exact ⟨y, Subtype.ext hy⟩

name: Ideal.reesAwayEquivAffineBlowup_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem reesAwayEquivAffineBlowup_apply
    (y : HomogeneousLocalization.Away J.reesGrading (J.reesX a ha)) :
    J.reesAwayEquivAffineBlowup a ha y = J.reesAwayToAffineBlowup a ha y
proof: := rfl

name: Ideal.reesAwayEquivAffineBlowup_fromZeroRingHom
statement:
theorem reesAwayEquivAffineBlowup_fromZeroRingHom (r : A) :
    J.reesAwayEquivAffineBlowup a ha
        (HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom _ _
          (⟨algebraMap A (reesAlgebra J) r, J.algebraMap_mem_reesGrading_zero r⟩ : J.reesGrading 0)) =
      algebraMap A (J.affineBlowup a) r
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [reesAwayEquivAffineBlowup_apply, coe_reesAwayToAffineBlowup,
    reesAwayToLocalization_fromZeroRingHom]
  simp only [reesEvalOne_algebraMap]
  rfl

name: Ideal.reesGrading_irrelevant_le_span
statement:
theorem reesGrading_irrelevant_le_span :
    (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant J.reesGrading).toIdeal ≤
      Ideal.span (Set.range fun b : J => J.reesX b b.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal_irrelevant_le]
  intro i hi x hx
  change x ∈ J.reesGrading i at hx
  change x ∈ Ideal.span _
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, i = k + 1 := ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrx⟩ := (J.mem_reesGrading_iff (k + 1) x).mp hx
  rw [pow_succ'] at hr
  
  have key : ∀ r ∈ J * J ^ k, ∃ hy : Polynomial.monomial (k + 1) r ∈ reesAlgebra J,
      (⟨Polynomial.monomial (k + 1) r, hy⟩ : reesAlgebra J) ∈
        Ideal.span (Set.range fun b : J => J.reesX b b.2) := by
    intro r hr
    refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hr ?_ ?_
    · intro c hc d hd
      have hmem : Polynomial.monomial (k + 1) (c * d) ∈ reesAlgebra J := by
        rw [add_comm, ← Polynomial.monomial_mul_monomial]
        exact Subalgebra.mul_mem _ (reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr (by simpa using hc))
          (reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr hd)
      refine ⟨hmem, ?_⟩
      have : (⟨_, hmem⟩ : reesAlgebra J) =
          J.reesX c hc * ⟨Polynomial.monomial k d, reesAlgebra.monomial_mem.mpr hd⟩ :=
        Subtype.ext (by
          rw [Subalgebra.coe_mul, coe_reesX, Polynomial.monomial_mul_monomial]
          show Polynomial.monomial (k + 1) (c * d) = Polynomial.monomial (1 + k) (c * d)
          rw [add_comm])
      rw [this]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.subset_span ⟨⟨c, hc⟩, rfl⟩)
    · rintro r₁ r₂ ⟨h₁, m₁⟩ ⟨h₂, m₂⟩
      have hmem : Polynomial.monomial (k + 1) (r₁ + r₂) ∈ reesAlgebra J := by
        rw [map_add]; exact Subalgebra.add_mem _ h₁ h₂
      refine ⟨hmem, ?_⟩
      have : (⟨_, hmem⟩ : reesAlgebra J) = ⟨_, h₁⟩ + ⟨_, h₂⟩ :=
        Subtype.ext (by rw [Subalgebra.coe_add]; exact map_add _ _ _)
      rw [this]
      exact Ideal.add_mem _ m₁ m₂
  obtain ⟨hy, hmem⟩ := key r hr
  have hx' : x = ⟨_, hy⟩ := Subtype.ext hrx.symm
  rw [hx']
  exact hmem

name: Ideal.reesGrading_iSup_basicOpen_eq_top
statement:
theorem reesGrading_iSup_basicOpen_eq_top :
    ⨆ b : J, AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.basicOpen J.reesGrading (J.reesX b b.2) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.iSup_basicOpen_eq_top J.reesGrading _ J.reesGrading_irrelevant_le_span

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.RuledSurfaceAlgebra.symmetric_ι_mem
statement: theorem symmetric_ι_mem (m : M) : SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m ∈ symmetricPiece R M 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [symmetricPiece, pow_one] using LinearMap.mem_range_self (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M) m

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.RuledSurfaceAlgebra.symmetric_algebraMap_mem
statement:
theorem symmetric_algebraMap_mem (r : R) :
    algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R M) r ∈ symmetricPiece R M 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [symmetricPiece, pow_zero] using
    (Submodule.algebraMap_mem r : algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R M) r ∈ (1 : Submodule R _))

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.RuledSurfaceAlgebra.symmetricGradedInclusion_apply
statement:
theorem symmetricGradedInclusion_apply (m : M) :
    symmetricGradedInclusion R M m =
      DirectSum.of (fun n : ℕ ↦ ↥(symmetricPiece R M n)) 1
        ⟨SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m, symmetric_ι_mem R M m⟩
proof: := rfl

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.RuledSurfaceAlgebra.symmetricDecomposition_on_piece
statement:
theorem symmetricDecomposition_on_piece (n : ℕ) (x : symmetricPiece R M n) :
    symmetricDecomposition R M (x : SymmetricAlgebra R M) =
      DirectSum.of (fun n : ℕ ↦ ↥(symmetricPiece R M n)) n x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
  change x ∈ (LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M)) ^ n at hx
  dsimp only [Subtype.coe_mk, DirectSum.lof_eq_of]
  induction hx using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
  | algebraMap r =>
    rw [AlgHom.commutes, DirectSum.algebraMap_apply]
    rfl
  | add x y n hx hy ihx ihy =>
    rw [map_add, ihx, ihy, ← map_add]
    rfl
  | mem_mul m hm n x hx ih =>
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hm
    rw [map_mul, ih, symmetricDecomposition, SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply,
      symmetricGradedInclusion_apply, DirectSum.of_mul_of]
    exact DirectSum.of_eq_of_gradedMonoid_eq (Sigma.subtype_ext (add_comm _ _) rfl)

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.RuledSurfaceAlgebra.symmetricDecomposition_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symmetricDecomposition_ι (m : M) :
    symmetricDecomposition R M (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m) =
      DirectSum.of (fun n : ℕ ↦ ↥(symmetricPiece R M n)) 1
        ⟨SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M m, symmetric_ι_mem R M m⟩
proof:
:=
  symmetricDecomposition_on_piece R M 1 ⟨_, symmetric_ι_mem R M m⟩

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.RuledSurfaceAlgebra.symmetricDecomposition_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symmetricDecomposition_algebraMap (r : R) :
    symmetricDecomposition R M (algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R M) r) =
      DirectSum.of (fun n : ℕ ↦ ↥(symmetricPiece R M n)) 0
        ⟨algebraMap R (SymmetricAlgebra R M) r, symmetric_algebraMap_mem R M r⟩
proof:
:=
  symmetricDecomposition_on_piece R M 0 ⟨_, symmetric_algebraMap_mem R M r⟩

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.RuledSurfaceAlgebra.symmetric_lift_linearMap_mem
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ (LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M)) ^ n at hx
  induction hx using Submodule.pow_induction_on_left' with
  | algebraMap r =>
    rw [AlgHom.commutes]
    exact symmetric_algebraMap_mem R N r
  | add x y n hx hy ihx ihy =>
    rw [map_add]
    exact (symmetricPiece R N n).add_mem ihx ihy
  | mem_mul m hm n x hx ih =>
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hm
    rw [map_mul, SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    change _ ∈ (LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R N)) ^ n.succ
    rw [pow_succ']
    exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ (f m)) ih

name: HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_of_surjective
statement:
theorem HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_of_surjective {A B σ τ : Type*} [Ring A] [Ring B]
    [SetLike σ A] [SetLike τ B] [AddSubgroupClass σ A] [AddSubmonoidClass τ B]
    {𝒜 : ℕ → σ} {ℬ : ℕ → τ} [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ] (f : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) : ℬ₊ ≤ 𝒜₊.map f
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hf b
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_iff, GradedRing.proj_apply] at hb
  have key : f a = f (a - (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 a 0 : A)) := by
    rw [map_sub, GradedRingHom.map_directSumDecompose, hb, sub_zero]
  rw [key]
  refine Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ?_
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.mem_iff, HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_iff, GradedRing.proj_apply,
    DirectSum.decompose_sub, DirectSum.sub_apply, AddSubgroupClass.coe_sub,
    DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same 𝒜 (SetLike.coe_mem _), sub_self]

name: ReesResidueBaseChange.coeff_aeval_monomial_one
statement:
theorem coeff_aeval_monomial_one (x : Fin d → R) (F : MvPolynomial (Fin d) R) (n : ℕ) :
    (MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i => Polynomial.monomial 1 (x i)) F).coeff n =
      MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent n F)
proof:
:= by
  induction F using MvPolynomial.induction_on' with
  | monomial m c =>
    have hprod : (m.prod fun i k => Polynomial.monomial 1 (x i) ^ k) =
        Polynomial.monomial m.degree (m.prod fun i k => x i ^ k) := by
      simp_rw [← Polynomial.C_mul_X_eq_monomial, mul_pow, ← map_pow]
      rw [Finsupp.prod_mul, ← map_finsuppProd]
      simp only [Finsupp.prod_pow]
      rw [Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum, ← Finsupp.degree_eq_sum, Polynomial.C_mul_X_pow_eq_monomial]
    rw [MvPolynomial.aeval_monomial, hprod, Polynomial.algebraMap_eq, Polynomial.C_mul_monomial, Polynomial.coeff_monomial,
      MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_of_mem (MvPolynomial.isHomogeneous_monomial c rfl)]
    split_ifs with h1 h2 h2
    · rw [MvPolynomial.eval_monomial]
    · exact absurd h1.symm h2
    · exact absurd h2.symm h1
    · rw [map_zero]
  | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add, Polynomial.coeff_add, map_add, map_add, hp, hq]

name: ReesResidueBaseChange.aeval_monomial_one_of_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem aeval_monomial_one_of_isHomogeneous (x : Fin d → R) {F : MvPolynomial (Fin d) R} {n : ℕ}
    (hF : F.IsHomogeneous n) :
    MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i => Polynomial.monomial 1 (x i)) F =
      Polynomial.monomial n (MvPolynomial.eval x F)
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  rw [coeff_aeval_monomial_one, MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_of_mem hF,
    Polynomial.coeff_monomial]
  split_ifs with h1 h2 h2
  · rfl
  · exact absurd h1.symm h2
  · exact absurd h2.symm h1
  · rw [map_zero]

name: ReesResidueBaseChange.coe_reesAeval
statement:
theorem coe_reesAeval (F : MvPolynomial (Fin d) R) :
    ((reesAeval I x hx F : reesAlgebra I) : Polynomial R) =
      MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i => Polynomial.monomial 1 (x i)) F
proof:
:= by
  change (reesAlgebra I).val (reesAeval I x hx F) = _
  rw [reesAeval, ← AlgHom.comp_apply, MvPolynomial.comp_aeval]
  rfl

name: ReesResidueBaseChange.reesAeval_surjective
statement:
theorem reesAeval_surjective (hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range x) = I) :
    Function.Surjective (reesAeval I x hx)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
  have hmem : q ∈ (MvPolynomial.aeval fun i => Polynomial.monomial 1 (x i) :
      MvPolynomial (Fin d) R →ₐ[R] Polynomial R).range := by
    rw [← adjoin_monomial_eq_reesAlgebra] at hq
    refine Algebra.adjoin_le ?_ hq
    rintro _ ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
    rw [← hspan] at hr
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun R).mp hr
    refine (AlgHom.mem_range _).mpr ⟨∑ i, c i • MvPolynomial.X i, ?_⟩
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, MvPolynomial.aeval_X]
  obtain ⟨F, hF⟩ := hmem
  exact ⟨F, Subtype.ext (by rw [coe_reesAeval]; exact hF)⟩

name: ReesResidueBaseChange.coeff_mem_of_reesAeval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem coeff_mem_of_reesAeval_eq_zero
    (h3 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : MvPolynomial (Fin d) R), F.IsHomogeneous n →
      MvPolynomial.eval x F ∈ I ^ (n + 1) → ∀ m, F.coeff m ∈ I)
    {F : MvPolynomial (Fin d) R} (hF : reesAeval I x hx F = 0) (m : Fin d →₀ ℕ) :
    F.coeff m ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  have hcoe : ∀ n, MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent n F) = 0 := by
    intro n
    rw [← coeff_aeval_monomial_one, ← coe_reesAeval I x hx, hF, Subalgebra.coe_zero,
      Polynomial.coeff_zero]
  have hcomp : ∀ n, (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent n F).coeff m ∈ I := fun n =>
    h3 n _ (MvPolynomial.homogeneousComponent_isHomogeneous n F)
      (by rw [hcoe]; exact zero_mem _) m
  have hsum := MvPolynomial.sum_homogeneousComponent F
  rw [← hsum, MvPolynomial.coeff_sum]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun n _ => hcomp n

name: ReesResidueBaseChange.residueMap_apply
statement:
theorem residueMap_apply (F : MvPolynomial (Fin d) R) :
    residueMap F = MvPolynomial.map (IsLocalRing.residue R) F
proof: := rfl

name: ReesResidueBaseChange.residueMap_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem residueMap_eq_zero_iff (F : MvPolynomial (Fin d) R) :
    residueMap F = 0 ↔ ∀ m, F.coeff m ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
proof:
:= by
  rw [residueMap_apply]
  constructor
  · intro h m
    have := congrArg (MvPolynomial.coeff m) h
    rwa [MvPolynomial.coeff_map, MvPolynomial.coeff_zero, IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff] at this
  · intro h
    ext m
    rw [MvPolynomial.coeff_map, MvPolynomial.coeff_zero, IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff]
    exact h m

name: ReesResidueBaseChange.residueMap_surjective
statement: theorem residueMap_surjective : Function.Surjective (residueMap (R := R) (d := d))
proof:
:=
  MvPolynomial.map_surjective _ IsLocalRing.residue_surjective

name: ReesResidueBaseChange.residueMap_isHomogeneous
statement:
theorem residueMap_isHomogeneous {F : MvPolynomial (Fin d) R} {n : ℕ} (hF : F.IsHomogeneous n) :
    (residueMap F).IsHomogeneous n
proof:
:=
  hF.map _

name: ReesResidueBaseChange.residueRees_reesAeval
statement:
theorem residueRees_reesAeval (F : MvPolynomial (Fin d) R) :
    residueRees x hx hspan h3 (reesAeval _ x hx F) = residueMap F
proof:
:= by
  show residueQuotLift x hx h3
    ((Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective (reesAeval_surjective _ x hx hspan)).symm
      (reesAeval _ x hx F)) = _
  rw [Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective_symm_apply]
  rfl

name: ReesResidueBaseChange.residueRees_surjective
statement: theorem residueRees_surjective : Function.Surjective (residueRees x hx hspan h3)
proof:
:= by
  intro b
  obtain ⟨F, rfl⟩ := residueMap_surjective (R := R) (d := d) b
  exact ⟨reesAeval _ x hx F, residueRees_reesAeval x hx hspan h3 F⟩

name: ReesResidueBaseChange.residueRees_mem
statement:
theorem residueRees_mem {n : ℕ} {p : reesAlgebra (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)}
    (hp : p ∈ Ideal.reesGrading (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) n) :
    residueRees x hx hspan h3 p ∈
      MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin d) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.ReesAlgebra.mem_grading_iff _ n p).mp hp
  have hamem : a ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range x) ^ n := by
    rw [hspan]
    have := (mem_reesAlgebra_iff _ _).mp p.2 n
    rwa [← ha, Polynomial.coeff_monomial_same] at this
  obtain ⟨G, hG, hGa⟩ := (Ideal.mem_span_pow_iff_exists_isHomogeneous x a).mp hamem
  have hpG : p = reesAeval _ x hx G := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [coe_reesAeval, aeval_monomial_one_of_isHomogeneous x hG, hGa, ha]
  rw [hpG, residueRees_reesAeval]
  exact residueMap_isHomogeneous hG

name: ReesResidueBaseChange.residueReesGraded_apply
statement:
theorem residueReesGraded_apply (p : reesAlgebra (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)) :
    residueReesGraded x hx hspan h3 p = residueRees x hx hspan h3 p
proof: := rfl

name: ReesResidueBaseChange.exists_one_tmul
statement:
theorem exists_one_tmul (t : IsLocalRing.ResidueField R ⊗[R] reesAlgebra (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)) :
    ∃ p, t = 1 ⊗ₜ p
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => exact ⟨0, (TensorProduct.tmul_zero _ _).symm⟩
  | tmul c p =>
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := IsLocalRing.residue_surjective c
    refine ⟨a • p, ?_⟩
    rw [← TensorProduct.smul_tmul, ← Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, IsLocalRing.ResidueField.algebraMap_eq]
  | add s t hs ht =>
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := hs
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := ht
    exact ⟨p + q, (TensorProduct.tmul_add _ _ _).symm⟩

name: ReesResidueBaseChange.one_tmul_eq_zero_of_residueRees_eq_zero
statement:
theorem one_tmul_eq_zero_of_residueRees_eq_zero (p : reesAlgebra (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R))
    (hp : residueRees x hx hspan h3 p = 0) :
    (1 : IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) ⊗ₜ[R] p = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, rfl⟩ := reesAeval_surjective _ x hx hspan p
  rw [residueRees_reesAeval, residueMap_eq_zero_iff] at hp
  have hF : reesAeval _ x hx F =
      ∑ v ∈ F.support, F.coeff v • reesAeval _ x hx (MvPolynomial.monomial v 1) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [MvPolynomial.as_sum F]
    rw [map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v _ => ?_
    rw [← map_smul, MvPolynomial.smul_monomial, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [hF, TensorProduct.tmul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun v _ => ?_
  rw [← TensorProduct.smul_tmul, ← Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
    IsLocalRing.ResidueField.algebraMap_eq, (IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff _).mpr (hp v),
    TensorProduct.zero_tmul]

name: ReesResidueBaseChange.residueReesLift_one_tmul
statement:
theorem residueReesLift_one_tmul (p : reesAlgebra (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)) :
    residueReesLift x hx hspan h3 (1 ⊗ₜ p) = residueRees x hx hspan h3 p
proof:
:=
  IsBaseChange.lift_eq _ _ p

name: ReesResidueBaseChange.residueReesLift_bijective
statement: theorem residueReesLift_bijective : Function.Bijective (residueReesLift x hx hspan h3)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro t₁ t₂ h
    obtain ⟨p₁, rfl⟩ := exists_one_tmul t₁
    obtain ⟨p₂, rfl⟩ := exists_one_tmul t₂
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← TensorProduct.tmul_sub]
    apply one_tmul_eq_zero_of_residueRees_eq_zero x hx hspan h3
    rw [map_sub, ← residueReesLift_one_tmul, ← residueReesLift_one_tmul, h, sub_self]
  · intro b
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := residueRees_surjective x hx hspan h3 b
    exact ⟨1 ⊗ₜ p, by rw [residueReesLift_one_tmul, hp]⟩

name: ReesResidueBaseChange.residueRees_isBaseChange
statement:
theorem residueRees_isBaseChange :
    IsBaseChange (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) (residueRees x hx hspan h3).toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  IsBaseChange.of_equiv (LinearEquiv.ofBijective _ (residueReesLift_bijective x hx hspan h3))
    fun p => residueReesLift_one_tmul x hx hspan h3 p

name: IsRegularLocalRing.exists_reesGrading_maximalIdeal_baseChange_residueField
statement:
theorem IsRegularLocalRing.exists_reesGrading_maximalIdeal_baseChange_residueField (A : Type u)
    [CommRing A] [IsRegularLocalRing A] (d : ℕ) (hdim : ringKrullDim A = d) :
    ∃ (f : Ideal.reesGrading (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) →+*ᵍ
          MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin d) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A))
      (_hf : (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin d) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A))₊ ≤
          (Ideal.reesGrading (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A))₊.map f)
      (fR : reesAlgebra (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) →ₐ[A]
          MvPolynomial (Fin d) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)),
      (∀ a, fR a = f a) ∧ IsBaseChange (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) fR.toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hspan, h3⟩ := IsRegularLocalRing.initialForms_algebraicallyIndependent A d hdim
  exact ⟨ReesResidueBaseChange.residueReesGraded x hx hspan h3,
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le_map_of_surjective _
      (ReesResidueBaseChange.residueRees_surjective x hx hspan h3),
    ReesResidueBaseChange.residueRees x hx hspan h3, fun _ => rfl,
    ReesResidueBaseChange.residueRees_isBaseChange x hx hspan h3⟩

name: veronese_pow_mem_grading
statement:
theorem veronese_pow_mem_grading {A σ : Type*} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) {f : A} {m : ℕ} (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 m) :
    (⟨f ^ d, (veronese_pow_mem 𝒜 d hd hf).1⟩ : veroneseSubring 𝒜 d) ∈ veroneseGrading 𝒜 d m
proof:
:=
  (veronese_pow_mem 𝒜 d hd hf).2.choose_spec

name: veroneseAwayEquiv_toRingHom_mk'
statement:
theorem veroneseAwayEquiv_toRingHom_mk' {A σ : Type*} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A]
    [AddSubgroupClass σ A] (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) {f : A} {i : ℕ}
    (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 i)
    (c : HomogeneousLocalization.NumDenSameDeg (veroneseGrading 𝒜 d)
      (Submonoid.powers (⟨f ^ d, (veronese_pow_mem 𝒜 d hd hf).1⟩ : veroneseSubring 𝒜 d))) :
    (veroneseAwayEquiv 𝒜 d hd hf).toRingHom (HomogeneousLocalization.mk c) =
      HomogeneousLocalization.mk (veroneseAwayEquiv.toNumDen 𝒜 d hd hf c)
proof: := rfl

name: veronese_powers_le_comap
statement:
theorem veronese_powers_le_comap {A σ : Type*} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A]
    [AddSubgroupClass σ A] (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) {f : A} {i : ℕ}
    (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 i) :
    Submonoid.powers (⟨f ^ d, (veronese_pow_mem 𝒜 d hd hf).1⟩ : veroneseSubring 𝒜 d) ≤
      (Submonoid.powers f).comap (Subring.subtype (veroneseSubring 𝒜 d))
proof:
:= by
  rintro y ⟨k, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨d * k, ?_⟩
  simp [pow_mul]

name: veroneseAwayEquiv_val
statement:
theorem veroneseAwayEquiv_val {A σ : Type*} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A]
    [AddSubgroupClass σ A] (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) {f : A} {i : ℕ}
    (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 i)
    (z : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (veroneseGrading 𝒜 d)
      (⟨f ^ d, (veronese_pow_mem 𝒜 d hd hf).1⟩ : veroneseSubring 𝒜 d)) :
    ((veroneseAwayEquiv 𝒜 d hd hf).toRingHom z).val =
      IsLocalization.map (Localization.Away f) (Subring.subtype (veroneseSubring 𝒜 d))
        (veronese_powers_le_comap 𝒜 d hd hf) z.val
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.mk_surjective z
  rw [veroneseAwayEquiv_toRingHom_mk', HomogeneousLocalization.val_mk,
    HomogeneousLocalization.val_mk, Localization.mk_eq_mk', Localization.mk_eq_mk',
    IsLocalization.map_mk']
  rfl

name: veronese_pow_mul_eq
statement:
theorem veronese_pow_mul_eq {A σ : Type*} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A]
    [AddSubgroupClass σ A] (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) {f g x : A}
    {i j k : ℕ} (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 i) (hg : g ∈ 𝒜 j) (hx : x = f * g) (hxk : x ∈ 𝒜 k) :
    (⟨x ^ d, (veronese_pow_mem 𝒜 d hd hxk).1⟩ : veroneseSubring 𝒜 d) =
      ⟨f ^ d, (veronese_pow_mem 𝒜 d hd hf).1⟩ * ⟨g ^ d, (veronese_pow_mem 𝒜 d hd hg).1⟩
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (show x ^ d = f ^ d * g ^ d by rw [hx, mul_pow])

name: veroneseAwayEquiv_awayMap_general
statement:
theorem veroneseAwayEquiv_awayMap_general {A σ : Type*} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A]
    [AddSubgroupClass σ A] (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) {f g x : A}
    {i j k : ℕ} (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 i) (hg : g ∈ 𝒜 j) (hx : x = f * g) (hxk : x ∈ 𝒜 k) :
    ((HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap 𝒜 hg hx).comp
        (veroneseAwayEquiv 𝒜 d hd hf).toRingHom) =
      (veroneseAwayEquiv 𝒜 d hd hxk).toRingHom.comp
        (HomogeneousLocalization.awayMap (veroneseGrading 𝒜 d)
          (g := (⟨g ^ d, (veronese_pow_mem 𝒜 d hd hg).1⟩ : veroneseSubring 𝒜 d))
          (veronese_pow_mem_grading 𝒜 d hd hg)
          (x := (⟨x ^ d, (veronese_pow_mem 𝒜 d hd hxk).1⟩ : veroneseSubring 𝒜 d))
          (veronese_pow_mul_eq 𝒜 d hd hf hg hx hxk))
proof:
:= by
  
  let R1 : Localization.Away f →+* Localization.Away x :=
    Localization.awayLift (algebraMap A (Localization.Away x)) f
      (isUnit_of_dvd_unit (map_dvd _ ⟨_, hx⟩) (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit x))
  let R2 : Localization.Away (⟨f ^ d, (veronese_pow_mem 𝒜 d hd hf).1⟩ : veroneseSubring 𝒜 d) →+*
      Localization.Away f :=
    IsLocalization.map (Localization.Away f) (Subring.subtype (veroneseSubring 𝒜 d))
      (veronese_powers_le_comap 𝒜 d hd hf)
  let R3 : Localization.Away (⟨x ^ d, (veronese_pow_mem 𝒜 d hd hxk).1⟩ : veroneseSubring 𝒜 d) →+*
      Localization.Away x :=
    IsLocalization.map (Localization.Away x) (Subring.subtype (veroneseSubring 𝒜 d))
      (veronese_powers_le_comap 𝒜 d hd hxk)
  let R4 : Localization.Away (⟨f ^ d, (veronese_pow_mem 𝒜 d hd hf).1⟩ : veroneseSubring 𝒜 d) →+*
      Localization.Away (⟨x ^ d, (veronese_pow_mem 𝒜 d hd hxk).1⟩ : veroneseSubring 𝒜 d) :=
    Localization.awayLift (algebraMap (veroneseSubring 𝒜 d) _) _
      (isUnit_of_dvd_unit (map_dvd _ ⟨_, veronese_pow_mul_eq 𝒜 d hd hf hg hx hxk⟩)
        (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit _))
  have key : R1.comp R2 = R3.comp R4 := by
    refine IsLocalization.ringHom_ext
      (Submonoid.powers (⟨f ^ d, (veronese_pow_mem 𝒜 d hd hf).1⟩ : veroneseSubring 𝒜 d)) ?_
    ext a
    simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, R1, R2, R3, R4]
    rw [IsLocalization.map_eq, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq,
      IsLocalization.map_eq]
  ext z
  simp only [RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply]
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_awayMap, veroneseAwayEquiv_val, veroneseAwayEquiv_val,
    HomogeneousLocalization.val_awayMap]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun key z.val

name: KaehlerDifferential.symEquivMvPolynomial_apply_f
statement:
theorem symEquivMvPolynomial_apply_f (i : I) :
    symEquivMvPolynomial hf b (f (b i)) = MvPolynomial.X i
proof:
:= by
  simp [symEquivMvPolynomial]

name: KaehlerDifferential.symEquivMvPolynomial_symm_X
statement:
theorem symEquivMvPolynomial_symm_X (i : I) :
    (symEquivMvPolynomial hf b).symm (MvPolynomial.X i) = f (b i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [AlgEquiv.symm_apply_eq, symEquivMvPolynomial_apply_f]

name: KaehlerDifferential.coordDerivationLinear_apply
statement:
theorem coordDerivationLinear_apply (a : A) :
    coordDerivationLinear hf b a = Finsupp.mapRange (symEquivMvPolynomial hf b).symm (map_zero _)
      (MvPolynomial.mkDerivation R (fun i : I => Finsupp.single i (1 : MvPolynomial I R))
        (symEquivMvPolynomial hf b a))
proof: := rfl

name: KaehlerDifferential.mapRange_symm_smul'
statement:
theorem mapRange_symm_smul' (q : MvPolynomial I R) (v : I →₀ MvPolynomial I R) :
    Finsupp.mapRange (symEquivMvPolynomial hf b).symm (map_zero _) (q • v) =
      (symEquivMvPolynomial hf b).symm q • Finsupp.mapRange (symEquivMvPolynomial hf b).symm (map_zero _) v
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp [Finsupp.mapRange_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_mul]

name: KaehlerDifferential.mapRange_symm_smul
statement:
theorem mapRange_symm_smul (a : A) (v : I →₀ MvPolynomial I R) :
    Finsupp.mapRange (symEquivMvPolynomial hf b).symm (map_zero _) (symEquivMvPolynomial hf b a • v) =
      a • Finsupp.mapRange (symEquivMvPolynomial hf b).symm (map_zero _) v
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapRange_symm_smul', AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: KaehlerDifferential.coordDerivation_apply
statement:
theorem coordDerivation_apply (a : A) :
    coordDerivation hf b a = Finsupp.mapRange (symEquivMvPolynomial hf b).symm (map_zero _)
      (MvPolynomial.mkDerivation R (fun i : I => Finsupp.single i (1 : MvPolynomial I R))
        (symEquivMvPolynomial hf b a))
proof: := rfl

name: KaehlerDifferential.coordDerivation_f
statement:
theorem coordDerivation_f (i : I) :
    coordDerivation hf b (f (b i)) = Finsupp.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordDerivation_apply, symEquivMvPolynomial_apply_f, MvPolynomial.mkDerivation_X,
    Finsupp.mapRange_single, map_one]

name: KaehlerDifferential.toCoords_ofCoords
statement: theorem toCoords_ofCoords : toCoords hf b ∘ₗ ofCoords (f := f) b = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  refine Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun i => LinearMap.ext_ring ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Finsupp.lsingle_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, ofCoords,
    Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul, toCoords, Derivation.liftKaehlerDifferential_comp_D,
    coordDerivation_f]

name: KaehlerDifferential.ofCoords_mapRange
statement:
theorem ofCoords_mapRange (q : MvPolynomial I R) :
    ofCoords (f := f) b (Finsupp.mapRange (symEquivMvPolynomial hf b).symm (map_zero _)
      (MvPolynomial.mkDerivation R (fun i : I => Finsupp.single i (1 : MvPolynomial I R)) q)) =
      KaehlerDifferential.D R A ((symEquivMvPolynomial hf b).symm q)
proof:
:= by
  induction q using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C r =>
    rw [← MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq, Derivation.map_algebraMap, Finsupp.mapRange_zero, map_zero,
      AlgEquiv.commutes, Derivation.map_algebraMap]
  | add p q hp hq =>
    rw [map_add, Finsupp.mapRange_add (map_add _), map_add, hp, hq, map_add, map_add]
  | mul_X p i hp =>
    rw [Derivation.leibniz, MvPolynomial.mkDerivation_X, Finsupp.mapRange_add (map_add _), map_add,
      Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, Finsupp.mapRange_single, mapRange_symm_smul',
      map_smul, hp, symEquivMvPolynomial_symm_X, map_mul, Derivation.leibniz,
      symEquivMvPolynomial_symm_X]
    simp only [ofCoords, Finsupp.linearCombination_single]

name: KaehlerDifferential.ofCoords_toCoords
statement: theorem ofCoords_toCoords : ofCoords (f := f) b ∘ₗ toCoords hf b = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext_on (KaehlerDifferential.span_range_derivation R A)
  rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, toCoords,
    Derivation.liftKaehlerDifferential_comp_D, coordDerivation_apply]
  rw [ofCoords_mapRange, AlgEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: KaehlerDifferential.exists_basis_of_isSymmetricAlgebra
statement:
theorem KaehlerDifferential.exists_basis_of_isSymmetricAlgebra {R M A : Type*} [CommRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] {f : M →ₗ[R] A}
    (hf : IsSymmetricAlgebra f) {I : Type*} (b : Module.Basis I R M) :
    ∃ c : Module.Basis I A (KaehlerDifferential R A),
      ∀ i, c i = KaehlerDifferential.D R A (f (b i))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Module.Basis.ofRepr (LinearEquiv.ofLinearMap (KaehlerDifferential.toCoords hf b)
    (KaehlerDifferential.ofCoords (f := f) b) (KaehlerDifferential.toCoords_ofCoords hf b)
    (KaehlerDifferential.ofCoords_toCoords hf b)), fun i => ?_⟩
  simp [KaehlerDifferential.ofCoords, Finsupp.linearCombination_single]

name: veroneseSubring.mul_mem_aux
statement:
theorem veroneseSubring.mul_mem_aux {σ A : Type*} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (d : ℕ) {a b : A}
    (ha : ∀ i, ¬ d ∣ i → GradedRing.proj 𝒜 i a = 0) (hb : ∀ i, ¬ d ∣ i → GradedRing.proj 𝒜 i b = 0) :
    ∀ i, ¬ d ∣ i → GradedRing.proj 𝒜 i (a * b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro n hn
  rw [GradedRing.proj_apply, DirectSum.decompose_mul, DirectSum.coe_mul_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun ij hij => ?_
  have hsum : ij.1 + ij.2 = n := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hij).2
  have h : ¬ d ∣ ij.1 ∨ ¬ d ∣ ij.2 := by
    by_contra hc
    push_neg at hc
    exact hn (hsum ▸ dvd_add hc.1 hc.2)
  rcases h with h | h
  · have h0 := ha _ h
    rw [GradedRing.proj_apply] at h0
    rw [h0, zero_mul]
  · have h0 := hb _ h
    rw [GradedRing.proj_apply] at h0
    rw [h0, mul_zero]

name: veroneseSubring.one_mem_aux
statement:
theorem veroneseSubring.one_mem_aux {σ A : Type*} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (d : ℕ) :
    ∀ i, ¬ d ∣ i → GradedRing.proj 𝒜 i (1 : A) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  have h0 : i ≠ 0 := fun h => hi (h ▸ dvd_zero d)
  rw [GradedRing.proj_apply]
  exact DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_ne 𝒜 (SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem) (Ne.symm h0)

name: veroneseGrading.one_mem
statement:
theorem veroneseGrading.one_mem {σ A : Type*} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (d : ℕ) :
    (1 : veroneseSubring 𝒜 d) ∈ veroneseGrading 𝒜 d 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨by simpa using (SetLike.GradedOne.one_mem : (1 : A) ∈ 𝒜 0), fun _ => Or.inl rfl⟩

name: veroneseGrading.mul_mem
statement:
theorem veroneseGrading.mul_mem {σ A : Type*} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (d : ℕ) {i j : ℕ}
    {x y : veroneseSubring 𝒜 d} (hx : x ∈ veroneseGrading 𝒜 d i) (hy : y ∈ veroneseGrading 𝒜 d j) :
    x * y ∈ veroneseGrading 𝒜 d (i + j)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun h0 => ?_⟩
  · have h := SetLike.GradedMul.mul_mem hx.1 hy.1
    rw [Nat.add_mul]
    simpa using h
  · rcases hx.2 h0 with hi | hx0
    · rcases hy.2 h0 with hj | hy0
      · left; omega
      · right; rw [hy0, mul_zero]
    · right; rw [hx0, zero_mul]

name: veroneseSubring.proj_mem
statement:
theorem veroneseSubring.proj_mem {σ A : Type*} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (d : ℕ) (x : A) {i : ℕ} (hi : d ∣ i) :
    (GradedRing.proj 𝒜 i x : A) ∈ veroneseSubring 𝒜 d
proof:
:= by
  show ∀ j, ¬ d ∣ j → GradedRing.proj 𝒜 j (GradedRing.proj 𝒜 i x) = 0
  intro j hj
  have hne : i ≠ j := fun h => hj (h ▸ hi)
  have hm : (GradedRing.proj 𝒜 i x : A) ∈ 𝒜 i := by
    rw [GradedRing.proj_apply]; exact SetLike.coe_mem _
  rw [GradedRing.proj_apply]
  exact DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_ne 𝒜 hm hne

name: veroneseGrading.proj_mem
statement:
theorem veroneseGrading.proj_mem {σ A : Type*} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (d : ℕ) (x : A) {i : ℕ} (hi : d ∣ i) :
    (⟨GradedRing.proj 𝒜 i x, veroneseSubring.proj_mem 𝒜 d x hi⟩ : veroneseSubring 𝒜 d) ∈
      veroneseGrading 𝒜 d (i / d)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun h0 => Or.inl (by subst h0; simp)⟩
  show (GradedRing.proj 𝒜 i x : A) ∈ 𝒜 (i / d * d)
  rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hi, GradedRing.proj_apply]
  exact SetLike.coe_mem _

name: veroneseSubring.mem_of_mem_graded
proof:
:= by
  show ∀ j, ¬ d ∣ j → GradedRing.proj 𝒜 j a = 0
  intro j hj
  have hne : i ≠ j := fun h => hj (h ▸ hi)
  rw [GradedRing.proj_apply]
  exact DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_ne 𝒜 ha hne

name: veroneseGrading.mem_of_mem_graded
statement:
theorem veroneseGrading.mem_of_mem_graded {σ A : Type*} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A]
    [AddSubgroupClass σ A] (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (d : ℕ) {i : ℕ} (hi : d ∣ i) {a : A}
    (ha : a ∈ 𝒜 i) :
    (⟨a, veroneseSubring.mem_of_mem_graded 𝒜 d hi ha⟩ : veroneseSubring 𝒜 d) ∈
      veroneseGrading 𝒜 d (i / d)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun h0 => Or.inl (by subst h0; simp)⟩
  show a ∈ 𝒜 (i / d * d)
  rw [Nat.div_mul_cancel hi]
  exact ha

name: veroneseDecomposeHom_of
statement:
theorem veroneseDecomposeHom_of {σ A : Type*} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (d : ℕ) (i : ℕ) (a : 𝒜 i) :
    veroneseDecomposeHom 𝒜 d (DirectSum.of (fun i => 𝒜 i) i a) =
      if hi : d ∣ i then
        DirectSum.of (fun n => veroneseGrading 𝒜 d n) (i / d) (veroneseComponentHom 𝒜 d i hi a)
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [veroneseDecomposeHom, DirectSum.toAddMonoid_of]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: veroneseDecompose_eq_hom
statement:
theorem veroneseDecompose_eq_hom {σ A : Type*} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (d : ℕ) (x : veroneseSubring 𝒜 d) :
    veroneseDecompose 𝒜 d x = veroneseDecomposeHom 𝒜 d (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 (x : A))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold veroneseDecompose
  conv_rhs => rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_of (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 (x : A)), map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [veroneseDecomposeHom_of]
  split_ifs with hi
  · exact congrArg _ (Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext (GradedRing.proj_apply 𝒜 i (x : A))))
  · rfl

name: veroneseDecompose_zero
statement:
theorem veroneseDecompose_zero {σ A : Type*} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (d : ℕ) : veroneseDecompose 𝒜 d 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [veroneseDecompose_eq_hom, Subring.coe_zero, DirectSum.decompose_zero, map_zero]

name: veroneseDecompose_left_inv
statement:
theorem veroneseDecompose_left_inv {σ A : Type*} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (d : ℕ) :
    Function.LeftInverse (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (veroneseGrading 𝒜 d)) (veroneseDecompose 𝒜 d)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [veroneseDecompose_eq_hom]
  conv_lhs => rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_of (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 (x : A)), map_sum, map_sum]
  rw [AddSubmonoidClass.coe_finsetSum]
  conv_rhs => rw [← DirectSum.sum_support_decompose 𝒜 (x : A)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [veroneseDecomposeHom_of]
  split_ifs with hi
  · rw [DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom_of]
    rfl
  · rw [map_zero, Subring.coe_zero, ← GradedRing.proj_apply]
    exact (x.2 i hi).symm

name: veroneseDecompose_right_inv
statement:
theorem veroneseDecompose_right_inv {σ A : Type*} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (d : ℕ) :
    Function.RightInverse (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (veroneseGrading 𝒜 d)) (veroneseDecompose 𝒜 d)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro z
  induction z using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    rw [map_zero]
    exact veroneseDecompose_zero 𝒜 d
  | of n y =>
    rw [DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom_of]
    by_cases hy : y = 0
    · subst hy
      rw [map_zero]
      exact veroneseDecompose_zero 𝒜 d
    have key : ∀ (m : ℕ) (_ : m = n) (v : veroneseGrading 𝒜 d m),
        ((v : veroneseSubring 𝒜 d) : A) = ((y : veroneseSubring 𝒜 d) : A) →
        DirectSum.of (fun n => veroneseGrading 𝒜 d n) m v =
          DirectSum.of (fun n => veroneseGrading 𝒜 d n) n y := by
      rintro m rfl v hv
      congr 1
      exact Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext hv)
    have hmem : ((y : veroneseSubring 𝒜 d) : A) ∈ 𝒜 (n * d) := y.2.1
    rw [veroneseDecompose_eq_hom, DirectSum.decompose_of_mem 𝒜 hmem, veroneseDecomposeHom_of,
      dif_pos (dvd_mul_left d n)]
    refine key _ ?_ _ rfl
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos d with hd | hd
    · subst hd
      rcases y.2.2 rfl with hn | hy0
      · subst hn; rfl
      · exact absurd (Subtype.ext hy0) hy
    · exact Nat.mul_div_cancel n hd
  | add x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_add, veroneseDecompose_eq_hom, Subring.coe_add, DirectSum.decompose_add, map_add,
      ← veroneseDecompose_eq_hom, ← veroneseDecompose_eq_hom, hx, hy]

name: veronese_pow_mem
statement:
theorem veronese_pow_mem {σ A : Type*} [CommRing A] [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → σ) [GradedRing 𝒜] (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) {f : A} {m : ℕ} (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 m) :
    f ^ d ∈ veroneseSubring 𝒜 d ∧ ∃ h : f ^ d ∈ veroneseSubring 𝒜 d, (⟨f ^ d, h⟩ : veroneseSubring 𝒜 d) ∈ veroneseGrading 𝒜 d m
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : f ^ d ∈ 𝒜 (m * d) := by
    have h := SetLike.pow_mem_graded d hf
    rwa [smul_eq_mul, Nat.mul_comm] at h
  have hsub : f ^ d ∈ veroneseSubring 𝒜 d :=
    veroneseSubring.mem_of_mem_graded 𝒜 d (dvd_mul_left d m) hpow
  exact ⟨hsub, hsub, hpow, fun h0 => absurd h0 hd.ne'⟩

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.IdealFractionChart.generator_mul_fraction
statement:
theorem generator_mul_fraction (I : Ideal R) (a : R) (b : I) :
    algebraMap R (chart I a) a * fraction I a b = algebraMap R (chart I a) (b : R)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) a *
      (algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) (b : R) *
        IsLocalization.Away.invSelf (S := Localization.Away a) a) =
    algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) (b : R)
  rw [mul_left_comm, IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf, mul_one]

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.IdealFractionChart.centerExtension_eq_span
statement:
theorem centerExtension_eq_span (I : Ideal R) (a : R) (ha : a ∈ I) :
    I.map (algebraMap R (chart I a)) =
      Ideal.span ({algebraMap R (chart I a) a} : Set (chart I a))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr
    intro b hb
    change algebraMap R (chart I a) b ∈
      Ideal.span ({algebraMap R (chart I a) a} : Set (chart I a))
    apply Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mpr
    exact ⟨fraction I a ⟨b, hb⟩, (generator_mul_fraction I a ⟨b, hb⟩).symm⟩
  · apply Ideal.span_le.mpr
    rintro b rfl
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.IdealFractionChart.generator_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem generator_mul_eq_zero (I : Ideal R) (a : R) (r : chart I a) :
    algebraMap R (chart I a) a * r = 0 → r = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply Subtype.ext
  have h' : algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) a * (r : Localization.Away a) = 0 :=
    congrArg Subtype.val h
  exact (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (S := Localization.Away a) a).mul_right_eq_zero.mp h'

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.IdealFractionChart.isLocalization_away
statement:
theorem isLocalization_away (I : Ideal R) (a : R) :
    IsLocalization.Away (algebraMap R (chart I a) a) (Localization.Away a)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsLocalization.Away.mk
  · change IsUnit (algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) a)
    exact IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit a
  · intro z
    obtain ⟨n, b, hb⟩ := IsLocalization.Away.surj a z
    refine ⟨n, algebraMap R (chart I a) b, ?_⟩
    change z * algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) a ^ n =
      algebraMap R (Localization.Away a) b
    exact hb
  · intro r s h
    have hrs : r = s := Subtype.ext h
    exact ⟨0, by simpa using hrs⟩

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.ReesAlgebra.mem_grading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_grading_iff (I : Ideal R) (n : ℕ) (f : reesAlgebra I) :
    f ∈ grading I n ↔ ∃ r : R, Polynomial.monomial n r = (f : Polynomial R)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.ReesAlgebra.eq_monomial_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := (mem_grading_iff I n f).mp hf
  rw [← hr, Polynomial.coeff_monomial_same]

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.ReesAlgebra.coeff_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
theorem coeff_eq_zero_of_mem (I : Ideal R) {n m : ℕ} {f : reesAlgebra I}
    (hf : f ∈ grading I n) (hnm : n ≠ m) : (f : Polynomial R).coeff m = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_monomial_of_mem I hf, Polynomial.coeff_monomial, if_neg hnm]

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.ReesAlgebra.component_mem
statement:
theorem component_mem (I : Ideal R) (n : ℕ) (f : reesAlgebra I) :
    component I n f ∈ grading I n
proof:
:=
  (mem_grading_iff I n _).mpr ⟨(f : Polynomial R).coeff n, rfl⟩

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.ReesAlgebra.sum_components
statement:
theorem sum_components (I : Ideal R) (f : reesAlgebra I) :
    ∑ n ∈ (f : Polynomial R).support, component I n f = f
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (reesAlgebra I).val (∑ n ∈ (f : Polynomial R).support, component I n f) = _
  rw [map_sum]
  exact (f : Polynomial R).as_sum_support.symm

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.ReesAlgebra.grading_iSupIndep
statement: theorem grading_iSupIndep (I : Ideal R) : iSupIndep (grading I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iSupIndep_def]
  intro n
  apply Submodule.disjoint_def.mpr
  intro f hf hother
  let c : reesAlgebra I →ₗ[R] R :=
    (Polynomial.lcoeff R n).comp (reesAlgebra I).val.toLinearMap
  have hle : (⨆ (m : ℕ) (_ : m ≠ n), grading I m) ≤ LinearMap.ker c := by
    refine iSup_le fun m ↦ iSup_le fun hmn ↦ ?_
    intro g hg
    exact coeff_eq_zero_of_mem I hg hmn
  have hzero : (f : Polynomial R).coeff n = 0 := hle hother
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [eq_monomial_of_mem I hf, hzero, map_zero]
  rfl

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.ReesAlgebra.grading_iSup_eq_top
statement: theorem grading_iSup_eq_top (I : Ideal R) : (⨆ n, grading I n) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  intro f _
  rw [← sum_components I f]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun n _ ↦ Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem n (component_mem I n f)

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.ReesAlgebra.isInternal
statement: theorem isInternal (I : Ideal R) : DirectSum.IsInternal (grading I)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top
    (grading_iSupIndep I) (grading_iSup_eq_top I)

name: MiyaokaMori.RingTheory.ReesAlgebra.coe_graded_proj
statement:
theorem coe_graded_proj (I : Ideal R) (n : ℕ) (f : reesAlgebra I) :
    ((GradedRing.proj (grading I) n f : reesAlgebra I) : Polynomial R) =
      Polynomial.monomial n ((f : Polynomial R).coeff n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hproj : ∀ m, GradedRing.proj (grading I) n (component I m f) =
      if m = n then component I n f else 0 := by
    intro m
    by_cases hmn : m = n
    · subst m
      rw [if_pos rfl, GradedRing.proj_apply]
      exact DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same (grading I) (component_mem I n f)
    · rw [if_neg hmn, GradedRing.proj_apply]
      exact DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_ne (grading I) (component_mem I m f) hmn
  have hsum : GradedRing.proj (grading I) n f = component I n f := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← sum_components I f]
    rw [map_sum]
    simp only [hproj]
    by_cases hn : n ∈ (f : Polynomial R).support
    · simp [hn]
    · have hcoeff : (f : Polynomial R).coeff n = 0 :=
        Polynomial.notMem_support_iff.mp hn
      have hc : component I n f = 0 := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        simp [component, hcoeff]
      simp [hc]
  exact congrArg (fun g : reesAlgebra I ↦ (g : Polynomial R)) hsum

name: GradedRing.mem_addSubgroupGrading
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_addSubgroupGrading {i : ι} {x : A} :
    x ∈ addSubgroupGrading 𝒜 i ↔ x ∈ 𝒜 i
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: ReesAlgebra.mem_tensorSub
statement:
theorem mem_tensorSub {M : Submodule R A} {x : A ⊗[R] B} :
    x ∈ tensorSub (B := B) M ↔ ∃ y : M ⊗[R] B, (M.subtype.rTensor B) y = x
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: ReesAlgebra.tensorSub_eq_tensorGrading
statement:
theorem tensorSub_eq_tensorGrading (𝒜 : ℕ → Submodule R A) (m : ℕ) :
    tensorSub (B := B) (𝒜 m) = GradedBaseChange.tensorGrading 𝒜 (B := B) m
proof: := rfl

name: ReesAlgebra.tmul_mem_tensorSub
statement:
theorem tmul_mem_tensorSub {M : Submodule R A} {a : A} (ha : a ∈ M) (b : B) :
    a ⊗ₜ[R] b ∈ tensorSub (B := B) M
proof:
:=
  ⟨(⟨a, ha⟩ : M) ⊗ₜ[R] b, by rw [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul]; rfl⟩

name: ReesAlgebra.tensorSub_mono
statement:
theorem tensorSub_mono {M N : Submodule R A} (h : M ≤ N) :
    tensorSub (B := B) M ≤ tensorSub (B := B) N
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨y, rfl⟩
  induction y using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add u v hu hv => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hu hv
  | tmul a b => rw [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul]; exact tmul_mem_tensorSub (h a.2) b

name: ReesAlgebra.tensorSub_mul
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hy
  induction u using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, zero_mul]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add u₁ u₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [map_add, add_mul]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h₁ h₂
  | tmul a b =>
    induction v using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => rw [map_zero, mul_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    | add v₁ v₂ h₁ h₂ => rw [map_add, mul_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h₁ h₂
    | tmul a' b' =>
      rw [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul]
      exact tmul_mem_tensorSub (h _ a.2 _ a'.2) _

name: ReesAlgebra.mem_irrPow
statement:
theorem mem_irrPow {p j : ℕ} {x : A} :
    x ∈ irrPow 𝒜 p j ↔ x ∈ (irrelevant 𝒜) ^ p ∧ x ∈ 𝒜 j
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: ReesAlgebra.irrPow_le
statement: theorem irrPow_le (p j : ℕ) : irrPow 𝒜 p j ≤ 𝒜 j
proof: := fun _ hx => hx.2

name: ReesAlgebra.irrPow_zero
statement: theorem irrPow_zero (j : ℕ) : irrPow 𝒜 0 j = 𝒜 j
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (irrPow_le 𝒜 0 j) fun x hx => ?_
  exact ⟨by rw [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]; exact Submodule.mem_top, hx⟩

name: ReesAlgebra.irrPow_anti
statement: theorem irrPow_anti {p q j : ℕ} (h : q ≤ p) : irrPow 𝒜 p j ≤ irrPow 𝒜 q j
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx => ⟨Ideal.pow_le_pow_right h hx.1, hx.2⟩

name: ReesAlgebra.one_mem_irrPow
statement: theorem one_mem_irrPow : (1 : A) ∈ irrPow 𝒜 0 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [irrPow_zero]
  exact SetLike.one_mem_graded 𝒜

name: ReesAlgebra.irrPow_mul
statement:
theorem irrPow_mul {p q j k : ℕ} {x y : A} (hx : x ∈ irrPow 𝒜 p j) (hy : y ∈ irrPow 𝒜 q k) :
    x * y ∈ irrPow 𝒜 (p + q) (j + k)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rw [pow_add]; exact Ideal.mul_mem_mul hx.1 hy.1,
    SetLike.mul_mem_graded hx.2 hy.2⟩

name: ReesAlgebra.mem_reesPiece_of
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem e ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: ReesAlgebra.one_mem_reesPiece
statement: theorem one_mem_reesPiece : (1 : A ⊗[R] B) ∈ reesPiece 𝒜 t 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : (1 : A ⊗[R] B) = lam (A := A) t ^ 0 * ((1 : A) ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : B)) := by
    rw [pow_zero, one_mul]; rfl
  rw [h]
  exact mem_reesPiece_of 𝒜 t (tmul_mem_tensorSub (one_mem_irrPow 𝒜) 1)

name: ReesAlgebra.mul_mem_reesPiece
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction (motive := fun z => z * y ∈ reesPiece 𝒜 t (j + k)) _ hx ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro e _ ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    refine Submodule.iSup_induction
      (motive := fun z => lam (A := A) t ^ e * u * z ∈ reesPiece 𝒜 t (j + k)) _ hy ?_ ?_ ?_
    · rintro f _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
      have key : lam (A := A) t ^ e * u * (lam (A := A) t ^ f * v) =
            lam (A := A) t ^ (e + f) * (u * v) := by
        rw [pow_add]; ring
      show lam (A := A) t ^ e * u * (lam (A := A) t ^ f * v) ∈ _
      rw [key]
