statement:
theorem val_awayHom (x : HomogeneousLocalization.Away
    (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w) (MvPolynomial.X i)) :
    (awayHom k w A i x).val = locHom k A i x.val
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.mk_surjective x
  rw [awayHom, HomogeneousLocalization.map_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_mk,
    HomogeneousLocalization.val_mk, locHom, Localization.mk_eq_mk', Localization.mk_eq_mk',
    IsLocalization.map_mk']
  rfl

name: WeightedAwayBaseChange.val_fromZeroRingHom
statement:
theorem val_fromZeroRingHom {R B : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → Submodule R B) [GradedAlgebra 𝒜] (P : Submonoid B) (x : 𝒜 0) :
    (HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom 𝒜 P x).val = algebraMap B (Localization P) x
proof:
:= by
  show (HomogeneousLocalization.mk _).val = _
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_mk, Localization.mk_eq_mk']
  exact IsLocalization.mk'_one _ _

name: WeightedAwayBaseChange.val_coeffHom
statement:
theorem val_coeffHom (a : A) : (coeffHom w A i a).val =
    algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) (Localization.Away (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ A))
      (MvPolynomial.C a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coeffHom, RingHom.comp_apply, val_fromZeroRingHom]
  rfl

name: WeightedAwayBaseChange.awayHom_algebraMap
statement:
theorem awayHom_algebraMap (c : k) :
    awayHom k w A i (algebraMap k _ c) = algebraMap k _ c
proof:
:= by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [val_awayHom, hk, RingHom.comp_apply, val_fromZeroRingHom, locHom, IsLocalization.map_eq]
  show _ = (coeffHom w A i (algebraMap k A c)).val
  rw [val_coeffHom]
  congr 1
  simp

name: WeightedAwayBaseChange.Φ_tmul
statement:
theorem Φ_tmul (a : A) (b : HomogeneousLocalization.Away
    (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w) (MvPolynomial.X i)) :
    Φ k w A i hk (a ⊗ₜ b) = coeffHom w A i a * awayHom k w A i b
proof: := rfl

name: WeightedAwayBaseChange.valLinear_apply
statement: theorem valLinear_apply (x) : valLinear k w i hk x = x.val
proof: := rfl

name: WeightedAwayBaseChange.coeffLocAlgHom_apply
statement:
theorem coeffLocAlgHom_apply (a : A) : coeffLocAlgHom k A i a =
    algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) (Localization.Away (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ A))
      (MvPolynomial.C a)
proof: := rfl

name: WeightedAwayBaseChange.Ψ_tmul
statement:
theorem Ψ_tmul (a : A) (l : Localization.Away (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ k)) :
    Ψ k A i (a ⊗ₜ l) =
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ A) (Localization.Away (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ A))
        (MvPolynomial.C a) * locHom k A i l
proof: := rfl

name: WeightedAwayBaseChange.val_Φ
statement:
theorem val_Φ (z : A ⊗[k] HomogeneousLocalization.Away
    (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w) (MvPolynomial.X i)) :
    (Φ k w A i hk z).val = Ψ k A i (LinearMap.lTensor A (valLinear k w i hk) z)
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp [HomogeneousLocalization.val_zero]
  | tmul a b =>
    rw [Φ_tmul, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, Ψ_tmul, HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, val_coeffHom,
      val_awayHom, valLinear_apply]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, HomogeneousLocalization.val_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: WeightedAwayBaseChange.ρ_map
statement:
theorem ρ_map (p : MvPolynomial σ k) : ρ k A i (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k A) p) =
    1 ⊗ₜ algebraMap (MvPolynomial σ k) (Localization.Away (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ k)) p
proof:
:= by
  simp [ρ, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul]

name: WeightedAwayBaseChange.ρ_C
statement: theorem ρ_C (a : A) : ρ k A i (MvPolynomial.C a) = a ⊗ₜ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [MvPolynomial.C_apply]
  show (Algebra.TensorProduct.map _ _)
    ((MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv k A).symm (MvPolynomial.monomial 0 a)) = _
  rw [MvPolynomial.algebraTensorAlgEquiv_symm_monomial, Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul]
  simp

name: WeightedAwayBaseChange.ρ_X_isUnit
statement: theorem ρ_X_isUnit : IsUnit (ρ k A i (MvPolynomial.X i))
proof:
:= by
  have h := ρ_map k A i (MvPolynomial.X i)
  rw [MvPolynomial.map_X] at h
  rw [h]
  exact (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit (MvPolynomial.X i)).map
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := k) (A := A))

name: WeightedAwayBaseChange.θ_Ψ
statement:
theorem θ_Ψ (z : A ⊗[k] Localization.Away (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ k)) :
    θ k A i (Ψ k A i z) = z
proof:
:= by
  induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a l =>
    obtain ⟨⟨p, y⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective
      (Submonoid.powers (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ k)) l
    have key : ∀ (q : MvPolynomial σ k)
        (y : Submonoid.powers (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ k)),
        IsLocalization.Away.lift (MvPolynomial.X i) (ρ_X_isUnit k A i)
          (IsLocalization.mk' (Localization.Away (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ A))
            (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k A) q)
            (⟨MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap k A) y, powers_le_comap_map k A i y.2⟩ :
              Submonoid.powers (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ A))) =
          1 ⊗ₜ IsLocalization.mk' (Localization.Away (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ k)) q y := by
      intro q y
      unfold IsLocalization.Away.lift
      rw [IsLocalization.lift_mk'_spec]
      show ρ k A i _ = ρ k A i _ * _
      rw [ρ_map, ρ_map, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, IsLocalization.mk'_spec']
    rw [Ψ_tmul, map_mul, θ, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq, ρ_C, locHom, IsLocalization.map_mk', key,
      Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: WeightedAwayBaseChange.Ψ_injective
statement: theorem Ψ_injective : Function.Injective (Ψ k A i)
proof:
:=
  Function.LeftInverse.injective (θ_Ψ k A i)

name: WeightedAwayBaseChange.Φ_injective
statement: theorem Φ_injective : Function.Injective (Φ k w A i hk)
proof:
:= by
  intro z₁ z₂ hz
  have h := congrArg HomogeneousLocalization.val hz
  rw [val_Φ, val_Φ] at h
  exact Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap (M := A) (valLinear k w i hk)
    (HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective _) (Ψ_injective k A i h)

name: WeightedAwayBaseChange.X_mem_weighted
statement:
theorem X_mem_weighted (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (j : σ) :
    (MvPolynomial.X j : MvPolynomial σ R) ∈ MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule R w (w j)
proof:
:=
  (MvPolynomial.mem_weightedHomogeneousSubmodule _ _ _ _).mpr
    (MvPolynomial.isWeightedHomogeneous_X R w j)

name: WeightedAwayBaseChange.Φ_surjective
statement: theorem Φ_surjective : Function.Surjective (Φ k w A i hk)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨n, p, hp, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective _ (X_mem_weighted w A i) y
  let T : Subring (Localization.Away (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ A)) :=
    ((algebraMap _ (Localization.Away (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ A))).comp
      (Φ k w A i hk).toRingHom).range
  suffices h : (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk _ (X_mem_weighted w A i) n p hp).val ∈ T by
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h
    exact ⟨z, HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective _ hz⟩
  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_eq_mk', IsLocalization.mk'_eq_mul_mk'_one]
  have hp' := (MvPolynomial.mem_weightedHomogeneousSubmodule _ _ _ _).mp hp
  rw [MvPolynomial.as_sum p, map_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Subring.sum_mem _ fun m hm => ?_
  have hweight := hp' (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hm)
  have hmono : (MvPolynomial.monomial m 1 : MvPolynomial σ k) ∈
      MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w (n • w i) :=
    (MvPolynomial.mem_weightedHomogeneousSubmodule _ _ _ _).mpr
      (MvPolynomial.isWeightedHomogeneous_monomial w m 1 hweight)
  refine ⟨MvPolynomial.coeff m p ⊗ₜ
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk _ (X_mem_weighted w k i) n (MvPolynomial.monomial m 1) hmono, ?_⟩
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
    HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply]
  rw [Φ_tmul, HomogeneousLocalization.val_mul, val_coeffHom, val_awayHom,
    HomogeneousLocalization.Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_eq_mk', locHom, IsLocalization.map_mk',
    IsLocalization.mk'_eq_mul_mk'_one, ← mul_assoc, ← map_mul, MvPolynomial.map_monomial, map_one,
    MvPolynomial.C_mul_monomial, mul_one]
  congr 1
  rw [IsLocalization.mk'_eq_iff_eq]
  simp

name: WeightedAwayBaseChange.tensor_isDomain
statement:
theorem tensor_isDomain [IsDomain A] :
    IsDomain (A ⊗[k] HomogeneousLocalization.Away
      (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w) (MvPolynomial.X i))
proof:
:=
  haveI := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isDomain
    (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule A w) (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero (R := A) i)
  (equiv k w A i hk).toMulEquiv.isDomain _

name: WeightedAwayBaseChange.tensor_isIntegrallyClosed
statement:
theorem tensor_isIntegrallyClosed [IsDomain A] [IsIntegrallyClosed A] (hwi : 0 < w i) :
    IsIntegrallyClosed (A ⊗[k] HomogeneousLocalization.Away
      (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule k w) (MvPolynomial.X i))
proof:
:=
  haveI := MvPolynomial.isIntegrallyClosed σ A
  haveI := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isIntegrallyClosed_of_isIntegrallyClosed
    (MvPolynomial.weightedHomogeneousSubmodule A w) hwi (X_mem_weighted w A i)
    (MvPolynomial.X_ne_zero i)
  IsIntegrallyClosed.of_equiv (equiv k w A i hk).symm

name: isProperOver_of_closedImmersion
statement:
theorem isProperOver_of_closedImmersion {k : Type u} [Field k] {X Z : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (hX : IsProperOver k X)
    (e : Z ⟶ X) [AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion e] :
    letI : Z.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
proof:
:=
      ⟨e ≫ (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of k))⟩
    IsProperOver k Z := by
  change AlgebraicGeometry.IsProper
    (e ≫ (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
  let _ : AlgebraicGeometry.IsProper
      (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := hX
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsIntegralHom.eq_of_specializes_of_eq
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hx'V, -⟩ := Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp Y.isBasis_affineOpens
    (Opens.mem_top (f.base x'))
  replace hV : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen V := hV
  have hU : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) := hV.preimage f
  have hx'U : x' ∈ f ⁻¹ᵁ V := hx'V
  have hxU : x ∈ f ⁻¹ᵁ V := h.mem_open (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).isOpen hx'U
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ : x ∈ Set.range hU.fromSpec := by rw [hU.range_fromSpec]; exact hxU
  obtain ⟨p', rfl⟩ : x' ∈ Set.range hU.fromSpec := by rw [hU.range_fromSpec]; exact hx'U
  have hpp' : p ⤳ p' := hU.fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.isInducing.specializes_iff.mp h
  have hcomm := AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec f hV hU le_rfl
  have hmap : (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (f.appLE V (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl)).base p =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (f.appLE V (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl)).base p' := by
    apply hV.fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.injective
    have e : ∀ q, hV.fromSpec.base ((AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map
        (f.appLE V (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl)).base q) = f.base (hU.fromSpec.base q) := fun q => by
      rw [← AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, ← AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.comp_apply,
        hcomm]
    rw [e, e, hf]
  congr 1
  by_contra hne
  have hint : (f.appLE V (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl).hom.IsIntegral := by
    rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.appLE]
    simpa using AlgebraicGeometry.IsIntegralHom.isIntegral_app f V hV
  have hle : p.asIdeal ≤ p'.asIdeal := (PrimeSpectrum.le_iff_specializes p p').mpr hpp'
  have hlt : p.asIdeal < p'.asIdeal :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne hle fun e => hne (PrimeSpectrum.ext e)
  algebraize [(f.appLE V (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl).hom]
  have := p.isPrime
  have := Ideal.IsIntegral.comap_lt_comap (R := Γ(Y, V)) hlt
  have e2 := congrArg PrimeSpectrum.asIdeal hmap
  exact this.ne e2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Omega.exists_small_affine
statement:
theorem Omega.exists_small_affine (p : X) (U₀ : X.Opens) (hp : p ∈ U₀) :
    ∃ (W : S.Opens) (_ : IsAffineOpen W) (V : Y.Opens) (_ : IsAffineOpen V) (U : X.Opens)
      (_ : IsAffineOpen U), p ∈ U ∧ U ≤ U₀ ∧ V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ W ∧ U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨W, hW : IsAffineOpen W, rfl⟩, hpW, -⟩ :=
    S.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (Set.mem_univ (g (f p))) isOpen_univ
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨V, hV : IsAffineOpen V, rfl⟩, hpV, hVW⟩ :=
    Y.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (show f p ∈ g ⁻¹ᵁ W from hpW) (g ⁻¹ᵁ W).isOpen
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨U, hU : IsAffineOpen U, rfl⟩, hpU, hUV⟩ :=
    X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (show p ∈ U₀ ⊓ f ⁻¹ᵁ V from ⟨hp, hpV⟩)
      (U₀ ⊓ f ⁻¹ᵁ V).isOpen
  exact ⟨W, hW, V, hV, U, hU, hpU, fun x hx => (hUV hx).1, hVW, fun x hx => (hUV hx).2⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Omega.compMap_epi
statement: theorem Omega.compMap_epi : Epi (Omega.compMap f g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Modules.epi_iff_locally_surjective_sections]
  intro U₀ s p hp
  obtain ⟨W, hW, V, hV, U, hU, hpU, hU₀, e₀, e₁⟩ := Omega.exists_small_affine f g p U₀ hp
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Omega.compMap_app_surjective_affine f g hW hV hU e₀ e₁
    ((Omega f).presheaf.map (homOfLE hU₀).op s)
  exact ⟨U, hU₀, hpU, y, hy⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Omega.baseChangeMap_compMap_exact
statement:
theorem Omega.baseChangeMap_compMap_exact :
    (ShortComplex.mk (Omega.baseChangeMap f g) (Omega.compMap f g)
      (Omega.baseChangeMap_comp_compMap f g)).Exact
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Modules.exact_iff_locally_lift_sections]
  intro U₀ x hx p hp
  obtain ⟨W, hW, V, hV, U, hU, hpU, hU₀, e₀, e₁⟩ := Omega.exists_small_affine f g p U₀ hp
  have hx' : (Omega.compMap f g).app U ((Omega (f ≫ g)).presheaf.map (homOfLE hU₀).op x) = 0 := by
    refine (congr($((Omega.compMap f g).mapPresheaf.naturality (homOfLE hU₀).op) x)).trans ?_
    change (Omega f).presheaf.map (homOfLE hU₀).op ((Omega.compMap f g).app U₀ x) = 0
    rw [hx, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Omega.compMap_app_exact_affine f g hW hV hU e₀ e₁ _ hx'
  exact ⟨U, hU₀, hpU, y, hy⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Omega.baseChangeMap_mono
statement: theorem Omega.baseChangeMap_mono [Smooth f] : Mono (Omega.baseChangeMap f g)
proof:
:= by
  let T : ShortComplex X.Modules :=
    ShortComplex.mk (0 : 0 ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (Omega g)) (Omega.baseChangeMap f g)
      zero_comp
  have hT : T.Exact := by
    rw [Scheme.Modules.exact_iff_locally_lift_sections]
    intro U₀ x hx p hp
    obtain ⟨W, hW, V, hV, U, hU, hpU, hU₀, e₀, e₁⟩ := Omega.exists_small_affine f g p U₀ hp
    refine ⟨U, hU₀, hpU, 0, ?_⟩
    have hx' : (Omega.baseChangeMap f g).app U
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (Omega g)).presheaf.map (homOfLE hU₀).op x) = 0 := by
      refine (congr($((Omega.baseChangeMap f g).mapPresheaf.naturality (homOfLE hU₀).op) x)).trans ?_
      change (Omega (f ≫ g)).presheaf.map (homOfLE hU₀).op ((Omega.baseChangeMap f g).app U₀ x) = 0
      rw [hx, map_zero]
    have h0 : ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (Omega g)).presheaf.map (homOfLE hU₀).op x = 0 :=
      Omega.baseChangeMap_app_injective_affine f g hW hV hU e₀ e₁
        (hx'.trans (map_zero ((Omega.baseChangeMap f g).app U).hom).symm)
    rw [h0]
    exact map_zero _
  exact (T.exact_iff_mono rfl).1 hT

name: exists_finite_extension_with_roots
statement:
theorem exists_finite_extension_with_roots {K : Type u} [Field K] {ι : Type v} [Finite ι]
    (b : ι → K) (q : ι → ℕ) (hq : ∀ j, 0 < q j) :
    ∃ (K' : Type u) (_ : Field K') (_ : Algebra K K') (_ : Module.Finite K K') (c : ι → K'),
      ∀ j, c j ^ q j = algebraMap K K' (b j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hz : ∀ j, ∃ z : AlgebraicClosure K, z ^ q j = algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K) (b j) :=
    fun j => IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq _ (hq j)
  choose z hzspec using hz
  have hSfin : (Set.range z).Finite := Set.finite_range z
  have : Finite (Set.range z : Set (AlgebraicClosure K)) := hSfin
  have hint : ∀ x ∈ Set.range z, IsIntegral K x := by
    rintro x ⟨j, rfl⟩
    refine IsIntegral.of_pow (hq j) ?_
    rw [hzspec j]
    exact isIntegral_algebraMap
  have : FiniteDimensional K (IntermediateField.adjoin K (Set.range z)) :=
    IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_adjoin hint
  refine ⟨IntermediateField.adjoin K (Set.range z), inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    fun j => ⟨z j, IntermediateField.subset_adjoin K (Set.range z) ⟨j, rfl⟩⟩, fun j => ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [IntermediateField.coe_pow, IntermediateField.coe_algebraMap_apply]
  exact hzspec j

name: factors_through_residueField_of_isConstant
statement:
theorem factors_through_residueField_of_isConstant {V X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    [AlgebraicGeometry.IsReduced V] (g : V ⟶ X) (x : X) (hx : ∀ v : V, g.base v = x) :
    ∃ h : V ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (X.residueField x),
      h ≫ X.fromSpecResidueField x = g
proof:
:= by
  let f : AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (X.residueField x) ⟶ X := X.fromSpecResidueField x
  letI : AlgebraicGeometry.Surjective (Limits.pullback.fst g f) := by
    rw [AlgebraicGeometry.surjective_iff, ← Set.range_eq_univ,
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Pullback.range_fst]
    ext v
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_range, Set.mem_univ]
    constructor
    · intro _
      trivial
    · intro _
      exact ⟨IsLocalRing.closedPoint _, by
        calc
          f (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (X.residueField x)) = x := by
            simpa [f] using AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.fromSpecResidueField_apply x
              (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (X.residueField x))
          _ = g v := (hx v).symm⟩
  letI : AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion (Limits.pullback.fst g f) := by
    apply AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion.of_isPreimmersion
    have hrange : Set.range (Limits.pullback.fst g f) = Set.univ := by
      rw [Set.range_eq_univ]
      exact (AlgebraicGeometry.surjective_iff _).mp inferInstance
    rw [hrange]
    exact isClosed_univ
  letI : IsIso (Limits.pullback.fst g f) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_of_isClosedImmersion_of_surjective _
  let h : V ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (X.residueField x) :=
    inv (Limits.pullback.fst g f) ≫ Limits.pullback.snd g f
  refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
  dsimp [h]
  rw [Category.assoc, ← Limits.pullback.condition, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.relativeTangent_shortExact
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.relativeTangent_shortExact {Z W S : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    (g : Z ⟶ W) (h : W ⟶ S) [AlgebraicGeometry.Smooth g] [AlgebraicGeometry.Smooth h] :
    ∃ (i : AlgebraicGeometry.relativeTangent g ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.relativeTangent (g ≫ h))
      (π : AlgebraicGeometry.relativeTangent (g ≫ h) ⟶
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj (AlgebraicGeometry.relativeTangent h))
      (hz : i ≫ π = 0),
      (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.mk i π hz).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨α, β, hz₀, hS₀⟩ := AlgebraicGeometry.Omega_shortExact_of_smooth g h
  
  have : (AlgebraicGeometry.Omega h).IsLocallyFree := AlgebraicGeometry.isLocallyFree_omega_of_smooth h
  have : (AlgebraicGeometry.Omega h).IsFiniteType := AlgebraicGeometry.Omega_isFiniteType h
  have : (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.mk α β hz₀).X₁.IsLocallyFree :=
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isLocallyFree_pullback g (AlgebraicGeometry.Omega h)).1
  have : (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.mk α β hz₀).X₂.IsLocallyFree :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.isLocallyFree_omega_of_smooth (g ≫ h)
  have : (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.mk α β hz₀).X₃.IsLocallyFree :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.isLocallyFree_omega_of_smooth g
  have : (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.mk α β hz₀).X₃.IsFiniteType :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Omega_isFiniteType g
  
  obtain ⟨i, π, hz₁, hS₁⟩ := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.dual_shortExact hS₀
  
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.dual_pullback g (AlgebraicGeometry.Omega h)
  refine ⟨i, π ≫ e.hom, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show i ≫ π ≫ e.hom = 0
    rw [← Category.assoc, hz₁, zero_comp]
  · refine shortExact_transport_of_iso (S := CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.mk i π hz₁)
      (T := CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.mk i (π ≫ e.hom) _) (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) e ?_ ?_ hS₁
    · show 𝟙 _ ≫ i = i ≫ 𝟙 _
      rw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
    · show 𝟙 _ ≫ (π ≫ e.hom) = π ≫ e.hom
      rw [Category.id_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.fromSpecResidueField_stalkMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma fromSpecResidueField_stalkMap_eq_zero (y : S) (p : Spec (S.residueField y))
    (a : S.presheaf.stalk (S.fromSpecResidueField y p)) (ha : a ∈ maximalIdeal _) :
    (S.fromSpecResidueField y).stalkMap p a = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl : p = closedPoint (S.residueField y) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have h0 : Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo (S.fromSpecResidueField y) a = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    exact ha (IsLocalHom.map_nonunit a (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne))
  rw [Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo, CommRingCat.comp_apply] at h0
  have hinj : Function.Injective (stalkClosedPointIso (S.residueField y)).hom :=
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _).1
  apply hinj
  rw [h0, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.fiberι_stalkMap_stalkMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma fiberι_stalkMap_stalkMap_eq_zero (y : S) (x' : f.fiber y)
    (a : S.presheaf.stalk (f (f.fiberι y x'))) (ha : a ∈ maximalIdeal _) :
    (f.fiberι y).stalkMap x' (f.stalkMap (f.fiberι y x') a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ b ∈ maximalIdeal (S.presheaf.stalk ((f.fiberι y ≫ f) x')),
      (f.fiberι y ≫ f).stalkMap x' b = 0 := by
    rw [f.fiber_fac]
    intro b hb
    have h0 := fromSpecResidueField_stalkMap_eq_zero (S := S) y (f.fiberToSpecResidueField y x') b hb
    rw [Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp]
    erw [CommRingCat.comp_apply]
    exact (congrArg (fun z ↦ (f.fiberToSpecResidueField y).stalkMap x' z) h0).trans (map_zero _)
  have := key a ha
  rw [Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp] at this
  erw [CommRingCat.comp_apply] at this
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.fiberStalkIdeal_ne_top
statement: lemma Scheme.Hom.fiberStalkIdeal_ne_top : f.fiberStalkIdeal x ≠ ⊤
proof:
:=
  (map_maximalIdeal_lt_top (f.stalkMap x).hom).ne

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.fiberStalkQuotMk_stalkMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma Scheme.Hom.fiberStalkQuotMk_stalkMap_eq_zero (a : S.presheaf.stalk (f x))
    (ha : a ∈ maximalIdeal _) : f.fiberStalkQuotMk x (f.stalkMap x a) = 0
proof:
:=
  Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.residue_fiberStalkQuotFromResidueField
statement:
lemma Scheme.Hom.residue_fiberStalkQuotFromResidueField :
    S.residue (f x) ≫ f.fiberStalkQuotFromResidueField x =
      f.stalkMap x ≫ f.fiberStalkQuotMk x
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.fiberStalkQuotTo_fiberι
statement:
lemma Scheme.Hom.fiberStalkQuotTo_fiberι :
    f.fiberStalkQuotTo x ≫ f.fiberι (f x) = Spec.map (f.fiberStalkQuotMk x) ≫ X.fromSpecStalk x
proof:
:=
  pullback.lift_fst _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.fiberStalkQuotTo_closedPoint
statement:
lemma Scheme.Hom.fiberStalkQuotTo_closedPoint :
    f.fiberStalkQuotTo x (closedPoint (f.fiberStalkQuot x)) = f.asFiber x
proof:
:= by
  apply (f.fiberι (f x)).isEmbedding.injective
  have h := congrArg (fun h : Spec (f.fiberStalkQuot x) ⟶ X ↦ h (closedPoint (f.fiberStalkQuot x)))
    (f.fiberStalkQuotTo_fiberι x)
  dsimp only at h
  rw [Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Spec_closedPoint,
    Scheme.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint] at h
  rw [Scheme.Hom.fiberι_asFiber]
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.fiberStalkFromStalk_surjective
statement:
lemma Scheme.Hom.fiberStalkFromStalk_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (f.fiberStalkFromStalk x)
proof:
:= by
  intro b
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := (f.fiberι (f x)).stalkMap_surjective (f.asFiber x) b
  refine ⟨(X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (f.fiberι_asFiber x).symm)).inv a, ?_⟩
  change ((X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (f.fiberι_asFiber x).symm)).inv ≫
    f.fiberStalkFromStalk x) a = _
  rw [Scheme.Hom.fiberStalkFromStalk, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.fiberStalkIdeal_le_ker
statement:
lemma Scheme.Hom.fiberStalkIdeal_le_ker :
    f.fiberStalkIdeal x ≤ RingHom.ker (f.fiberStalkFromStalk x).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro a ha
  rw [Ideal.mem_comap, RingHom.mem_ker]
  change (f.stalkMap x ≫ f.fiberStalkFromStalk x) a = 0
  have h := Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_congr_point f x _ (f.fiberι_asFiber x).symm
  unfold Scheme.Hom.fiberStalkFromStalk
  rw [← Category.assoc, h, Category.assoc, CommRingCat.comp_apply]
  refine fiberι_stalkMap_stalkMap_eq_zero f (f x) (f.asFiber x) _ ?_
  have : IsLocalHom (S.presheaf.stalkCongr
      (.of_eq (congrArg f (f.fiberι_asFiber x).symm))).hom.hom := isLocalHom_of_isIso _
  intro hu
  exact ha (IsLocalHom.map_nonunit a hu)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo_eq_of_eq_SpecMap_fromSpecStalk
statement:
lemma Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo_eq_of_eq_SpecMap_fromSpecStalk {R : CommRingCat.{u}} [IsLocalRing R]
    (h : Spec R ⟶ X) (x : X) (φ : X.presheaf.stalk x ⟶ R) [IsLocalHom φ.hom]
    (e : h = Spec.map φ ≫ X.fromSpecStalk x) :
    Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo h = (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (by
      rw [e, Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, Spec_closedPoint, Scheme.fromSpecStalk_closedPoint]))).hom ≫ φ
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := SpecToEquivOfLocalRing_eq_iff.mp
    ((SpecToEquivOfLocalRing X R).right_inv ⟨x, φ, inferInstance⟩)
  exact h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp_eq_transport
statement:
lemma Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp_eq_transport {Z : Scheme.{u}} (ι : Z ⟶ X) {B : CommRingCat.{u}}
    {z₁ z₂ : Z} (hz : z₁ = z₂) {x : X} (hx : ι z₁ = x)
    (t : Z.presheaf.stalk z₁ ⟶ B) (π : X.presheaf.stalk x ⟶ B)
    (H : ι.stalkMap z₁ ≫ t = (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hx)).hom ≫ π) :
    (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq (show x = ι z₂ by rw [← hz, hx]))).hom ≫ ι.stalkMap z₂ ≫
      (Z.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hz.symm)).hom ≫ t = π
proof:
:= by
  subst hz hx
  simpa using H

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.ker_le_fiberStalkIdeal
statement:
lemma Scheme.Hom.ker_le_fiberStalkIdeal :
    RingHom.ker (f.fiberStalkFromStalk x).hom ≤ f.fiberStalkIdeal x
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker] at ha
  have hg : f.fiberStalkQuotTo x (closedPoint (f.fiberStalkQuot x)) = f.asFiber x :=
    f.fiberStalkQuotTo_closedPoint x
  have hx : f.fiberι (f x) (f.fiberStalkQuotTo x (closedPoint (f.fiberStalkQuot x))) = x := by
    rw [hg, Scheme.Hom.fiberι_asFiber]
  have h1 := Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo_eq_of_eq_SpecMap_fromSpecStalk
    (f.fiberStalkQuotTo x ≫ f.fiberι (f x)) x (f.fiberStalkQuotMk x) (f.fiberStalkQuotTo_fiberι x)
  rw [Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo_comp] at h1
  have h2 := Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp_eq_transport (f.fiberι (f x)) hg hx
    (Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo (f.fiberStalkQuotTo x)) (f.fiberStalkQuotMk x) h1
  have h3 : f.fiberStalkFromStalk x ≫
      (((f.fiber (f x)).presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hg.symm)).hom ≫
        Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo (f.fiberStalkQuotTo x)) = f.fiberStalkQuotMk x := by
    rw [← h2]
    rfl
  have h4 : f.fiberStalkQuotMk x a =
      ((((f.fiber (f x)).presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hg.symm)).hom ≫
        Scheme.stalkClosedPointTo (f.fiberStalkQuotTo x))) (f.fiberStalkFromStalk x a) := by
    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, h3]
  have ha' : f.fiberStalkFromStalk x a = 0 := ha
  refine Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp ?_
  change f.fiberStalkQuotMk x a = 0
  rw [h4, ha', map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.ker_fiberStalkFromStalk
statement:
lemma Scheme.Hom.ker_fiberStalkFromStalk :
    RingHom.ker (f.fiberStalkFromStalk x).hom = f.fiberStalkIdeal x
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (f.ker_le_fiberStalkIdeal x) (f.fiberStalkIdeal_le_ker x)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.fiber_stalk_iso
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.fiber_stalk_iso {X S : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (x : X) :
    Nonempty ((f.fiber (f.base x)).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber x) ≃+*
      X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ Ideal.map (f.stalkMap x).hom (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (S.presheaf.stalk (f.base x))))
proof:
:=
  ⟨((f.fiberStalkFromStalk x).hom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective
      (f.fiberStalkFromStalk_surjective x)).symm.trans
    (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq (f.ker_fiberStalkFromStalk x))⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkMapOfEq_germ
statement:
theorem stalkMapOfEq_germ {x : X} {z : Y} (hx : p.base x = z) (U : Y.Opens) (hz : z ∈ U)
    (r : Γ(Y, U)) :
    stalkMapOfEq p hx (Y.presheaf.germ U z hz r) =
      X.presheaf.germ (p ⁻¹ᵁ U) x (show p.base x ∈ U from hx ▸ hz) (p.app U r)
proof:
:= by
  subst hx
  simp only [stalkMapOfEq, TopCat.Presheaf.stalkCongr, CommRingCat.hom_comp, RingHom.comp_apply]
  erw [TopCat.Presheaf.germ_stalkSpecializes_apply]
  exact Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply p U x hz r

name: AlgebraicGeometry.finrank_residueField_congr
statement:
private theorem finrank_residueField_congr {A S : Type*} [CommRing A] [CommRing S] [IsLocalRing A]
    [IsLocalRing S] (f g : A →+* S) [IsLocalHom f] [IsLocalHom g] (h : f = g) :
    (letI := (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map f).toAlgebra
     Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField S)) =
    (letI := (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map g).toAlgebra
     Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField S))
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.finrank_residueField_stalkMapOfEq
statement:
theorem finrank_residueField_stalkMapOfEq {x : X} {z : Y} (hx : p.base x = z) :
    (letI := (IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map (stalkMapOfEq p hx)).toAlgebra
     Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Y.presheaf.stalk z))
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk x))) = p.residueDegree x
proof:
:= by
  subst hx
  have h : stalkMapOfEq p rfl = (p.stalkMap x).hom := by
    ext a
    simp [stalkMapOfEq, TopCat.Presheaf.stalkCongr]
  exact (finrank_residueField_congr _ _ h).trans rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.fromSpec_mem_of_isAffineOpen
statement:
theorem fromSpec_mem_of_isAffineOpen {X : Scheme.{u}} {W : X.Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    (𝔮 : Spec Γ(X, W)) : hW.fromSpec 𝔮 ∈ W
proof:
:= by
  have : hW.fromSpec 𝔮 ∈ Set.range hW.fromSpec := ⟨𝔮, rfl⟩
  rwa [hW.range_fromSpec] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.primeIdealOf_fromSpec
statement:
theorem primeIdealOf_fromSpec {X : Scheme.{u}} {W : X.Opens} (hW : IsAffineOpen W)
    (𝔮 : Spec Γ(X, W)) :
    hW.primeIdealOf ⟨hW.fromSpec 𝔮, fromSpec_mem_of_isAffineOpen hW 𝔮⟩ = 𝔮
proof:
:= by
  apply hW.fromSpec.isOpenEmbedding.injective
  exact hW.fromSpec_primeIdealOf _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.comap_primeIdealOf_app
statement:
theorem comap_primeIdealOf_app {x : X} (hx : x ∈ p ⁻¹ᵁ U) :
    (hW.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal.comap (appPreimage p U) =
      (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨p.base x, hx⟩).asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  have h := IsAffineOpen.comap_primeIdealOf_appLE (f := p) U hU (p ⁻¹ᵁ U) hW le_rfl hx
  rw [← Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE] at h
  exact congr($(h).asIdeal)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.base_fromSpec_eq
statement:
theorem base_fromSpec_eq (𝔮 : Spec Γ(X, p ⁻¹ᵁ U))
    (h𝔮 : 𝔮.asIdeal.comap (appPreimage p U) = (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨z, hz⟩).asIdeal) :
    p.base (hW.fromSpec 𝔮) = z
proof:
:= by
  have hx := fromSpec_mem_of_isAffineOpen hW 𝔮
  have h1 := comap_primeIdealOf_app p hU hW hx
  rw [primeIdealOf_fromSpec hW 𝔮, h𝔮] at h1
  have h2 : hU.primeIdealOf ⟨z, hz⟩ = hU.primeIdealOf ⟨p.base (hW.fromSpec 𝔮), hx⟩ :=
    PrimeSpectrum.ext h1
  have h3 := hU.fromSpec_primeIdealOf ⟨z, hz⟩
  rw [h2, hU.fromSpec_primeIdealOf] at h3
  exact h3

name: AlgebraicGeometry.fiberEquiv_apply
statement: theorem fiberEquiv_apply (𝔮) : (fiberEquiv p hU hW hz 𝔮).1 = hW.fromSpec 𝔮.1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Omega_shortExact_of_smooth
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Omega_shortExact_of_smooth {X Y S : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ S) [AlgebraicGeometry.Smooth f] :
    ∃ (α : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (AlgebraicGeometry.Omega g) ⟶
        AlgebraicGeometry.Omega (f ≫ g))
      (β : AlgebraicGeometry.Omega (f ≫ g) ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Omega f) (hz : α ≫ β = 0),
      (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.mk α β hz).ShortExact
proof:
:=
  ⟨AlgebraicGeometry.Omega.baseChangeMap f g, AlgebraicGeometry.Omega.compMap f g,
    AlgebraicGeometry.Omega.baseChangeMap_comp_compMap f g,
    CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' (AlgebraicGeometry.Omega.baseChangeMap_compMap_exact f g)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Omega.baseChangeMap_mono f g) (AlgebraicGeometry.Omega.compMap_epi f g)⟩

name: KaehlerDifferential.mapBaseChange_injective_of_formallySmooth
statement:
theorem KaehlerDifferential.mapBaseChange_injective_of_formallySmooth
    (R : Type u) (A : Type v) (B : Type w) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra A B] [Algebra R B] [IsScalarTower R A B] [Algebra.FormallySmooth A B] :
    Function.Injective (KaehlerDifferential.mapBaseChange R A B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (Algebra.H1Cotangent.exact_δ_mapBaseChange R A B x).mp hx
  rw [Subsingleton.elim y 0, map_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.eq_of_comp_fromSpecResidueField_comp_eq
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.eq_of_comp_fromSpecResidueField_comp_eq {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} (str : X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType str] (x : X) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X))
    {S : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} (a b : S ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (X.residueField x))
    (h : a ≫ X.fromSpecResidueField x ≫ str = b ≫ X.fromSpecResidueField x ≫ str) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← AlgebraicGeometry.SpecMap_residueFieldIsoBase_inv str x hx] at h
  exact (cancel_mono _).mp h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.eq_of_constant_at_closedPoint
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.eq_of_constant_at_closedPoint {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} (str : X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType str] (x : X) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X))
    {S : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} [AlgebraicGeometry.IsReduced S] (a b : S ⟶ X)
    (ha : ∀ s : S, a.base s = x) (hb : ∀ s : S, b.base s = x)
    (h : a ≫ str = b ≫ str) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := factors_through_residueField_of_isConstant a x ha
  obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := factors_through_residueField_of_isConstant b x hb
  have : a' = b' := by
    apply AlgebraicGeometry.eq_of_comp_fromSpecResidueField_comp_eq str x hx
    rw [← Category.assoc, ha', ← Category.assoc, hb']
    exact h
  rw [← ha', ← hb', this]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isClosed_singleton_image_of_isClosed_singleton
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.isClosed_singleton_image_of_isClosed_singleton {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    {Y X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    (strY : Y ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType strY]
    (strX : X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType strX]
    (g : Y ⟶ X) (hg : g ≫ strX = strY) (y : Y) (hy : IsClosed ({y} : Set Y)) :
    IsClosed ({g.base y} : Set X)
proof:
:= by
  let q : AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of k) ⟶ X := AlgebraicGeometry.pointOfClosedPoint strY y hy ≫ g
  have hq : q ≫ strX = 𝟙 _ := by
    simp only [q, Category.assoc, hg, AlgebraicGeometry.pointOfClosedPoint_comp]
  have hmem : IsClosed ({q (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k)} : Set X) :=
    (AlgebraicGeometry.pointEquivClosedPoint strX ⟨q, hq⟩).2
  have hpt : q (IsLocalRing.closedPoint k) = g y :=
    congrArg g (AlgebraicGeometry.pointOfClosedPoint_apply strY y hy _)
  rwa [hpt] at hmem

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.exists_closedImmersion_projectiveSpaceOver_of_generated
statement:
theorem exists_closedImmersion_projectiveSpaceOver_of_generated (φ : A →+* 𝒜 0) (s : Finset B)
    (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, x ∈ 𝒜 1)
    (hgen : ∀ n, 0 < n → ∀ x ∈ 𝒜 n,
      x ∈ Subring.closure (Set.range (fun a : A => ((φ a : 𝒜 0) : B)) ∪ (↑s : Set B))) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (j : Proj 𝒜 ⟶ ProjectiveSpaceOver n A),
      IsClosedImmersion j ∧
        j ≫ ProjectiveSpaceOver.toSpecBase n A =
          Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜 ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set N := s.card with hN
  let v : Fin (N + 1) → B := Fin.cases 0 (fun i => ((s.equivFin.symm i : B)))
  have hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ 𝒜 1 := by
    intro i
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · exact zero_mem _
    · exact hs _ (s.equivFin.symm j).2
  have hsv : (↑s : Set B) ⊆ Set.range v := by
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨Fin.succ (s.equivFin ⟨x, hx⟩), ?_⟩
    simp [v]
  let φ' : A →+* B := coeffHom' 𝒜 φ
  let ψ0 : MvPolynomial (Fin (N + 1)) A →+* B := MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ' v
  
  have hψ0 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (N + 1)) A),
      p ∈ MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (N + 1)) A n → ψ0 p ∈ 𝒜 n := by
    intro n p hp
    have hp' : p.IsHomogeneous n := hp
    have hsum : ψ0 p = ∑ d ∈ p.support, ψ0 (MvPolynomial.monomial d (MvPolynomial.coeff d p)) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [MvPolynomial.as_sum p]
      rw [map_sum]
    rw [hsum]
    refine sum_mem fun d hd => ?_
    rw [MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_monomial]
    have h1 : φ' (MvPolynomial.coeff d p) ∈ 𝒜 0 := (φ _).2
    have hw : (∑ i ∈ d.support, d i • (1 : ℕ)) = n := by
      have := hp' (MvPolynomial.mem_support_iff.mp hd)
      rw [Finsupp.weight_apply] at this
      simpa [Finsupp.sum, Pi.one_apply] using this
    have h2 : (d.prod fun i k => v i ^ k) ∈ 𝒜 n := by
      rw [Finsupp.prod, ← hw]
      exact SetLike.prod_pow_mem_graded 𝒜 (fun _ => 1) v (fun i => d i) (fun i _ => hv i)
    rw [← zero_add n]
    exact SetLike.mul_mem_graded h1 h2
  let ψ : MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (N + 1)) A →+*ᵍ 𝒜 :=
    { toRingHom := ψ0, map_mem := fun {n} {p} hp => hψ0 n p hp }
  have hψC : ∀ a : A, ψ (MvPolynomial.C a) = (φ a : B) := fun a =>
    MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C φ' v a
  have hψX : ∀ i, ψ (MvPolynomial.X i) = v i := fun i => MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X' φ' v i
  
  have hsurj : ∀ n, 0 < n → ∀ y ∈ 𝒜 n,
      ∃ p ∈ MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (N + 1)) A n, ψ p = y := by
    intro n hn y hy
    have hle : Subring.closure (Set.range (fun a : A => ((φ a : 𝒜 0) : B)) ∪ (↑s : Set B)) ≤
        ψ0.range := by
      rw [Subring.closure_le]
      rintro x (⟨a, rfl⟩ | hx)
      · exact RingHom.mem_range.mpr ⟨MvPolynomial.C a, hψC a⟩
      · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hsv hx
        exact RingHom.mem_range.mpr ⟨MvPolynomial.X i, hψX i⟩
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := RingHom.mem_range.mp (hle (hgen n hn y hy))
    refine ⟨(DirectSum.decompose (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (N + 1)) A) p n :
      MvPolynomial (Fin (N + 1)) A), SetLike.coe_mem _, ?_⟩
    rw [GradedRingHom.map_directSumDecompose]
    change (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 (ψ0 p) n : B) = y
    rw [hp]
    exact DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same 𝒜 hy
  
  have hψ : HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜 ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (N + 1)) A)).map ψ := by
    rw [HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le]
    intro d hd y hy
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := hsurj d hd y hy
    show ψ p ∈ Ideal.map ψ
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (N + 1)) A)).toIdeal
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem _ hd hp)
  refine ⟨N, Proj.map ψ hψ, isClosedImmersion_map ψ hψ hsurj, ?_⟩
  show Proj.map ψ hψ ≫ (Proj.toSpecZero (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (N + 1)) A) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap A (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (N + 1)) A 0)))) =
      Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜 ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)
  rw [← Category.assoc, AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.proj_map_toSpecZero ψ hψ, Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp]
  congr 2
  refine CommRingCat.hom_ext (RingHom.ext fun a => Subtype.ext ?_)
  exact hψC a

name: GradedRing.mem_subring_of_pos_of_irrelevant_le_span_one
statement:
theorem GradedRing.mem_subring_of_pos_of_irrelevant_le_span_one
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] (𝒜 : ℕ → AddSubgroup A) [GradedRing 𝒜] (C : Subring A)
    (h1 : ∀ x ∈ 𝒜 1, x ∈ C)
    (h : (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).toIdeal ≤ Ideal.span ((𝒜 1 : AddSubgroup A) : Set A)) :
    ∀ n, 0 < n → ∀ x ∈ 𝒜 n, x ∈ C
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ 𝒜 (k + 1), x ∈ C := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact h1
    | succ k ih =>
      intro x hx
      have hx' : x ∈ Ideal.span ((𝒜 1 : AddSubgroup A) : Set A) :=
        h (HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem 𝒜 (Nat.succ_pos _) hx)
      have hP : ∀ a : A, (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 (a * x) (k + 1 + 1) : A) ∈ C := by
        refine Submodule.span_induction
          (p := fun y _ => ∀ a : A, (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 (a * y) (k + 1 + 1) : A) ∈ C)
          ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hx'
        · intro b hb a
          rw [DirectSum.coe_decompose_mul_of_right_mem_of_le 𝒜 hb (Nat.le_add_left 1 (k + 1)),
            Nat.add_sub_cancel]
          exact C.mul_mem (ih _ (SetLike.coe_mem _)) (h1 b hb)
        · intro a
          rw [mul_zero, DirectSum.decompose_zero, DirectSum.zero_apply, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]
          exact C.zero_mem
        · intro y z _ _ hy hz a
          rw [mul_add, DirectSum.decompose_add, DirectSum.add_apply, AddMemClass.coe_add]
          exact C.add_mem (hy a) (hz a)
        · intro c y _ hy a
          rw [smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc]
          exact hy (a * c)
      have h1' := hP 1
      rwa [one_mul, DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same 𝒜 hx] at h1'
  intro n hn x hx
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = k + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  exact key k x hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.exists_finset_degOne_mem_closure_of_generatedInDegreeOne
statement:
theorem exists_finset_degOne_mem_closure_of_generatedInDegreeOne (hS : S.GeneratedInDegreeOne)
    [hft : (S.part 1).IsFiniteType] (V : X.affineOpens) :
    ∃ s : Finset (S.sectionsRing V.1), (∀ x ∈ s, x ∈ S.sectionsGrading V.1 1) ∧
      ∀ n, 0 < n → ∀ x ∈ S.sectionsGrading V.1 n,
        x ∈ Subring.closure
          (Set.range (S.sectionsUnitHom V.1) ∪ (↑s : Set (S.sectionsRing V.1)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := S.quasicoherent 1
  have hfin : Module.Finite Γ(X, V.1) Γ(S.part 1, V.1) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.finite_sections_of_isFiniteType (S.part 1) V.2
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hfin.fg_top
  refine ⟨t.image (S.ofPiece V.1 1), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨a, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    exact ⟨a, rfl⟩
  set C := Subring.closure
    (Set.range (S.sectionsUnitHom V.1) ∪ (↑(t.image (S.ofPiece V.1 1)) : Set (S.sectionsRing V.1)))
    with hC
  have hunit : ∀ r, S.sectionsUnitHom V.1 r ∈ C := fun r =>
    Subring.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨r, rfl⟩)
  have hpiece : ∀ a : Γ(S.part 1, V.1), S.ofPiece V.1 1 a ∈ C := by
    intro a
    have ha : a ∈ Submodule.span Γ(X, V.1) (↑t : Set Γ(S.part 1, V.1)) := by
      rw [ht]; trivial
    refine Submodule.span_induction
      (p := fun (a : Γ(S.part 1, V.1)) _ => S.ofPiece V.1 1 a ∈ C) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ha
    · intro a hat
      exact Subring.subset_closure
        (Or.inr (Finset.mem_coe.mpr (Finset.mem_image_of_mem (S.ofPiece V.1 1) hat)))
    · have e : S.ofPiece V.1 1 (0 : Γ(S.part 1, V.1)) = 0 :=
        map_zero (DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece V.1) 1)
      exact Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun x => x ∈ C) e) C.zero_mem
    · intro a b _ _ ha hb
      have e : S.ofPiece V.1 1 (a + b) = S.ofPiece V.1 1 a + S.ofPiece V.1 1 b :=
        map_add (DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece V.1) 1) a b
      rw [e]
      exact C.add_mem ha hb
    · intro r a _ ha
      have e := S.sectionsUnitHom_mul_ofPiece V.1 r a
      rw [← e]
      exact C.mul_mem (hunit r) ha
  have hdeg1 : ∀ x ∈ S.sectionsGrading V.1 1, x ∈ C := by
    rintro x ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact hpiece a
  exact GradedRing.mem_subring_of_pos_of_irrelevant_le_span_one (S.sectionsGrading V.1) C hdeg1
    (S.irrelevant_le_span_degOne_of_generatedInDegreeOne hS V)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.affineIso_hom_toSpecZero_sectionsUnit
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.affineIso_hom_toSpecZero_sectionsUnit
    {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} (S : X.GradedQCAlgebra) (V : X.affineOpens) :
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.affineIso S V).hom ≫
        AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.toSpecZero (S.sectionsGrading V.1) ≫
          AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (S.sectionsUnit V.1)) =
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj S).hom ∣_ V.1) ≫ V.2.isoSpec.hom
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ : ∃ P : AlgebraicGeometry.Proj (S.sectionsGrading V.1) ⟶ V.1.toScheme,
      P = S.toGradedAffineAlgebra.projToOpen ⟨V.1, V.2⟩ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have h : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.affineIso S V).inv ≫
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj S).hom ∣_ V.1) = P := by
    rw [hP]
    apply (cancel_mono V.1.ι).mp
    rw [Category.assoc, morphismRestrict_ι, ← Category.assoc,
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.affineIso_inv_ι]
    exact S.toGradedAffineAlgebra.projChart_hom ⟨V.1, V.2⟩
  have h2 : P ≫ V.2.isoSpec.hom =
      AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.toSpecZero (S.sectionsGrading V.1) ≫
        AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (S.sectionsUnit V.1)) := by
    rw [hP]
    show (AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.toSpecZero (S.sectionsGrading V.1) ≫
      AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (S.toGradedAffineAlgebra.unitZero ⟨V.1, V.2⟩)) ≫ V.2.isoSpec.inv) ≫
      V.2.isoSpec.hom = _
    rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
    rfl
  rw [Iso.inv_comp_eq] at h
  rw [h, Category.assoc, h2]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsProjectiveMorphism.exists_closedImmersion_projectiveSpaceOver
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.IsProjectiveMorphism.exists_closedImmersion_projectiveSpaceOver
    {X S : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [AlgebraicGeometry.IsProjectiveMorphism f]
    (V : S.affineOpens) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (j : (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).toScheme ⟶ ProjectiveSpaceOver n Γ(S, V.1)),
      AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion j ∧
        j ≫ ProjectiveSpaceOver.toSpecBase n Γ(S, V.1) = (f ∣_ V.1) ≫ V.2.isoSpec.hom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨𝒜, i, hgen, hft, hi, rfl⟩ :=
    (‹AlgebraicGeometry.IsProjectiveMorphism f›).exists_closed_immersion
  have := hft
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hcl⟩ := 𝒜.exists_finset_degOne_mem_closure_of_generatedInDegreeOne hgen V
  obtain ⟨n, j', hj', hcomp⟩ :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Proj.exists_closedImmersion_projectiveSpaceOver_of_generated
      (𝒜.sectionsGrading V.1) (𝒜.sectionsUnit V.1) s hs hcl
  have := hj'
  have := hi
  have hci1 : AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion
      (i ∣_ ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj 𝒜).hom ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)) := inferInstance
  have hci2 : AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.affineIso 𝒜 V).hom := inferInstance
  have hci3 : AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.affineIso 𝒜 V).hom ≫ j') :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion.comp _ _
  have hci4 : AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion
      ((i ∣_ ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj 𝒜).hom ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)) ≫
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.affineIso 𝒜 V).hom ≫ j') :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion.comp _ _
  refine ⟨n, (i ∣_ ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj 𝒜).hom ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)) ≫
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.affineIso 𝒜 V).hom ≫ j', hci4, ?_⟩
  have key : ((i ∣_ ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj 𝒜).hom ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)) ≫
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.affineIso 𝒜 V).hom ≫ j') ≫
        ProjectiveSpaceOver.toSpecBase n Γ(S, V.1) =
      ((i ∣_ ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj 𝒜).hom ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)) ≫
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj 𝒜).hom ∣_ V.1)) ≫ V.2.isoSpec.hom := by
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [hcomp, AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.affineIso_hom_toSpecZero_sectionsUnit]
  rw [morphismRestrict_comp]
  exact key

name: MiyaokaMori.Statement.pointIdeal_comap_ι_eq_top_of_notMem
statement:
theorem MiyaokaMori.Statement.pointIdeal_comap_ι_eq_top_of_notMem {Y : Scheme.{u}} (c : Y)
    (V : Y.Opens) (hV : c ∉ V) :
    (MiyaokaMori.Statement.pointIdeal Y c).comap V.ι = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply (Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_eq_bot_iff _).mp
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.support_comap]
  ext t
  change V.ι t ∈ ((MiyaokaMori.Statement.pointIdeal Y c).support : Set Y) ↔ t ∈ (∅ : Set V)
  rw [MiyaokaMori.Statement.pointIdeal, Scheme.Hom.support_ker, Scheme.range_fromSpecResidueField]
  simp only [Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
  intro h
  have ht : V.ι t ∈ (V : Set Y) := t.2
  obtain ⟨y, hyV, hyc⟩ := mem_closure_iff.mp h (V : Set Y) V.isOpen ht
  exact hV (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hyc ▸ hyV)

name: GroupSchemeAction.coaction.range_subset
proof:
:= GroupSchemeAction.coaction.algebra (k := k) (A := A) U
    Set.range (GroupSchemeAction.coaction.act' α U) ⊆
      Set.range ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec A).hom ⁻¹ᵁ U.1).ι := by
  let _ := GroupSchemeAction.coaction.algebra (k := k) (A := A) U
  
  
  have key : GroupSchemeAction.coaction.act' α U ≫ (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec A).hom =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackSpecIso k (LaurentPolynomial k) (A.sectionsRing U.1)).inv ≫
        CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.snd _ _ ≫
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.affineIso A U).inv ≫
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec A).hom ⁻¹ᵁ U.1).ι ≫
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec A).hom := by
    unfold GroupSchemeAction.coaction.act' GroupSchemeAction.coaction.toDom
    rw [CategoryTheory.Category.assoc, α.act_over, CategoryTheory.Category.assoc,
      CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.lift_snd_assoc]
    simp only [CategoryTheory.Category.assoc]
  rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Opens.range_ι, SetLike.mem_coe,
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.mem_preimage, ← AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.comp_apply, key]

name: ProjectiveSpace.IsLocalTupleAt.pullbackAlong
statement:
theorem ProjectiveSpace.IsLocalTupleAt.pullbackAlong {k : Type u} [Field k] {N : ℕ}
    {X' X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X'] [IsIntegral X]
    [X'.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (f : X' ⟶ X) [f.IsOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsDominant f]
    (g : X.PartialMap (ProjectiveSpace N k))
    (hd : Dense ((f ⁻¹ᵁ g.domain : X'.Opens) : Set X')) (x' : X')
    {a : Fin (N + 1) → X.presheaf.stalk (f x')}
    (h : ProjectiveSpace.IsLocalTupleAt k N g.fromFunctionField (f x') a) :
    ProjectiveSpace.IsLocalTupleAt k N (g.pullbackAlong f hd).fromFunctionField x'
      (fun i => (f.stalkMap x').hom (a i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hspan, hg⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ, hpull⟩ := Scheme.PartialMap.exists_functionField_hom_pullbackAlong f g hd
  have hsq : ∀ i, θ.hom (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (f x')) X.functionField (a i)) =
      algebraMap (X'.presheaf.stalk x') X'.functionField ((f.stalkMap x').hom (a i)) := fun i =>
    congrArg (fun r => r (a i)) (hθ x')
  
  have hc : θ.hom.comp (X.stalkStructureHom k (genericPoint X)) =
      X'.stalkStructureHom k (genericPoint X') := by
    have h1 := X.stalkSpecializes_comp_stalkStructureHom k (genericPoint_specializes (f x'))
    have h2 := X'.stalkSpecializes_comp_stalkStructureHom k (genericPoint_specializes x')
    have h3 := Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp_stalkStructureHom k f x'
    have h1' : (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (f x')) X.functionField).comp
        (X.stalkStructureHom k (f x')) = X.stalkStructureHom k (genericPoint X) := h1
    have h2' : (algebraMap (X'.presheaf.stalk x') X'.functionField).comp
        (X'.stalkStructureHom k x') = X'.stalkStructureHom k (genericPoint X') := h2
    rw [← h1', ← RingHom.comp_assoc, hθ x', RingHom.comp_assoc, h3, h2']
  have hspan1 : Ideal.span (Set.range fun i =>
      θ.hom (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (f x')) X.functionField (a i))) = ⊤ := by
    have := congrArg (Ideal.map θ.hom) hspan
    rw [Ideal.map_span, Ideal.map_top, ← Set.range_comp] at this
    exact this
  have hfun : (fun i => θ.hom (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (f x')) X.functionField (a i))) =
      fun i => algebraMap (X'.presheaf.stalk x') X'.functionField ((f.stalkMap x').hom (a i)) :=
    funext hsq
  have hspan2 : Ideal.span (Set.range fun i =>
      algebraMap (X'.presheaf.stalk x') X'.functionField ((f.stalkMap x').hom (a i))) = ⊤ := by
    rw [← hfun]; exact hspan1
  refine ⟨hspan2, ?_⟩
  rw [hpull, hg]
  exact (ProjectiveSpace.tuplePoint_map k N (X.stalkStructureHom k (genericPoint X))
      (X'.stalkStructureHom k (genericPoint X')) θ.hom hc _ hspan hspan1).trans
    (ProjectiveSpace.tuplePoint_congr k N _ _ _ _ hspan1 hspan2 hfun)

statement:
theorem appLE_comp_appLE_apply {X Y Z : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (U : Z.Opens) (V : Y.Opens) (W : X.Opens) (e₁ : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U) (e₂ : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (x : Γ(Z, U)) :
    (f.appLE V W e₂).hom ((g.appLE U V e₁).hom x) =
      ((f ≫ g).appLE U W (e₂.trans ((TopologicalSpace.Opens.map f.base).map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE e₁)).le)).hom x
proof:
:= by
  have h := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE f g U V W e₁ e₂
  exact congrArg (fun φ : Γ(Z, U) ⟶ Γ(X, W) => φ.hom x) h

name: GroupSchemeAction.appLE_congr_apply
statement:
theorem appLE_congr_apply {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} {f g : X ⟶ Y} (h : f = g)
    (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens) (e : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U) (e' : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U) (x : Γ(Y, U)) :
    (f.appLE U V e).hom x = (g.appLE U V e').hom x
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: GroupSchemeAction.appLE_top_apply
statement:
theorem appLE_top_apply {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (W : X.Opens)
    (e : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ ⊤) (x : Γ(Y, ⊤)) :
    (f.appLE ⊤ W e).hom x =
      (X.presheaf.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op).hom (f.appTop.hom x)
proof: := rfl

name: GroupSchemeAction.comp_appTop_apply
statement:
theorem comp_appTop_apply {X Y Z : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (x : Γ(Z, ⊤)) :
    ((f ≫ g).appTop).hom x = (f.appTop).hom ((g.appTop).hom x)
