    (hφ : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a b : A.carrier.val.obj (Opposite.op U)),
      (show Γ(T, g ⁻¹ᵁ U) from φ.app U (A.mul.app U (tensorSections A.carrier A.carrier U a b))) =
        (show Γ(T, g ⁻¹ᵁ U) from φ.app U a) * (show Γ(T, g ⁻¹ᵁ U) from φ.app U b)) :
    A.mul ≫ φ = (φ ⊗ₘ φ) ≫ pushforwardUnitMul g
proof:
:= by
  apply tensorObj_hom_ext
  intro U a b
  exact (hφ U a b).trans (tensorHom_pushforwardUnitMul_val_app_tensorSections A g φ U a b).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.QCAlgebra.isAlgebraMap_mul_of_mul_comp
statement:
theorem isAlgebraMap_mul_of_mul_comp (h : A.mul ≫ φ = (φ ⊗ₘ φ) ≫ pushforwardUnitMul g) :
    ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a b : A.carrier.val.obj (Opposite.op U)),
      (show Γ(T, g ⁻¹ᵁ U) from φ.app U (A.mul.app U (tensorSections A.carrier A.carrier U a b))) =
        (show Γ(T, g ⁻¹ᵁ U) from φ.app U a) * (show Γ(T, g ⁻¹ᵁ U) from φ.app U b)
proof:
:= by
  intro U a b
  have h' : (A.mul ≫ φ).val.app (Opposite.op U) (tensorSections A.carrier A.carrier U a b) =
      ((φ ⊗ₘ φ) ≫ pushforwardUnitMul g).val.app (Opposite.op U)
        (tensorSections A.carrier A.carrier U a b) := by rw [h]
  exact h'.trans (tensorHom_pushforwardUnitMul_val_app_tensorSections A g φ U a b)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.QCAlgebra.one_comp_eq_of_isAlgebraMap_one
statement:
theorem one_comp_eq_of_isAlgebraMap_one
    (φ₁ φ₂ : A.carrier ⟶ (pushforward g).obj (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf))
    (h₁ : ∀ U : X.Opens, (show Γ(T, g ⁻¹ᵁ U) from φ₁.app U (A.one.app U (show Γ(X, U) from 1))) = 1)
    (h₂ : ∀ U : X.Opens, (show Γ(T, g ⁻¹ᵁ U) from φ₂.app U (A.one.app U (show Γ(X, U) from 1))) = 1) :
    A.one ≫ φ₁ = A.one ≫ φ₂
proof:
:=
  unit_hom_ext fun U => (h₁ U).trans (h₂ U).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorHom_homEquiv_pushforwardUnitMul
statement:
theorem tensorHom_homEquiv_pushforwardUnitMul (g : T ⟶ X) {M N : X.Modules}
    (a : (pullback g).obj M ⟶ 𝟙_ T.Modules) (b : (pullback g).obj N ⟶ 𝟙_ T.Modules) :
    ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).homEquiv _ _ a ⊗ₘ
        (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).homEquiv _ _ b) ≫ pushforwardUnitMul g =
      (pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).homEquiv _ _
        (pullbackTensorObjHom g M N ≫ (a ⊗ₘ b) ≫ (λ_ (𝟙_ T.Modules)).hom)
proof:
:= by
  let _ := pushforwardLaxMonoidal g
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right, Functor.map_comp, homEquiv_pullbackTensorObjHom,
    Adjunction.homEquiv_unit, Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  unfold pushforwardUnitMul
  rw [← MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, Category.assoc,
    CategoryTheory.Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural_assoc]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsGOne_app_of_one_comp
statement:
theorem sectionsGOne_app_of_one_comp (h1 : S.one ≫ ι 0 = A.one) (U : X.Opens) :
    (ι 0).app U (S.sectionsGOne U) = (1 : A.sectionsRing U)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun φ : 𝟙_ X.Modules ⟶ A.carrier => φ.app U (1 : Γ(X, U))) h1
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsGMul_app_of_mul_comp
statement:
theorem sectionsGMul_app_of_mul_comp
    (h2 : ∀ m n, S.mul m n ≫ ι (m + n) = (ι m ⊗ₘ ι n) ≫ A.mul) (U : X.Opens) {m n : ℕ}
    (a : S.sectionsPiece U m) (b : S.sectionsPiece U n) :
    (ι (m + n)).app U (S.sectionsGMul U a b) =
      (show A.sectionsRing U from (ι m).app U a) * (show A.sectionsRing U from (ι n).app U b)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg
    (fun φ : CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorObj (C := X.Modules) (S.part m) (S.part n) ⟶
        A.carrier =>
      φ.app U (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (S.part m) (S.part n) U a b))
    (h2 m n)
  have hT := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorHom_tensorSections (ι m) (ι n) U a b
  rw [A.sectionsMul_eq_mul_tensorSections]
  refine h.trans ?_
  show A.mul.app U ((CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorHom (C := X.Modules) (ι m) (ι n)).val.app
    (Opposite.op U) (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (S.part m) (S.part n) U a b)) = _
  rw [hT]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsToRingHom_of
statement:
theorem sectionsToRingHom_of (h1 : S.one ≫ ι 0 = A.one)
    (h2 : ∀ m n, S.mul m n ≫ ι (m + n) = (ι m ⊗ₘ ι n) ≫ A.mul) (U : X.Opens) (m : ℕ)
    (a : S.sectionsPiece U m) :
    S.sectionsToRingHom A ι h1 h2 U (DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U) m a) = (ι m).app U a
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toSemiring_of _ _ _ m a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsToRingHom_restrict
statement:
theorem sectionsToRingHom_restrict (h1 : S.one ≫ ι 0 = A.one)
    (h2 : ∀ m n, S.mul m n ≫ ι (m + n) = (ι m ⊗ₘ ι n) ≫ A.mul) {U U' : X.Opens} (h : U ≤ U')
    (x : S.sectionsRing U') :
    S.sectionsToRingHom A ι h1 h2 U (S.sectionsRestrict h x) =
      A.sectionsRestrict h (S.sectionsToRingHom A ι h1 h2 U' x)
proof:
:= by
  have key : (S.sectionsToRingHom A ι h1 h2 U).toAddMonoidHom.comp
        (S.sectionsRestrictRingHom h).toAddMonoidHom =
      (A.sectionsRestrict h).toAddMonoidHom.comp (S.sectionsToRingHom A ι h1 h2 U').toAddMonoidHom := by
    refine DirectSum.addHom_ext ?_
    intro m a
    show S.sectionsToRingHom A ι h1 h2 U (S.sectionsRestrictRingHom h (DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U') m a)) =
      A.sectionsRestrict h (S.sectionsToRingHom A ι h1 h2 U' (DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U') m a))
    rw [S.sectionsRestrictRingHom_of, S.sectionsToRingHom_of, S.sectionsToRingHom_of]
    exact _root_.PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply (ι m).val (CategoryTheory.homOfLE h).op a
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun key x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsRestrictHom_refl
statement:
theorem sectionsRestrictHom_refl {U : X.Opens} (h : U ≤ U) :
    S.sectionsRestrictHom h = RingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  have hpiece : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : S.sectionsPiece U m),
      S.sectionsRestrictPiece h m a = a := by
    intro m a
    have h1 : homOfLE h = 𝟙 U := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    show ((S.part m).val.map (homOfLE h).op).hom a = a
    rw [h1, op_id, (S.part m).val.map_id]
    rfl
  refine DirectSum.ringHom_ext fun m a => ?_
  show S.sectionsRestrictRingHom h (DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U) m a)
    = DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U) m a
  rw [S.sectionsRestrictRingHom_of h m a, hpiece m a]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsRestrictHom_trans
statement:
theorem sectionsRestrictHom_trans {U V W : X.Opens} (hUV : U ≤ V) (hVW : V ≤ W) (hUW : U ≤ W) :
    S.sectionsRestrictHom hUW = (S.sectionsRestrictHom hUV).comp (S.sectionsRestrictHom hVW)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : homOfLE hUW = homOfLE hUV ≫ homOfLE hVW := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hpiece : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : S.sectionsPiece W m),
      S.sectionsRestrictPiece hUW m a
        = S.sectionsRestrictPiece hUV m (S.sectionsRestrictPiece hVW m a) := by
    intro m a
    show ((S.part m).val.map (homOfLE hUW).op).hom a
      = ((S.part m).val.map (homOfLE hUV).op).hom (((S.part m).val.map (homOfLE hVW).op).hom a)
    exact (PresheafOfModules.congr_map_apply _ (congrArg Quiver.Hom.op h1) _).trans
      (PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply _ _ _ _)
  refine DirectSum.ringHom_ext fun m a => ?_
  show S.sectionsRestrictRingHom hUW (DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece W) m a)
    = S.sectionsRestrictRingHom hUV (S.sectionsRestrictRingHom hVW
        (DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece W) m a))
  rw [S.sectionsRestrictRingHom_of hUW m a, S.sectionsRestrictRingHom_of hVW m a,
    S.sectionsRestrictRingHom_of hUV m _, hpiece m a]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsUnitHom_naturality
statement:
theorem sectionsUnitHom_naturality {U V : X.Opens} (h : U ≤ V) (r : Γ(X, V)) :
    S.sectionsRestrictHom h (S.sectionsUnitHom V r) =
      S.sectionsUnitHom U ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom r)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ((MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorUnit X.Modules).val.map (homOfLE h).op) r
      = (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom r := rfl
  have hone : S.sectionsRestrictPiece h 0 (S.one.app V r)
      = S.one.app U ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom r) := by
    have hn := PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply S.one.val (homOfLE h).op r
    rw [h1] at hn
    exact hn.symm
  have hV : S.sectionsUnitHom V r = DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece V) 0 (S.one.app V r) := rfl
  have hU : S.sectionsUnitHom U ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom r)
      = DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U) 0
        (S.one.app U ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom r)) := rfl
  rw [hV, hU]
  show S.sectionsRestrictRingHom h (DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece V) 0 (S.one.app V r))
    = DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U) 0 _
  rw [S.sectionsRestrictRingHom_of h 0 (S.one.app V r)]
  exact congrArg _ hone

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.mul_add_mul_aux
statement:
private theorem mul_add_mul_aux {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (x y A B : R) :
    (x + y) * (A * B) = x * A * B + y * B * A
proof: := by ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsUnitHom_mul_ofPiece
statement:
theorem sectionsUnitHom_mul_ofPiece (U : X.Opens) (r : Γ(X, U)) {m : ℕ}
    (a : S.sectionsPiece U m) :
    S.sectionsUnitHom U r * S.ofPiece U m a
      = S.ofPiece U m (@HSMul.hSMul Γ(X, U) Γ(S.part m, U) Γ(S.part m, U) _ r a)
proof:
:= by
  refine Eq.trans (DirectSum.of_mul_of (A := S.sectionsPiece U) (S.one.app U r) a)
    (DirectSum.of_eq_of_gradedMonoid_eq ?_)
  show (GradedMonoid.mk (0 + m) (S.sectionsGMul U (S.one.app U r) a) :
      GradedMonoid (S.sectionsPiece U)) = GradedMonoid.mk m _
  rw [S.sectionsGOne_app_sectionsGMul U r a]
  exact S.mk_eqToHom_app U (Nat.zero_add m).symm _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsRestrictHom_ofPiece
statement:
theorem sectionsRestrictHom_ofPiece {U V : X.Opens} (h : U ≤ V) (m : ℕ)
    (a : S.sectionsPiece V m) :
    S.sectionsRestrictHom h (S.ofPiece V m a) = S.ofPiece U m (S.sectionsRestrictPiece h m a)
proof:
:=
  S.sectionsRestrictRingHom_of h m a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsRestrictHom_toAddMonoidHom
statement:
theorem sectionsRestrictHom_toAddMonoidHom {U V : X.Opens} (h : U ≤ V) :
    (S.sectionsRestrictHom h).toAddMonoidHom
      = DirectSum.map (fun m => S.sectionsRestrictPiece h m)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.addHom_ext fun i a =>
    (S.sectionsRestrictHom_ofPiece h i a).trans (DirectSum.map_of _ i a).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sum_supp
statement:
theorem sum_supp (U : X.Opens) (x : S.sectionsRing U) :
    ∑ m ∈ S.supp U x, S.ofPiece U m (S.component U m x) = x
proof:
:= by
  let _ : ∀ (i : ℕ) (a : S.sectionsPiece U i), Decidable (a ≠ 0) := fun _ _ => Classical.dec _
  exact DirectSum.sum_support_of (β := S.sectionsPiece U) x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsRestrictHom_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem sectionsRestrictHom_eq_zero_iff {U V : X.Opens} (h : U ≤ V) (x : S.sectionsRing V) :
    S.sectionsRestrictHom h x = 0 ↔ ∀ m, S.sectionsRestrictPiece h m (S.component V m x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hx : (S.sectionsRestrictHom h).toAddMonoidHom x
      = DirectSum.map (fun m => S.sectionsRestrictPiece h m) x :=
    congrArg (fun φ => φ x) (S.sectionsRestrictHom_toAddMonoidHom h)
  constructor
  · intro h0 m
    have h1 : DirectSum.map (fun m => S.sectionsRestrictPiece h m) x = 0 := hx.symm.trans h0
    have h2 := congrArg (fun (y : DirectSum ℕ (S.sectionsPiece U)) => y m) h1
    exact (DirectSum.map_apply (fun m => S.sectionsRestrictPiece h m) m x).symm.trans h2
  · intro h0
    refine hx.trans (DirectSum.ext fun m => ?_)
    exact (DirectSum.map_apply (fun m => S.sectionsRestrictPiece h m) m x).trans
      ((h0 m).trans (DirectSum.zero_apply m).symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.pieceSmulHom_eq
statement:
theorem pieceSmulHom_eq (U : X.Opens) (r : Γ(X, U)) (z : S.sectionsRing U) :
    S.pieceSmulHom U r z = S.sectionsUnitHom U r * z
proof:
:= by
  induction z using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    exact (map_zero (S.pieceSmulHom U r)).trans (mul_zero (S.sectionsUnitHom U r)).symm
  | of m a =>
    refine Eq.trans ?_ (S.sectionsUnitHom_mul_ofPiece U r a).symm
    exact ((DirectSum.lof Γ(X, U) ℕ (S.sectionsPiece U) m).map_smul r a).symm
  | add x0 y0 hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ : ∃ x : S.sectionsRing U, x = x0 := ⟨x0, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ : ∃ y : S.sectionsRing U, y = y0 := ⟨y0, rfl⟩
    have h3 : S.pieceSmulHom U r (x + y) = S.pieceSmulHom U r x + S.pieceSmulHom U r y :=
      map_add (S.pieceSmulHom U r) x y
    have h4 := congrArg₂ (fun a b : S.sectionsRing U => a + b) hx hy
    exact h3.trans (h4.trans (mul_add (S.sectionsUnitHom U r) x y).symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.affineUnit_coequifibered
statement: theorem affineUnit_coequifibered : S.affineUnit.Coequifibered
proof:
:= by
  rw [AffineZariskiSite.coequifibered_iff_forall_isLocalizationAway]
  intro U f
  have hV : X.basicOpen f ≤ U.toOpens := X.basicOpen_le f
  letI : Algebra (S.sectionsRing U.toOpens) (S.sectionsRing (X.basicOpen f)) :=
    (S.sectionsRestrictHom hV).toAlgebra
  show IsLocalization.Away (S.sectionsUnitHom U.toOpens f) (S.sectionsRing (X.basicOpen f))
  have halg : ∀ a : S.sectionsRing U.toOpens,
      algebraMap (S.sectionsRing U.toOpens) (S.sectionsRing (X.basicOpen f)) a
        = S.sectionsRestrictHom hV a := fun _ => rfl
  have hres : ∀ r : Γ(X, U.toOpens),
      S.sectionsRestrictHom hV (S.sectionsUnitHom U.toOpens r)
        = S.sectionsUnitHom (X.basicOpen f) ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom r) :=
    fun r => S.sectionsUnitHom_naturality hV r
  
  
  
  
  letI inst1 : ∀ m : ℕ, Module Γ(X, U.toOpens) Γ(S.part m, X.basicOpen f) := fun _ =>
    Module.compHom _ (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom
  letI inst2 : ∀ m : ℕ, Module Γ(X, U.toOpens) (S.sectionsPiece (X.basicOpen f) m) := inst1
  have hsm : ∀ (m : ℕ) (r : Γ(X, U.toOpens)) (x : Γ(S.part m, X.basicOpen f)),
      r • x = (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom r • x := fun _ _ _ => rfl
  let fm : ∀ m : ℕ, S.sectionsPiece U.toOpens m →ₗ[Γ(X, U.toOpens)]
      S.sectionsPiece (X.basicOpen f) m := fun m =>
    { toFun := S.sectionsRestrictPiece hV m
      map_add' := fun a b => map_add (S.sectionsRestrictPiece hV m) a b
      map_smul' := fun r a =>
        (Scheme.Modules.map_smul (S.part m) (homOfLE hV) r a).trans (hsm m r _).symm }
  
  haveI : ∀ m : ℕ, IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) (fm m) := fun m => by
    haveI := S.quasicoherent m
    exact Scheme.Modules.isLocalizedModule_basicOpen (S.part m) U.2 f (hsm m) (fm m)
      (fun _ => rfl)
  haveI hloc : IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) (DirectSum.lmap fm) :=
    IsLocalizedModule.directSum (Submonoid.powers f) fm
  
  have hlmap : ∀ x : S.sectionsRing U.toOpens,
      DirectSum.lmap fm x = S.sectionsRestrictHom hV x := by
    intro x
    have h1 : (S.sectionsRestrictHom hV).toAddMonoidHom x
        = DirectSum.map (fun m => S.sectionsRestrictPiece hV m) x :=
      congrArg (fun φ => φ x) (S.sectionsRestrictHom_toAddMonoidHom hV)
    refine DirectSum.ext fun m => ?_
    have h2 := congrArg (fun (y : DirectSum ℕ (S.sectionsPiece (X.basicOpen f))) => y m) h1
    exact (h2.trans (DirectSum.map_apply (fun m => S.sectionsRestrictPiece hV m) m x)).symm
  refine (_root_.isLocalization_iff (Submonoid.powers _) _).mpr ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨-, n, rfl⟩
    rw [halg, map_pow, hres]
    exact IsUnit.pow n (RingHom.isUnit_map (S.sectionsUnitHom (X.basicOpen f))
      (X.toRingedSpace.isUnit_res_basicOpen f))
  · intro z
    obtain ⟨⟨x, ⟨-, n, rfl⟩⟩, hx⟩ :=
      IsLocalizedModule.surj (Submonoid.powers f) (DirectSum.lmap fm) z
    refine ⟨⟨x, ⟨_, n, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    have h1 : S.pieceSmulHom (X.basicOpen f)
        ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom (f ^ n)) z = S.sectionsRestrictHom hV x :=
      hx.trans (hlmap x)
    rw [S.pieceSmulHom_eq, ← hres, map_pow] at h1
    rw [halg, halg]
    exact (_root_.mul_comm z _).trans h1
  · intro x y hxy
    rw [halg, halg] at hxy
    have h1 : DirectSum.lmap fm x = DirectSum.lmap fm y :=
      (hlmap x).trans (hxy.trans (hlmap y).symm)
    obtain ⟨⟨-, n, rfl⟩, hc⟩ :=
      IsLocalizedModule.exists_of_eq (S := Submonoid.powers f) (f := DirectSum.lmap fm) h1
    refine ⟨⟨S.sectionsUnitHom U.toOpens f ^ n, ⟨n, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    have h2 : S.pieceSmulHom U.toOpens (f ^ n) x = S.pieceSmulHom U.toOpens (f ^ n) y := hc
    rw [S.pieceSmulHom_eq, S.pieceSmulHom_eq, map_pow] at h2
    exact h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.component_ofPiece
statement:
@[simp] theorem component_ofPiece (a : S.sectionsPiece U m) :
    S.component U m (S.ofPiece U m a) = a
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.of_eq_same m a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.ofPiece_injective
statement: theorem ofPiece_injective : Function.Injective (S.ofPiece U m)
proof:
:= fun a b hab => by
  have h := congrArg (S.component U m) hab
  rwa [S.component_ofPiece, S.component_ofPiece] at h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.mem_sectionsGrading_iff
statement:
theorem mem_sectionsGrading_iff (x : S.sectionsRing U) :
    x ∈ S.sectionsGrading U m ↔ S.ofPiece U m (S.component U m x) = x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact congrArg (S.ofPiece U m) (S.component_ofPiece U m a)
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨S.component U m x, hx⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.coe_sectionsPieceEquivGrading
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_sectionsPieceEquivGrading (a : S.sectionsPiece U m) :
    ((S.sectionsPieceEquivGrading U m a : S.sectionsGrading U m) : S.sectionsRing U)
      = S.ofPiece U m a
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsPieceEquivGrading_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem sectionsPieceEquivGrading_symm_apply (x : S.sectionsGrading U m) :
    (S.sectionsPieceEquivGrading U m).symm x = S.component U m x.1
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsPieceEquivGrading_restrict
statement:
theorem sectionsPieceEquivGrading_restrict {V : X.Opens} (h : U ≤ V) (a : S.sectionsPiece V m) :
    ((S.sectionsPieceEquivGrading U m (S.sectionsRestrictPiece h m a) :
        S.sectionsGrading U m) : S.sectionsRing U)
      = S.sectionsRestrictHom h
          ((S.sectionsPieceEquivGrading V m a : S.sectionsGrading V m) : S.sectionsRing V)
proof:
:=
  (S.sectionsRestrictHom_ofPiece h m a).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsPieceEquivGrading_smul
statement:
theorem sectionsPieceEquivGrading_smul (r : Γ(X, U)) (a : S.sectionsPiece U m) :
    S.sectionsUnitHom U r
        * ((S.sectionsPieceEquivGrading U m a : S.sectionsGrading U m) : S.sectionsRing U)
      = ((S.sectionsPieceEquivGrading U m
          (@HSMul.hSMul Γ(X, U) Γ(S.part m, U) Γ(S.part m, U) _ r a) :
            S.sectionsGrading U m) : S.sectionsRing U)
proof:
:=
  S.sectionsUnitHom_mul_ofPiece U r a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.toGradedAffineAlgebra_grading
statement:
theorem toGradedAffineAlgebra_grading (U : X.AffineZariskiSite) (m : ℕ) :
    S.toGradedAffineAlgebra.grading U m = S.sectionsGrading U.toOpens m
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections_zero_left
statement:
theorem tensorSections_zero_left (A B : X.Modules) (U : X.Opens)
    (b : B.val.obj (Opposite.op U)) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections A B U 0 b = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tensorSectionsHom_app A B U 0 b, TensorProduct.zero_tmul]
  exact map_zero _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections_zero_right
statement:
theorem tensorSections_zero_right (A B : X.Modules) (U : X.Opens)
    (a : A.val.obj (Opposite.op U)) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections A B U a 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tensorSectionsHom_app A B U a 0, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
  exact map_zero _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.mk_eqToHom_app
statement:
theorem mk_eqToHom_app {m n : ℕ} (e : m = n) (x : S.sectionsPiece U m) :
    (GradedMonoid.mk n ((CategoryTheory.eqToHom (congrArg S.part e)).app U x) :
        GradedMonoid (S.sectionsPiece U)) = GradedMonoid.mk m x
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsGMul_zero_right
statement:
theorem sectionsGMul_zero_right {m n : ℕ} (a : S.sectionsPiece U m) :
    S.sectionsGMul U a (0 : S.sectionsPiece U n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  show (S.mul m n).app U
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (S.part m) (S.part n) U a 0) = 0
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections_zero_right]
  exact map_zero _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsGMul_zero_left
statement:
theorem sectionsGMul_zero_left {m n : ℕ} (b : S.sectionsPiece U n) :
    S.sectionsGMul U (0 : S.sectionsPiece U m) b = 0
proof:
:= by
  show (S.mul m n).app U
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (S.part m) (S.part n) U 0 b) = 0
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections_zero_left]
  exact map_zero _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsGMul_add_right
statement:
theorem sectionsGMul_add_right {m n : ℕ} (a : S.sectionsPiece U m)
    (b b' : S.sectionsPiece U n) :
    S.sectionsGMul U a (b + b') = S.sectionsGMul U a b + S.sectionsGMul U a b'
proof:
:= by
  show (S.mul m n).app U
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (S.part m) (S.part n) U a (b + b')) = _
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections_add_right]
  exact map_add _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsGMul_add_left
statement:
theorem sectionsGMul_add_left {m n : ℕ} (a a' : S.sectionsPiece U m)
    (b : S.sectionsPiece U n) :
    S.sectionsGMul U (a + a') b = S.sectionsGMul U a b + S.sectionsGMul U a' b
proof:
:= by
  show (S.mul m n).app U
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (S.part m) (S.part n) U (a + a') b) = _
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections_add_left]
  exact map_add _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsGOne_app_sectionsGMul
statement:
theorem sectionsGOne_app_sectionsGMul {m : ℕ} (r : Γ(X, U)) (a : S.sectionsPiece U m) :
    S.sectionsGMul U (S.one.app U r) a =
      (CategoryTheory.eqToHom (congrArg S.part (Nat.zero_add m).symm)).app U
        (@HSMul.hSMul Γ(X, U) Γ(S.part m, U) Γ(S.part m, U) _ r a)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg
    (fun (φ : CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorObj (C := X.Modules)
        (𝟙_ X.Modules) (S.part m) ⟶ S.part (0 + m)) =>
      φ.app U (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections
        (𝟙_ X.Modules) (S.part m) U r a))
    (S.one_mul m)
  have hT := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorHom_tensorSections
    S.one (𝟙 (S.part m)) U r a
  rw [CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_id] at hT
  have hL := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.leftUnitor_app_tensorSections (S.part m) U r a
  have hR : ((S.one ▷ S.part m) ≫ S.mul 0 m).app U
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (𝟙_ X.Modules) (S.part m) U r a)
      = S.sectionsGMul U (S.one.app U r) a := by
    show (S.mul 0 m).app U ((S.one ▷ S.part m).val.app (Opposite.op U)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (𝟙_ X.Modules) (S.part m) U r a)) = _
    rw [hT]; rfl
  refine hR.symm.trans (h.trans ?_)
  show (CategoryTheory.eqToHom (congrArg S.part (Nat.zero_add m).symm)).app U
      ((λ_ (S.part m)).hom.app U
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (𝟙_ X.Modules) (S.part m) U r a)) = _
  rw [hL]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsGOne_mul_mk
statement:
theorem sectionsGOne_mul_mk {m : ℕ} (a : S.sectionsPiece U m) :
    (GradedMonoid.mk (0 + m) (S.sectionsGMul U (S.sectionsGOne U) a) :
        GradedMonoid (S.sectionsPiece U)) = GradedMonoid.mk m a
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : S.sectionsGMul U (S.sectionsGOne U) a
      = (CategoryTheory.eqToHom (congrArg S.part (Nat.zero_add m).symm)).app U a := by
    refine (S.sectionsGOne_app_sectionsGMul U 1 a).trans ?_
    exact congrArg _ (one_smul Γ(X, U) (show Γ(S.part m, U) from a))
  rw [h1]
  exact S.mk_eqToHom_app U (Nat.zero_add m).symm a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsGMul_comm_app
statement:
theorem sectionsGMul_comm_app {m n : ℕ} (a : S.sectionsPiece U m) (b : S.sectionsPiece U n) :
    S.sectionsGMul U b a =
      (CategoryTheory.eqToHom (congrArg S.part (Nat.add_comm m n))).app U
        (S.sectionsGMul U a b)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg
    (fun (φ : CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorObj (C := X.Modules)
        (S.part m) (S.part n) ⟶ S.part (n + m)) =>
      φ.app U (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections
        (S.part m) (S.part n) U a b))
    (S.mul_comm m n)
  have hb := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.braiding_app_tensorSections
    (S.part m) (S.part n) U a b
  have hLHS : ((β_ (S.part m) (S.part n)).hom ≫ S.mul n m).app U
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (S.part m) (S.part n) U a b)
      = S.sectionsGMul U b a := by
    show (S.mul n m).app U ((β_ (S.part m) (S.part n)).hom.app U
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (S.part m) (S.part n) U a b)) = _
    rw [hb]; rfl
  exact hLHS.symm.trans h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsGMul_mk_comm
statement:
theorem sectionsGMul_mk_comm {m n : ℕ} (a : S.sectionsPiece U m) (b : S.sectionsPiece U n) :
    (GradedMonoid.mk (m + n) (S.sectionsGMul U a b) : GradedMonoid (S.sectionsPiece U))
      = GradedMonoid.mk (n + m) (S.sectionsGMul U b a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [S.sectionsGMul_comm_app U a b]
  exact (S.mk_eqToHom_app U (Nat.add_comm m n) (S.sectionsGMul U a b)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsGMul_one_mk
statement:
theorem sectionsGMul_one_mk {m : ℕ} (a : S.sectionsPiece U m) :
    (GradedMonoid.mk (m + 0) (S.sectionsGMul U a (S.sectionsGOne U)) :
        GradedMonoid (S.sectionsPiece U)) = GradedMonoid.mk m a
proof:
:=
  (S.sectionsGMul_mk_comm U a (S.sectionsGOne U)).trans (S.sectionsGOne_mul_mk U a)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsGMul_assoc_app
statement:
theorem sectionsGMul_assoc_app {m n p : ℕ} (a : S.sectionsPiece U m) (b : S.sectionsPiece U n)
    (c : S.sectionsPiece U p) :
    S.sectionsGMul U a (S.sectionsGMul U b c) =
      (CategoryTheory.eqToHom (congrArg S.part (Nat.add_assoc m n p))).app U
        (S.sectionsGMul U (S.sectionsGMul U a b) c)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg
    (fun (φ : CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorObj (C := X.Modules)
        (CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorObj (C := X.Modules) (S.part m) (S.part n))
        (S.part p) ⟶ S.part (m + (n + p))) =>
      φ.app U (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections
        (CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorObj (C := X.Modules) (S.part m) (S.part n))
        (S.part p) U
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (S.part m) (S.part n) U a b) c))
    (S.mul_assoc m n p)
  have hTR := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorHom_tensorSections
    (S.mul m n) (𝟙 (S.part p)) U
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (S.part m) (S.part n) U a b) c
  rw [CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_id] at hTR
  have hTL := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorHom_tensorSections
    (𝟙 (S.part m)) (S.mul n p) U a
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (S.part n) (S.part p) U b c)
  rw [CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.id_tensorHom] at hTL
  have ha := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.associator_app_tensorSections
    (S.part m) (S.part n) (S.part p) U a b c
  have hL : ((α_ (S.part m) (S.part n) (S.part p)).hom ≫
        (S.part m ◁ S.mul n p) ≫ S.mul m (n + p)).app U
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections
        (CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorObj (C := X.Modules) (S.part m) (S.part n))
        (S.part p) U
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (S.part m) (S.part n) U a b) c)
      = S.sectionsGMul U a (S.sectionsGMul U b c) := by
    show (S.mul m (n + p)).app U ((S.part m ◁ S.mul n p).val.app (Opposite.op U)
      ((α_ (S.part m) (S.part n) (S.part p)).hom.val.app (Opposite.op U) _)) = _
    rw [show (α_ (S.part m) (S.part n) (S.part p)).hom.val.app (Opposite.op U) _ = _ from ha,
      hTL]
    rfl
  have hR : ((S.mul m n ▷ S.part p) ≫ S.mul (m + n) p ≫
        CategoryTheory.eqToHom (congrArg S.part (Nat.add_assoc m n p))).app U
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections
        (CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorObj (C := X.Modules) (S.part m) (S.part n))
        (S.part p) U
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (S.part m) (S.part n) U a b) c)
      = (CategoryTheory.eqToHom (congrArg S.part (Nat.add_assoc m n p))).app U
        (S.sectionsGMul U (S.sectionsGMul U a b) c) := by
    show (CategoryTheory.eqToHom (congrArg S.part (Nat.add_assoc m n p))).app U
      ((S.mul (m + n) p).app U ((S.mul m n ▷ S.part p).val.app (Opposite.op U) _)) = _
    rw [hTR]
    rfl
  exact hL.symm.trans (h.trans hR)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsGMul_mk_assoc
statement:
theorem sectionsGMul_mk_assoc {m n p : ℕ} (a : S.sectionsPiece U m) (b : S.sectionsPiece U n)
    (c : S.sectionsPiece U p) :
    (GradedMonoid.mk (m + n + p) (S.sectionsGMul U (S.sectionsGMul U a b) c) :
        GradedMonoid (S.sectionsPiece U))
      = GradedMonoid.mk (m + (n + p)) (S.sectionsGMul U a (S.sectionsGMul U b c))
proof:
:= by
  rw [S.sectionsGMul_assoc_app U a b c]
  exact (S.mk_eqToHom_app U (Nat.add_assoc m n p) _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsGOne_app_mul
statement:
theorem sectionsGOne_app_mul (r s : Γ(X, U)) :
    (GradedMonoid.mk 0 (S.one.app U (r * s)) : GradedMonoid (S.sectionsPiece U))
      = GradedMonoid.mk (0 + 0) (S.sectionsGMul U (S.one.app U r) (S.one.app U s))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : S.sectionsGMul U (S.one.app U r) (S.one.app U s)
      = (CategoryTheory.eqToHom (congrArg S.part (Nat.zero_add 0).symm)).app U
          (S.one.app U (r * s)) := by
    refine (S.sectionsGOne_app_sectionsGMul U r (S.one.app U s)).trans ?_
    exact congrArg _ (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul S.one r
      (s : Γ(𝟙_ X.Modules, U))).symm
  rw [h1]
  exact (S.mk_eqToHom_app U (Nat.zero_add 0).symm (S.one.app U (r * s))).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsGrading_one_mem
statement:
theorem sectionsGrading_one_mem (U : X.Opens) :
    (1 : S.sectionsRing U) ∈ S.sectionsGrading U 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨GradedMonoid.GOne.one, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsGrading_mul_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hi
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := hj
  exact ⟨GradedMonoid.GMul.mul a b, (DirectSum.of_mul_of a b).symm⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsDecompose_left_inv
statement:
theorem sectionsDecompose_left_inv (U : X.Opens) :
    Function.LeftInverse (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (S.sectionsGrading U))
      (S.sectionsDecompose U)
proof:
:= by
  have key : (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (S.sectionsGrading U)).comp (S.sectionsDecompose U)
      = AddMonoidHom.id (S.sectionsRing U) := by
    refine DirectSum.addHom_ext ?_
    intro i a
    show DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (S.sectionsGrading U)
      (DirectSum.map (fun m => (DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U) m).rangeRestrict)
        (DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U) i a)) = _
    rw [DirectSum.map_of]
    exact DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom_of (S.sectionsGrading U) i _
  intro x
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun key x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsDecompose_right_inv
statement:
theorem sectionsDecompose_right_inv (U : X.Opens) :
    Function.RightInverse (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (S.sectionsGrading U))
      (S.sectionsDecompose U)
proof:
:= by
  have key : (S.sectionsDecompose U).comp (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (S.sectionsGrading U))
      = AddMonoidHom.id (⨁ m, (S.sectionsGrading U m)) := by
    refine DirectSum.addHom_ext ?_
    intro i y
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := y.2
    show DirectSum.map (fun m => (DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U) m).rangeRestrict)
      (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom (S.sectionsGrading U)
        (DirectSum.of (fun m => (S.sectionsGrading U m)) i y)) = _
    rw [DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom_of, ← hv, DirectSum.map_of]
    exact congrArg (DirectSum.of (fun m => (S.sectionsGrading U m)) i) (Subtype.ext hv)
  intro y
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun key y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsGOne_restrict
statement:
theorem sectionsGOne_restrict {U U' : X.Opens} (h : U ≤ U') :
    S.sectionsRestrictPiece h 0 (S.sectionsGOne U') = S.sectionsGOne U
proof:
:= by
  have hn := _root_.PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply S.one.val
    (CategoryTheory.homOfLE h).op (1 : X.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (Opposite.op U'))
  have h1 : ((𝟙_ X.Modules).val.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE h).op)
      (1 : X.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (Opposite.op U')) =
      (1 : X.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (Opposite.op U)) := by
    change (X.presheaf.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE h).op).hom 1 = 1
    exact map_one _
  rw [h1] at hn
  exact hn.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsGMul_restrict
statement:
theorem sectionsGMul_restrict {U U' : X.Opens} (h : U ≤ U') {m n : ℕ}
    (a : S.sectionsPiece U' m) (b : S.sectionsPiece U' n) :
    S.sectionsRestrictPiece h (m + n) (S.sectionsGMul U' a b)
      = S.sectionsGMul U (S.sectionsRestrictPiece h m a) (S.sectionsRestrictPiece h n b)
proof:
:= by
  show ((S.part (m + n)).val.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE h).op)
      ((S.mul m n).val.app (Opposite.op U')
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (S.part m) (S.part n) U' a b))
    = (S.mul m n).val.app (Opposite.op U)
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (S.part m) (S.part n) U
          (((S.part m).val.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE h).op) a)
          (((S.part n).val.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE h).op) b))
  rw [← AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections_restrict (S.part m) (S.part n)
    (CategoryTheory.homOfLE h) a b]
  exact (_root_.PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply (S.mul m n).val
    (CategoryTheory.homOfLE h).op _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsRestrictRingHom_of
statement:
theorem sectionsRestrictRingHom_of {U U' : X.Opens} (h : U ≤ U') (m : ℕ)
    (a : S.sectionsPiece U' m) :
    S.sectionsRestrictRingHom h (DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U') m a)
      = DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U) m (S.sectionsRestrictPiece h m a)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toSemiring_of _ _ _ m a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.smul_sectionsGOne
proof:
:= by
  refine (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul S.one r
    (show Γ(𝟙_ X.Modules, U) from (1 : Γ(X, U)))).symm.trans ?_
  refine congrArg (fun x => S.one.app U x) ?_
  show r * (1 : Γ(X, U)) = r
  exact mul_one r

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsUnit_apply
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsUnit_apply {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    (S : X.GradedQCAlgebra) (U : X.Opens) (r : Γ(X, U)) :
    (S.sectionsUnit U r : S.sectionsRing U) =
      DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U) 0
        (@HSMul.hSMul Γ(X, U) Γ(S.part 0, U) Γ(S.part 0, U) _ r (S.sectionsGOne U))
proof:
:=
  congrArg (DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U) 0) (S.smul_sectionsGOne U r).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsUnit_mul_of
statement:
theorem sectionsUnit_mul_of (U : X.Opens) (r : Γ(X, U)) {m : ℕ} (a : S.sectionsPiece U m) :
    @HMul.hMul (S.sectionsRing U) (S.sectionsRing U) (S.sectionsRing U) _
        (S.sectionsUnit U r) (DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U) m a)
      = DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U) m
          (@HSMul.hSMul Γ(X, U) Γ(S.part m, U) Γ(S.part m, U) _ r a)
proof:
:= by
  show DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U) 0 (S.one.app U r) * DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U) m a
    = DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U) m
        (@HSMul.hSMul Γ(X, U) Γ(S.part m, U) Γ(S.part m, U) _ r a)
  rw [DirectSum.of_mul_of]
  refine DirectSum.of_eq_of_gradedMonoid_eq ?_
  show (GradedMonoid.mk (0 + m) (S.sectionsGMul U (S.one.app U r) a) :
      GradedMonoid (S.sectionsPiece U)) = GradedMonoid.mk m _
  rw [S.sectionsGOne_app_sectionsGMul U r a]
  exact S.mk_eqToHom_app U (Nat.zero_add m).symm _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsRestrictPiece_smul
statement:
theorem sectionsRestrictPiece_smul {U U' : X.Opens} (h : U ≤ U') (m : ℕ) (r : Γ(X, U'))
    (a : S.sectionsPiece U' m) :
    S.sectionsRestrictPiece h m
        (@HSMul.hSMul Γ(X, U') Γ(S.part m, U') Γ(S.part m, U') _ r a)
      = @HSMul.hSMul Γ(X, U) Γ(S.part m, U) Γ(S.part m, U) _
          ((X.presheaf.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE h).op) r) (S.sectionsRestrictPiece h m a)
proof:
:=
  _root_.PresheafOfModules.map_smul (S.part m).val (CategoryTheory.homOfLE h).op r a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsRestrictPiece_trans
statement:
theorem sectionsRestrictPiece_trans {U V W : X.Opens} (hUV : U ≤ V) (hVW : V ≤ W) (m : ℕ)
    (a : S.sectionsPiece W m) :
    S.sectionsRestrictPiece hUV m (S.sectionsRestrictPiece hVW m a)
      = S.sectionsRestrictPiece (hUV.trans hVW) m a
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : CategoryTheory.homOfLE (hUV.trans hVW)
      = CategoryTheory.homOfLE hUV ≫ CategoryTheory.homOfLE hVW := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  show ((S.part m).val.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE hUV).op).hom
      (((S.part m).val.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE hVW).op).hom a)
    = ((S.part m).val.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE (hUV.trans hVW)).op).hom a
  exact ((_root_.PresheafOfModules.congr_map_apply _ (congrArg Quiver.Hom.op h1) _).trans
    (_root_.PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply _ _ _ _)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsRestrict_irrelevant
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsRestrict_irrelevant {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    (S : X.GradedQCAlgebra) {U U' : X.Opens} (hU : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen U)
    (hU' : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen U') (h : U ≤ U') :
    HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (S.sectionsGrading U) ≤
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (S.sectionsGrading U')).map (S.sectionsRestrict h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant_le]
  intro d hd x hx
  have : (S.part d).IsQuasicoherent := S.quasicoherent d
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ : ∃ a : S.sectionsPiece U d, DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U) d a = x := hx
  set I : Ideal (S.sectionsRing U) :=
    Ideal.map (S.sectionsRestrict h : S.sectionsRing U' →+* S.sectionsRing U)
      (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant (S.sectionsGrading U')).toIdeal with hI
  show DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U) d a ∈ I
  
  let K : Ideal Γ(X, U) :=
    { carrier := {r | DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U) d
        (@HSMul.hSMul Γ(X, U) Γ(S.part d, U) Γ(S.part d, U) _ r a) ∈ I}
      add_mem' := by
        intro r s hr hs
        show DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U) d
          (@HSMul.hSMul Γ(X, U) Γ(S.part d, U) Γ(S.part d, U) _ (r + s) a) ∈ I
        rw [add_smul, map_add]
        exact I.add_mem hr hs
      zero_mem' := by
        show DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U) d
          (@HSMul.hSMul Γ(X, U) Γ(S.part d, U) Γ(S.part d, U) _ 0 a) ∈ I
        rw [zero_smul, map_zero]
        exact I.zero_mem
      smul_mem' := by
        intro c r hr
        show DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U) d
          (@HSMul.hSMul Γ(X, U) Γ(S.part d, U) Γ(S.part d, U) _ (c * r) a) ∈ I
        rw [mul_smul, ← S.sectionsUnit_mul_of U c]
        exact I.mul_mem_left _ hr }
  
  have key : ∀ p ∈ U, ∃ g : Γ(X, U), g ∈ K.radical ∧ p ∈ X.basicOpen g := by
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨f, hfU, hpf⟩ := hU'.exists_basicOpen_le ⟨p, hp⟩ (h hp)
    set g : Γ(X, U) := (X.presheaf.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE h).op) f with hg
    have hDg : X.basicOpen g = X.basicOpen f := by
      rw [hg, AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.basicOpen_res]
      exact inf_eq_right.mpr hfU
    refine ⟨g, ?_, hDg ▸ hpf⟩
    have hDf : X.basicOpen f ≤ U := hfU
    obtain ⟨n, t, ht⟩ := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_pow_smul_eq_map_basicOpen
      (S.part d) hU' f (S.sectionsRestrictPiece hDf d a)
    set c : S.sectionsPiece U d :=
      @HSub.hSub Γ(S.part d, U) Γ(S.part d, U) Γ(S.part d, U) _
        (@HSMul.hSMul Γ(X, U) Γ(S.part d, U) Γ(S.part d, U) _ (g ^ n) a)
        (S.sectionsRestrictPiece h d t) with hc_def
    
    have hcf : S.sectionsRestrictPiece hDf d c = 0 := by
      rw [hc_def, map_sub, S.sectionsRestrictPiece_smul hDf d, S.sectionsRestrictPiece_trans hDf h d t,
        sub_eq_zero, hg, ← map_pow]
      have e : ((X.presheaf.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE hDf).op)
          ((X.presheaf.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE h).op) (f ^ n)))
          = (X.presheaf.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)).op) (f ^ n) := by
        have h1 : CategoryTheory.homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le f)
            = CategoryTheory.homOfLE hDf ≫ CategoryTheory.homOfLE h := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        rw [h1, CategoryTheory.op_comp, X.presheaf.map_comp]
        rfl
      rw [e, map_pow]
      exact ht.symm
    
    have hcg : (S.part d).presheaf.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le g)).op c = 0 := by
      show S.sectionsRestrictPiece (X.basicOpen_le g) d c = 0
      rw [← S.sectionsRestrictPiece_trans hDg.le hDf d c, hcf, map_zero]
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_map_basicOpen_eq_zero
      (S.part d) hU g c hcg
    refine ⟨N + n, ?_⟩
    show DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U) d
      (@HSMul.hSMul Γ(X, U) Γ(S.part d, U) Γ(S.part d, U) _ (g ^ (N + n)) a) ∈ I
    have hEq : @HSMul.hSMul Γ(X, U) Γ(S.part d, U) Γ(S.part d, U) _ (g ^ (N + n)) a
        = @HSMul.hSMul Γ(X, U) Γ(S.part d, U) Γ(S.part d, U) _ (g ^ N)
            (S.sectionsRestrictPiece h d t) := by
      rw [hc_def, smul_sub, sub_eq_zero, smul_smul, ← pow_add] at hN
      exact hN
    rw [hEq, ← S.sectionsUnit_mul_of U (g ^ N)]
    refine I.mul_mem_left _ ?_
    rw [← S.sectionsRestrictRingHom_of h d t]
    exact Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ (HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem _ hd ⟨t, rfl⟩)
  
  have hK : K = ⊤ := by
    rw [← Ideal.radical_eq_top, ← Ideal.span_eq K.radical, ← hU.self_le_iSup_basicOpen_iff]
    intro p hp
    obtain ⟨g, hgK, hpg⟩ := key p hp
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨g, hgK⟩, hpg⟩
  have h1 : (1 : Γ(X, U)) ∈ K := hK ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  have h1' : DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U) d
      (@HSMul.hSMul Γ(X, U) Γ(S.part d, U) Γ(S.part d, U) _ (1 : Γ(X, U)) a) ∈ I := h1
  rwa [one_smul] at h1'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symGradedAlgebra_generatedInDegreeOne
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symGradedAlgebra_generatedInDegreeOne
    {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} (V : X.Modules) [hV : V.IsQuasicoherent] :
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symGradedAlgebra V).GeneratedInDegreeOne
proof:
:= by
  have hE : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symGradedAlgebra V =
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symGradedAlgebraOfQC V hV := by
    delta AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symGradedAlgebra
    exact dif_pos hV
  rw [hE]
  
  have hmul : ∀ m n : ℕ, Epi (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symPowMul V m n) := fun m n => by
    have h1 : Epi ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symPowπ V m ⊗ₘ
        AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symPowπ V n) ≫
          AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symPowMul V m n) := by
      rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorHom_symPowπ_symPowMul]
      exact @epi_comp _ _ _ _ _ (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.monoidalPowCat V m n).hom
        (@IsIso.epi_of_iso _ _ _ _ _ (Iso.isIso_hom _))
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symPowπ V (m + n))
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symPowπ_epi V (m + n))
    exact @epi_of_epi _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h1
  have key : ∀ ℓ : ℕ,
      Epi ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symGradedAlgebraOfQC V hV).mulPowOne ℓ) := by
    intro ℓ
    induction ℓ with
    | zero => exact AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symPowπ_epi V 0
    | succ ℓ ih =>
      have h2 : Epi ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symGradedAlgebraOfQC V hV).mulPowOne ℓ ▷
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symGradedAlgebraOfQC V hV).part 1) :=
        @AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.epi_whiskerRight_of_epi _ _ _ _ ih _
      have h3 : Epi ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symGradedAlgebraOfQC V hV).mul ℓ 1) := hmul ℓ 1
      exact @epi_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ (@IsIso.epi_of_iso _ _ _ _ _ (Iso.isIso_hom _)) _
        (@epi_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ h2 _ h3)
  exact fun ℓ _ => key ℓ

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.restrict_refl
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrict_refl (U : X.AffineZariskiSite) (a : A.sections U) :
    A.restrict (le_refl U) a = a
proof:
:= by
  show (A.ring.map (𝟙 (op U))).hom a = a
  rw [A.ring.map_id]; rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.restrict_restrict
statement:
theorem restrict_restrict {U V W : X.AffineZariskiSite} (hUV : U ≤ V) (hVW : V ≤ W)
    (a : A.sections W) : A.restrict hUV (A.restrict hVW a) = A.restrict (hUV.trans hVW) a
proof:
:= by
  show ((A.ring.map (homOfLE hVW).op) ≫ (A.ring.map (homOfLE hUV).op)).hom a = _
  rw [← A.ring.map_comp]; rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.restrict_unitHom
statement:
theorem restrict_unitHom {U V : X.AffineZariskiSite} (h : U ≤ V) (r : Γ(X, V.toOpens)) :
    A.restrict h (A.unitHom V r) =
      A.unitHom U ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (AffineZariskiSite.toOpens_mono h)).op).hom r)
proof:
:=
  (congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom r) (A.unit.naturality (homOfLE h).op)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.isLocalization_basicOpen
statement:
theorem isLocalization_basicOpen (U : X.AffineZariskiSite) (f : Γ(X, U.toOpens)) :
    letI
proof:
:= (A.restrict (U.basicOpen_le f)).toAlgebra
    IsLocalization.Away (A.unitHom U f) (A.sections (U.basicOpen f)) :=
  AffineZariskiSite.coequifibered_iff_forall_isLocalizationAway.mp A.coequifibered U f

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.gluingData_natTrans_app
statement:
theorem gluingData_natTrans_app (U : X.AffineZariskiSite) :
    A.gluingData.natTrans.app U = A.chartToOpen U
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.chart_hom
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem chart_hom (U : X.AffineZariskiSite) :
    A.chart U ≫ A.relativeSpec.hom = A.chartToOpen U ≫ U.toOpens.ι
proof:
:= by
  change colimit.ι A.gluingData.functor U ≫ A.gluingData.toBase = _
  rw [A.gluingData.ι_toBase U]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.map_chart
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem map_chart {U V : X.AffineZariskiSite} (h : U ≤ V) :
    Spec.map (A.ring.map (homOfLE h).op) ≫ A.chart V = A.chart U
proof:
:=
  colimit.w A.gluingData.functor (homOfLE h)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.preimage_eq_opensRange
statement:
theorem preimage_eq_opensRange (U : X.AffineZariskiSite) :
    A.relativeSpec.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U.toOpens = (A.chart U).opensRange
proof:
:= by
  have h := A.gluingData.toBase_preimage_eq_opensRange_ι U
  rw [← show A.gluingData.toBase ⁻¹ᵁ ((AffineZariskiSite.directedCover X).f U).opensRange =
    A.relativeSpec.hom ⁻¹ᵁ U.toOpens from by
      congr 1
      exact Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι U.toOpens]
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.chart_isPullback
statement:
theorem chart_isPullback (U : X.AffineZariskiSite) :
    IsPullback (A.chartToOpen U) (A.chart U) U.toOpens.ι A.relativeSpec.hom
proof:
:=
  A.gluingData.isPullback_natTrans_ι_toBase U

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.exists_chart_mem
statement:
theorem exists_chart_mem (x : A.relativeSpec.left) :
    ∃ (U : X.AffineZariskiSite) (y : Spec (A.sections U)), A.chart U y = x
proof:
:=
  Scheme.IsLocallyDirected.ι_jointly_surjective A.gluingData.functor x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.Hom.appHom_unitHom
statement:
theorem appHom_unitHom (φ : Hom A B) (U : X.AffineZariskiSite) (r : Γ(X, U.toOpens)) :
    φ.appHom U (A.unitHom U r) = B.unitHom U r
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun α => (α.app (op U)).hom r) φ.unit_app

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.specNatTrans_app
statement:
theorem specNatTrans_app {A B : X.AffineAlgebra} (φ : Hom A B) (U : X.AffineZariskiSite) :
    (specNatTrans φ).app U = Spec.map (φ.app.app (op U))
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.relativeSpec.chart_map
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem relativeSpec.chart_map {A B : X.AffineAlgebra} (φ : Hom A B) (U : X.AffineZariskiSite) :
    B.chart U ≫ relativeSpec.map φ = Spec.map (φ.app.app (op U)) ≫ A.chart U
proof:
:= by
  change colimit.ι B.gluingData.functor U ≫ colimMap (specNatTrans φ) =
    (specNatTrans φ).app U ≫ colimit.ι A.gluingData.functor U
  exact ι_colimMap _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.spec_map_unit
statement:
theorem spec_map_unit {A B : X.AffineAlgebra} (φ : Hom A B) (U : X.AffineZariskiSite) :
    Spec.map (φ.app.app (op U)) ≫ Spec.map (A.unit.app (op U)) = Spec.map (B.unit.app (op U))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Spec.map_comp]
  exact congrArg Spec.map (congrArg (fun α => α.app (op U)) φ.unit_app)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.specMap_chartToOpen
statement:
theorem specMap_chartToOpen {A B : X.AffineAlgebra} (φ : Hom A B) (U : X.AffineZariskiSite) :
    Spec.map (φ.app.app (op U)) ≫ A.chartToOpen U = B.chartToOpen U
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartToOpen
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
    (congrArg (fun g => g ≫ U.2.isoSpec.inv) (spec_map_unit φ U))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.relativeSpec.map_hom
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem relativeSpec.map_hom {A B : X.AffineAlgebra} (φ : Hom A B) :
    relativeSpec.map φ ≫ A.relativeSpec.hom = B.relativeSpec.hom
proof:
:= by
  refine colimit.hom_ext fun (U : X.AffineZariskiSite) => ?_
  change B.chart U ≫ relativeSpec.map φ ≫ A.relativeSpec.hom = B.chart U ≫ B.relativeSpec.hom
  rw [relativeSpec.chart_map_assoc, chart_hom, chart_hom, ← Category.assoc,
    specMap_chartToOpen]

name: wsaPullback_aux_summand
statement:
private theorem wsaPullback_aux_summand {A₁ A₂ Z P₁ P₂ Q : C} {A₁' A₂' Z' P₁' P₂' Q' : D}
    (π₁ : P₁ ⟶ A₁) (π₂ : P₂ ⟶ A₂) (m : A₁ ⊗ A₂ ⟶ Z) (ι : Z ⟶ Q)
    (e₁ : F.obj A₁ ⟶ A₁') (e₂ : F.obj A₂ ⟶ A₂') (eZ : F.obj Z ⟶ Z') (eP₁ : F.obj P₁ ⟶ P₁')
    (eP₂ : F.obj P₂ ⟶ P₂') (eQ : F.obj Q ⟶ Q')
    (π₁' : P₁' ⟶ A₁') (π₂' : P₂' ⟶ A₂') (m' : A₁' ⊗ A₂' ⟶ Z') (ι' : Z' ⟶ Q')
    (hπ₁ : F.map π₁ ≫ e₁ = eP₁ ≫ π₁') (hπ₂ : F.map π₂ ≫ e₂ = eP₂ ≫ π₂')
    (hm : Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F A₁ A₂ ≫ F.map m ≫ eZ = (e₁ ⊗ₘ e₂) ≫ m')
    (hι : F.map ι ≫ eQ = eZ ≫ ι') :
    (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F P₁ P₂ ≫ F.map ((π₁ ⊗ₘ π₂) ≫ m ≫ ι)) ≫ eQ =
      (eP₁ ⊗ₘ eP₂) ≫ (π₁' ⊗ₘ π₂') ≫ m' ≫ ι'
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.map_comp, F.map_comp, ← Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural_assoc]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [hι, reassoc_of% hm, ← Category.assoc, MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, hπ₁, hπ₂,
    ← MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, Category.assoc]

name: wsaPullback_aux_one
statement:
private theorem wsaPullback_aux_one {Z Q : C} {Z' Q' : D} (o : 𝟙_ C ⟶ Z) (ι : Z ⟶ Q)
    (eZ : F.obj Z ⟶ Z') (eQ : F.obj Q ⟶ Q') (ι' : Z' ⟶ Q') (o' : 𝟙_ D ⟶ Z')
    (hι : F.map ι ≫ eQ = eZ ≫ ι')
    (ho : Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε F ≫ F.map o ≫ eZ = o') :
    (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε F ≫ F.map (o ≫ ι)) ≫ eQ = o' ≫ ι'
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.map_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [hι, ← ho]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: wsaPullback_mapBiproduct_hom_π
statement:
private theorem wsaPullback_mapBiproduct_hom_π (j : J) :
    (F.mapBiproduct f).hom ≫ biproduct.π (F.obj ∘ f) j = F.map (biproduct.π f j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Functor.mapBiproduct_hom]
  exact biproduct.lift_π _ _

name: wsaPullback_map_ι_mapBiproduct_hom
statement:
private theorem wsaPullback_map_ι_mapBiproduct_hom (j : J) :
    F.map (biproduct.ι f j) ≫ (F.mapBiproduct f).hom = biproduct.ι (F.obj ∘ f) j
proof:
:= by
  rw [← biproduct.ι_desc (fun j => F.map (biproduct.ι f j)) j, ← Functor.mapBiproduct_inv,
    Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.pullbackIsoApp_hom
statement:
theorem GradedQCAlgebra.pullbackIsoApp_hom {S : X.GradedQCAlgebra} {T : X'.GradedQCAlgebra}
    (e : S.pullback g ≅ T) (m : ℕ) : (GradedQCAlgebra.pullbackIsoApp g e m).hom = e.hom.app m
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.pullbackIsoApp_map_mul
statement:
theorem GradedQCAlgebra.pullbackIsoApp_map_mul {S : X.GradedQCAlgebra} {T : X'.GradedQCAlgebra}
    (e : S.pullback g ≅ T) (m n : ℕ) :
    (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (Modules.pullback g) (S.part m) (S.part n) ≫
        (Modules.pullback g).map (S.mul m n)) ≫ (GradedQCAlgebra.pullbackIsoApp g e (m + n)).hom =
      ((GradedQCAlgebra.pullbackIsoApp g e m).hom ⊗ₘ (GradedQCAlgebra.pullbackIsoApp g e n).hom) ≫
        T.mul m n
proof:
:=
  e.hom.map_mul m n

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.pullbackIsoApp_map_one
statement:
theorem GradedQCAlgebra.pullbackIsoApp_map_one {S : X.GradedQCAlgebra} {T : X'.GradedQCAlgebra}
    (e : S.pullback g ≅ T) :
    (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε (Modules.pullback g) ≫ (Modules.pullback g).map S.one) ≫
        (GradedQCAlgebra.pullbackIsoApp g e 0).hom = T.one
proof:
:=
  e.hom.map_one

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.pullbackWeightedSymTensorIso_zero_hom
statement:
theorem pullbackWeightedSymTensorIso_zero_hom (W : Fin 0 → X.Modules) (W' : Fin 0 → X'.Modules)
    (ψ : ∀ q, (Modules.symGradedAlgebra (W q)).pullback g ≅ Modules.symGradedAlgebra (W' q))
    (d : Fin 0 → ℕ) :
    (pullbackWeightedSymTensorIso g 0 W W' ψ d).hom = (Functor.Monoidal.εIso (Modules.pullback g)).inv
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.pullbackWeightedSymTensorIso_succ_hom
statement:
theorem pullbackWeightedSymTensorIso_succ_hom (r : ℕ) (W : Fin (r + 1) → X.Modules)
    (W' : Fin (r + 1) → X'.Modules)
    (ψ : ∀ q, (Modules.symGradedAlgebra (W q)).pullback g ≅ Modules.symGradedAlgebra (W' q))
    (d : Fin (r + 1) → ℕ) :
    (pullbackWeightedSymTensorIso g (r + 1) W W' ψ d).hom =
      (Functor.Monoidal.μIso (Modules.pullback g) ((Modules.symGradedAlgebra (W 0)).part (d 0))
          (weightedSymTensor r (Fin.tail W) (Fin.tail d))).inv ≫
        ((GradedQCAlgebra.pullbackIsoApp g (ψ 0) (d 0)).hom ⊗ₘ
          (pullbackWeightedSymTensorIso g r (Fin.tail W) (Fin.tail W') (fun q => ψ q.succ)
            (Fin.tail d)).hom)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.pullbackWeightedSymTensorMul_iso
statement:
theorem pullbackWeightedSymTensorMul_iso : ∀ (r : ℕ) (W : Fin r → X.Modules) (W' : Fin r → X'.Modules)
    (ψ : ∀ q, (Modules.symGradedAlgebra (W q)).pullback g ≅ Modules.symGradedAlgebra (W' q))
    (d d' : Fin r → ℕ),
    (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (Modules.pullback g) (weightedSymTensor r W d) (weightedSymTensor r W d') ≫
        (Modules.pullback g).map (weightedSymTensorMul r W d d')) ≫
        (pullbackWeightedSymTensorIso g r W W' ψ (d + d')).hom =
      ((pullbackWeightedSymTensorIso g r W W' ψ d).hom ⊗ₘ
          (pullbackWeightedSymTensorIso g r W W' ψ d').hom) ≫
        weightedSymTensorMul r W' d d'
  | 0, _, _, _, _, _ => by
    show (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (Modules.pullback g) (𝟙_ X.Modules) (𝟙_ X.Modules) ≫
        (Modules.pullback g).map (λ_ (𝟙_ X.Modules)).hom) ≫ (Functor.Monoidal.εIso (Modules.pullback g)).inv =
      ((Functor.Monoidal.εIso (Modules.pullback g)).inv ⊗ₘ (Functor.Monoidal.εIso (Modules.pullback g)).inv) ≫
        (λ_ (𝟙_ X'.Modules)).hom
    simp only [Functor.Monoidal.εIso_inv]
    rw [Functor.Monoidal.map_leftUnitor, Functor.Monoidal.μ_δ_assoc, Category.assoc,
      ← leftUnitor_naturality, ← tensorHom_def_assoc]
  | r + 1, W, W', ψ, d, d' => by
    have hψ
proof:
:= GradedQCAlgebra.pullbackIsoApp_map_mul g (ψ 0) (d 0) (d' 0)
    have hIH := pullbackWeightedSymTensorMul_iso r (Fin.tail W) (Fin.tail W') (fun q => ψ q.succ)
      (Fin.tail d) (Fin.tail d')
    simp only [Category.assoc] at hψ hIH
    rw [pullbackWeightedSymTensorIso_succ_hom, pullbackWeightedSymTensorIso_succ_hom,
      pullbackWeightedSymTensorIso_succ_hom]
    show (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (Modules.pullback g)
          ((Modules.symGradedAlgebra (W 0)).part (d 0) ⊗ weightedSymTensor r (Fin.tail W) (Fin.tail d))
          ((Modules.symGradedAlgebra (W 0)).part (d' 0) ⊗ weightedSymTensor r (Fin.tail W) (Fin.tail d')) ≫
        (Modules.pullback g).map (tensorμ _ _ _ _ ≫
          ((Modules.symGradedAlgebra (W 0)).mul (d 0) (d' 0) ⊗ₘ
            weightedSymTensorMul r (Fin.tail W) (Fin.tail d) (Fin.tail d')))) ≫
        ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso (Modules.pullback g) ((Modules.symGradedAlgebra (W 0)).part (d 0 + d' 0))
            (weightedSymTensor r (Fin.tail W) (Fin.tail d + Fin.tail d'))).inv ≫
          ((GradedQCAlgebra.pullbackIsoApp g (ψ 0) (d 0 + d' 0)).hom ⊗ₘ
            (pullbackWeightedSymTensorIso g r (Fin.tail W) (Fin.tail W') (fun q => ψ q.succ)
              (Fin.tail d + Fin.tail d')).hom)) =
      (((Functor.Monoidal.μIso (Modules.pullback g) ((Modules.symGradedAlgebra (W 0)).part (d 0))
            (weightedSymTensor r (Fin.tail W) (Fin.tail d))).inv ≫
          ((GradedQCAlgebra.pullbackIsoApp g (ψ 0) (d 0)).hom ⊗ₘ
            (pullbackWeightedSymTensorIso g r (Fin.tail W) (Fin.tail W') (fun q => ψ q.succ)
              (Fin.tail d)).hom)) ⊗ₘ
        ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso (Modules.pullback g) ((Modules.symGradedAlgebra (W 0)).part (d' 0))
            (weightedSymTensor r (Fin.tail W) (Fin.tail d'))).inv ≫
          ((GradedQCAlgebra.pullbackIsoApp g (ψ 0) (d' 0)).hom ⊗ₘ
            (pullbackWeightedSymTensorIso g r (Fin.tail W) (Fin.tail W') (fun q => ψ q.succ)
              (Fin.tail d')).hom))) ≫
        (tensorμ _ _ _ _ ≫
          ((Modules.symGradedAlgebra (W' 0)).mul (d 0) (d' 0) ⊗ₘ
            weightedSymTensorMul r (Fin.tail W') (Fin.tail d) (Fin.tail d')))
    simp only [Functor.Monoidal.μIso_inv]
    rw [← cancel_epi (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (Modules.pullback g) _ _ ⊗ₘ
      Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (Modules.pullback g) _ _)]
    conv_rhs => rw [← Category.assoc, tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, Functor.Monoidal.μ_δ_assoc,
      Functor.Monoidal.μ_δ_assoc]
    rw [(Modules.pullback g).map_comp]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [← tensorμ_comp_μ_tensorHom_μ_comp_μ_assoc, ← Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural_assoc,
      Functor.Monoidal.μ_δ_assoc, tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, hψ, hIH,
      ← tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, ← tensorμ_natural_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.pullbackWeightedSymTensorOne_iso
statement:
theorem pullbackWeightedSymTensorOne_iso : ∀ (r : ℕ) (W : Fin r → X.Modules) (W' : Fin r → X'.Modules)
    (ψ : ∀ q, (Modules.symGradedAlgebra (W q)).pullback g ≅ Modules.symGradedAlgebra (W' q)),
    (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε (Modules.pullback g) ≫ (Modules.pullback g).map (weightedSymTensorOne r W)) ≫
        (pullbackWeightedSymTensorIso g r W W' ψ 0).hom =
      weightedSymTensorOne r W'
  | 0, _, _, _ => by
    show (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε (Modules.pullback g) ≫ (Modules.pullback g).map (𝟙 (𝟙_ X.Modules))) ≫
        (Functor.Monoidal.εIso (Modules.pullback g)).inv = 𝟙 _
    simp only [Functor.Monoidal.εIso_inv]
    rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.comp_id, Functor.Monoidal.ε_η]
  | r + 1, W, W', ψ => by
    have hψ
proof:
:= GradedQCAlgebra.pullbackIsoApp_map_one g (ψ 0)
    have hIH := pullbackWeightedSymTensorOne_iso r (Fin.tail W) (Fin.tail W') (fun q => ψ q.succ)
    simp only [Category.assoc] at hψ hIH
    rw [pullbackWeightedSymTensorIso_succ_hom]
    show (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε (Modules.pullback g) ≫
        (Modules.pullback g).map ((λ_ (𝟙_ X.Modules)).inv ≫
          ((Modules.symGradedAlgebra (W 0)).one ⊗ₘ weightedSymTensorOne r (Fin.tail W)))) ≫
        ((Functor.Monoidal.μIso (Modules.pullback g) ((Modules.symGradedAlgebra (W 0)).part 0)
            (weightedSymTensor r (Fin.tail W) 0)).inv ≫
          ((GradedQCAlgebra.pullbackIsoApp g (ψ 0) 0).hom ⊗ₘ
            (pullbackWeightedSymTensorIso g r (Fin.tail W) (Fin.tail W') (fun q => ψ q.succ) 0).hom)) =
      (λ_ (𝟙_ X'.Modules)).inv ≫
        ((Modules.symGradedAlgebra (W' 0)).one ⊗ₘ weightedSymTensorOne r (Fin.tail W'))
    simp only [Functor.Monoidal.μIso_inv]
    rw [(Modules.pullback g).map_comp, Functor.Monoidal.map_leftUnitor_inv]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [← Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural_assoc, Functor.Monoidal.μ_δ_assoc, tensorHom_comp_tensorHom,
      leftUnitor_inv_naturality_assoc, ← tensorHom_def'_assoc, tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, hψ, hIH]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.pullbackPartIso_hom

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.map_π_pullbackPartIso
statement:

      (pullbackPartIso g V V' ψ m).hom ≫ biproduct.π (fun d => term V' d) d

statement:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.pullbackMulHom_iso
statement:
theorem pullbackMulHom_iso (m n : ℕ) :
    (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (Modules.pullback g) (part V m) (part V n) ≫
        (Modules.pullback g).map (mulHom V m n)) ≫ (pullbackPartIso g V V' ψ (m + n)).hom =
      ((pullbackPartIso g V V' ψ m).hom ⊗ₘ (pullbackPartIso g V V' ψ n).hom) ≫ mulHom V' m n
proof:
:= by
  have : (Modules.pullback g).Additive :=
    (Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).left_adjoint_additive
  simp only [mulHom, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_sum, Preadditive.sum_comp, Preadditive.comp_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
  exact wsaPullback_aux_summand (Modules.pullback g) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    (map_π_pullbackPartIso g V V' ψ p.1) (map_π_pullbackPartIso g V V' ψ p.2)
    (pullbackWeightedSymTensorMul_iso g r (gen V) (gen V') ψ (fun q => (p.1.1 q : ℕ))
      (fun q => (p.2.1 q : ℕ)))
    (map_ι_pullbackPartIso g V V' ψ (p.1.add p.2))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.pullbackOneHom_iso
statement:

        (pullbackPartIso g V V' ψ 0).hom = oneHom V'
proof:
:=
  wsaPullback_aux_one (Modules.pullback g) _ _ _ _ _ _
    (map_ι_pullbackPartIso g V V' ψ (⟨0, by simp⟩ : weightedSymIndex r 0))
    (pullbackWeightedSymTensorOne_iso g r (gen V) (gen V') ψ)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra_pullback
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra_pullback
    {X X' : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} {r : ℕ} (V : Fin r → X.Modules)
    [∀ q, (V q).IsLocallyFree] [∀ q, (V q).IsFiniteType] (g : X' ⟶ X) :
    haveI
proof:
:= fun q => (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isLocallyFree_pullback g (V q)).1
    haveI := fun q => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isFiniteType_pullback g (V q)
    Nonempty ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).pullback g ≅
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra
        (fun q => (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj (V q))) := by
  have := fun q => (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isLocallyFree_pullback g (V q)).1
  have := fun q => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isFiniteType_pullback g (V q)
  refine ⟨AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebraPullbackIso g V _ fun q => ?_⟩
  haveI : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.dual (V q)).IsLocallyFree :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isLocallyFree_dual' (V q)
  haveI : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.dual (V q)).IsQuasicoherent :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_of_isLocallyFree _
  exact (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symGradedAlgebra_pullback g
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.dual (V q))).some ≪≫
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symGradedAlgebra_congr
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.dual_pullback g (V q)).some.symm

name: transpAux_naturality
proof:
:= by
  have h : P ◁ (β_ V V).hom ≫ (a ⊗ₘ (g ⊗ₘ g)) = (a ⊗ₘ (g ⊗ₘ g)) ≫ P' ◁ (β_ W W).hom := by
    rw [tensorHom_def', ← whiskerLeft_comp_assoc, ← BraidedCategory.braiding_naturality,
      whiskerLeft_comp_assoc, whisker_exchange, Category.assoc]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← associator_inv_naturality, reassoc_of% h, associator_naturality_assoc]

name: map_whiskerRight_δ_comm
proof:
:= by
  rw [← δ_natural_left_assoc, ← comp_whiskerRight, h, comp_whiskerRight, Category.assoc]

name: map_transpAux_δ_comm
statement:
private theorem map_transpAux_δ_comm (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Braided] {P V : C} {Q : D} (c : F.obj P ⟶ Q) :
    F.map ((α_ P V V).hom ≫ P ◁ (β_ V V).hom ≫ (α_ P V V).inv) ≫
        δ F (P ⊗ V) V ≫ (δ F P V ≫ c ▷ F.obj V) ▷ F.obj V =
      (δ F (P ⊗ V) V ≫ (δ F P V ≫ c ▷ F.obj V) ▷ F.obj V) ≫
        (α_ Q (F.obj V) (F.obj V)).hom ≫ Q ◁ (β_ (F.obj V) (F.obj V)).hom ≫
          (α_ Q (F.obj V) (F.obj V)).inv
proof:
:= by
  have hb : F.map (β_ V V).hom ≫ δ F V V = δ F V V ≫ (β_ (F.obj V) (F.obj V)).hom := by
    rw [F.map_braiding, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, μ_δ, Category.comp_id]
  have h1' := transpAux_naturality c (𝟙 (F.obj V))
  simp only [tensorHom_id, Category.assoc] at h1'
  simp only [F.map_comp, Category.assoc, comp_whiskerRight]
  rw [← Functor.OplaxMonoidal.associativity_inv_assoc, ← δ_natural_right_assoc, ← whiskerLeft_comp_assoc, hb,
    whiskerLeft_comp_assoc, ← Functor.OplaxMonoidal.associativity_assoc, h1']

name: map_rightUnitor_δ_comm
proof:
:= by
  rw [hu, map_rightUnitor, tensorHom_def']
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [rightUnitor_naturality]

name: map_cat_succ_δ_comm
statement:
private theorem map_cat_succ_δ_comm (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Monoidal] {P Q W S : C} {P' Q' S' : D}
    (a : F.obj P ⟶ P') (b : F.obj Q ⟶ Q') (c : F.obj S ⟶ S')
    (k : P ⊗ Q ⟶ S) (k' : P' ⊗ Q' ⟶ S')
    (ih : F.map k ≫ c = δ F P Q ≫ (a ⊗ₘ b) ≫ k') :
    F.map ((α_ P Q W).inv ≫ k ▷ W) ≫ δ F S W ≫ c ▷ F.obj W =
      δ F P (Q ⊗ W) ≫ (a ⊗ₘ (δ F Q W ≫ b ▷ F.obj W)) ≫ (α_ P' Q' (F.obj W)).inv ≫ k' ▷ F.obj W
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (a ⊗ₘ (δ F Q W ≫ b ▷ F.obj W)) =
      (F.obj P ◁ δ F Q W) ≫ (a ⊗ₘ (b ⊗ₘ 𝟙 (F.obj W))) := by
    rw [← id_tensorHom, tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, Category.id_comp, tensorHom_id]
  rw [F.map_comp, Category.assoc, ← δ_natural_left_assoc, ← comp_whiskerRight, ih, map_associator_inv, h1]
  simp only [Category.assoc, comp_whiskerRight, μ_δ_assoc, whiskerRight_μ_δ_assoc]
  rw [associator_inv_naturality_assoc, tensorHom_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback_map_monoidalPowTransp_iso
statement:
theorem pullback_map_monoidalPowTransp_iso (f : X ⟶ Y) (W : Y.Modules) : ∀ (m i : ℕ),
    (pullback f).map (monoidalPowTransp W m i) ≫ (pullbackMonoidalPowIso f W m).hom =
      (pullbackMonoidalPowIso f W m).hom ≫ monoidalPowTransp ((pullback f).obj W) m i
  | 0, 0 =>
    ((congrArg (· ≫ _) ((pullback f).map_id _)).trans (Category.id_comp _)).trans
      (Category.comp_id _).symm
  | 0, _ + 1 =>
    ((congrArg (· ≫ _) ((pullback f).map_id _)).trans (Category.id_comp _)).trans
      (Category.comp_id _).symm
  | 1, 0 =>
    ((congrArg (· ≫ _) ((pullback f).map_id _)).trans (Category.id_comp _)).trans
      (Category.comp_id _).symm
  | n + 2, 0 => map_transpAux_δ_comm (pullback f) (pullbackMonoidalPowIso f W n).hom
  | 0 + 1, i + 1 => map_whiskerRight_δ_comm (pullback f) (pullbackMonoidalPowIso f W 0).hom _ _
      (pullback_map_monoidalPowTransp_iso f W 0 i)
  | (n + 1) + 1, i + 1 => map_whiskerRight_δ_comm (pullback f) (pullbackMonoidalPowIso f W (n + 1)).hom _ _
      (pullback_map_monoidalPowTransp_iso f W (n + 1) i)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback_map_monoidalPowCat_iso
statement:
theorem pullback_map_monoidalPowCat_iso (f : X ⟶ Y) (W : Y.Modules) (m : ℕ) : ∀ n : ℕ,
    (pullback f).map (monoidalPowCat W m n).hom ≫ (pullbackMonoidalPowIso f W (m + n)).hom =
      (pullbackTensorObjIso f (monoidalPow W m) (monoidalPow W n)).hom ≫
        ((pullbackMonoidalPowIso f W m).hom ⊗ₘ (pullbackMonoidalPowIso f W n).hom) ≫
        (monoidalPowCat ((pullback f).obj W) m n).hom
  | 0 => map_rightUnitor_δ_comm (pullback f) (pullbackMonoidalPowIso f W m).hom _ (pullback_η f).symm
  | n + 1 => map_cat_succ_δ_comm (pullback f) _ _ _ _ _ (pullback_map_monoidalPowCat_iso f W m n)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback_map_monoidalPowTransp_symPowπ
statement:
theorem pullback_map_monoidalPowTransp_symPowπ (f : X ⟶ Y) (W : Y.Modules) (m : ℕ) (i : Fin m) :

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback_map_symPowπ_pullbackSymPowHom

:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symPowπ_pullbackSymPowInv

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback_map_symPowπ_pullbackSymPowIso_hom
statement:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symGradedAlgebraOfQC_pullback_map_mul
statement:
theorem symGradedAlgebraOfQC_pullback_map_mul (f : X ⟶ Y) (F : Y.Modules) (hF : F.IsQuasicoherent)
    (m n : ℕ) :
    ((symGradedAlgebraOfQC F hF).pullback f).mul m n ≫ (pullbackSymPowIso f F (m + n)).hom =
      ((pullbackSymPowIso f F m).hom ⊗ₘ (pullbackSymPowIso f F n).hom) ≫
        symPowMul ((pullback f).obj F) m n
proof:
:= by
  change (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (pullback f) (symPow F m) (symPow F n) ≫
      (pullback f).map (symPowMul F m n)) ≫ _ = _
  have : Epi ((pullback f).map (symPowπ F m)) := inferInstance
  have : Epi ((pullback f).map (symPowπ F n)) := inferInstance
  have := epi_tensorHom_of_epi ((pullback f).map (symPowπ F m)) ((pullback f).map (symPowπ F n))
  
  have hμδ : Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (pullback f) (monoidalPow F m) (monoidalPow F n) ≫
      (pullbackTensorObjIso f (monoidalPow F m) (monoidalPow F n)).hom = 𝟙 _ :=
    Iso.inv_hom_id _
  rw [← cancel_epi ((pullback f).map (symPowπ F m) ⊗ₘ (pullback f).map (symPowπ F n))]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, tensorHom_symPowπ_symPowMul,
    Functor.map_comp_assoc, pullback_map_symPowπ_pullbackSymPowIso_hom,
    reassoc_of% (pullback_map_monoidalPowCat_iso f F m n), reassoc_of% hμδ,
    tensorHom_comp_tensorHom_assoc, pullback_map_symPowπ_pullbackSymPowIso_hom,
    pullback_map_symPowπ_pullbackSymPowIso_hom, ← tensorHom_comp_tensorHom_assoc,
    tensorHom_symPowπ_symPowMul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symGradedAlgebraOfQC_pullback_map_one
statement:
theorem symGradedAlgebraOfQC_pullback_map_one (f : X ⟶ Y) (F : Y.Modules) (hF : F.IsQuasicoherent) :
    ((symGradedAlgebraOfQC F hF).pullback f).one ≫ (pullbackSymPowIso f F 0).hom =
      symPowπ ((pullback f).obj F) 0
proof:
:= by
  
  
  have hε : Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε (pullback f) ≫ (pullbackMonoidalPowIso f F 0).hom = 𝟙 _ :=
    (congrArg (· ≫ (pullbackMonoidalPowIso f F 0).hom) (pullback_ε_eq f)).trans
      (Iso.inv_hom_id (pullbackUnitIso f))
  change (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε (pullback f) ≫ (pullback f).map (symPowπ F 0)) ≫
    (pullbackSymPowIso f F 0).hom = _
  refine (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans ?_
  refine (congrArg (fun t => Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε (pullback f) ≫ t)
    (pullback_map_symPowπ_pullbackSymPowIso_hom f F 0)).trans ?_
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (· ≫ symPowπ ((pullback f).obj F) 0) hε).trans (Category.id_comp _))

statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symGradedAlgebra_pullback {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}

    eqToIso (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symGradedAlgebra_eq_ofQC

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.isIso_of_isIso_app
statement: theorem isIso_of_isIso_app {S T : X.GradedQCAlgebra} (φ : S ⟶ T) [hφ : ∀ m, IsIso (φ.app m)] : IsIso φ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨⟨fun m => inv (φ.app m), ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro m n
    rw [← cancel_epi (φ.app m ⊗ₘ φ.app n), ← Category.assoc, ← φ.map_mul, Category.assoc,
      IsIso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id, ← Category.assoc,
      CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, IsIso.hom_inv_id, IsIso.hom_inv_id,
      CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.id_tensorHom_id, Category.id_comp]
  · rw [← φ.map_one, Category.assoc, IsIso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  · exact Hom.ext_app fun m => IsIso.hom_inv_id (φ.app m)
  · exact Hom.ext_app fun m => IsIso.inv_hom_id (φ.app m)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.pullbackSections_id
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.pullbackSections_id {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    (A : X.QCAlgebra) (U : X.Opens) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.pullbackSections A (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec A)
        (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id _) U =
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.structureRingMap A).app (Opposite.op U)).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ (Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}) (V : Y.Opens) (e : V = V),
      Y.presheaf.map (CategoryTheory.eqToHom e).op = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id _ := by
    intro Y V e; simp
  refine RingHom.ext fun c => ?_
  exact congrArg (fun f : Γ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec A).left,
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec A).hom ⁻¹ᵁ U) ⟶
      Γ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec A).left, (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec A).hom ⁻¹ᵁ U) =>
      f.hom (((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.structureRingMap A).app (Opposite.op U)).hom c))
    (h1 _ ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec A).hom ⁻¹ᵁ U) _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.structureHom_app_apply

theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.structureHom_app_apply {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.structureHom_app_affine
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.structureHom_app_affine {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
