name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.structureHom_app_bijective
proof:
:= by
  have hbij : Function.Bijective (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.sectionsIso A U).hom.hom :=
    (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).mp
      (CategoryTheory.Iso.isIso_hom (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.sectionsIso A U))
  have heq := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.structureHom_app_affine A U
  exact ⟨fun a b hab => hbij.1 ((heq a).symm.trans (hab.trans (heq b))),
    fun y => (hbij.2 y).imp fun a ha => (heq a).trans ha⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_bijective_on_affineOpens
proof:
:= by
  have hb : TopologicalSpace.Opens.IsBasis (Set.range (fun U : X.affineOpens => (U.1 : X.Opens))) := by
    rw [Subtype.range_coe]
    exact X.isBasis_affineOpens
  have h1 : CategoryTheory.IsIso ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map φ) :=
    TopCat.Sheaf.isIso_iff_isIso_basis hb (fun U =>
      (CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).mpr (h U))
  exact CategoryTheory.isIso_of_reflects_iso (C := SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf) φ
    (SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.structureIso_inv_app_affine
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.structureIso_inv_app_affine {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    (A : X.QCAlgebra) (U : X.affineOpens)
    (s : Γ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec A).left, (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec A).hom ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)) :
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.structureIso A).inv.app U.1 s =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.sectionsIso A U).inv.hom s
proof:
:= by
  apply (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.structureHom_app_bijective A U).1
  have h1 : ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.structureHom A).app U.1).hom
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.structureIso A).inv.app U.1 s) = s :=
    congrArg (fun f : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pushforward (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec A).hom).obj
        (SheafOfModules.unit (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec A).left.ringCatSheaf) ⟶ _ => (f.app U.1).hom s)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.structureIso A).inv_hom_id
  have h2 : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.sectionsIso A U).hom.hom
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.sectionsIso A U).inv.hom s) = s :=
    congrArg (fun f : Γ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec A).left,
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec A).hom ⁻¹ᵁ U.1) ⟶ _ => f.hom s)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.sectionsIso A U).inv_hom_id
  exact h1.trans ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.structureHom_app_affine A U _).trans h2).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.pushforward_unit_isQuasicoherent
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.pushforward_unit_isQuasicoherent {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    (A : X.QCAlgebra) :
    ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pushforward (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec A).hom).obj
      (SheafOfModules.unit (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec A).left.ringCatSheaf)).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:=
  (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.structureIso A) A.quasicoherent

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.totalCurry_symm_apply
statement:
theorem totalCurry_symm_apply (F G H : X.Modules) (ψ : F ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.internalHom G H) :
    (totalCurry F G H).symm ψ = (ψ ▷ G) ≫ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.internalHomEval G H
proof:
:= by
  have e : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorHomEquiv F G H).symm ψ =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorIsoTensorObj F G).hom ≫ (ψ ▷ G) ≫
        AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.internalHomEval G H := rfl
  show ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorIsoTensorObj F G).homCongr (Iso.refl H))
    ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorHomEquiv F G H).symm ψ) = _
  rw [e]
  simp [Iso.homCongr]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.totalCurry_naturality_left
statement:
theorem totalCurry_naturality_left {F' F : X.Modules} (G H : X.Modules) (a : F' ⟶ F) (f : F ⊗ G ⟶ H) :
    a ≫ totalCurry F G H f = totalCurry F' G H ((a ▷ G) ≫ f)
proof:
:= by
  apply (totalCurry F' G H).symm.injective
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply, totalCurry_symm_apply, MonoidalCategory.comp_whiskerRight,
    Category.assoc, ← totalCurry_symm_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.whiskerRight_totalCurry_symm
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_totalCurry_symm {F' F G H : X.Modules} (a : F' ⟶ F)
    (D : F ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.internalHom G H) :
    (a ▷ G) ≫ (totalCurry F G H).symm D = (totalCurry F' G H).symm (a ≫ D)
proof:
:= by
  apply (totalCurry F' G H).injective
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, ← totalCurry_naturality_left, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.coprod_whiskerRight_hom_ext
proof:
:= by
  apply (totalCurry _ _ _).injective
  apply Sigma.hom_ext
  intro i
  rw [totalCurry_naturality_left, totalCurry_naturality_left, h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.coprod_whiskerLeft_hom_ext
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_epi (β_ (∐ P) F).hom]
  apply coprod_whiskerRight_hom_ext
  intro j
  rw [BraidedCategory.braiding_naturality_left_assoc, BraidedCategory.braiding_naturality_left_assoc, h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.coprod_tensor_hom_ext
proof:
:= by
  apply coprod_whiskerRight_hom_ext
  intro i
  apply coprod_whiskerLeft_hom_ext
  intro j
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, ← MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_def', h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.coprod_tensor_tensor_hom_ext
statement:
theorem coprod_tensor_tensor_hom_ext {ι κ μ : Type w} (P : ι → X.Modules) (Q : κ → X.Modules)
    (R : μ → X.Modules) [HasCoproduct P] [HasCoproduct Q] [HasCoproduct R]
    {H : X.Modules} {f g : ((∐ P) ⊗ (∐ Q)) ⊗ (∐ R) ⟶ H}
    (h : ∀ i j k, ((Sigma.ι P i ⊗ₘ Sigma.ι Q j) ⊗ₘ Sigma.ι R k) ≫ f =
      ((Sigma.ι P i ⊗ₘ Sigma.ι Q j) ⊗ₘ Sigma.ι R k) ≫ g) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply coprod_whiskerLeft_hom_ext
  intro k
  apply (totalCurry _ _ _).injective
  apply coprod_tensor_hom_ext
  intro i j
  rw [totalCurry_naturality_left, totalCurry_naturality_left]
  congr 1
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, ← MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_def, h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.whiskerRight_ι_comp_totalMul
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_ι_comp_totalMul (S : X.GradedQCAlgebra) (m : ℕ) :
    (Sigma.ι S.part m ▷ (∐ S.part)) ≫ totalMul S = totalMulRow S m
proof:
:= by
  unfold totalMul
  rw [whiskerRight_totalCurry_symm, Sigma.ι_desc, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.whiskerLeft_ι_comp_totalMulRow
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_ι_comp_totalMulRow (S : X.GradedQCAlgebra) (m n : ℕ) :
    (S.part m ◁ Sigma.ι S.part n) ≫ totalMulRow S m = S.mul m n ≫ Sigma.ι S.part (m + n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold totalMulRow
  rw [← Category.assoc, BraidedCategory.braiding_naturality_right, Category.assoc,
    whiskerRight_totalCurry_symm, Sigma.ι_desc, Equiv.symm_apply_apply,
    SymmetricCategory.symmetry_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.tensor_ι_comp_totalMul
statement:
theorem tensor_ι_comp_totalMul (S : X.GradedQCAlgebra) (m n : ℕ) :
    (Sigma.ι S.part m ⊗ₘ Sigma.ι S.part n) ≫ totalMul S = S.mul m n ≫ Sigma.ι S.part (m + n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_def', Category.assoc, whiskerRight_ι_comp_totalMul,
    whiskerLeft_ι_comp_totalMulRow]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.total_isQuasicoherent
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.total_isQuasicoherent {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    (S : X.GradedQCAlgebra) : (∐ S.part).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  have h : (∐ (S.part ∘ (Equiv.ulift.{u, 0} : ULift.{u} ℕ ≃ ℕ))).IsQuasicoherent :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_colimit
      (Discrete.functor (S.part ∘ (Equiv.ulift.{u, 0} : ULift.{u} ℕ ≃ ℕ)))
      (fun j => S.quasicoherent j.as.down)
  exact ObjectProperty.prop_of_iso (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf)
    (Sigma.reindex (Equiv.ulift.{u, 0} : ULift.{u} ℕ ≃ ℕ) S.part) h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.total_one_mul
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.total_one_mul {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    (S : X.GradedQCAlgebra) :
    (λ_ (∐ S.part)).hom =
      ((S.one ≫ CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.ι S.part 0) ▷ (∐ S.part)) ≫ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.totalMul S
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.coprod_whiskerLeft_hom_ext
  intro n
  have hR : (𝟙_ X.Modules ◁ Sigma.ι S.part n) ≫
      ((S.one ≫ Sigma.ι S.part 0) ▷ (∐ S.part)) ≫ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.totalMul S =
      (S.one ▷ S.part n) ≫ S.mul 0 n ≫ Sigma.ι S.part (0 + n) := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_def',
      ← MonoidalCategory.whiskerRight_comp_tensorHom, Category.assoc,
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.tensor_ι_comp_totalMul]
  have e := reassoc_of% (S.one_mul n)
  rw [hR, MonoidalCategory.leftUnitor_naturality, e, Sigma.eqToHom_comp_ι S.part (Nat.zero_add n).symm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.total_mul_assoc
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.total_mul_assoc {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    (S : X.GradedQCAlgebra) :
    (α_ (∐ S.part) (∐ S.part) (∐ S.part)).hom ≫ ((∐ S.part) ◁ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.totalMul S) ≫ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.totalMul S =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.totalMul S ▷ (∐ S.part)) ≫ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.totalMul S
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.coprod_tensor_tensor_hom_ext
  intro m n p
  have hL : ((Sigma.ι S.part m ⊗ₘ Sigma.ι S.part n) ⊗ₘ Sigma.ι S.part p) ≫
      (α_ (∐ S.part) (∐ S.part) (∐ S.part)).hom ≫
        ((∐ S.part) ◁ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.totalMul S) ≫
          AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.totalMul S =
      (α_ (S.part m) (S.part n) (S.part p)).hom ≫ (S.part m ◁ S.mul n p) ≫ S.mul m (n + p) ≫
        Sigma.ι S.part (m + (n + p)) := by
    rw [MonoidalCategory.associator_naturality_assoc, ← Category.assoc (_ ⊗ₘ _),
      MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_comp_whiskerLeft,
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.tensor_ι_comp_totalMul,
      ← MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_comp_tensorHom, Category.assoc,
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.tensor_ι_comp_totalMul]
  have hR : ((Sigma.ι S.part m ⊗ₘ Sigma.ι S.part n) ⊗ₘ Sigma.ι S.part p) ≫
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.totalMul S ▷ (∐ S.part)) ≫
        AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.totalMul S =
      (S.mul m n ▷ S.part p) ≫ S.mul (m + n) p ≫ Sigma.ι S.part (m + n + p) := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_comp_whiskerRight,
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.tensor_ι_comp_totalMul,
      ← MonoidalCategory.whiskerRight_comp_tensorHom, Category.assoc,
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.tensor_ι_comp_totalMul]
  have e := reassoc_of% (S.mul_assoc m n p)
  rw [hL, hR, e, Sigma.eqToHom_comp_ι S.part (Nat.add_assoc m n p)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.total_mul_comm
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.coprod_tensor_hom_ext
  intro m n
  rw [← Category.assoc, BraidedCategory.braiding_naturality, Category.assoc,
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.tensor_ι_comp_totalMul,
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.tensor_ι_comp_totalMul, ← Category.assoc, S.mul_comm m n,
    Category.assoc, Sigma.eqToHom_comp_ι S.part (Nat.add_comm m n)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.ofAlgebraMap_appLE_structureHom
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.ofAlgebraMap_appLE_structureHom {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    (A : X.QCAlgebra) (T : CategoryTheory.Over X)
    (φ : A.carrier ⟶ (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pushforward T.hom).obj
      (SheafOfModules.unit T.left.ringCatSheaf))
    (hφ : A.IsAlgebraMapToPushforward T.hom φ) (V : X.Opens) (c : A.carrier.val.obj (Opposite.op V))
    (hle : T.hom ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.ofAlgebraMap A T φ hφ).left ⁻¹ᵁ
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec A).hom ⁻¹ᵁ V)) :
    ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.ofAlgebraMap A T φ hφ).left.appLE
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec A).hom ⁻¹ᵁ V) (T.hom ⁻¹ᵁ V) hle).hom
      (show Γ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec A).left, (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec A).hom ⁻¹ᵁ V) from
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.structureHom A).app V c) =
    (show Γ(T.left, T.hom ⁻¹ᵁ V) from φ.app V c)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.structureHom_app_apply]
  exact congrArg (fun ψ : CommRingCat.of (A.sectionsRing V) ⟶ CommRingCat.of Γ(T.left, T.hom ⁻¹ᵁ V) => ψ.hom c)
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeSpec.pullbackSections_ofAlgebraMap A T φ hφ V)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.comp_app_apply_sec
statement:
theorem comp_app_apply_sec {A B C : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) (x : Γ(A, U)) :
    (f ≫ g).app U x = g.app U (f.app U x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.iso_inv_app_eq
statement:
theorem iso_inv_app_eq {A B : X.Modules} (f : A ≅ B) {x : Γ(A, U)} {y : Γ(B, U)}
    (h : f.hom.app U x = y) : f.inv.app U y = x
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  have := congrArg (fun k : A ⟶ A => k.app U x) f.hom_inv_id
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.eqToHom_app_self
statement: theorem eqToHom_app_self {A : X.Modules} (h : A = A) (x : Γ(A, U)) : (eqToHom h).app U x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [eqToHom_refl]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorHom_app_tsec
statement:
theorem tensorHom_app_tsec {A B A' B' : X.Modules} (φ : A ⟶ A') (ψ : B ⟶ B') (a : Γ(A, U)) (b : Γ(B, U)) :
    (φ ⊗ₘ ψ).app U (tsec A B U a b) = tsec A' B' U (φ.app U a) (ψ.app U b)
proof:
:=
  tensorHom_tensorSections φ ψ U a b

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.whiskerLeft_app_tsec
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_app_tsec (A : X.Modules) {B B' : X.Modules} (f : B ⟶ B') (a : Γ(A, U)) (b : Γ(B, U)) :
    (A ◁ f).app U (tsec A B U a b) = tsec A B' U a (f.app U b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidalCategory.id_tensorHom]
  exact tensorHom_tensorSections (𝟙 A) f U a b

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.whiskerRight_app_tsec
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_app_tsec {A A' : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ A') (B : X.Modules) (a : Γ(A, U)) (b : Γ(B, U)) :
    (f ▷ B).app U (tsec A B U a b) = tsec A' B U (f.app U a) b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_id]
  exact tensorHom_tensorSections f (𝟙 B) U a b

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.associator_app_tsec
statement:
theorem associator_app_tsec (A B C : X.Modules) (a : Γ(A, U)) (b : Γ(B, U)) (c : Γ(C, U)) :
    (α_ A B C).hom.app U (tsec (A ⊗ B) C U (tsec A B U a b) c) = tsec A (B ⊗ C) U a (tsec B C U b c)
proof:
:=
  associator_app_tensorSections A B C U a b c

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.associator_inv_app_tsec
statement:
theorem associator_inv_app_tsec (A B C : X.Modules) (a : Γ(A, U)) (b : Γ(B, U)) (c : Γ(C, U)) :
    (α_ A B C).inv.app U (tsec A (B ⊗ C) U a (tsec B C U b c)) = tsec (A ⊗ B) C U (tsec A B U a b) c
proof:
:=
  iso_inv_app_eq U (α_ A B C) (associator_app_tsec U A B C a b c)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.braiding_app_tsec
statement:
theorem braiding_app_tsec (A B : X.Modules) (a : Γ(A, U)) (b : Γ(B, U)) :
    (β_ A B).hom.app U (tsec A B U a b) = tsec B A U b a
proof:
:=
  braiding_app_tensorSections A B U a b

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.leftUnitor_app_tsec
statement:
theorem leftUnitor_app_tsec (A : X.Modules) (r : Γ(X, U)) (a : Γ(A, U)) :
    (λ_ A).hom.app U (tsec (𝟙_ X.Modules) A U r a) = r • a
proof:
:=
  leftUnitor_app_tensorSections A U r a

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.rightUnitor_app_tsec
statement:
theorem rightUnitor_app_tsec (A : X.Modules) (a : Γ(A, U)) (r : Γ(X, U)) :
    (ρ_ A).hom.app U (tsec A (𝟙_ X.Modules) U a r) = r • a
proof:
:=
  rightUnitor_app_tensorSections A U a r

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.leftUnitor_app_tsec_unitSec
statement:
theorem leftUnitor_app_tsec_unitSec (A : X.Modules) (a : Γ(A, U)) :
    (λ_ A).hom.app U (tsec (𝟙_ X.Modules) A U (unitSec U) a) = a
proof:
:=
  (leftUnitor_app_tensorSections A U 1 a).trans (one_smul _ a)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.rightUnitor_app_tsec_unitSec
statement:
theorem rightUnitor_app_tsec_unitSec (A : X.Modules) (a : Γ(A, U)) :
    (ρ_ A).hom.app U (tsec A (𝟙_ X.Modules) U a (unitSec U)) = a
proof:
:=
  (rightUnitor_app_tensorSections A U a 1).trans (one_smul _ a)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.leftUnitor_inv_app
statement:
theorem leftUnitor_inv_app (A : X.Modules) (a : Γ(A, U)) :
    (λ_ A).inv.app U a = tsec (𝟙_ X.Modules) A U (unitSec U) a
proof:
:=
  iso_inv_app_eq U (λ_ A) (leftUnitor_app_tsec_unitSec U A a)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.rightUnitor_inv_app
statement:
theorem rightUnitor_inv_app (A : X.Modules) (a : Γ(A, U)) :
    (ρ_ A).inv.app U a = tsec A (𝟙_ X.Modules) U a (unitSec U)
proof:
:=
  iso_inv_app_eq U (ρ_ A) (rightUnitor_app_tsec_unitSec U A a)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tsec_smul_left
statement:
theorem tsec_smul_left (A B : X.Modules) (r : Γ(X, U)) (a : Γ(A, U)) (b : Γ(B, U)) :
    tsec A B U (r • a) b = r • tsec A B U a b
proof:
:=
  tensorSections_smul_left A B U r a b _ rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tsec_smul_right
statement:
theorem tsec_smul_right (A B : X.Modules) (r : Γ(X, U)) (a : Γ(A, U)) (b : Γ(B, U)) :
    tsec A B U a (r • b) = r • tsec A B U a b
proof:
:=
  tensorSections_smul_right A B U r a b _ rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tsec_add_left
statement:
theorem tsec_add_left (A B : X.Modules) (a a' : Γ(A, U)) (b : Γ(B, U)) :
    tsec A B U (a + a') b = tsec A B U a b + tsec A B U a' b
proof:
:=
  tensorSections_add_left A B U a a' b

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tsec_add_right
statement:
theorem tsec_add_right (A B : X.Modules) (a : Γ(A, U)) (b b' : Γ(B, U)) :
    tsec A B U a (b + b') = tsec A B U a b + tsec A B U a b'
proof:
:=
  tensorSections_add_right A B U a b b'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorμ_app_tsec
statement:
theorem tensorμ_app_tsec (X₁ X₂ Y₁ Y₂ : X.Modules) (x₁ : Γ(X₁, U)) (x₂ : Γ(X₂, U))
    (y₁ : Γ(Y₁, U)) (y₂ : Γ(Y₂, U)) :
    (tensorμ X₁ X₂ Y₁ Y₂).app U (tsec (X₁ ⊗ X₂) (Y₁ ⊗ Y₂) U (tsec X₁ X₂ U x₁ x₂) (tsec Y₁ Y₂ U y₁ y₂)) =
      tsec (X₁ ⊗ Y₁) (X₂ ⊗ Y₂) U (tsec X₁ Y₁ U x₁ y₁) (tsec X₂ Y₂ U x₂ y₂)
proof:
:= by
  unfold tensorμ
  rw [comp_app_apply_sec, comp_app_apply_sec, comp_app_apply_sec, comp_app_apply_sec, associator_app_tsec,
    whiskerLeft_app_tsec, associator_inv_app_tsec, whiskerLeft_app_tsec, whiskerRight_app_tsec,
    braiding_app_tsec, whiskerLeft_app_tsec, associator_app_tsec, associator_inv_app_tsec]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.gradedPure_zero
statement:
theorem gradedPure_zero (S : X.GradedQCAlgebra) {V : X.Modules} (g : V ⟶ S.part 1) (v : Fin 0 → Γ(V, U)) :
    S.gradedPure U g 0 v = S.one.app U (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.unitSec U)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.gradedPure_succ
statement:
theorem gradedPure_succ (S : X.GradedQCAlgebra) {V : X.Modules} (g : V ⟶ S.part 1) (e : ℕ)
    (v : Fin (e + 1) → Γ(V, U)) :
    S.gradedPure U g (e + 1) v = (S.mul e 1).app U (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tsec
      (S.part e) (S.part 1) U (S.gradedPure U g e (Fin.init v)) (g.app U (v (Fin.last e))))
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.ofPiece_mul_app_tsec
statement:
theorem ofPiece_mul_app_tsec (S : X.GradedQCAlgebra) {m n : ℕ} (a : Γ(S.part m, U))
    (b : Γ(S.part n, U)) :
    S.ofPiece U (m + n) ((S.mul m n).app U
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tsec (S.part m) (S.part n) U a b)) =
      S.ofPiece U m a * S.ofPiece U n b
proof:
:=
  (DirectSum.of_mul_of (A := S.sectionsPiece U) a b).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.ofPiece_one_app_one
statement:
theorem ofPiece_one_app_one (S : X.GradedQCAlgebra) :
    S.ofPiece U 0 (S.one.app U (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.unitSec U)) = 1
proof:
:=
  (DirectSum.one_def (A := S.sectionsPiece U)).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.ofPiece_eqToHom_app
statement:
theorem ofPiece_eqToHom_app (S : X.GradedQCAlgebra) {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (x : Γ(S.part m, U)) :
    S.ofPiece U n ((eqToHom (congrArg S.part h)).app U x) = S.ofPiece U m x
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rw [eqToHom_refl]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.ofPiece_gradedPure
statement:
theorem ofPiece_gradedPure (S : X.GradedQCAlgebra) {V : X.Modules} (g : V ⟶ S.part 1) (e : ℕ)
    (v : Fin e → Γ(V, U)) :
    S.ofPiece U e (S.gradedPure U g e v) = ∏ i, S.ofPiece U 1 (g.app U (v i))
proof:
:= by
  induction e with
  | zero => rw [gradedPure_zero, ofPiece_one_app_one, Fin.prod_univ_zero]
  | succ e ih =>
    rw [gradedPure_succ]
    rw [ofPiece_mul_app_tsec, ih, Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
    rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.mul_app_gradedPure
statement:
theorem mul_app_gradedPure (S : X.GradedQCAlgebra) {V : X.Modules} (g : V ⟶ S.part 1) (m n : ℕ)
    (v : Fin m → Γ(V, U)) (v' : Fin n → Γ(V, U)) :
    (S.mul m n).app U (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tsec (S.part m) (S.part n) U
        (S.gradedPure U g m v) (S.gradedPure U g n v')) =
      S.gradedPure U g (m + n) (Fin.append v v')
proof:
:= by
  apply S.ofPiece_injective U (m + n)
  rw [ofPiece_mul_app_tsec, ofPiece_gradedPure, ofPiece_gradedPure, ofPiece_gradedPure,
    Fin.prod_univ_add]
  congr 1
  · exact Fintype.prod_congr _ _ fun i => by rw [Fin.append_left]
  · exact Fintype.prod_congr _ _ fun i => by rw [Fin.append_right]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.mul_app_one_tsec
statement:
theorem mul_app_one_tsec (S : X.GradedQCAlgebra) (m : ℕ) (b : Γ(S.part m, U)) :
    (S.mul 0 m).app U (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tsec (S.part 0) (S.part m) U
        (S.one.app U (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.unitSec U)) b) =
      (eqToHom (congrArg S.part (Nat.zero_add m).symm)).app U b
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun k : 𝟙_ X.Modules ⊗ S.part m ⟶ S.part (0 + m) =>
    k.app U (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tsec (𝟙_ X.Modules) (S.part m) U
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.unitSec U) b)) (S.one_mul m)
  simp only at h
  rw [Modules.comp_app_apply_sec, Modules.comp_app_apply_sec, Modules.whiskerRight_app_tsec,
    Modules.leftUnitor_app_tsec_unitSec] at h
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.eqToHom_app_eq_gradedPure_one
statement:
theorem eqToHom_app_eq_gradedPure_one (S : X.GradedQCAlgebra) {V : X.Modules} (g : V ⟶ S.part 1)
    {e : ℕ} (he : e = 1) (x : Γ(V, U)) (w : Fin e → Γ(V, U)) (hw : ∀ i, w i = x) :
    (eqToHom (congrArg S.part he.symm)).app U (g.app U x) = S.gradedPure U g e w
proof:
:= by
  subst he
  rw [eqToHom_refl, Modules.Hom.id_app, gradedPure_succ, gradedPure_zero, hw, mul_app_one_tsec]
  exact (Modules.eqToHom_app_self U _ _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.eqToHom_app_eq_gradedPure_zero
statement:
theorem eqToHom_app_eq_gradedPure_zero (S : X.GradedQCAlgebra) {V : X.Modules} (g : V ⟶ S.part 1)
    {e : ℕ} (he : e = 0) (w : Fin e → Γ(V, U)) :
    (eqToHom (congrArg S.part he.symm)).app U (S.one.app U (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.unitSec U)) = S.gradedPure U g e w
proof:
:= by
  subst he
  rw [eqToHom_refl]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedTensorPure_zero
statement:
theorem weightedTensorPure_zero (F : Fin 0 → X.Modules) (d : Fin 0 → ℕ) (w : ∀ q, Fin (d q) → Γ(F q, U)) :
    weightedTensorPure U 0 F d w = AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.unitSec U
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedTensorPure_succ
statement:
theorem weightedTensorPure_succ (r : ℕ) (F : Fin (r + 1) → X.Modules) (d : Fin (r + 1) → ℕ)
    (w : ∀ q, Fin (d q) → Γ(F q, U)) :
    weightedTensorPure U (r + 1) F d w = weightedTensorUp U r F d (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tsec _ _ U
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symGradedAlgebra (F 0)).gradedPure U
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symGen (F 0)) (d 0) (w 0))
      (weightedTensorPure U r (Fin.tail F) (Fin.tail d) (fun q => w q.succ)))
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedTensorCast_rfl
proof:
:= by
  unfold weightedTensorCast
  rw [eqToHom_refl]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedTensorCast_weightedTensorPure
statement:
theorem weightedTensorCast_weightedTensorPure (r : ℕ) (F : Fin r → X.Modules) {d d' : Fin r → ℕ} (h : d = d')
    (w : ∀ q, Fin (d q) → Γ(F q, U)) (w' : ∀ q, Fin (d' q) → Γ(F q, U))
    (hw : ∀ q i, w q i = w' q (Fin.cast (congrFun h q) i)) :
    weightedTensorCast U r F h (weightedTensorPure U r F d w) = weightedTensorPure U r F d' w'
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rw [weightedTensorCast_rfl]
  congr 1
  funext q i
  exact hw q i

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymTensorOne_app_one
statement:
theorem weightedSymTensorOne_app_one : ∀ (r : ℕ) (F : Fin r → X.Modules)
    (w : ∀ q, Fin ((0 : Fin r → ℕ) q) → Γ(F q, U)),
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymTensorOne r F).app U (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.unitSec U) =
      weightedTensorPure U r F 0 w
  | 0, _, _ => rfl
  | r + 1, F, w =>
    (congrArg (fun k => k.app U (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.unitSec U))
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymTensorOne.eq_2 r F)).trans <|
    (Modules.comp_app_apply_sec U _ _ _).trans <|
    (congrArg _ (Modules.leftUnitor_inv_app U _ _)).trans <|
    (Modules.tensorHom_app_tsec U _ _ _ _).trans <|
    congrArg (weightedTensorUp U r F 0)
      (congrArg₂ _ rfl (weightedSymTensorOne_app_one r (Fin.tail F) (fun q => w q.succ)))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymTensorMul_app_weightedTensorPure
statement:
theorem weightedSymTensorMul_app_weightedTensorPure : ∀ (r : ℕ) (F : Fin r → X.Modules) (a b : Fin r → ℕ)
    (wa : ∀ q, Fin (a q) → Γ(F q, U)) (wb : ∀ q, Fin (b q) → Γ(F q, U)),
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymTensorMul r F a b).app U
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tsec _ _ U (weightedTensorPure U r F a wa)
          (weightedTensorPure U r F b wb)) =
      weightedTensorPure U r F (a + b) (fun q => Fin.append (wa q) (wb q))
  | 0, _, _, _, _, _ => Modules.leftUnitor_app_tsec_unitSec U (𝟙_ X.Modules) (Modules.unitSec U)
  | r + 1, F, a, b, wa, wb => by
    refine (congrArg (fun k => k.app U (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tsec _ _ U
        (weightedTensorPure U (r + 1) F a wa) (weightedTensorPure U (r + 1) F b wb)))
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymTensorMul.eq_2 r F a b)).trans ?_
    refine (Modules.comp_app_apply_sec U _ _ _).trans ?_
    rw [weightedTensorPure_succ, weightedTensorPure_succ]
    refine (congrArg _ (Modules.tensorμ_app_tsec U _ _ _ _
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symGradedAlgebra (F 0)).gradedPure U
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symGen (F 0)) (a 0) (wa 0))
      (weightedTensorPure U r (Fin.tail F) (Fin.tail a) (fun q => wa q.succ))
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symGradedAlgebra (F 0)).gradedPure U
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.symGen (F 0)) (b 0) (wb 0))
      (weightedTensorPure U r (Fin.tail F) (Fin.tail b) (fun q => wb q.succ)))).trans ?_
    refine (Modules.tensorHom_app_tsec U _ _ _ _).trans ?_
    exact congrArg (weightedTensorUp U r F (a + b))
      (congrArg₂ _ (GradedQCAlgebra.mul_app_gradedPure U _ _ (a 0) (b 0) (wa 0) (wb 0))
        (weightedSymTensorMul_app_weightedTensorPure r (Fin.tail F) (Fin.tail a) (Fin.tail b) _ _))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymTensorGen_app
statement:
theorem weightedSymTensorGen_app : ∀ (r : ℕ) (F : Fin r → X.Modules) (j : Fin r) (e : Fin r → ℕ)
    (he : ∀ q, e q = if q = j then 1 else 0) (x : Γ(F j, U)) (w : ∀ q, Fin (e q) → Γ(F q, U))
    (hw : ∀ i, w j i = x),
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymTensorGen r F j e he).app U x = weightedTensorPure U r F e w
  | 0, _, j, _, _, _, _, _ => j.elim0
  | r + 1, F, ⟨0, h0⟩, e, he, x, w, hw => by
    have he0 : e 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
      rw [he 0, if_pos]
      exact Fin.ext rfl
    refine (congrArg (fun k => k.app U x)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymTensorGen.eq_2 r F h0 e he)).trans ?_
    refine (Modules.comp_app_apply_sec U _ _ _).trans ?_
    refine (Modules.comp_app_apply_sec U _ _ _).trans ?_
    refine (congrArg _ (congrArg _ (Modules.eqToHom_app_self U _ x))).trans ?_
    refine (congrArg _ (Modules.rightUnitor_inv_app U _ x)).trans ?_
    refine (Modules.tensorHom_app_tsec U _ _ _ _).trans ?_
    refine congrArg (weightedTensorUp U r F e) (congrArg₂ _ ?_ ?_)
    · exact (Modules.comp_app_apply_sec U _ _ _).trans
        (GradedQCAlgebra.eqToHom_app_eq_gradedPure_one U _ _ he0 x (w 0) hw)
    · have hetail : (0 : Fin r → ℕ) = Fin.tail e := by
        funext q
        show 0 = e q.succ
        rw [he q.succ, if_neg]
        intro h
        exact absurd (congrArg Fin.val h) (by simp)
      refine (Modules.comp_app_apply_sec U _ _ _).trans ?_
      refine (congrArg _ (weightedSymTensorOne_app_one U r (Fin.tail F) (fun _ => Fin.elim0))).trans ?_
      exact weightedTensorCast_weightedTensorPure U r (Fin.tail F) hetail (fun _ => Fin.elim0)
        (fun q => w q.succ) (fun q i => (show Fin 0 from i).elim0)
  | r + 1, F, ⟨j + 1, hj⟩, e, he, x, w, hw => by
    have he0 : e 0 = 0 := by
      rw [he 0, if_neg]
      intro h
      exact absurd (congrArg Fin.val h) (by simp)
    refine (congrArg (fun k => k.app U x)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymTensorGen.eq_3 r F j hj e he)).trans ?_
    refine (Modules.comp_app_apply_sec U _ _ _).trans ?_
    refine (congrArg _ (Modules.leftUnitor_inv_app U _ x)).trans ?_
    refine (Modules.tensorHom_app_tsec U _ _ _ _).trans ?_
    refine congrArg (weightedTensorUp U r F e) (congrArg₂ _ ?_ ?_)
    · exact (Modules.comp_app_apply_sec U _ _ _).trans
        (GradedQCAlgebra.eqToHom_app_eq_gradedPure_zero U _ _ he0 (w 0))
    · exact weightedSymTensorGen_app r (Fin.tail F) ⟨j, by omega⟩ (Fin.tail e) _ x (fun q => w q.succ) hw

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.ofAffineHom_relativeSpec_iso'
statement: theorem ofAffineHom_relativeSpec_iso' : Nonempty ((ofAffineHom p).relativeSpec ≅ Over.mk p)
proof:
:=
  ofAffineHom_relativeSpec_iso p

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.ofAffineHom_sections
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofAffineHom_sections (p : W ⟶ T) [IsAffineHom p] (U : T.AffineZariskiSite) :
    (ofAffineHom p).sections U = Γ(W, p ⁻¹ᵁ U.toOpens)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.ofAffineHom_unitHom
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofAffineHom_unitHom (p : W ⟶ T) [IsAffineHom p] (U : T.AffineZariskiSite)
    (r : Γ(T, U.toOpens)) : (ofAffineHom p).unitHom U r = (p.app U.toOpens) r
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.ofAffineHom_restrict
statement:
theorem ofAffineHom_restrict (p : W ⟶ T) [IsAffineHom p] {U V : T.AffineZariskiSite} (h : U ≤ V)
    (a : Γ(W, p ⁻¹ᵁ V.toOpens)) :
    (ofAffineHom p).restrict h a =
      (W.presheaf.map ((Opens.map p.base).map
        (homOfLE (AffineZariskiSite.toOpens_mono h))).op).hom a
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.ofAffineHom_id
statement: theorem ofAffineHom_id : ofAffineHom (𝟙 T) = structureSheaf T
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.pullback_sections
statement:
@[simp] theorem pullback_sections (A : X.AffineAlgebra) (g : T ⟶ X) (V : T.AffineZariskiSite) :
    (A.pullback g).sections V =
      Γ(Limits.pullback A.relativeSpec.hom g,
        Limits.pullback.snd A.relativeSpec.hom g ⁻¹ᵁ V.toOpens)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.ofAffineHom.map_toSource
statement:
theorem map_toSource {U V : T.AffineZariskiSite} (h : U ≤ V) :
    Spec.map ((ofAffineHom p).ring.map (homOfLE h).op) ≫ toSource p V = toSource p U
proof:
:=
  IsAffineOpen.map_fromSpec (V.2.preimage p) (U.2.preimage p)
    ((Opens.map p.base).map (homOfLE (AffineZariskiSite.toOpens_mono h))).op

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.ofAffineHom.chart_toSourceHom
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem chart_toSourceHom (U : T.AffineZariskiSite) :
    (ofAffineHom p).chart U ≫ toSourceHom p = (U.2.preimage p).fromSpec
proof:
:=
  colimit.ι_desc (toSourceCocone p) U

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.ofAffineHom.specMap_app_fromSpec
statement:
theorem specMap_app_fromSpec (U : T.AffineZariskiSite) :
    Spec.map (p.app U.toOpens) ≫ U.2.fromSpec = (U.2.preimage p).fromSpec ≫ p
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.app_eq_appLE]
  exact IsAffineOpen.SpecMap_appLE_fromSpec p U.2 (U.2.preimage p) le_rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.ofAffineHom.chartToOpen_eq
statement:
theorem chartToOpen_eq (U : T.AffineZariskiSite) :
    (ofAffineHom p).chartToOpen U = (U.2.preimage p).isoSpec.inv ≫ (p ∣_ U.toOpens)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cancel_mono U.toOpens.ι]
  change Spec.map (p.app U.toOpens) ≫ U.2.isoSpec.inv ≫ U.toOpens.ι = _
  rw [IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι, Category.assoc, morphismRestrict_ι,
    IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι_assoc]
  exact specMap_app_fromSpec p U

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.ofAffineHom.toSourceHom_comp
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem toSourceHom_comp : toSourceHom p ≫ p = (ofAffineHom p).relativeSpec.hom
proof:
:= by
  refine colimit.hom_ext fun (U : T.AffineZariskiSite) => ?_
  change (ofAffineHom p).chart U ≫ toSourceHom p ≫ p = (ofAffineHom p).chart U ≫ _
  rw [chart_toSourceHom_assoc, chart_hom, chartToOpen_eq, Category.assoc, morphismRestrict_ι,
    IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.ofAffineHom.isPullback_chart
statement:
theorem isPullback_chart (U : T.AffineZariskiSite) :
    IsPullback (U.2.preimage p).isoSpec.inv ((ofAffineHom p).chart U) (p ⁻¹ᵁ U.toOpens).ι
      (toSourceHom p)
proof:
:= by
  have s := (ofAffineHom p).chart_isPullback U
  rw [chartToOpen_eq, ← toSourceHom_comp] at s
  exact IsPullback.of_right s
    (by rw [IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_inv_ι, chart_toSourceHom])
    (isPullback_morphismRestrict p U.toOpens)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.ofAffineHom.toSourceHom_isIso
statement: theorem toSourceHom_isIso : IsIso (toSourceHom p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← MorphismProperty.isomorphisms.iff]
  refine IsZariskiLocalAtTarget.of_openCover (preimageCover p) fun U => ?_
  rw [MorphismProperty.isomorphisms.iff]
  have h := (isPullback_chart p U).flip.isoIsPullback_inv_snd _ _
    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback (toSourceHom p) (p ⁻¹ᵁ U.toOpens).ι)
  change IsIso (pullback.snd (toSourceHom p) (p ⁻¹ᵁ U.toOpens).ι)
  rw [← h]
  infer_instance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.ofAffineHom_relativeSpec_iso
statement:
theorem ofAffineHom_relativeSpec_iso (p : W ⟶ T) [IsAffineHom p] :
    Nonempty ((ofAffineHom p).relativeSpec ≅ Over.mk p)
proof:
:=
  have := ofAffineHom.toSourceHom_isIso p
  ⟨Over.isoMk (asIso (ofAffineHom.toSourceHom p)) (ofAffineHom.toSourceHom_comp p)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineAlgebra.pullback_relativeSpec_iso
statement:
theorem pullback_relativeSpec_iso (A : X.AffineAlgebra) (g : T ⟶ X) :
    Nonempty ((A.pullback g).relativeSpec ≅
      Over.mk (Limits.pullback.snd A.relativeSpec.hom g))
proof:
:=
  ofAffineHom_relativeSpec_iso _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.smul_def'
statement:
theorem smul_def' (c : Γ(X, U)) (z : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsRing U) :
    c • z = (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsUnitHom U c * z
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.algebraMap_eq
statement:
theorem algebraMap_eq (c : Γ(X, U)) :
    algebraMap Γ(X, U) ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsRing U) c =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsUnitHom U c
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.genSections_mem_sectionsGrading
statement:
theorem genSections_mem_sectionsGrading (q : Fin r)
    (w : Γ(AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.dual (V q), U)) :
    genSections V U q w ∈
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsGrading U ((q : ℕ) + 1)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.genSections_add
statement:
theorem genSections_add (q : Fin r) (w w' : Γ(AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.dual (V q), U)) :
    genSections V U q (w + w') = genSections V U q w + genSections V U q w'
proof:
:= by
  unfold genSections
  rw [map_add]
  exact map_add (DirectSum.of ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsPiece U)
    ((q : ℕ) + 1)) _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.genSections_smul
statement:
theorem genSections_smul (q : Fin r) (c : Γ(X, U))
    (w : Γ(AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.dual (V q), U)) :
    genSections V U q (c • w) = c • genSections V U q w
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_def']
  unfold genSections
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul]
  exact ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsUnitHom_mul_ofPiece U c _).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.symLiftHom_apply
statement:
theorem symLiftHom_apply
    (a : SymmetricAlgebra Γ(X, U) (⨁ q, Γ(AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.dual (V q), U))) :
    symLiftHom V U a = symLift V U a
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.symLiftHom_algebraMap
statement:
theorem symLiftHom_algebraMap (c : Γ(X, U)) :
    symLiftHom V U (algebraMap Γ(X, U) _ c) =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsUnitHom U c
proof:
:=
  (symLift V U).commutes c

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.symLiftHom_gen
statement:
theorem symLiftHom_gen (q : Fin r) (w : Γ(AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.dual (V q), U)) :
    symLiftHom V U (WeightedSym.gen Γ(X, U) (genSectionsModule V U) q w) = genSections V U q w
proof:
:= by
  rw [symLiftHom_apply]
  show SymmetricAlgebra.lift (genDirectSum V U)
    (SymmetricAlgebra.ι Γ(X, U) _ (DirectSum.lof Γ(X, U) (Fin r) (genSectionsModule V U) q w)) = _
  rw [SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply]
  exact DirectSum.toModule_lof (R := Γ(X, U)) (M := genSectionsModule V U) (φ := genLinear V U) q w

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.symLiftHom_smul
statement:
theorem symLiftHom_smul (c : Γ(X, U))
    (a : SymmetricAlgebra Γ(X, U) (⨁ q, Γ(AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.dual (V q), U))) :
    symLiftHom V U (c • a) =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsUnitHom U c * symLiftHom V U a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.smul_def, map_mul, symLiftHom_algebraMap]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.symLiftHom_mem_sectionsGrading
proof:
:= by
  let Q : ℕ → Submodule Γ(X, U)
      (SymmetricAlgebra Γ(X, U) (⨁ q, Γ(AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.dual (V q), U))) := fun k =>
    { carrier := {b | symLiftHom V U b ∈ (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsGrading U k}
      add_mem' := fun {x y} hx hy => by
        show symLiftHom V U (x + y) ∈ (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsGrading U k
        rw [map_add]
        exact add_mem hx hy
      zero_mem' := by
        show symLiftHom V U 0 ∈ (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsGrading U k
        rw [map_zero]
        exact zero_mem _
      smul_mem' := fun c x hx => by
        show symLiftHom V U (c • x) ∈ (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsGrading U k
        rw [symLiftHom_smul]
        have h0 : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsUnitHom U c ∈
            (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsGrading U 0 :=
          ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsUnit U c).2
        have := (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsGrading_mul_mem U h0 hx
        rwa [Nat.zero_add] at this }
  have h1 : (1 : SymmetricAlgebra Γ(X, U) (⨁ q, Γ(AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.dual (V q), U))) ∈ Q 0 := by
    show symLiftHom V U 1 ∈ (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsGrading U 0
    rw [map_one]
    exact (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsGrading_one_mem U
  have hmul : ∀ i j, Q i * Q j ≤ Q (i + j) := fun i j => by
    refine Submodule.mul_le.mpr fun x hx y hy => ?_
    show symLiftHom V U (x * y) ∈ (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsGrading U (i + j)
    rw [map_mul]
    exact (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsGrading_mul_mem U hx hy
  have hgen : ∀ q, WeightedSym.genSpan Γ(X, U) (genSectionsModule V U) q ≤ Q (weight q) := by
    rintro q _ ⟨w, rfl⟩
    show symLiftHom V U (WeightedSym.gen Γ(X, U) (genSectionsModule V U) q w) ∈
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsGrading U ((q : ℕ) + 1)
    rw [symLiftHom_gen]
    exact genSections_mem_sectionsGrading V U q w
  exact WeightedSym.piece_le_of_gen h1 hmul hgen m ha

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.monomial_mul
statement:
theorem monomial_mul (p p' : Σ d : Fin r → ℕ, ∀ q, Fin (d q) → genSectionsModule V U q) :
    monomial V U p * monomial V U p' = monomial V U ⟨p.1 + p'.1, fun q => Fin.append (p.2 q) (p'.2 q)⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold monomial
  rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  refine Fintype.prod_congr _ _ fun q => ?_
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (Fin.prod_univ_add (fun i : Fin (p.1 q + p'.1 q) =>
    WeightedSym.gen (X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U)) (genSectionsModule V U) q (Fin.append (p.2 q) (p'.2 q) i))).symm
  congr 1
  · exact Fintype.prod_congr _ _ fun i => by rw [Fin.append_left]
  · exact Fintype.prod_congr _ _ fun i => by rw [Fin.append_right]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.monomial_zero
statement: theorem monomial_zero : monomial V U ⟨0, fun _ => Fin.elim0⟩ = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold monomial
  exact Fintype.prod_eq_one _ fun q => Fintype.prod_eq_one _ fun i => (show Fin 0 from i).elim0

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.monomial_single
statement:
theorem monomial_single (q : Fin r) (y : genSectionsModule V U q) :
    monomial V U ⟨fun q' => if q' = q then 1 else 0, fun q' i => if h : q' = q then
        cast (congrArg (genSectionsModule V U) h.symm) y else (Fin.cast (if_neg h) i).elim0⟩ =
      WeightedSym.gen (X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U)) (genSectionsModule V U) q y
proof:
:= by
  unfold monomial
  rw [Finset.prod_eq_single q]
  · have h1 : ∀ i : Fin (if q = q then 1 else 0),
        (if h : q = q then cast (congrArg (genSectionsModule V U) h.symm) y
          else (Fin.cast (if_neg h) i).elim0) = y := fun i => by
      rw [dif_pos rfl]
      exact cast_eq _ y
    rw [Fintype.prod_congr _ _ fun i => congrArg _ (h1 i), Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin, if_pos rfl, pow_one]
  · intro q' _ hq'
    exact Fintype.prod_eq_one _ fun i => (Fin.cast (if_neg hq') i).elim0
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ q) h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.span_monomials_eq_top
statement: theorem span_monomials_eq_top : Submodule.span (X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U)) (Set.range (monomial V U)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hmono : ∀ p, monomial V U p ∈ Submodule.span (X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U)) (Set.range (monomial V U)) :=
    fun p => Submodule.subset_span ⟨p, rfl⟩
  have hmul : Submodule.span (X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U)) (Set.range (monomial V U)) *
      Submodule.span (X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U)) (Set.range (monomial V U)) ≤ Submodule.span (X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U)) (Set.range (monomial V U)) := by
    rw [Submodule.span_mul_span]
    refine Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_
    rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨p, rfl⟩, _, ⟨p', rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    show monomial V U p * monomial V U p' ∈ Submodule.span (X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U)) (Set.range (monomial V U))
    rw [monomial_mul]
    exact hmono _
  refine Submodule.eq_top_iff'.mpr fun a => ?_
  induction a using SymmetricAlgebra.induction with
  | algebraMap c =>
    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one]
    refine Submodule.smul_mem _ c ?_
    have h := hmono ⟨0, fun _ => Fin.elim0⟩
    rw [monomial_zero] at h
    exact h
  | ι x =>
    rw [← DirectSum.sum_univ_of x, map_sum]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun q _ => ?_
    have h := hmono ⟨fun q' => if q' = q then 1 else 0, fun q' i => if h : q' = q then
      cast (congrArg (genSectionsModule V U) h.symm) (x q) else (Fin.cast (if_neg h) i).elim0⟩
    rw [monomial_single] at h
    exact h
  | mul a b ha hb => exact hmul (Submodule.mul_mem_mul ha hb)
  | add a b ha hb => exact Submodule.add_mem _ ha hb

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.symLiftHom_bijective
statement:
theorem symLiftHom_bijective {U : X.Opens} (hU : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen U) :
    Function.Bijective (symLiftHom V U)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨ψ, hψ_smul, hψ_mono⟩ := exists_addMonoidHom_sectionsRing V hU
      (C := SymmetricAlgebra Γ(X, U) (⨁ q, Γ(AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.dual (V q), U)))
      (fun q => WeightedSym.gen Γ(X, U) (genSectionsModule V U) q)
    have key : ∀ a, ψ (symLiftHom V U a) = a := by
      intro a
      have ha : a ∈ Submodule.span (X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U)) (Set.range (monomial V U)) := by
        rw [span_monomials_eq_top]
        trivial
      refine Submodule.span_induction ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ha
      · rintro _ ⟨⟨d, w⟩, rfl⟩
        have h1 : ∀ q, symLiftHom V U (∏ i, WeightedSym.gen (X.presheaf.obj (Opposite.op U))
            (genSectionsModule V U) q (w q i)) = ∏ i, genSections V U q (w q i) := fun q => by
          rw [map_prod]
          exact Fintype.prod_congr _ _ fun i => symLiftHom_gen V U q (w q i)
        have h2 : symLiftHom V U (monomial V U ⟨d, w⟩) = ∏ q, ∏ i, genSections V U q (w q i) := by
          unfold monomial
          rw [map_prod]
          exact Fintype.prod_congr _ _ h1
        rw [h2]
        exact hψ_mono d w
      · rw [map_zero, map_zero]
      · intro x y _ _ hx hy
        rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
      · intro c x _ hx
        rw [symLiftHom_smul, hψ_smul, hx]
    exact fun a b hab => by rw [← key a, hab, key b]
  · have hle : Subring.closure (Set.range ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsUnitHom U) ∪
        ⋃ q : Fin r, Set.range (fun x : Γ(AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.dual (V q), U) =>
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).ofPiece U ((q : ℕ) + 1) ((genIncl V q).app U x))) ≤
        (symLiftHom V U).range := by
      refine Subring.closure_le.mpr (Set.union_subset ?_ ?_)
      · rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨algebraMap Γ(X, U) _ c, symLiftHom_algebraMap V U c⟩
      · intro z hz
        obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz
        obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hq
        exact ⟨WeightedSym.gen Γ(X, U) (genSectionsModule V U) q x, symLiftHom_gen V U q x⟩
    rw [closure_sectionsUnitHom_genIncl_eq_top V hU] at hle
    exact fun z => hle trivial

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.decompose_symLiftHom
statement:
theorem decompose_symLiftHom
    (a : SymmetricAlgebra Γ(X, U) (⨁ q, Γ(AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.dual (V q), U))) (k : ℕ) :
    ((DirectSum.decompose ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsGrading U)
        (symLiftHom V U a) k : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsGrading U k) :
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsRing U) =
      symLiftHom V U
        (DirectSum.decompose (WeightedSym.piece Γ(X, U) (genSectionsModule V U) (weight (r := r))) a k :
          SymmetricAlgebra Γ(X, U) (⨁ q, Γ(AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.dual (V q), U)))
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.Decomposition.inductionOn
    (ℳ := WeightedSym.piece Γ(X, U) (genSectionsModule V U) (weight (r := r))) ?_ ?_ ?_ a
  · rw [map_zero, DirectSum.decompose_zero, DirectSum.decompose_zero, DirectSum.zero_apply,
      DirectSum.zero_apply, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, map_zero]
  · intro j x
    have hx : (x : SymmetricAlgebra Γ(X, U) (⨁ q, Γ(AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.dual (V q), U))) ∈
        WeightedSym.piece Γ(X, U) (genSectionsModule V U) (weight (r := r)) j := x.2
    by_cases hjk : j = k
    · subst hjk
      rw [DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same _ hx,
        DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same _ (symLiftHom_mem_sectionsGrading V U hx)]
    · rw [DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_ne _ hx hjk,
        DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_ne _ (symLiftHom_mem_sectionsGrading V U hx) hjk, map_zero]
  · intro x y hx hy
    rw [map_add, DirectSum.decompose_add, DirectSum.decompose_add, DirectSum.add_apply,
      DirectSum.add_apply, AddSubgroup.coe_add, Submodule.coe_add, map_add, hx, hy]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.symLiftHom_mem_sectionsGrading_iff
statement:
theorem symLiftHom_mem_sectionsGrading_iff (hinj : Function.Injective (symLiftHom V U)) (m : ℕ)
    (a : SymmetricAlgebra Γ(X, U) (⨁ q, Γ(AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.dual (V q), U))) :
    symLiftHom V U a ∈ (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsGrading U m ↔
      a ∈ WeightedSym.piece Γ(X, U) (genSectionsModule V U) (weight (r := r)) m
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, symLiftHom_mem_sectionsGrading V U⟩
  set ℳ := WeightedSym.piece Γ(X, U) (genSectionsModule V U) (weight (r := r)) with hℳ
  have hzero : ∀ k, k ≠ m → DirectSum.decompose ℳ a k = 0 := by
    intro k hk
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply hinj
    rw [ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, map_zero, ← decompose_symLiftHom,
      DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_ne _ h (Ne.symm hk)]
  have hdec : DirectSum.decompose ℳ a = DirectSum.of (fun k => ℳ k) m (DirectSum.decompose ℳ a m) := by
    refine DirectSum.ext fun k => ?_
    by_cases hk : k = m
    · subst hk
      rw [DirectSum.of_eq_same]
    · rw [DirectSum.of_eq_of_ne m k _ hk, hzero k hk]
  have ha : a = (DirectSum.decompose ℳ a m : _) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← (DirectSum.decompose ℳ).symm_apply_apply a, hdec, DirectSum.decompose_symm_of]
  rw [ha]
  exact (DirectSum.decompose ℳ a m).2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.exists_sectionsRing_equiv_symmetricAlgebra
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.exists_sectionsRing_equiv_symmetricAlgebra
    {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} {r : ℕ} (V : Fin r → X.Modules)
    [∀ q, (V q).IsLocallyFree] [∀ q, (V q).IsFiniteType] (U : X.AffineZariskiSite) :
    ∃ e : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsRing U.toOpens ≃+*
        SymmetricAlgebra Γ(X, U.toOpens)
          (⨁ q, Γ(AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.dual (V q), U.toOpens)),
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (a : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsRing U.toOpens),
        a ∈ (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsGrading U.toOpens m ↔
          e a ∈ WeightedSym.piece Γ(X, U.toOpens)
            (fun q : Fin r => Γ(AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.dual (V q), U.toOpens))
            (fun q : Fin r => (q : ℕ) + 1) m) ∧
      (∀ s : Γ(X, U.toOpens),
        e ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra V).sectionsUnitHom U.toOpens s) =
          algebraMap Γ(X, U.toOpens) _ s)
proof:
:= by
  open AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra in
  have hbij := symLiftHom_bijective V U.2
  let e0 := RingEquiv.ofBijective (symLiftHom V U.toOpens) hbij
  refine ⟨e0.symm, fun m a => ?_, fun s => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ : ∃ b, e0 b = a := hbij.2 a
    rw [e0.symm_apply_apply]
    exact symLiftHom_mem_sectionsGrading_iff V U.toOpens hbij.1 m b
  · apply e0.injective
    rw [e0.apply_symm_apply]
    exact (symLiftHom_algebraMap V U.toOpens s).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.QCAlgebra.unit_coequifibered
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.QCAlgebra.unit_coequifibered {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    (A : X.QCAlgebra) : A.affineUnit.Coequifibered
proof:
:= by
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.AffineZariskiSite.coequifibered_iff_forall_isLocalizationAway]
  haveI := A.quasicoherent
  intro U f
  have hUaff : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen U.toOpens := U.2
  have hV : X.basicOpen f ≤ U.toOpens := X.basicOpen_le f
  letI : Algebra (A.sectionsRing U.toOpens) (A.sectionsRing (X.basicOpen f)) :=
    (A.sectionsRestrict hV).toAlgebra
  show IsLocalization.Away (A.sectionsUnit U.toOpens f) (A.sectionsRing (X.basicOpen f))
  have halg : ∀ a : A.sectionsRing U.toOpens,
      algebraMap (A.sectionsRing U.toOpens) (A.sectionsRing (X.basicOpen f)) a =
        A.sectionsRestrict hV a := fun _ => rfl
  have hres : ∀ r : Γ(X, U.toOpens),
      A.sectionsRestrict hV (A.sectionsUnit U.toOpens r) =
        A.sectionsUnit (X.basicOpen f) ((X.presheaf.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE hV).op).hom r) := by
    intro r
    have hn := _root_.PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply A.one.val (CategoryTheory.homOfLE hV).op r
    have h1 : ((CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorUnit X.Modules).val.map
          (CategoryTheory.homOfLE hV).op).hom r =
        (X.presheaf.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE hV).op).hom r := rfl
    rw [h1] at hn
    exact hn.symm
  refine (_root_.isLocalization_iff (Submonoid.powers _) _).mpr ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨-, n, rfl⟩
    rw [halg, map_pow, hres]
    exact IsUnit.pow n (RingHom.isUnit_map (A.sectionsUnit (X.basicOpen f))
      (X.toRingedSpace.isUnit_res_basicOpen f))
  · intro z
    obtain ⟨n, t, ht⟩ := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_pow_smul_eq_map_basicOpen
      A.carrier hUaff f z
    have key : z * A.sectionsRestrict hV ((A.sectionsUnit U.toOpens f) ^ n) =
        A.sectionsRestrict hV t := by
      rw [map_pow, hres, _root_.mul_comm, ← map_pow, A.smul_eq_sectionsUnit_mul]
      exact ht.symm
    exact ⟨⟨t, ⟨_, n, rfl⟩⟩, key⟩
  · intro x y hxy
    rw [halg, halg] at hxy
    have h0 : A.sectionsRestrict hV (x - y) = 0 := by rw [map_sub, hxy, sub_self]
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_map_basicOpen_eq_zero
        A.carrier hUaff f (x - y) h0
    have key : (A.sectionsUnit U.toOpens f) ^ n * x = (A.sectionsUnit U.toOpens f) ^ n * y := by
      rw [← _root_.sub_eq_zero, ← mul_sub, ← map_pow, A.smul_eq_sectionsUnit_mul]
      exact hn
    exact ⟨⟨_, n, rfl⟩, key⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymTensor_isGradedMonoid
statement:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.mulTerm_one_mul
statement:
theorem mulTerm_one_mul {m : ℕ} (d : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymIndex r m) :
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymTensorOne r (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.gen V) ▷ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) ≫
        mulTerm V (⟨0, by simp⟩ : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymIndex r 0) d =

    (α_ (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V a) (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V b) (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V c)).hom ≫ (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V a ◁ mulTerm V b c) ≫ mulTerm V a (b.add c) =
      (mulTerm V a b ▷ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V c) ≫ mulTerm V (a.add b) c ≫ eqToHom (term_congr V (add_assoc_val a b c))

:=

    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.gen V)).mul_assoc (dv a) (dv b) (dv c)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.ι_tensor_ι_comp_mulHom
statement:
theorem ι_tensor_ι_comp_mulHom {m n : ℕ} (a : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymIndex r m)
    (b : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymIndex r n) :
    (CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) a ⊗ₘ CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) b) ≫ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.mulHom V m n =
      mulTerm V a b ≫ CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) (a.add b)
proof:
:= by
  have := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.monoidalPreadditive X
  unfold AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.mulHom
  simp only [Preadditive.comp_sum, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single a, Finset.sum_eq_single b]
  · rw [← Category.assoc, tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι_π_self,
      CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι_π_self, id_tensorHom_id, Category.id_comp]
    rfl
  · intro b' _ hb'
    rw [← Category.assoc, tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι_π_ne _ (Ne.symm hb'),
      MonoidalPreadditive.tensor_zero, zero_comp]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h
  · intro a' _ ha'
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro b' _
    rw [← Category.assoc, tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι_π_ne _ (Ne.symm ha'),
      MonoidalPreadditive.zero_tensor, zero_comp]
  · intro h; exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.ext₁
statement:
theorem ext₁ {m : ℕ} {Y : X.Modules} {g h : 𝟙_ X.Modules ⊗ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part V m ⟶ Y}
    (w : ∀ d, (𝟙_ X.Modules ◁ CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) d) ≫ g = (𝟙_ X.Modules ◁ CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) d) ≫ h) : g = h
proof:
:= by
  have := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.monoidalPreadditive X
  have e : ∀ k : 𝟙_ X.Modules ⊗ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part V m ⟶ Y, k = (𝟙_ X.Modules ◁ ∑ d, CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.π (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) d ≫ CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) d) ≫ k := by
    intro k
    rw [CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.total, whiskerLeft_id, Category.id_comp]
  rw [e g, e h]
  simp only [whiskerLeft_sum, whiskerLeft_comp, Preadditive.sum_comp, Category.assoc, w]

statement:
theorem ext₂ {m n : ℕ} {Y : X.Modules} {g h : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part V m ⊗ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part V n ⟶ Y}
    (w : ∀ a b, (CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) a ⊗ₘ CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) b) ≫ g = (CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) a ⊗ₘ CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) b) ≫ h) : g = h
proof:
:= by
  have := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.monoidalPreadditive X
  have e : ∀ k : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part V m ⊗ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part V n ⟶ Y,
      k = ((∑ a, CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.π (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) a ≫ CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) a) ⊗ₘ (∑ b, CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.π (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) b ≫ CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) b)) ≫ k := by
    intro k
    rw [CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.total, CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.total, id_tensorHom_id,
      Category.id_comp]
  rw [e g, e h]
  simp only [sum_tensor, tensor_sum, Preadditive.sum_comp, ← tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, Category.assoc, w]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.ext₃
statement:
theorem ext₃ {m n l : ℕ} {Y : X.Modules} {g h : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part V m ⊗ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part V n) ⊗ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part V l ⟶ Y}
    (w : ∀ a b c, ((CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) a ⊗ₘ CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) b) ⊗ₘ CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) c) ≫ g = ((CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) a ⊗ₘ CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) b) ⊗ₘ CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) c) ≫ h) : g = h
proof:
:= by
  have := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.monoidalPreadditive X
  have e : ∀ k : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part V m ⊗ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part V n) ⊗ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part V l ⟶ Y,
      k = (((∑ a, CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.π (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) a ≫ CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) a) ⊗ₘ (∑ b, CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.π (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) b ≫ CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) b)) ⊗ₘ (∑ c, CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.π (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) c ≫ CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.term V d) c)) ≫ k := by
    intro k
    rw [CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.total, CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.total,
      CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.total, id_tensorHom_id, id_tensorHom_id, Category.id_comp]
  rw [e g, e h]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part_isQuasicoherent
proof:
:=
  AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_biproduct_of_fintype _ fun _ =>

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.one_mul
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.one_mul {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    {r : ℕ} (V : Fin r → X.Modules) (m : ℕ) :
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.oneHom V ▷ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part V m) ≫ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.mulHom V 0 m =
      (λ_ (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part V m)).hom ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part V) (Nat.zero_add m).symm)
proof:
:= by
  open AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra in
  open CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory in
  apply ext₁
  intro d
  slice_lhs 1 2 => rw [← tensorHom_def']
  rw [oneHom, ← whiskerRight_comp_tensorHom, Category.assoc, ι_tensor_ι_comp_mulHom]
  slice_lhs 1 2 => rw [mulTerm_one_mul]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [eqToHom_comp_ι V (Nat.zero_add m).symm (zero_add_val d), leftUnitor_naturality_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.mul_assoc
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.mul_assoc {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    {r : ℕ} (V : Fin r → X.Modules) (m n l : ℕ) :
    (α_ (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part V m) (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part V n) (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part V l)).hom ≫
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part V m ◁ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.mulHom V n l) ≫ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.mulHom V m (n + l) =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.mulHom V m n ▷ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part V l) ≫ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.mulHom V (m + n) l ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part V) (Nat.add_assoc m n l))
proof:
:= by
  open AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra in
  open CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory in
  apply ext₃
  intro a b c
  slice_lhs 1 2 => rw [associator_naturality]
  slice_lhs 2 3 => rw [tensorHom_comp_whiskerLeft, ι_tensor_ι_comp_mulHom, ← whiskerLeft_comp_tensorHom]
  slice_lhs 3 4 => rw [ι_tensor_ι_comp_mulHom]
  slice_lhs 1 3 => rw [mulTerm_assoc]
  slice_lhs 3 4 => rw [eqToHom_comp_ι V (Nat.add_assoc m n l) (add_assoc_val a b c)]
  slice_rhs 1 2 => rw [tensorHom_comp_whiskerRight, ι_tensor_ι_comp_mulHom, ← whiskerRight_comp_tensorHom]
  slice_rhs 2 3 => rw [ι_tensor_ι_comp_mulHom]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.mul_comm
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.mul_comm {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    {r : ℕ} (V : Fin r → X.Modules) (m n : ℕ) :
    (β_ (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part V m) (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part V n)).hom ≫ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.mulHom V n m =
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.mulHom V m n ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra.part V) (Nat.add_comm m n))
proof:
:= by
  open AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra in
  open CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory in
  apply ext₂
  intro a b
  slice_lhs 1 2 => rw [BraidedCategory.braiding_naturality]
  slice_lhs 2 3 => rw [ι_tensor_ι_comp_mulHom]
  slice_lhs 1 2 => rw [mulTerm_comm]
  slice_lhs 2 3 => rw [eqToHom_comp_ι V (Nat.add_comm m n) (add_comm_val a b)]
  slice_rhs 1 2 => rw [ι_tensor_ι_comp_mulHom]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.symm_monomial_mem
statement:
theorem symm_monomial_mem
    (he : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : T.sectionsRing V),
      a ∈ T.sectionsGrading V m ↔ (e a).IsWeightedHomogeneous w m)
    (m : ℕ) (d : weightedMonomials w m) :
    e.symm (MvPolynomial.monomial d.1 1) ∈ T.sectionsGrading V m
proof:
:=
  (he m _).mpr (by
    rw [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact MvPolynomial.isWeightedHomogeneous_monomial w d.1 1 d.2)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.ofPiece_polyGen
statement:
theorem ofPiece_polyGen
    (he : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : T.sectionsRing V),
      a ∈ T.sectionsGrading V m ↔ (e a).IsWeightedHomogeneous w m)
    (m : ℕ) (d : weightedMonomials w m) :
    T.ofPiece V m (polyGen T V w e m d) = e.symm (MvPolynomial.monomial d.1 1)
proof:
:=
  (T.mem_sectionsGrading_iff V m _).mp (symm_monomial_mem T V w e he m d)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.ofPiece_sectionsGMul
statement:
theorem ofPiece_sectionsGMul {m n : ℕ} (a : T.sectionsPiece V m) (b : T.sectionsPiece V n) :
    T.ofPiece V (m + n) (T.sectionsGMul V a b) = T.ofPiece V m a * T.ofPiece V n b
proof:
:=
  (DirectSum.of_mul_of (A := T.sectionsPiece V) a b).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsGMul_polyGen
statement:
theorem sectionsGMul_polyGen
    (he : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : T.sectionsRing V),
      a ∈ T.sectionsGrading V m ↔ (e a).IsWeightedHomogeneous w m)
    {m n : ℕ} (d : weightedMonomials w m) (d' : weightedMonomials w n) :
    T.sectionsGMul V (polyGen T V w e m d) (polyGen T V w e n d') =
      polyGen T V w e (m + n) ⟨d.1 + d'.1, by rw [map_add, d.2, d'.2]⟩
proof:
:= by
  apply T.ofPiece_injective V (m + n)
  rw [ofPiece_sectionsGMul, ofPiece_polyGen T V w e he, ofPiece_polyGen T V w e he,
    ofPiece_polyGen T V w e he, ← map_mul, MvPolynomial.monomial_mul, _root_.one_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.polyGen_zero
statement:
theorem polyGen_zero
    (he : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : T.sectionsRing V),
      a ∈ T.sectionsGrading V m ↔ (e a).IsWeightedHomogeneous w m)
    (hu : ∀ r : Γ(X, V), e (T.sectionsUnitHom V r) = MvPolynomial.C r) :
    polyGen T V w e 0 ⟨0, by simp⟩ = T.sectionsGOne V
proof:
:= by
  apply T.ofPiece_injective V 0
  rw [ofPiece_polyGen T V w e he]
  have h1 : e.symm (MvPolynomial.monomial (0 : σ →₀ ℕ) (1 : Γ(X, V))) = T.sectionsUnitHom V 1 := by
    rw [← MvPolynomial.C_apply, ← hu 1, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  exact h1

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.homogeneousEquivFinsupp_symm_single
statement:
theorem homogeneousEquivFinsupp_symm_single (m : ℕ) (d : weightedMonomials w m) :
    ((homogeneousEquivFinsupp V w m).symm (Finsupp.single d 1) :
      MvPolynomial σ Γ(X, V)) = MvPolynomial.monomial d.1 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [homogeneousEquivFinsupp, AddMonoidAlgebra.supportedEquivFinsupp]
  rw [Finsupp.supportedEquivFinsupp_symm_single]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.pieceEquivFinsupp_polyGen
statement:
theorem pieceEquivFinsupp_polyGen
    (he : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : T.sectionsRing V),
      a ∈ T.sectionsGrading V m ↔ (e a).IsWeightedHomogeneous w m)
    (hu : ∀ r : Γ(X, V), e (T.sectionsUnitHom V r) = MvPolynomial.C r)
    (m : ℕ) (d : weightedMonomials w m) :
    pieceEquivFinsupp T V w e he hu m (polyGen T V w e m d) = Finsupp.single d 1
proof:
:= by
  show (homogeneousEquivFinsupp V w m)
      ((gradingEquivHomogeneous T V w e he m)
        ((T.sectionsPieceEquivGrading V m) (polyGen T V w e m d))) = _
  rw [← LinearEquiv.eq_symm_apply]
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [homogeneousEquivFinsupp_symm_single]
  show e (T.ofPiece V m (polyGen T V w e m d)) = _
  rw [ofPiece_polyGen T V w e he, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.pieceBasis_apply
statement:
theorem pieceBasis_apply
    (he : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : T.sectionsRing V),
      a ∈ T.sectionsGrading V m ↔ (e a).IsWeightedHomogeneous w m)
    (hu : ∀ r : Γ(X, V), e (T.sectionsUnitHom V r) = MvPolynomial.C r)
    (m : ℕ) (d : weightedMonomials w m) :
    pieceBasis T V w e he hu m d = polyGen T V w e m d
proof:
:= by
  unfold pieceBasis
  rw [Module.Basis.coe_ofRepr]
  exact (LinearEquiv.symm_apply_eq _).mpr (pieceEquivFinsupp_polyGen T V w e he hu m d).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.ofPiece_one_mem_sectionsDegOneIdeal
statement:
theorem ofPiece_one_mem_sectionsDegOneIdeal (W : X.Opens) (b : S.sectionsPiece W 1) :
    S.ofPiece W 1 b ∈ S.sectionsDegOneIdeal W

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.sectionsRestrictHom_mem_sectionsDegOneIdeal
statement:
theorem sectionsRestrictHom_mem_sectionsDegOneIdeal {U V : X.Opens} (h : U ≤ V)
    {x : S.sectionsRing V} (hx : x ∈ S.sectionsDegOneIdeal V) :
    S.sectionsRestrictHom h x ∈ S.sectionsDegOneIdeal U
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (S.sectionsRestrictHom h) hx
  rw [Ideal.map_span] at h1
  refine Ideal.span_mono ?_ h1
  rintro y ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
  exact (S.sectionsRestrict h).map_mem hz

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.InDegOne.restrict
proof:
:= by
  unfold InDegOne at hy ⊢
  rw [GenAux.app_map_res]
  have e : S.ofPiece W₀ ℓ ((S.part ℓ).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op ((S.mulPowOne ℓ).app W y))
      = S.sectionsRestrictHom h (S.ofPiece W ℓ ((S.mulPowOne ℓ).app W y)) :=
    (S.sectionsRestrictHom_ofPiece h ℓ _).symm
  rw [e]
  exact S.sectionsRestrictHom_mem_sectionsDegOneIdeal h hy

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.InDegOne.zero
statement: theorem InDegOne.zero (S : X.GradedQCAlgebra) (ℓ : ℕ) (W : X.Opens) : S.InDegOne ℓ W 0
proof:

  refine Set.mem_of_eq_of_mem ?_ (Ideal.zero_mem _)

    (map_zero (ConcreteCategory.hom ((S.mulPowOne ℓ).app W)))).trans

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.InDegOne.add
proof:

  exact (congrArg (S.ofPiece W ℓ)
    (map_add (ConcreteCategory.hom ((S.mulPowOne ℓ).app W)) y₁ y₂)).trans
    (map_add (DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece W) ℓ) _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.GoodDegOne.of_inDegOne

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.GoodDegOne.zero
statement: theorem GoodDegOne.zero (S : X.GradedQCAlgebra) (ℓ : ℕ) (W : X.Opens) : S.GoodDegOne ℓ W 0
