    ∃ (E : S.Modules) (_ : E.IsQuasicoherent) (_ : E.IsFiniteType) (φ : E ⟶ F)
      (e : ∀ i, Γ(E, (V i).1)),
      ∀ i, (φ.val.app (Opposite.op (V i).1)).hom (e i) = s i
proof:
:= by
  choose E hqc hft φ e he using fun i =>
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.QcApprox.exists_isFiniteType_hom_of_affine_section F (V i).2 (s i)
  have : ∀ i, (E i).IsFiniteType := hft
  refine ⟨⨁ E, AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_biproduct_of_fintype E hqc, inferInstance,
    biproduct.desc φ, fun i => ((biproduct.ι E i).val.app (Opposite.op (V i).1)).hom (e i), fun i => ?_⟩
  have h1 : biproduct.ι E i ≫ biproduct.desc φ = φ i := biproduct.ι_desc φ i
  rw [← he i, ← h1]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.QcApprox.mem_span_of_unit_pow_smul_eq
statement:
theorem mem_span_of_unit_pow_smul_eq {U : S.Opens} {ι : Type u} (e : ι → Γ(F, U)) (i : ι)
    {u : Γ(S, U)} (hu : IsUnit u) (N : ℕ) (a : Γ(F, U)) (h : e i = u ^ N • a) :
    a ∈ Submodule.span Γ(S, U) (Set.range e)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hu
  have hone : ((↑(w⁻¹ ^ N) : Γ(S, U)) * (↑w : Γ(S, U)) ^ N) = 1 := by
    rw [← Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, ← Units.val_mul, inv_pow, inv_mul_cancel, Units.val_one]
  have ha : a = (↑(w⁻¹ ^ N) : Γ(S, U)) • e i :=
    calc a = (1 : Γ(S, U)) • a := (one_smul _ _).symm
      _ = ((↑(w⁻¹ ^ N) : Γ(S, U)) * (↑w : Γ(S, U)) ^ N) • a := by rw [hone]
      _ = (↑(w⁻¹ ^ N) : Γ(S, U)) • ((↑w : Γ(S, U)) ^ N • a) := mul_smul _ _ _
      _ = _ := by rw [h]
  rw [ha]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.QcApprox.GoodOn.exists_basicOpen_cover_fg
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcomp : IsCompact ((U ⊓ W : S.Opens) : Set S) := hU.inter_of_isOpen hW.isCompact U.2 W.2
  have hpt : ∀ x : S, x ∈ U ⊓ W → ∃ g : Γ(S, W), x ∈ S.basicOpen g ∧ S.basicOpen g ≤ U ∧
      ∃ (p : ℕ) (a : Fin p → Γ(F, S.basicOpen g)),
        objΓ G (S.basicOpen g) = Submodule.span Γ(S, S.basicOpen g) (Set.range a) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨U₁, hU₁, hxU₁, hle, hfg⟩ := hG.exists_affine_fg x hx.1
    obtain ⟨f, g, hfg', hxf⟩ := AlgebraicGeometry.exists_basicOpen_le_affine_inter hU₁ hW x ⟨hxU₁, hx.2⟩
    have hspan := hG.exists_span_basicOpen hle hU₁ hfg f
    rw [hfg'] at hspan hxf
    exact ⟨g, hxf, hfg' ▸ (S.basicOpen_le f).trans hle, hspan⟩
  choose! g hg using hpt
  obtain ⟨T₀, hT₀⟩ := hcomp.elim_finite_subcover
    (fun x : (U ⊓ W : S.Opens) => (S.basicOpen (g x) : Set S))
    (fun x => (S.basicOpen (g x)).2)
    (fun x hx => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, (hg x hx).1⟩)
  refine ⟨T₀.image fun x : (U ⊓ W : S.Opens) => g x.1, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro g' hg'
    obtain ⟨x, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hg'
    exact (hg x.1 x.2).2.1
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, hxT, hyx⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hT₀ hy)
    exact ⟨g x.1, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x, hxT, rfl⟩, hyx⟩
  · intro g' hg'
    obtain ⟨x, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hg'
    exact (hg x.1 x.2).2.2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.QcApprox.GoodOn.exists_global_of_basicOpen_mem
statement:
theorem GoodOn.exists_global_of_basicOpen_mem [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] {G : F.val.Submodule}
    {U : S.Opens} (hG : GoodOn F G U) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set S)) {W : S.Opens}
    (hW : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen W) (g : Γ(S, W)) (hg : S.basicOpen g ≤ U)
    (a : Γ(F, S.basicOpen g)) (ha : a ∈ objΓ G (S.basicOpen g)) :
    ∃ (h : Γ(F, W)) (N : ℕ),
      F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ⊓ W ≤ W)).op h ∈ objΓ G (U ⊓ W) ∧
      F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (S.basicOpen_le g)).op h =
        (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (S.basicOpen_le g)).op g) ^ N • a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, t, ht⟩ := F.exists_pow_smul_eq_map_basicOpen hW g a
  have htG : F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (S.basicOpen_le g)).op t ∈ objΓ G (S.basicOpen g) := by
    rw [ht]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ha
  have h1 : F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans (S.basicOpen_le g) :
      S.basicOpen g ⊓ U ≤ W)).op t ∈ objΓ G (S.basicOpen g ⊓ U) := by
    rw [← map_map (S.basicOpen_le g) inf_le_left]
    exact (mem_iff_map_mem_of_le_of_le G inf_le_left (le_inf le_rfl hg) _).mp htG
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hG.exists_pow_smul_map_inf_mem hU hW g t h1
  refine ⟨g ^ m • t, m + n, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (mem_iff_map_mem_of_le_of_le G (le_inf inf_le_right inf_le_left)
      (le_inf inf_le_right inf_le_left) _).mpr (by rw [map_map]; exact hm)
  · rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.map_smul, ht, map_pow, smul_smul, ← pow_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.QcApprox.GoodOn.exists_spanSub_agree
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨T, hTU, hTcov, hTfg⟩ := hG.exists_basicOpen_cover_fg hU hW
  choose p a ha using hTfg
  have hgen : ∀ (g : Γ(S, W)) (hg : g ∈ T) (l : Fin (p g hg)),
      ∃ (h : Γ(F, W)) (N : ℕ),
        F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ⊓ W ≤ W)).op h ∈ objΓ G (U ⊓ W) ∧
        F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (S.basicOpen_le g)).op h =
          (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (S.basicOpen_le g)).op g) ^ N • a g hg l := by
    intro g hg l
    exact hG.exists_global_of_basicOpen_mem hU hW g (hTU g hg) (a g hg l)
      ((ha g hg) ▸ Submodule.subset_span ⟨l, rfl⟩)
  choose h N hhG hhN using hgen
  let ι : Type u := Σ g : {g // g ∈ T}, Fin (p g.1 g.2)
  let e : ι → Γ(F, W) := fun i => h i.1.1 i.1.2 i.2
  refine ⟨ι, inferInstance, e, fun V hV => ?_⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · 
    intro t ht
    rw [mem_spanSub_iff]
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hxg⟩ := hTcov x (hV hx.1)
    have hDg : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen (S.basicOpen g) := hW.basicOpen g
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hxb⟩ := hDg.exists_basicOpen_le (V := V ⊓ S.basicOpen g) ⟨x, ⟨hx.1, hxg⟩⟩ hxg
    have hbV : S.basicOpen b ≤ V := hb.trans inf_le_left
    have hbg : S.basicOpen b ≤ S.basicOpen g := hb.trans inf_le_right
    have hbW : S.basicOpen b ≤ V ⊓ W := le_inf hbV (hbg.trans (S.basicOpen_le g))
    refine ⟨S.basicOpen b, hbW, hxb, ?_⟩
    have htb : F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hbW.trans inf_le_left)).op t ∈ objΓ G (S.basicOpen b) :=
      mem_map_of_mem G _ ht
    rw [hG.obj_basicOpen_eq_span (hTU g hg) hDg b (a g hg) (ha g hg)] at htb
    refine (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_) htb
    rintro _ ⟨l, rfl⟩
    
    have hcomp : S.presheaf.map (homOfLE hbg).op (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (S.basicOpen_le g)).op g) =
        S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hbg.trans (S.basicOpen_le g))).op g := by
      rw [← S.presheaf.map_comp_apply, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp]
    have hunit : IsUnit (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hbg.trans (S.basicOpen_le g))).op g) := by
      rw [← hcomp]
      exact (S.toRingedSpace.isUnit_res_basicOpen g).map (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE hbg).op).hom
    refine mem_span_of_unit_pow_smul_eq F _ ⟨⟨g, hg⟩, l⟩ hunit (N g hg l) _ ?_
    show F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hbW.trans inf_le_right)).op (h g hg l) = _
    rw [← map_map (S.basicOpen_le g) hbg, hhN g hg l, AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.map_smul, map_pow,
      hcomp]
  · 
    intro t ht
    rw [mem_spanSub_iff] at ht
    apply hG.mem_of_locally V (hV.trans inf_le_left)
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨U₀, h₀, hx₀, ht₀⟩ := ht x ⟨hx, (hV hx).2⟩
    refine ⟨U₀, h₀.trans inf_le_left, hx₀, ?_⟩
    refine (Submodule.span_le.mpr ?_) ht₀
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    have := mem_map_of_mem G (h₀.trans (inf_le_inf_right W (hV.trans inf_le_left))) (hhG i.1.1 i.1.2 i.2)
    rw [map_map] at this
    exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_isAffine_of_bijective_top
statement:
theorem isIso_of_isAffine_of_bijective_top {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} [AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffine X]
    {M N : X.Modules} [M.IsQuasicoherent] [N.IsQuasicoherent] (φ : M ⟶ N)
    (h : Function.Bijective (φ.app ⊤).hom) : IsIso φ
proof:
:= by
  have hG : IsIso ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pushforward X.isoSpec.hom ⋙
      AlgebraicGeometry.moduleSpecΓFunctor).map φ) := by
    rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
    exact h
  have hF : IsIso ((AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.functor Γ(X, ⊤) ⋙
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback X.isoSpec.hom).map
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pushforward X.isoSpec.hom ⋙
          AlgebraicGeometry.moduleSpecΓFunctor).map φ)) := inferInstance
  have h1 : IsIso (AffineTilde.adj.counit.app M) := AffineTilde.isIso_counit_app M
  have h2 : IsIso (AffineTilde.adj.counit.app N) := AffineTilde.isIso_counit_app N
  have hnat := AffineTilde.adj.counit.naturality φ
  have key : φ = inv (AffineTilde.adj.counit.app M) ≫
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pushforward X.isoSpec.hom ⋙ AlgebraicGeometry.moduleSpecΓFunctor) ⋙
        (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.functor Γ(X, ⊤) ⋙ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback X.isoSpec.hom)).map φ ≫
      AffineTilde.adj.counit.app N := by
    rw [hnat, IsIso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    rfl
  have hF' : IsIso (((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pushforward X.isoSpec.hom ⋙
      AlgebraicGeometry.moduleSpecΓFunctor) ⋙
        (AlgebraicGeometry.tilde.functor Γ(X, ⊤) ⋙ AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback X.isoSpec.hom)).map φ) :=
    hF
  rw [key]
  exact IsIso.comp_isIso

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.bijective_app_of_eq
statement:
theorem bijective_app_of_eq {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} {M N : X.Modules} (φ : M ⟶ N)
    {U V : X.Opens} (e : U = V) (h : Function.Bijective (φ.app V).hom) :
    Function.Bijective (φ.app U).hom
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  exact h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_affineOpens_cover_bijective
statement:
theorem isIso_of_affineOpens_cover_bijective {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} {M N : X.Modules}
    [M.IsQuasicoherent] [N.IsQuasicoherent] (φ : M ⟶ N) {ι : Type*} (Us : ι → X.Opens)
    (haff : ∀ i, AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen (Us i)) (hcov : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ Us i)
    (h : ∀ i, Function.Bijective (φ.app (Us i)).hom) : IsIso φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.moduleHom_isIso_iff_stalk_bijective]
  intro x
  obtain ⟨i, hx⟩ := hcov x
  have : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffine (Us i).toScheme := haff i
  haveI : (M.restrict (Us i).ι).IsQuasicoherent :=
    (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent (Us i).toScheme.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (Us i).ι).app M).symm
      (inferInstanceAs ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback (Us i).ι).obj M).IsQuasicoherent)
  haveI : (N.restrict (Us i).ι).IsQuasicoherent :=
    (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent (Us i).toScheme.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback (Us i).ι).app N).symm
      (inferInstanceAs ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback (Us i).ι).obj N).IsQuasicoherent)
  have e : (Us i).ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : (Us i).toScheme.Opens) = Us i := by
    rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange, AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
  have hb : Function.Bijective
      (((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Us i).ι).map φ).app ⊤).hom :=
    bijective_app_of_eq φ e (h i)
  haveI : IsIso ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (Us i).ι).map φ) :=
    isIso_of_isAffine_of_bijective_top _ hb
  exact AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.moduleStalkMap_bijective_of_restrict_isIso (Us i).ι φ ⟨x, hx⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.germₗ_apply
statement: theorem germₗ_apply (m : Γ(H, W)) : H.germₗ W x hx m = H.presheaf.germ W x hx m
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.germ_smul_sections
statement:
private theorem germ_smul_sections (r : Γ(X, W)) (m : Γ(H, W)) :
    H.presheaf.germ W x hx (r • m) = (X.presheaf.germ W x hx r) • H.presheaf.germ W x hx m
proof:
:=
  PresheafOfModules.germ_smul (R := X.presheaf) H.val x W hx r m

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isLocalizedModule_germₗ_of_isQuasicoherent
statement:
theorem isLocalizedModule_germₗ_of_isQuasicoherent [H.IsQuasicoherent] (hW : IsAffineOpen W) :
    letI
proof:
:= H.stalkModuleSections W x hx
    IsLocalizedModule (hW.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl (H.germₗ W x hx) := by
  letI := H.stalkModuleSections W x hx
  set p := hW.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩ with hp
  letI := TopCat.Presheaf.algebra_section_stalk X.presheaf (⟨x, hx⟩ : W)
  have hloc : IsLocalization.AtPrime (X.presheaf.stalk x) p.asIdeal := hW.isLocalization_stalk ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hunit : ∀ h : Γ(X, W), h ∈ p.asIdeal.primeCompl ↔ IsUnit (X.presheaf.germ W x hx h) := fun h =>
    (IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_to_map_iff (X.presheaf.stalk x) p.asIdeal h).symm
  have hsmul : ∀ (r : Γ(X, W)) (m : H.presheaf.stalk x),
      r • m = (X.presheaf.germ W x hx r) • m := fun _ _ => rfl
  constructor
  · 
    intro s
    rw [Module.End.isUnit_iff]
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := (hunit s).mp s.2
    constructor
    · intro m₁ m₂ h
      simp only [Module.algebraMap_end_apply, hsmul, ← hu] at h
      have := congrArg (fun m => (↑u⁻¹ : X.presheaf.stalk x) • m) h
      simpa [smul_smul] using this
    · intro m
      refine ⟨(↑u⁻¹ : X.presheaf.stalk x) • m, ?_⟩
      simp [Module.algebraMap_end_apply, hsmul, ← hu, smul_smul]
  · 
    intro m
    obtain ⟨U, hUW, hxU, s₀, rfl⟩ := H.presheaf.exists_le_germ_eq m hx
    obtain ⟨h, hhU, hxh⟩ := hW.exists_basicOpen_le ⟨x, hxU⟩ hx
    obtain ⟨n, t, ht⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_pow_smul_eq_map_basicOpen H hW h
      (H.presheaf.map (homOfLE hhU).op s₀)
    have hhp : h ∈ p.asIdeal.primeCompl := (hunit h).mpr ((X.mem_basicOpen h x hx).mp hxh)
    refine ⟨(t, ⟨h ^ n, pow_mem hhp n⟩), ?_⟩
    show (h ^ n) • H.presheaf.germ U x hxU s₀ = H.presheaf.germ W x hx t
    have hxb : x ∈ X.basicOpen h := hxh
    rw [← H.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le h)) x hxb t, ht,
      germ_smul_sections H (X.basicOpen h) x hxb, map_pow,
      X.presheaf.germ_res_apply, H.presheaf.germ_res_apply, hsmul, map_pow]
  · 
    intro t₁ t₂ h12
    obtain ⟨V, hxV, iU, iV, e⟩ := H.presheaf.germ_eq x hx hx t₁ t₂ h12
    obtain ⟨h, hhV, hxh⟩ := hW.exists_basicOpen_le ⟨x, hxV⟩ hx
    have hzero : H.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le h)).op (t₁ - t₂) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, sub_eq_zero]
      have := congrArg (H.presheaf.map (homOfLE hhV).op) e
      rw [← H.presheaf.map_comp_apply, ← H.presheaf.map_comp_apply] at this
      exact this
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Scheme.Modules.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_map_basicOpen_eq_zero H hW h
      (t₁ - t₂) hzero
    have hhp : h ∈ p.asIdeal.primeCompl := (hunit h).mpr ((X.mem_basicOpen h x hx).mp hxh)
    refine ⟨⟨h ^ n, pow_mem hhp n⟩, ?_⟩
    show (h ^ n) • t₁ = (h ^ n) • t₂
    rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← smul_sub]
    exact hn

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffinePushforwardAux.isQuasicoherent_of_affineOpens_restrict
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_of_affineOpens_restrict {Y : Scheme.{u}} (N : Y.Modules)
    (h : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, (N.restrict U.1.ι).IsQuasicoherent) : N.IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens, (N.over U.1).IsQuasicoherent := fun U => by
    have : IsAffine U.1 := U.2
    have := h U
    exact (PullbackQcAux.presentationOver U.1 (presentationOfAffine (N.restrict U.1.ι))).isQuasicoherent
  refine SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.of_coversTop N (fun U : Y.affineOpens => U.1) ?_
  rw [_root_.Opens.coversTop_iff, TopologicalSpace.IsOpenCover]
  exact AlgebraicGeometry.iSup_affineOpens_eq_top Y

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffinePushforwardAux.isQuasicoherent_unit_of_isAffine
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_unit_of_isAffine (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y] :
    (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:=
  haveI : (SheafOfModules.unit (Spec Γ(Y, ⊤)).ringCatSheaf).IsQuasicoherent :=
    (isQuasicoherent_iff_isIso_fromTildeΓ _).mpr inferInstance
  (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent Y.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    (PullbackQcAux.unitPullbackIso Y.isoSpec.hom).symm (isQuasicoherent_pullback _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffinePushforwardAux.isQuasicoherent_unit
statement: theorem isQuasicoherent_unit (X : Scheme.{u}) : (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  refine isQuasicoherent_of_affineOpens_restrict _ fun U => ?_
  have : IsAffine U.1 := U.2
  have := isQuasicoherent_unit_of_isAffine U.1
  exact (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent U.1.toScheme.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    (restrictUnitIso U.1.ι).symm inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffinePushforwardAux.image_preimage_preimage_eq
statement:
theorem image_preimage_preimage_eq (W : (V : Scheme.{u}).Opens) :
    (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ''ᵁ ((f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ (V.ι ''ᵁ W))) = f ⁻¹ᵁ (V.ι ''ᵁ W)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.image_preimage_eq_opensRange_inf, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι, inf_eq_right]
  exact f.preimage_mono (V.ι_image_le W)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffinePushforwardAux.isIso_restrict_pushforward_unit
statement:
theorem isIso_restrict_pushforward_unit :
    IsIso ((restrictFunctor V.ι).map ((pushforward f).map
      ((restrictAdjunction (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).unit.app M)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app]
  intro W
  change IsIso (((restrictAdjunction (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).unit.app M).app (f ⁻¹ᵁ (V.ι ''ᵁ W)))
  rw [restrictAdjunction_unit_app_app]
  have : homOfLE ((f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι.image_preimage_le (f ⁻¹ᵁ (V.ι ''ᵁ W))) =
      eqToHom (image_preimage_preimage_eq f V W) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [this]
  have : IsIso (eqToHom (image_preimage_preimage_eq f V W)).op := isIso_op _
  exact Functor.map_isIso M.presheaf _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffinePushforwardAux.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffine
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffine {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine Y] [IsAffine Z]
    (g : Y ⟶ Z) (N : Y.Modules) [N.IsQuasicoherent] :
    ((pushforward g).obj N).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  have hg : (Y.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map g.appTop) ≫ Z.isoSpec.inv = g := by
    rw [Scheme.isoSpec_hom_naturality, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
  have h1 : ((pushforward Y.isoSpec.hom).obj N).IsQuasicoherent :=
    AffineTilde.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_hom Y.isoSpec N
  have h2 : ((pushforward (Spec.map g.appTop)).obj
      ((pushforward Y.isoSpec.hom).obj N)).IsQuasicoherent := by
    rw [isQuasicoherent_iff_isIso_fromTildeΓ]
    exact isIso_fromTildeΓ_pushforward g.appTop _
  have h3 : ((pushforward Z.isoSpec.inv).obj ((pushforward (Spec.map g.appTop)).obj
      ((pushforward Y.isoSpec.hom).obj N))).IsQuasicoherent :=
    AffineTilde.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_hom Z.isoSpec.symm _
  refine (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent Z.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso ?_ h3
  exact (pushforward Z.isoSpec.inv).mapIso
      ((pushforwardComp Y.isoSpec.hom (Spec.map g.appTop)).app N) ≪≫
    (pushforwardComp (Y.isoSpec.hom ≫ Spec.map g.appTop) Z.isoSpec.inv).app N ≪≫
    (pushforwardCongr hg).app N

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffinePushforwardAux.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffineHom
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffineHom [IsAffineHom f] [M.IsQuasicoherent] :
    ((pushforward f).obj M).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  refine isQuasicoherent_of_affineOpens_restrict _ fun V => ?_
  have : IsAffine V.1 := V.2
  have : IsAffine (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) := V.2.preimage f
  have : ((pushforward (f.resLE V.1 (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) le_rfl)).obj
      (M.restrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι)).IsQuasicoherent :=
    isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffine _ _
  exact (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent V.1.toScheme.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    (pushforwardRestrictIso f M V.1).symm inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_one_of_isAffineHom
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_one_of_isAffineHom {X S : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) [AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineHom f] :
    ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj
      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:=
  haveI := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffinePushforwardAux.isQuasicoherent_unit X
  AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffinePushforwardAux.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffineHom f _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Stacks01lcAux.B_eq
statement: theorem B_eq (V : X.Opens) : B s V = V ⊓ X.basicOpen s
proof: := X.basicOpen_res _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Stacks01lcAux.B_le
statement: theorem B_le (V : X.Opens) : B s V ≤ V
proof: := X.basicOpen_le _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Stacks01lcAux.B_mono
statement: theorem B_mono {V W : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ W) : B s V ≤ B s W
proof:
:= by
  rw [B_eq, B_eq]; exact inf_le_inf_right _ h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Stacks01lcAux.rs_res
statement: theorem rs_res {V W : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ V) : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (rs s V) = rs s W
proof:
:= by
  rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Stacks01lcAux.res_res
statement:
theorem res_res {V W Z : X.Opens} (h1 : W ≤ V) (h2 : Z ≤ W) (h3 : Z ≤ V) (t : Γ(M, V)) :
    M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h2).op (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h1).op t) =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h3).op t
proof:
:= by
  rw [← CategoryTheory.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Stacks01lcAux.eq_of_le_bot
statement: theorem eq_of_le_bot {V : X.Opens} (hV : V ≤ ⊥) (a b : Γ(M, V)) : a = b
proof:
:=
  TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' ⟨M.presheaf, M.isSheaf⟩ (fun i : PEmpty.{u + 1} => i.elim)
    V (fun i => i.elim) (hV.trans bot_le) a b (fun i => i.elim)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Stacks01lcAux.exists_glue_pair
statement:
theorem exists_glue_pair (S U : X.Opens) (a : Γ(M, S)) (b : Γ(M, U))
    (h : M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : S ⊓ U ≤ S)).op a =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : S ⊓ U ≤ U)).op b) :
    ∃ t : Γ(M, S ⊔ U), M.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_sup_left).op t = a ∧
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_sup_right).op t = b
proof:
:= by
  let F : TopCat.Sheaf Ab X := ⟨M.presheaf, M.isSheaf⟩
  let W : Bool → X.Opens := fun i => Bool.rec U S i
  let sf : ∀ i : Bool, Γ(M, W i) := fun i => Bool.rec (motive := fun i => Γ(M, W i)) b a i
  have hcover : S ⊔ U ≤ iSup W := sup_le (le_iSup W true) (le_iSup W false)
  have hcompat : TopCat.Presheaf.IsCompatible F.1 W sf := by
    rintro (_ | _) (_ | _)
    · rfl
    · change M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ S ≤ U)).op b =
        M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ⊓ S ≤ S)).op a
      have := congrArg (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_comm U S).le).op) h
      rw [res_res M _ _ inf_le_right, res_res M _ _ inf_le_left] at this
      exact this.symm
    · exact h
    · rfl
  obtain ⟨t, ht, -⟩ := F.existsUnique_gluing' W (S ⊔ U)
    (fun i => homOfLE (by cases i <;> simp [W])) hcover sf hcompat
  exact ⟨t, ht true, ht false⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Stacks01lcAux.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_isCompact
statement:
theorem exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_isCompact (V : X.Opens) (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X)) :
    ∀ t : Γ(M, V), M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (B_le s V)).op t = 0 → ∃ n : ℕ, rs s V ^ n • t = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine compact_open_induction_on (P := fun V => ∀ t : Γ(M, V),
    M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (B_le s V)).op t = 0 → ∃ n : ℕ, rs s V ^ n • t = 0) V hV ?_ ?_
  · intro t _
    exact ⟨0, eq_of_le_bot M le_rfl _ _⟩
  · intro S _ U ih t ht
    have h1 : M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (B_le s S)).op (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_sup_left).op t) = 0 := by
      rw [res_res M _ _ ((B_mono s le_sup_left).trans (B_le s (S ⊔ U.1))),
        ← res_res M (B_le s (S ⊔ U.1)) (B_mono s le_sup_left), ht, map_zero]
    have h2 : M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le (rs s U.1))).op
        (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_sup_right).op t) = 0 := by
      rw [res_res M _ _ ((B_mono s le_sup_right).trans (B_le s (S ⊔ U.1))),
        ← res_res M (B_le s (S ⊔ U.1)) (B_mono s le_sup_right), ht, map_zero]
    obtain ⟨n₁, hn₁⟩ := ih _ h1
    obtain ⟨n₂, hn₂⟩ := exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_map_basicOpen_eq_zero M U.2 (rs s U.1) _ h2
    refine ⟨n₁ + n₂, ?_⟩
    refine TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq₂ (⟨M.presheaf, M.isSheaf⟩ : TopCat.Sheaf Ab X)
      (homOfLE (le_sup_left : S ≤ S ⊔ U.1)) (homOfLE (le_sup_right : U.1 ≤ S ⊔ U.1)) le_rfl _ _ ?_ ?_
    · change M.presheaf.map _ (rs s (S ⊔ U.1) ^ (n₁ + n₂) • t) = M.presheaf.map _ (0 : Γ(M, S ⊔ U.1))
      rw [map_zero, map_smul, map_pow, rs_res, pow_add, mul_comm, mul_smul, hn₁, smul_zero]
    · change M.presheaf.map _ (rs s (S ⊔ U.1) ^ (n₁ + n₂) • t) = M.presheaf.map _ (0 : Γ(M, S ⊔ U.1))
      rw [map_zero, map_smul, map_pow, rs_res, pow_add, mul_smul, hn₂, smul_zero]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Stacks01lcAux.exists_pow_smul_eq_map_of_isCompact
statement:
theorem exists_pow_smul_eq_map_of_isCompact [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (V : X.Opens)
    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X)) :
    ∀ y : Γ(M, B s V), ∃ (n : ℕ) (t : Γ(M, V)),
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (B_le s V)).op t = rs s (B s V) ^ n • y
proof:
:= by
  refine compact_open_induction_on (P := fun V => ∀ y : Γ(M, B s V), ∃ (n : ℕ) (t : Γ(M, V)),
    M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (B_le s V)).op t = rs s (B s V) ^ n • y) V hV ?_ ?_
  · intro y
    exact ⟨0, 0, eq_of_le_bot M (B_le s ⊥) _ _⟩
  · intro S hS U ih y
    obtain ⟨n₁, t₁, ht₁⟩ := ih (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (B_mono s le_sup_left)).op y)
    obtain ⟨n₂, t₂, ht₂⟩ := exists_pow_smul_eq_map_basicOpen M U.2 (rs s U.1)
      (M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (B_mono s le_sup_right)).op y)
    rw [rs_res] at ht₂
    have hSU : IsCompact ((S ⊓ U.1 : X.Opens) : Set X) :=
      QuasiSeparatedSpace.inter_isCompact _ _ S.2 hS U.1.2 U.2.isCompact
    
    have hab : M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (B_le s (S ⊓ U.1))).op
        (rs s (S ⊓ U.1) ^ n₂ • M.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op t₁ -
          rs s (S ⊓ U.1) ^ n₁ • M.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op t₂) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, sub_eq_zero, map_smul, map_smul, map_pow, map_pow, rs_res,
        res_res M _ _ ((B_le s (S ⊓ U.1)).trans inf_le_left),
        res_res M _ _ ((B_le s (S ⊓ U.1)).trans inf_le_right),
        ← res_res M (B_le s S) (B_mono s inf_le_left),
        ← res_res M (B_le s U.1) (B_mono s inf_le_right), ht₁, ht₂,
        map_smul, map_smul, map_pow, map_pow, rs_res, rs_res, smul_smul, smul_smul, ← pow_add,
        ← pow_add, add_comm,
        res_res M _ _ ((B_mono s inf_le_left).trans (B_mono s le_sup_left)),
        res_res M _ _ ((B_mono s inf_le_right).trans (B_mono s le_sup_right))]
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_isCompact M s (S ⊓ U.1) hSU _ hab
    rw [smul_sub, sub_eq_zero, smul_smul, smul_smul, ← pow_add, ← pow_add] at hm
    have hglue : M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : S ⊓ U.1 ≤ S)).op (rs s S ^ (m + n₂) • t₁) =
        M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : S ⊓ U.1 ≤ U.1)).op (rs s U.1 ^ (m + n₁) • t₂) := by
      rw [map_smul, map_smul, map_pow, map_pow, rs_res, rs_res]
      exact hm
    obtain ⟨t, ht1, ht2⟩ := exists_glue_pair M S U.1 _ _ hglue
    refine ⟨m + n₁ + n₂, t, ?_⟩
    have hcover : B s (S ⊔ U.1) ≤ B s S ⊔ B s U.1 := by
      rw [B_eq, B_eq, B_eq]; exact (inf_sup_right _ _ _).le
    refine TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq₂ (⟨M.presheaf, M.isSheaf⟩ : TopCat.Sheaf Ab X)
      (homOfLE (B_mono s (le_sup_left : S ≤ S ⊔ U.1)))
      (homOfLE (B_mono s (le_sup_right : U.1 ≤ S ⊔ U.1))) hcover _ _ ?_ ?_
    · change M.presheaf.map _ (M.presheaf.map _ t) =
        M.presheaf.map _ (rs s (B s (S ⊔ U.1)) ^ (m + n₁ + n₂) • y)
      rw [res_res M _ _ ((B_le s S).trans le_sup_left), ← res_res M le_sup_left (B_le s S), ht1,
        map_smul, map_smul, map_pow, map_pow, rs_res, rs_res, ht₁, smul_smul, ← pow_add]
      congr 2
      omega
    · change M.presheaf.map _ (M.presheaf.map _ t) =
        M.presheaf.map _ (rs s (B s (S ⊔ U.1)) ^ (m + n₁ + n₂) • y)
      rw [res_res M _ _ ((B_le s U.1).trans le_sup_right), ← res_res M le_sup_right (B_le s U.1), ht2,
        map_smul, map_smul, map_pow, map_pow, rs_res, rs_res, ht₂, smul_smul, ← pow_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Stacks01lcAux.rs_top
statement: theorem rs_top : rs s ⊤ = s
proof:
:= by
  have : (homOfLE (le_top : (⊤ : X.Opens) ≤ ⊤)) = 𝟙 _ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  change X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op s = s
  rw [this, op_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Stacks01lcAux.exists_pow_smul_eq_map_top
statement:
theorem exists_pow_smul_eq_map_top [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] {W : X.Opens}
    (hW : W = X.basicOpen s) (y : Γ(M, W)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (t : Γ(M, ⊤)), M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op t =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)).op s ^ n • y
proof:
:= by
  have hW' : W = B s ⊤ := by rw [hW, B_eq, top_inf_eq]
  subst hW'
  obtain ⟨n, t, ht⟩ := exists_pow_smul_eq_map_of_isCompact M s ⊤ isCompact_univ y
  exact ⟨n, t, ht⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Stacks01lcAux.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_top
proof:
:= by
  have hW' : W = B s ⊤ := by rw [hW, B_eq, top_inf_eq]
  subst hW'
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_isCompact M s ⊤ isCompact_univ t ht
  rw [rs_top] at hn
  exact ⟨n, hn⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Stacks01lcAux.smul_pushforward_spec
statement:
theorem smul_pushforward_spec (V : (Spec R).Opens) (r : R) (x : Γ(M, g ⁻¹ᵁ V)) :
    (r • (show Γ((pushforward g).obj M, V) from x) : Γ((pushforward g).obj M, V)) =
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : g ⁻¹ᵁ V ≤ ⊤)).op (g.appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv r)) • x :
        Γ(M, g ⁻¹ᵁ V))
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_Spec_def]
  change ((g.app V ((Spec R).presheaf.map V.leTop.op ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv r))) • x :
    Γ(M, g ⁻¹ᵁ V)) = _
  congr 1
  have h1 := ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (g.naturality V.leTop.op) ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv r)
  rw [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at h1
  rw [h1]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Stacks01lcAux.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_spec
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_pushforward_spec [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [M.IsQuasicoherent] : ((pushforward g).obj M).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  rw [isQuasicoherent_iff_isIso_fromTildeΓ, isIso_fromTildeΓ_iff_isLocalizing]
  intro r
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s : Γ(X, ⊤), s = g.appTop ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso R).inv r) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hW : g ⁻¹ᵁ (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r : (Spec R).Opens) = X.basicOpen s := by
    rw [hs, ← basicOpen_eq_of_affine, preimage_basicOpen_top]
  refine IsLocalizedModule.Away.mk_of_addCommGroup ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact isUnit_algebraMap_end_of_le_basicOpen r le_rfl
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨n, t, ht⟩ := exists_pow_smul_eq_map_top M s hW
      (x : Γ(M, g ⁻¹ᵁ (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r : (Spec R).Opens)))
    refine ⟨n, t, ?_⟩
    change r ^ n • x = M.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (le_top : g ⁻¹ᵁ (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r : (Spec R).Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op t
    refine (smul_pushforward_spec g M _ (r ^ n) x).trans ?_
    rw [map_pow, map_pow, ← hs, map_pow]
    exact ht.symm
  · intro t ht
    have ht' : M.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_top : g ⁻¹ᵁ (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r : (Spec R).Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op t = 0 := ht
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_top M s hW t ht'
    refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
    refine (smul_pushforward_spec g M ⊤ (r ^ n) t).trans ?_
    rw [map_pow, map_pow, ← hs, map_pow]
    have e : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : g ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op s = s := rs_top s
    rw [e]
    exact hn

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Stacks01lcAux.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffine_target
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffine_target {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine Y]
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (f : X ⟶ Y) [M.IsQuasicoherent] :
    ((pushforward f).obj M).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := isQuasicoherent_pushforward_spec (f ≫ Y.isoSpec.hom) M
  have h2 : ((pushforward Y.isoSpec.inv).obj
      ((pushforward (f ≫ Y.isoSpec.hom)).obj M)).IsQuasicoherent :=
    AffineTilde.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_hom Y.isoSpec.symm _
  refine (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent Y.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso ?_ h2
  exact (pushforwardComp (f ≫ Y.isoSpec.hom) Y.isoSpec.inv).app M ≪≫
    (pushforwardCongr (by rw [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id])).app M

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_pushforward
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_pushforward {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [AlgebraicGeometry.QuasiCompact f] [AlgebraicGeometry.QuasiSeparated f]
    (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] :
    ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  refine AffinePushforwardAux.isQuasicoherent_of_affineOpens_restrict _ fun V => ?_
  have : IsAffine V.1 := V.2
  have hc : CompactSpace (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) :=
    isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (f.isCompact_preimage V.2.isCompact)
  have hqs : QuasiSeparatedSpace (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) :=
    (isQuasiSeparated_iff_quasiSeparatedSpace _ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).2).mp
      (f.isQuasiSeparated_preimage V.2.isQuasiSeparated)
  have := Stacks01lcAux.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_of_isAffine_target
    (M.restrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι) (f.resLE V.1 (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) le_rfl)
  exact (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent V.1.toScheme.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    (AffinePushforwardAux.pushforwardRestrictIso f M V.1).symm this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.unit_isQuasicoherent
statement: theorem unit_isQuasicoherent (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}) : (𝟙_ X.Modules).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  have h : (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit.{u+1}).IsQuasicoherent :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_of_isLocallyFree _
  have e : (SheafOfModules.free (R := X.ringCatSheaf) PUnit.{u+1} : X.Modules) ≅ 𝟙_ X.Modules :=
    coproductUniqueIso _ ≪≫ eqToIso (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.unit_eq_tensorUnit X)
  exact (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso e h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorObj_isQuasicoherent
statement:
theorem tensorObj_isQuasicoherent (F G : X.Modules) (hF : F.IsQuasicoherent) (hG : G.IsQuasicoherent) :
    (F ⊗ G).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:=
  (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorIsoTensorObj F G)
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_tensor F G)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_biproduct_of_fintype
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_biproduct_of_fintype {J : Type} [Fintype J] (M : J → X.Modules)
    (hM : ∀ j, (M j).IsQuasicoherent) : (⨁ M).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:= by
  let F : Discrete (ULift.{u} J) ⥤ X.Modules := Discrete.functor (fun j => M j.down)
  have h : (colimit F).IsQuasicoherent :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_colimit F (fun j => hM j.as.down)
  have e : ⨁ M ≅ colimit F :=
    biproduct.isoCoproduct M ≪≫
      Sigma.whiskerEquiv (f := M) (g := fun k : ULift.{u} J => M k.down) Equiv.ulift.symm
        (fun j => Iso.refl _)
  exact (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso e.symm h

name: Stacks01pbAffineOpenAux.finite_of_generatingSections
statement:
theorem finite_of_generatingSections {R : CommRingCat.{u}} (N : (Spec R).Modules)
    [N.IsQuasicoherent] (σ : N.GeneratingSections) [σ.IsFiniteType] :
    Module.Finite R Γ(N, ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  let P : ModuleCat.{u} R := (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj N).presheaf.obj (.op ⊤)
  have : IsIso N.fromTildeΓ := Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent N
  have : Epi (C := (Spec R).Modules) σ.π := σ.epi
  let φ : SheafOfModules.free.{u} σ.I ⟶ tilde P := σ.π ≫ inv N.fromTildeΓ
  have : Epi φ := epi_comp _ _
  let ψ : (tilde.functor R).obj (ModuleCat.of R (σ.I →₀ R)) ⟶ (tilde.functor R).obj P :=
    (tildeFinsupp σ.I).hom ≫ φ
  have : Epi ψ := epi_comp _ _
  let g : ModuleCat.of R (σ.I →₀ R) ⟶ P := (tilde.functor R).preimage ψ
  have : Epi ((tilde.functor R).map g) := by
    rw [Functor.map_preimage]; infer_instance
  have : Epi g := (tilde.functor R).epi_of_epi_map this
  have hg := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective g).mp this
  have : Finite σ.I := SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.IsFiniteType.finite
  have : Module.Finite R (σ.I →₀ R) := inferInstance
  have : Module.Finite R P := Module.Finite.of_surjective g.hom hg
  exact this

name: Stacks01pbAffineOpenAux.exists_generatingSections_restrict
statement:
theorem exists_generatingSections_restrict {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion f]
    (M : X.Modules) {V : X.Opens} (hf : f.opensRange ≤ V)
    (σ : (M.over V).GeneratingSections) [σ.IsFiniteType] :
    ∃ τ : (M.restrict f).GeneratingSections, τ.IsFiniteType
proof:
:= by
  have hrange : Set.range f.base ⊆ Set.range V.ι.base := by
    rw [Scheme.Opens.range_ι]
    exact fun x hx => hf (show x ∈ f.opensRange from hx)
  let f' : Y ⟶ V.toScheme := IsOpenImmersion.lift V.ι f hrange
  have hf' : f' ≫ V.ι = f := IsOpenImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _
  have : IsOpenImmersion f' := inferInstance
  have h1 : PreservesColimitsOfSize.{u, u} (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).functor := inferInstance
  have h2 : PreservesColimitsOfSize.{u, u} (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f') := inferInstance
  let F := (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv V).functor ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f'
  have : PreservesColimitsOfSize.{u, u} F := @comp_preservesColimits _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h1 h2
  let η : SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf ≅ F.obj (SheafOfModules.unit _) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictUnitIso f').symm
  let iso : F.obj (M.over V) ≅ M.restrict f :=
    (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor f').mapIso ((Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv V).app M) ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorComp f' V.ι).app M).symm ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctorCongr hf').app M
  exact ⟨(σ.map F η).ofEpi iso.hom, inferInstance⟩

name: Stacks01pbAffineOpenAux.finite_of_finite_restrict
proof:
:= by
  have hV : hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ ⊤ = U := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange, hU.opensRange_fromSpec]
  let e : Γ(X, U) ≃+* Γ(X, U) :=
    ((X.presheaf.mapIso (eqToIso hV).op) ≪≫ (hU.fromSpec.appIso ⊤) ≪≫
      Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
  have : RingHomSurjective (e : Γ(X, U) →+* Γ(X, U)) := ⟨e.surjective⟩
  have : RingHomSurjective (e.symm : Γ(X, U) →+* Γ(X, U)) := ⟨e.symm.surjective⟩
  have key : ∀ (r : Γ(X, hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ ⊤)) (y : Γ(M, hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ ⊤)),
      (M.restrictAppIso hU.fromSpec ⊤).inv (r • y) =
        ((hU.fromSpec.appIso ⊤).hom r) • (M.restrictAppIso hU.fromSpec ⊤).inv y := fun r y => by
    have := Scheme.Modules.smul_restrictAppIso_inv_apply hU.fromSpec M ⊤ r y
    exact this
  let g : Γ(M, U) →ₛₗ[(e : Γ(X, U) →+* Γ(X, U))] Γ(M.restrict hU.fromSpec, ⊤) :=
    { toFun := fun m => (M.restrictAppIso hU.fromSpec ⊤).inv (M.presheaf.map (eqToHom hV).op m)
      map_add' := fun a b => by simp
      map_smul' := fun a m => by
        rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul, key, Scheme.Modules.smul_Spec_def]
        congr 1
        simp only [e]
        have h1 : (Opens.leTop (⊤ : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Opens)).op = 𝟙 _ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        rw [h1, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
        simp [Iso.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv] }
  have hg : Function.Bijective g :=
    ((ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (M.restrictAppIso hU.fromSpec ⊤).inv)).comp
      (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (M.presheaf.map (eqToHom hV).op))
  have : RingHomInvPair (e : Γ(X, U) →+* Γ(X, U)) (e.symm : Γ(X, U) →+* Γ(X, U)) :=
    RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv e
  have : RingHomInvPair (e.symm : Γ(X, U) →+* Γ(X, U)) (e : Γ(X, U) →+* Γ(X, U)) :=
    RingHomInvPair.of_ringEquiv_symm e
  let ge : Γ(M, U) ≃ₛₗ[(e : Γ(X, U) →+* Γ(X, U))] Γ(M.restrict hU.fromSpec, ⊤) :=
    LinearEquiv.ofBijective g hg
  exact Module.Finite.of_surjective
    (ge.symm : Γ(M.restrict hU.fromSpec, ⊤) →ₛₗ[(e.symm : Γ(X, U) →+* Γ(X, U))] Γ(M, U))
    ge.symm.surjective

name: Stacks01pbAffineOpenAux.finite_basicOpen
statement:
theorem finite_basicOpen {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] {U : X.Opens}
    (hU : IsAffineOpen U) {V : X.Opens} (σ : (M.over V).GeneratingSections) [σ.IsFiniteType]
    (g : Γ(X, U)) (hg : X.basicOpen g ≤ V) :
    Module.Finite Γ(X, X.basicOpen g) Γ(M, X.basicOpen g)
proof:
:= by
  have hD : IsAffineOpen (X.basicOpen g) := hU.basicOpen g
  have hrange : hD.fromSpec.opensRange ≤ V := by
    rw [hD.opensRange_fromSpec]; exact hg
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := exists_generatingSections_restrict hD.fromSpec M hrange σ
  have := hτ
  have : Module.Finite Γ(X, X.basicOpen g) Γ(M.restrict hD.fromSpec, ⊤) :=
    finite_of_generatingSections (M.restrict hD.fromSpec) τ
  exact finite_of_finite_restrict M hD

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.finite_sections_of_isFiniteType
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.finite_sections_of_isFiniteType
    {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] [M.IsFiniteType]
    {U : X.Opens} (hU : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen U) :
    Module.Finite Γ(X, U) Γ(M, U)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := SheafOfModules.IsFiniteType.exists_localGeneratorsData M
  have hcov : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ d.X i := by
    have h := d.coversTop
    rw [Opens.coversTop_iff] at h
    intro x
    have hx : x ∈ ⨆ i, d.X i := by rw [h]; trivial
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mp hx
  have hloc : ∀ x : U, ∃ g : Γ(X, U), x.1 ∈ X.basicOpen g ∧
      Module.Finite Γ(X, X.basicOpen g) Γ(M, X.basicOpen g) := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcov x.1
    obtain ⟨g, hg1, hg2⟩ := hU.exists_basicOpen_le (V := d.X i) ⟨x.1, hi⟩ x.2
    have := hd.isFiniteType i
    exact ⟨g, hg2, Stacks01pbAffineOpenAux.finite_basicOpen M hU (d.generators i) g hg1⟩
  choose gof hg1 hg2 using hloc
  have hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range gof) = ⊤ := by
    rw [← hU.self_le_iSup_basicOpen_iff]
    intro x hx
    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨gof ⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩, hg1 ⟨x, hx⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨t, hts, ht⟩ := (Ideal.span_eq_top_iff_finite _).mp hspan
  have hfin : ∀ g : t, Module.Finite Γ(X, X.basicOpen g.1) Γ(M, X.basicOpen g.1) := by
    intro g
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hts g.2
    have := hg2 x
    rw [hx] at this
    exact this
  let modD : ∀ g : t, Module Γ(X, U) Γ(M, X.basicOpen g.1) := fun g =>
    Module.compHom Γ(M, X.basicOpen g.1) (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le g.1)).op).hom
  have : ∀ g : t, IsScalarTower Γ(X, U) Γ(X, X.basicOpen g.1) Γ(M, X.basicOpen g.1) := fun g =>
    ⟨fun r a m => by
      change ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le g.1)).op).hom r * a) • m =
        (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le g.1)).op).hom r • (a • m)
      rw [mul_smul]⟩
  let f : ∀ g : t, Γ(M, U) →ₗ[Γ(X, U)] Γ(M, X.basicOpen g.1) := fun g =>
    { toFun := M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le g.1)).op
      map_add' := fun a b => by simp
      map_smul' := fun r m => by
        rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul]; rfl }
  have : ∀ g : t, IsLocalization.Away g.1 Γ(X, X.basicOpen g.1) := fun g =>
    hU.isLocalization_basicOpen g.1
  have : ∀ g : t, IsLocalizedModule.Away g.1 (f g) := fun g =>
    Scheme.Modules.isLocalizedModule_basicOpen M hU g.1 (fun _ _ => rfl) (f g) (fun _ => rfl)
  exact Module.Finite.of_localizationSpan_finite' t ht f hfin

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.BasicOpenRestrictionKernel.ker_restriction_eq_powerTorsion
statement:
theorem ker_restriction_eq_powerTorsion
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (V : X.affineOpens) (a : Γ(X, V))
    (W : X.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ V.1) (hW : W = X.basicOpen a) :
    RingHom.ker (X.presheaf.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE hWV).op).hom =
      (Submodule.torsion' Γ(X, V) Γ(X, V) ↥(Submonoid.powers a) : Ideal Γ(X, V))
proof:
:= by
  let : Algebra Γ(X, V) Γ(X, W) := (X.presheaf.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE hWV).op).hom.toAlgebra
  have : IsLocalization.Away a Γ(X, W) :=
    V.2.isLocalization_of_eq_basicOpen a (CategoryTheory.homOfLE hWV) hW
  ext s
  change algebraMap Γ(X, V) Γ(X, W) s = 0 ↔
    ∃ m : Submonoid.powers a, (m : Γ(X, V)) * s = 0
  exact IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff (Submonoid.powers a) Γ(X, W) s

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.BasicOpenRestrictionKernel.mem_ker_restriction_iff_pow_mul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mem_ker_restriction_iff_pow_mul_eq_zero
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (V : X.affineOpens) (a : Γ(X, V))
    (W : X.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ V.1) (hW : W = X.basicOpen a) (s : Γ(X, V)) :
    s ∈ RingHom.ker (X.presheaf.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE hWV).op).hom ↔
      ∃ n : ℕ, a ^ n * s = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ker_restriction_eq_powerTorsion X V a W hWV hW]
  change (∃ m : Submonoid.powers a, (m : Γ(X, V)) * s = 0) ↔ _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨m, hm⟩, hms⟩
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := (Submonoid.mem_powers_iff m a).mp hm
    exact ⟨n, hms⟩
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    exact ⟨⟨a ^ n, (Submonoid.mem_powers_iff _ a).mpr ⟨n, rfl⟩⟩, hn⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isFiniteType_pullback
proof:
:= by
  open AlgebraicGeometry in
  refine Scheme.Modules.isFiniteType_of_epi_free_pullback _ fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨U, J, hJ, π, hx, hπ⟩ :=
    Scheme.Modules.exists_epi_free_pullback_of_isFiniteType F (f x)
  
  let f' : (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme ⟶ U.toScheme := f ∣_ U
  let e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F) ≅
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback f').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).obj F) :=
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι f).app F ≪≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (morphismRestrict_ι f U).symm).app F ≪≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' U.ι).app F).symm
  have h1 : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map π) :=
    @Functor.map_epi _ _ _ _ (Scheme.Modules.pullback f') _ _ _ π hπ
  have h2 : Epi e.inv := @IsIso.epi_of_iso _ _ _ _ _ (Iso.isIso_inv e)
  have h3 : Epi (Scheme.Modules.pullbackObjFreeIso f' J).inv :=
    @IsIso.epi_of_iso _ _ _ _ _ (Iso.isIso_inv _)
  have h4 := @epi_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ h1 _ h2
  exact ⟨f ⁻¹ᵁ U, J, hJ, _, hx, @epi_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ h3 _ h4⟩

name: QcAffineLocalAux.ideal_eq_top
statement:
theorem ideal_eq_top {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (I : Ideal Γ(X, U))
    (h : ∀ p : X, p ∈ U → ∃ (f : Γ(X, U)) (n : ℕ), p ∈ X.basicOpen f ∧ f ^ n ∈ I) : I = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hI
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hIm⟩ := Ideal.exists_le_maximal I hI
  let 𝔭 : Spec Γ(X, U) := ⟨m, hm.isPrime⟩
  have hp : hU.fromSpec 𝔭 ∈ U := by
    have : hU.fromSpec 𝔭 ∈ Set.range hU.fromSpec := ⟨𝔭, rfl⟩
    rw [hU.range_fromSpec] at this
    exact this
  obtain ⟨f, n, hpf, hfn⟩ := h _ hp
  have h1 : 𝔭 ∈ hU.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen f := hpf
  rw [hU.fromSpec_preimage_basicOpen] at h1
  exact h1 (hm.isPrime.mem_of_pow_mem n (hIm hfn))

name: QcAffineLocalAux.range_of_exact
statement:
theorem range_of_exact (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) [S.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₂.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hS : S.Exact) {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (x : Γ(S.X₂, U)) (hx : S.g.app U x = 0) :
    ∃ z : Γ(S.X₁, U), S.f.app U z = x
proof:
:= by
  let I : Ideal Γ(X, U) :=
    { carrier := {a | ∃ z : Γ(S.X₁, U), S.f.app U z = a • x}
      add_mem' := by
        rintro a b ⟨z, hz⟩ ⟨w, hw⟩
        exact ⟨z + w, by rw [map_add, hz, hw, add_smul]⟩
      zero_mem' := ⟨0, by rw [map_zero, zero_smul]⟩
      smul_mem' := by
        rintro c a ⟨z, hz⟩
        exact ⟨c • z, by rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, hz, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul]⟩ }
  have hI : I = ⊤ := by
    refine ideal_eq_top hU I fun p hp => ?_
    obtain ⟨V, hVU, hpV, y, hy⟩ :=
      (Scheme.Modules.exact_iff_locally_lift_sections S).mp hS U x hx p hp
    obtain ⟨h, hhV, hph⟩ := hU.exists_basicOpen_le ⟨p, hpV⟩ hp
    let y' := S.X₁.presheaf.map (homOfLE hhV).op y
    obtain ⟨n, t, ht⟩ := S.X₁.exists_pow_smul_eq_map_basicOpen hU h y'
    have hnat : ∀ {A B : X.Opens} (i : A ⟶ B) (w : Γ(S.X₁, B)),
        S.f.app A (S.X₁.presheaf.map i.op w) = S.X₂.presheaf.map i.op (S.f.app B w) :=
      fun i w => congr($(S.f.mapPresheaf.naturality i.op) w)
    have hy' : S.f.app (X.basicOpen h) y' =
        S.X₂.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le h)).op x := by
      rw [hnat, hy, ← S.X₂.presheaf.map_comp_apply]
      rfl
    have hzero : S.X₂.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le h)).op (S.f.app U t - h ^ n • x) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, ← hnat, ht, Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, hy', Scheme.Modules.map_smul, map_pow,
        sub_self]
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := S.X₂.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_map_basicOpen_eq_zero hU h _ hzero
    refine ⟨h, k + n, hph, h ^ k • t, ?_⟩
    rw [smul_sub, sub_eq_zero] at hk
    rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul, hk, pow_add, mul_smul]
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ : (1 : Γ(X, U)) ∈ I := by rw [hI]; trivial
  exact ⟨z, by rw [hz, one_smul]⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.gammaAffine_exact_iff
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.gammaAffine_exact_iff {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    (S : CategoryTheory.ShortComplex X.Modules) [S.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₂.IsQuasicoherent]
    [S.X₃.IsQuasicoherent] :
    S.Exact ↔ ∀ U : X.affineOpens,
      Function.Exact (S.f.app U.1).hom (S.g.app U.1).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : ∀ (V : X.Opens) (z : Γ(S.X₁, V)), S.g.app V (S.f.app V z) = 0 := fun V z => by
    rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, S.zero]
    rfl
  constructor
  · intro hS U x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := QcAffineLocalAux.range_of_exact S hS U.2 x hx
      exact ⟨z, hz⟩
    · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
      exact hzero U.1 z
  · intro h
    rw [Scheme.Modules.exact_iff_locally_lift_sections]
    intro U x hx p hp
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩, hpV, hVU⟩ :=
      X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open hp U.isOpen
    have hVU' : V ≤ U := hVU
    have hx' : S.g.app V (S.X₂.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU').op x) = 0 := by
      have := congr($(S.g.mapPresheaf.naturality (homOfLE hVU').op) x)
      refine Eq.trans this ?_
      change S.X₃.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU').op (S.g.app U x) = 0
      rw [hx, map_zero]
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ((h ⟨V, hV⟩) _).mp hx'
    exact ⟨V, hVU', hpV, y, hy⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isIso_of_affine
proof:
:= by
  have hb : Opens.IsBasis (Set.range (fun U : X.affineOpens => (U.1 : X.Opens))) := by
    rw [Subtype.range_coe]
    exact X.isBasis_affineOpens
  have h1 : IsIso ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map φ) :=
    TopCat.Sheaf.isIso_iff_isIso_basis hb (fun U =>
      (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).mpr (h U))
  exact isIso_of_reflects_iso (C := SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf) φ
    (SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf)

name: sheafification_tensor_map_epi
statement:
private theorem sheafification_tensor_map_epi {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    {A B P : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) [Epi f] :
    Epi ((PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).map
      (((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
        PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).map f) ▷
        ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
          PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).obj P)))
proof:
:= by
  let J := Opens.grothendieckTopology X
  let f₀ := (SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
    PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).map f
  let p₀ := (SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
    PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).obj P
  have hf : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective J
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
        (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map f₀) := by
    change Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective J
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
        (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map
        ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
          PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).map f))
    exact (ModulesLocLiftAux.locSurj_iff f).mp (ModulesLocLiftAux.locSurj_of_epi f)
  letI : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
        (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map
        ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
          PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).map f)) := by
    exact hf
  have htp := PresheafOfModules.isLocallySurjective_whiskerRight
    (R := X.presheaf) (M := (SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
      PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).obj A)
    (N := (SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
      PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).obj B)
    J ((SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
      PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).map f) p₀
  have htp' : Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective J
      ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
        (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map (f₀ ▷ p₀)) := htp
  let sf := PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)
  let g := sf.map (f₀ ▷ p₀)
  have hg : Epi g := by
    have hloc : Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective
        ((CategoryTheory.presheafToSheaf J AddCommGrpCat).map
          ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
            (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map (f₀ ▷ p₀))) :=
      (Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_presheafToSheaf_map_iff J
        ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
          (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map (f₀ ▷ p₀))).2 htp'
    have hloc' : TopCat.Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map g).hom := by
      change Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective
        ((CategoryTheory.presheafToSheaf J AddCommGrpCat).map
        ((PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf
          (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).map (f₀ ▷ p₀)))
      exact hloc
    have he : Epi ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).map g) :=
      (TopCat.Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi _).mp hloc'
    exact (SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).epi_of_epi_map he
  exact hg

name: epi_whiskerRight
statement:
private theorem epi_whiskerRight {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    {A B P : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ B) [Epi f] : Epi (f ▷ P)
proof:
:= by
  letI := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.monoidalCategory X
  let F := (SheafOfModules.forget X.ringCatSheaf ⋙
    PresheafOfModules.restrictScalars (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj))
  let f₀ := F.map f
  let p₀ := F.obj P
  let sf := PresheafOfModules.sheafification (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)
  let g := sf.map (f₀ ▷ p₀)
  have hg : Epi g := by
    change Epi (sf.map (f₀ ▷ p₀))
    exact sheafification_tensor_map_epi f
  let sA := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.sheafifyTensorTo A P
  let sB := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.sheafifyTensorTo B P
  have hsA : Epi sA := by
    letI : IsIso sA := by
      dsimp [sA]
      exact Iso.isIso_hom (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorIsoTensorObj A P)
    exact IsIso.epi_of_iso sA
  have hsB : Epi sB := by
    letI : IsIso sB := by
      dsimp [sB]
      exact Iso.isIso_hom (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorIsoTensorObj B P)
    exact IsIso.epi_of_iso sB
  have hn := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.sheafifyTensorTo_naturality
    (X := X) f (𝟙 P)
  change sA ≫
      (CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorHom (C := X.Modules) f (𝟙 P)) =
    sf.map (CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorHom (C :=
      PresheafOfModules (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
      (F.map f) (F.map (𝟙 P))) ≫ sB at hn
  have hmap : F.map (𝟙 P) = 𝟙 p₀ := F.map_id P
  rw [hmap, MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_id] at hn
  have hfg : sA ≫ (f ▷ P) = g ≫ sB := by
    dsimp [sA, sB, g, f₀, p₀, F]
    exact hn
  letI : Epi g := hg
  letI : Epi sB := hsB
  have hcomp : Epi (sA ≫ (f ▷ P)) := by
    rw [hfg]
    exact epi_comp _ _
  letI : Epi sA := hsA
  exact (epi_comp_iff_of_epi sA _).mp hcomp

name: epi_whiskerLeft
statement:
private theorem epi_whiskerLeft {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    {A P Q : X.Modules} (g : P ⟶ Q) [Epi g] : Epi (A ◁ g)
proof:
:= by
  letI := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.monoidalCategory X
  let e₁ := β_ A P
  let e₂ := β_ A Q
  haveI : IsIso e₁.hom := Iso.isIso_hom e₁
  haveI : IsIso e₂.inv := Iso.isIso_inv e₂
  have hright : Epi (g ▷ A) := epi_whiskerRight g
  haveI : Epi (g ▷ A) := hright
  have hcomp : Epi (e₁.hom ≫ (g ▷ A) ≫ e₂.inv) := by
    exact epi_comp (e₁.hom ≫ (g ▷ A)) e₂.inv
  have hnat : (A ◁ g) ≫ e₂.hom = e₁.hom ≫ (g ▷ A) :=
    BraidedCategory.braiding_naturality_right A g
  haveI : Epi (e₁.hom ≫ (g ▷ A) ≫ e₂.inv) := hcomp
  have heq : A ◁ g = e₁.hom ≫ (g ▷ A) ≫ e₂.inv := by
    apply (cancel_mono e₂.hom).1
    calc
      (A ◁ g) ≫ e₂.hom = e₁.hom ≫ (g ▷ A) := hnat
      _ = (e₁.hom ≫ (g ▷ A) ≫ e₂.inv) ≫ e₂.hom := by simp
  rw [heq]
  infer_instance

name: epi_tensorHom
statement:
private theorem epi_tensorHom {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    {A A' B B' : X.Modules} (f : A ⟶ A') (g : B ⟶ B')
    (hf : Epi f) (hg : Epi g) :
    Epi (CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorHom (C := X.Modules) f g)
proof:
:= by
  letI := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.monoidalCategory X
  letI : Epi f := hf
  letI : Epi g := hg
  rw [MonoidalCategory.tensorHom_def]
  haveI : Epi (f ▷ B) := epi_whiskerRight f
  haveI : Epi (A' ◁ g) := epi_whiskerLeft g
  exact epi_comp _ _

name: finiteType_tensorObj
proof:
:= by
  refine AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isFiniteType_of_epi_free_pullback _ (fun x => ?_)
  obtain ⟨UF, J, hJ, πF, hxF, hπF⟩ :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_epi_free_pullback_of_isFiniteType F x
  obtain ⟨UG, K, hK, πG, hxG, hπG⟩ :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_epi_free_pullback_of_isFiniteType G x
  have hxV : x ∈ (UF ⊓ UG : X.Opens) := ⟨hxF, hxG⟩
  letI := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.monoidalCategory (UF ⊓ UG).toScheme
  obtain ⟨πF', hπF'⟩ :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.epi_free_pullback_of_le F inf_le_left J πF hπF
  obtain ⟨πG', hπG'⟩ :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.epi_free_pullback_of_le G inf_le_right K πG hπG
  letI : Epi πF' := hπF'
  letI : Epi πG' := hπG'
  let t := CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorHom (C := (UF ⊓ UG).toScheme.Modules)
    πF' πG'
  have ht : Epi t := by
    dsimp [t]
    exact epi_tensorHom (X := (UF ⊓ UG).toScheme) πF' πG' hπF' hπG'
  let e := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.freeTensorFreeIso
    (X := (UF ⊓ UG).toScheme) J K
  have he : Epi e.inv := by
    letI : IsIso e.inv := Iso.isIso_inv e
    exact IsIso.epi_of_iso e.inv
  letI : Epi e.inv := he
  letI : Epi t := ht
  let q := e.inv ≫ t ≫
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullbackTensorObjIsoOpen (UF ⊓ UG).ι F G).inv
  have hq : Epi q := by
    dsimp [q]
    exact epi_comp _ _
  exact ⟨UF ⊓ UG, J × K, inferInstance, q, hxV, hq⟩

name: finiteType_of_iso
statement:
private theorem finiteType_of_iso {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    {M N : X.Modules} (e : M ≅ N) [M.IsFiniteType] : N.IsFiniteType
proof:
:= by
  refine AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isFiniteType_of_epi_free_pullback N (fun x => ?_)
  obtain ⟨U, J, hJ, π, hx, hπ⟩ :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_epi_free_pullback_of_isFiniteType M x
  let e' := (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback U.ι).mapIso e
  let π' := π ≫ e'.hom
  have he : Epi e'.hom := by
    letI : IsIso e'.hom := Iso.isIso_hom e'
    exact IsIso.epi_of_iso e'.hom
  letI : Epi e'.hom := he
  have hp : Epi π' := by
    dsimp [π']
    exact @epi_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ hπ _ he
  exact ⟨U, J, hJ, π', hx, hp⟩

name: finiteType_tensor
proof:
:= by
  letI := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.monoidalCategory X
  letI : (CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorObj (C := X.Modules) F G).IsFiniteType :=
    finiteType_tensorObj F G
  exact finiteType_of_iso (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorIsoTensorObj F G).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.QcApprox.LocallySpan.map
statement:
theorem LocallySpan.map {W : S.Opens} {ι : Type v} {e : ι → Γ(F, W)} {U' V' : S.Opens} (h : V' ≤ U')
    {t : Γ(F, U')} (ht : LocallySpan F e U' t) :
    LocallySpan F e V' (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op t)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨U₀, h₀, hx₀, ht₀⟩ := ht x ⟨h hx.1, hx.2⟩
  refine ⟨U₀ ⊓ V', le_inf inf_le_right (inf_le_left.trans (h₀.trans inf_le_right)), ⟨hx₀, hx.1⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [map_map]
  have := map_mem_span_range_map F (inf_le_left : U₀ ⊓ V' ≤ U₀) _ ht₀
  simp only [map_map] at this
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.QcApprox.LocallySpan.zero
statement:
theorem LocallySpan.zero {W : S.Opens} {ι : Type v} (e : ι → Γ(F, W)) (U' : S.Opens) :
    LocallySpan F e U' 0
proof:
:= fun x hx =>
  ⟨U' ⊓ W, le_rfl, hx, by rw [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.QcApprox.LocallySpan.add
statement:
theorem LocallySpan.add {W : S.Opens} {ι : Type v} {e : ι → Γ(F, W)} {U' : S.Opens} {s t : Γ(F, U')}
    (hs : LocallySpan F e U' s) (ht : LocallySpan F e U' t) : LocallySpan F e U' (s + t)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨U₁, h₁, hx₁, hs₁⟩ := hs x hx
  obtain ⟨U₂, h₂, hx₂, ht₂⟩ := ht x hx
  refine ⟨U₁ ⊓ U₂, inf_le_left.trans h₁, ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [map_add]
  refine Submodule.add_mem _ ?_ ?_
  · have := map_mem_span_range_map F (inf_le_left : U₁ ⊓ U₂ ≤ U₁) _ hs₁
    simp only [map_map] at this
    exact this
  · have := map_mem_span_range_map F (inf_le_right : U₁ ⊓ U₂ ≤ U₂) _ ht₂
    simp only [map_map] at this
    exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.QcApprox.LocallySpan.smul
statement:
theorem LocallySpan.smul {W : S.Opens} {ι : Type v} {e : ι → Γ(F, W)} {U' : S.Opens} (r : Γ(S, U'))
    {t : Γ(F, U')} (ht : LocallySpan F e U' t) : LocallySpan F e U' (r • t)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨U₀, h₀, hx₀, ht₀⟩ := ht x hx
  refine ⟨U₀, h₀, hx₀, ?_⟩
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.map_smul]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ht₀

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.QcApprox.mem_spanSub_iff
statement:
theorem mem_spanSub_iff (W : S.Opens) {ι : Type v} (e : ι → Γ(F, W)) (U' : S.Opens) (t : Γ(F, U')) :
    t ∈ objΓ (spanSub F W e) U' ↔ LocallySpan F e U' t
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.QcApprox.mem_spanSub_iff_mem_span
statement:
theorem mem_spanSub_iff_mem_span {W : S.Opens} {ι : Type v} [Fintype ι] (e : ι → Γ(F, W))
    {U'' : S.Opens} (hU'' : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen U'') (hle : U'' ≤ W) (t : Γ(F, U'')) :
    t ∈ objΓ (spanSub F W e) U'' ↔ t ∈ spanRes F e hle
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_spanSub_iff]
  constructor
  · intro ht
    apply mem_span_of_locally F hU'' (fun i => F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op (e i)) t
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨U₀, h₀, hx₀, ht₀⟩ := ht x ⟨hx, hle hx⟩
    refine ⟨U₀, h₀.trans inf_le_left, hx₀, ?_⟩
    simp only [map_map]
    exact ht₀
  · intro ht x hx
    refine ⟨U'', le_inf le_rfl hle, hx.1, ?_⟩
    rw [map_self]
    exact ht

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.QcApprox.spanSub_obj_eq_span
statement:
theorem spanSub_obj_eq_span {W : S.Opens} {ι : Type v} [Fintype ι] (e : ι → Γ(F, W))
    {U'' : S.Opens} (hU'' : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen U'') (hle : U'' ≤ W) :
    objΓ (spanSub F W e) U'' = spanRes F e hle
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  exact mem_spanSub_iff_mem_span F e hU'' hle t

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.QcApprox.goodOn_spanSub
statement:
theorem goodOn_spanSub {W : S.Opens} (hW : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen W) {ι : Type v} [Fintype ι]
    (e : ι → Γ(F, W)) : GoodOn F (spanSub F W e) W where
  mem_of_locally U' _ t ht
proof:
:= by
    rw [mem_spanSub_iff]
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨U₀, h₀, hx₀, ht₀⟩ := ht x hx.1
    rw [mem_spanSub_iff] at ht₀
    obtain ⟨U₁, h₁, hx₁, ht₁⟩ := ht₀ x ⟨hx₀, hx.2⟩
    refine ⟨U₁, h₁.trans (inf_le_inf_right W h₀), hx₁, ?_⟩
    rw [map_map] at ht₁
    exact ht₁
  exists_pow_smul_eq_map U'' hle haff h s hs := by
    classical
    rw [mem_spanSub_iff_mem_span F e (haff.basicOpen h) ((S.basicOpen_le h).trans hle)] at hs
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun _).mp hs
    have hloc : IsLocalization.Away h Γ(S, S.basicOpen h) := haff.isLocalization_basicOpen h
    have hcoef : ∀ i, ∃ (b : Γ(S, U'')) (n : ℕ),
        c i * (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (S.basicOpen_le h)).op h) ^ n =
          S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (S.basicOpen_le h)).op b := by
      intro i
      obtain ⟨⟨b, ⟨_, n, rfl⟩⟩, hb⟩ := IsLocalization.surj (Submonoid.powers h) (c i)
      refine ⟨b, n, ?_⟩
      have e1 : algebraMap Γ(S, U'') Γ(S, S.basicOpen h) =
          (S.presheaf.map (homOfLE (S.basicOpen_le h)).op).hom := rfl
      rw [e1, map_pow] at hb
      exact hb
    choose b n hbn using hcoef
    set N := Finset.univ.sup n with hN
    refine ⟨N, ∑ i, (h ^ (N - n i) * b i) • F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op (e i), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [mem_spanSub_iff_mem_span F e haff hle]
      exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    · rw [← hc, Finset.smul_sum, map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.map_smul, map_mul, map_pow, map_map, smul_smul, ← hbn i]
      congr 1
      have hle' : n i ≤ N := Finset.le_sup (f := n) (Finset.mem_univ i)
      conv_rhs => rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel hle', pow_add]
      ring
  exists_pow_smul_mem U'' hle haff h t ht := by
    rw [mem_spanSub_iff_mem_span F e (haff.basicOpen h) ((S.basicOpen_le h).trans hle)] at ht
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_pow_smul_mem_span_of_map_mem_span F haff h
      (fun i => F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hle).op (e i)) t (by simpa only [map_map] using ht)
    refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
    rw [mem_spanSub_iff_mem_span F e haff hle]
    exact hN
  exists_affine_fg x hx := by
    classical
    refine ⟨W, hW, hx, le_rfl, Fintype.card ι, fun j => e ((Fintype.equivFin ι).symm j), ?_⟩
    rw [spanSub_obj_eq_span F e hW le_rfl]
    have hrange : (Set.range fun i => F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_rfl : W ≤ W)).op (e i)) =
        Set.range fun j => e ((Fintype.equivFin ι).symm j) := by
      ext t
      simp only [Set.mem_range, map_self]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨Fintype.equivFin ι i, by simp⟩
      · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
    show Submodule.span Γ(S, W) _ = _
    rw [hrange]

name: QcBasicOpenLocAux.spec_exists
statement:
theorem spec_exists (f : R) (s : Γ(N, D f)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (t : Γ(N, ⊤)), N.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : D f ≤ ⊤)).op t = f ^ n • s
proof:
:= by
  have h : IsLocalizedModule.Away f
      ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj N).obj.map (D f).leTop.op).hom :=
    (isIso_fromTildeΓ_iff_isLocalizing N).mp inferInstance f
  obtain ⟨n, y, hy⟩ := h.surj _ _ s
  exact ⟨n, y, hy.symm⟩

name: QcBasicOpenLocAux.spec_unique
statement:
theorem spec_unique (f : R) (t : Γ(N, ⊤))
    (ht : N.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : D f ≤ ⊤)).op t = 0) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, f ^ n • t = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : IsLocalizedModule.Away f
      ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj N).obj.map (D f).leTop.op).hom :=
    (isIso_fromTildeΓ_iff_isLocalizing N).mp inferInstance f
  obtain ⟨⟨_, n, rfl⟩, hn⟩ := (IsLocalizedModule.eq_zero_iff (.powers f)
    ((modulesSpecToSheaf.obj N).obj.map (D f).leTop.op).hom).mp ht
  exact ⟨n, hn⟩

name: QcBasicOpenLocAux.image_le
statement: theorem image_le (V : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Opens) : hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ V ≤ U
proof:
:= by
  have := Scheme.Hom.image_le_opensRange hU.fromSpec V
  rwa [hU.opensRange_fromSpec] at this

name: QcBasicOpenLocAux.ring_key
statement:
theorem ring_key (V : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Opens) :
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv ≫ (Spec Γ(X, U)).presheaf.map V.leTop.op ≫
      (hU.fromSpec.appIso V).inv = X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (image_le hU V)).op
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, U)).inv ≫ (Spec Γ(X, U)).presheaf.map V.leTop.op =
      hU.fromSpec.appLE U V (by rw [hU.fromSpec_preimage_self]; exact le_top) := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE, hU.fromSpec_app_self, Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
    rfl
  rw [← Category.assoc, h1, Scheme.Hom.appLE_appIso_inv]

name: QcBasicOpenLocAux.smul_key
statement:
theorem smul_key (V : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Opens) (r : Γ(X, U)) (x : Γ(M.restrict hU.fromSpec, V)) :
    r • x = (M.restrictAppIso hU.fromSpec V).inv
      ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (image_le hU V)).op r) • (M.restrictAppIso hU.fromSpec V).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Modules.smul_Spec_def, ← ring_key hU V]
  rfl

name: QcBasicOpenLocAux.image_top
statement: theorem image_top : hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ ⊤ = U
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Hom.image_top_eq_opensRange, hU.opensRange_fromSpec]

name: QcBasicOpenLocAux.exists_lift
statement:
theorem exists_lift [M.IsQuasicoherent] (h : Γ(X, U)) (s : Γ(M, X.basicOpen h)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (t : Γ(M, U)), M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le h)).op t =
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le h)).op h) ^ n • s
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ D h = X.basicOpen h := hU.fromSpec_image_basicOpen h
  obtain ⟨n, t', ht⟩ := spec_exists (M.restrict hU.fromSpec) h
    ((M.restrictAppIso hU.fromSpec _).inv (M.presheaf.map (eqToHom e1).op s))
  refine ⟨n, M.presheaf.map (eqToHom (image_top hU).symm).op ((M.restrictAppIso hU.fromSpec ⊤).hom t'), ?_⟩
  rw [smul_key] at ht
  replace ht := congr((M.restrictAppIso hU.fromSpec (D h)).hom $ht)
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_restrictAppIso_hom_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id_apply] at ht
  have hinj : Function.Injective (M.presheaf.map (eqToHom e1).op) :=
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _).injective
  apply hinj
  rw [Scheme.Modules.map_smul, ← map_pow, ← X.presheaf.map_comp_apply, ← M.presheaf.map_comp_apply,
    ← M.presheaf.map_comp_apply]
  exact ht

name: QcBasicOpenLocAux.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_pow_smul_eq_zero [M.IsQuasicoherent] (h : Γ(X, U)) (t : Γ(M, U))
    (ht : M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le h)).op t = 0) : ∃ n : ℕ, h ^ n • t = 0
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : hU.fromSpec ''ᵁ D h = X.basicOpen h := hU.fromSpec_image_basicOpen h
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := spec_unique (M.restrict hU.fromSpec) h
    ((M.restrictAppIso hU.fromSpec _).inv (M.presheaf.map (eqToHom (image_top hU)).op t)) (by
      apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (M.restrictAppIso hU.fromSpec (D h)).hom).injective
      rw [Scheme.Modules.map_restrictAppIso_hom_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id_apply, map_zero,
        ← M.presheaf.map_comp_apply]
      have := congr(M.presheaf.map (eqToHom e1).op $ht)
      rw [← M.presheaf.map_comp_apply, map_zero] at this
      exact this)
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  rw [smul_key] at hn
  replace hn := congr((M.restrictAppIso hU.fromSpec ⊤).hom $hn)
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id_apply, map_zero] at hn
  have hinj : Function.Injective (M.presheaf.map (eqToHom (image_top hU)).op) :=
    (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _).injective
  apply hinj
  rw [map_zero, Scheme.Modules.map_smul]
  exact hn

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_pow_smul_eq_map_basicOpen
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_pow_smul_eq_map_basicOpen
    {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] {U : X.Opens}
    (hU : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen U) (h : Γ(X, U)) (s : Γ(M, X.basicOpen h)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (t : Γ(M, U)), M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le h)).op t =
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le h)).op h) ^ n • s
proof:
:=
  QcBasicOpenLocAux.exists_lift hU M h s

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_map_basicOpen_eq_zero
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero_of_map_basicOpen_eq_zero
    {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] {U : X.Opens}
    (hU : AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineOpen U) (h : Γ(X, U)) (t : Γ(M, U))
    (ht : M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le h)).op t = 0) : ∃ n : ℕ, h ^ n • t = 0
proof:
:=
  QcBasicOpenLocAux.exists_pow_smul_eq_zero hU M h t ht

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isFiniteType_iff_finite_sections
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro _
    exact AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.finite_sections_of_isFiniteType M
      (AlgebraicGeometry.isAffineOpen_top X)
  · intro hM
    letI : Module.Finite Γ(X, ⊤) Γ(M, ⊤) := hM
    apply AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isFiniteType_of_finite_affine_sections M
    intro x
    exact ⟨⊤, AlgebraicGeometry.isAffineOpen_top X, trivial, hM⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isFiniteType_biproduct
statement:
theorem isFiniteType_biproduct {J : Type} [Finite J] (M : J → X.Modules)
    (hM : ∀ j, (M j).IsFiniteType) : (⨁ M).IsFiniteType
proof:
:= by
  have : Fintype J := Fintype.ofFinite J
  have : ∀ j, (M j).IsFiniteType := hM
  exact AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.biproduct_isFiniteType M

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffineTilde.isEquivalence_pullback_hom
statement:
theorem isEquivalence_pullback_hom {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (e : Y ≅ Z) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback e.hom).IsEquivalence
proof:
:=
  (pullbackEquivOfIso e).isEquivalence_functor

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffineTilde.isEquivalence_pushforward_hom
statement:
theorem isEquivalence_pushforward_hom {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (e : Y ≅ Z) :
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward e.hom).IsEquivalence
proof:
:=
  have : (Scheme.Modules.pullback e.inv).IsEquivalence := isEquivalence_pullback_hom e.symm
  Functor.isEquivalence_of_iso (pushforwardIsoPullbackInv e).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffineTilde.isQuasicoherent_pushforward_hom
statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_pushforward_hom {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (e : Y ≅ Z) (N : Y.Modules)
    [N.IsQuasicoherent] : ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward e.hom).obj N).IsQuasicoherent
proof:
:=
  (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent Z.ringCatSheaf).prop_of_iso
    ((pushforwardIsoPullbackInv e).app N).symm inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffineTilde.toTop_smul
statement:
theorem toTop_smul (N : X.Modules) (a : Γ(X, ⊤))
    (x : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward X.isoSpec.hom).obj N, ⊤)) :
    toTop N (a • x) = a • toTop N x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Scheme.Modules.smul_Spec_def]
  change ((X.isoSpec.hom.appTop ((Spec Γ(X, ⊤)).presheaf.map (Opens.leTop ⊤).op
    ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso Γ(X, ⊤)).inv a)) : Γ(X, ⊤)) • (toTop N x) : Γ(N, ⊤)) = a • toTop N x
  have h1 : (Opens.leTop (⊤ : (Spec Γ(X, ⊤)).Opens)).op = 𝟙 _ := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [h1, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Scheme.isoSpec_hom, Scheme.toSpecΓ_appTop]
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffineTilde.toTop_smul'
statement:
theorem toTop_smul' (N : X.Modules) (a : Γ(X, ⊤)) (x : ΓS N) :
    toTop N (a • x) = a • toTop N x
proof:
:=
  toTop_smul N a x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffineTilde.homEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem homEquiv_apply (P : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤)) (N : X.Modules) (α : T P ⟶ N) (p : P) :
    toTop N ((adj.homEquiv P N α).hom p) = α.app ⊤ (unitEl P p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffineTilde.T_hom_ext
statement:
theorem T_hom_ext {P : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤)} {N : X.Modules} {α β : T P ⟶ N}
    (h : ∀ p, α.app ⊤ (unitEl P p) = β.app ⊤ (unitEl P p)) : α = β
proof:
:= by
  apply (adj.homEquiv P N).injective
  ext p
  exact (homEquiv_apply P N α p).trans ((h p).trans (homEquiv_apply P N β p).symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffineTilde.isIso_unit_app
statement: theorem isIso_unit_app (P : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤)) : IsIso (adj.unit.app P)
proof:
:=
  have := isEquivalence_pullback_hom X.isoSpec
  inferInstance

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffineTilde.unitEl_bijective
statement: theorem unitEl_bijective (P : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤)) : Function.Bijective (unitEl P)
proof:
:=
  have := isIso_unit_app P
  ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (adj.unit.app P)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffineTilde.unitEl_smul
statement:
theorem unitEl_smul (P : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤)) (a : Γ(X, ⊤)) (p : P) :
    unitEl P (a • p) = a • unitEl P p
proof:
:= by
  unfold unitEl
  rw [LinearMap.map_smul]
  exact toTop_smul' (T P) a _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffineTilde.unitEl_add
statement:
theorem unitEl_add (P : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤)) (p q : P) :
    unitEl P (p + q) = unitEl P p + unitEl P q
proof:
:= by
  unfold unitEl
  rw [LinearMap.map_add]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffineTilde.unitEl_zero
statement: theorem unitEl_zero (P : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤)) : unitEl P 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold unitEl
  rw [LinearMap.map_zero]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffineTilde.isIso_counit_app
statement: theorem isIso_counit_app (N : X.Modules) [N.IsQuasicoherent] : IsIso (adj.counit.app N)
proof:
:= by
  unfold adj
  rw [Adjunction.comp_counit_app]
  have := isEquivalence_pushforward_hom X.isoSpec
  have := isQuasicoherent_pushforward_hom X.isoSpec N
  have h1 : IsIso (tilde.adjunction.counit.app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward X.isoSpec.hom).obj N)) :=
    @Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent _
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward X.isoSpec.hom).obj N) inferInstance
  have h2 : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback X.isoSpec.hom).map
      (tilde.adjunction.counit.app ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward X.isoSpec.hom).obj N))) :=
    inferInstance
  have h3 : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction X.isoSpec.hom).counit.app N) :=
    inferInstance
  exact IsIso.comp_isIso

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffineTilde.counit_app_top_unitEl
statement:
theorem counit_app_top_unitEl (N : X.Modules) (x : ΓS N) :
    (adj.counit.app N).app ⊤ (unitEl (ΓS N) x) = toTop N x
proof:
:= by
  have h := adj.right_triangle_components N
  have h2 := congrArg (fun f => toTop N ((ModuleCat.Hom.hom f) x)) h
  simp only [Functor.comp_map, Functor.comp_obj, ModuleCat.hom_comp,
    LinearMap.comp_apply, ModuleCat.hom_id, LinearMap.id_apply] at h2
  exact h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffineTilde.hom_ext_of_app_top
statement:
theorem hom_ext_of_app_top {N G : X.Modules} [N.IsQuasicoherent] {β₁ β₂ : N ⟶ G}
    (h : ∀ x : Γ(N, ⊤), β₁.app ⊤ x = β₂.app ⊤ x) : β₁ = β₂
proof:
:= by
  have : IsIso (adj.counit.app N) := isIso_counit_app N
  rw [← cancel_epi (adj.counit.app N)]
  apply T_hom_ext
  intro p
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app, Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app]
  change β₁.app ⊤ ((adj.counit.app N).app ⊤ (unitEl (ΓS N) p)) =
    β₂.app ⊤ ((adj.counit.app N).app ⊤ (unitEl (ΓS N) p))
  rw [counit_app_top_unitEl]
  exact h _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffineTilde.inv_counit_app_top
statement:
theorem inv_counit_app_top (N : X.Modules) [N.IsQuasicoherent] (x : ΓS N) :
    haveI
proof:
:= isIso_counit_app N
    (inv (adj.counit.app N)).app ⊤ (toTop N x) = unitEl (ΓS N) x := by
  have := isIso_counit_app N
  rw [← counit_app_top_unitEl N x, Scheme.Modules.inv_app]
  exact IsIso.hom_inv_id_apply ((adj.counit.app N).app ⊤) (unitEl (ΓS N) x)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffineTilde.exists_hom_of_linear'
statement:
theorem exists_hom_of_linear' {N G : X.Modules} [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    (l : Γ(N, ⊤) →ₗ[Γ(X, ⊤)] Γ(G, ⊤)) :
    ∃ β : N ⟶ G, ∀ x : ΓS N, β.app ⊤ (toTop N x) = l (toTop N x)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsIso (adj.counit.app N) := isIso_counit_app N
  let l' : ΓS N ⟶ ΓS G :=
    ModuleCat.ofHom (R := Γ(X, ⊤)) (X := ΓS N) (Y := ΓS G)
      ((secTop G).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ l ∘ₗ (secTop N).toLinearMap)
  refine ⟨inv (adj.counit.app N) ≫ (adj.homEquiv (ΓS N) G).symm l', fun x => ?_⟩
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app]
  change ((adj.homEquiv (ΓS N) G).symm l').app ⊤ ((inv (adj.counit.app N)).app ⊤ (toTop N x)) =
    l (toTop N x)
  rw [inv_counit_app_top, ← homEquiv_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.AffineTilde.exists_hom_of_linear
statement:
theorem exists_hom_of_linear {N G : X.Modules} [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    (l : Γ(N, ⊤) →ₗ[Γ(X, ⊤)] Γ(G, ⊤)) :
    ∃ β : N ⟶ G, ∀ x : Γ(N, ⊤), β.app ⊤ x = l x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := exists_hom_of_linear' l
  exact ⟨β, fun x => hβ x⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.QcApprox.mem_glue_iff
statement:
theorem mem_glue_iff (G G'' : F.val.Submodule) (U W U' : S.Opens) (t : Γ(F, U')) :
    t ∈ objΓ (glue F G G'' U W) U' ↔
      F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U' ⊓ U ≤ U')).op t ∈ objΓ G (U' ⊓ U) ∧
      F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U' ⊓ W ≤ U')).op t ∈ objΓ G'' (U' ⊓ W)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.QcApprox.glue_obj_eq_left
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  rw [mem_glue_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, -⟩
    exact (mem_iff_map_mem_of_le_of_le G inf_le_left (le_inf le_rfl hU') t).mpr h1
  · intro ht
    refine ⟨mem_map_of_mem G _ ht, ?_⟩
    rw [← hagree (U' ⊓ W) (inf_le_inf_right W hU')]
    exact mem_map_of_mem G _ ht

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.QcApprox.glue_obj_eq_right
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  rw [mem_glue_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, h2⟩
    exact (mem_iff_map_mem_of_le_of_le G'' inf_le_left (le_inf le_rfl hU') t).mpr h2
  · intro ht
    refine ⟨?_, mem_map_of_mem G'' _ ht⟩
    rw [hagree (U' ⊓ U) (le_inf inf_le_right (inf_le_left.trans hU'))]
    exact mem_map_of_mem G'' _ ht

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.QcApprox.map_inf_of_map
statement:
private theorem map_inf_of_map {U'' U : S.Opens} (h : Γ(S, U'')) (t : Γ(F, U'')) :
