name: TopCat.Sheaf.toSheafify_extendByZeroToPushforward_hom
statement:
theorem toSheafify_extendByZeroToPushforward_hom :
    toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (extendByZeroPresheaf U G) ≫
      (extendByZeroToPushforward U G).hom = extendByZeroPresheafι U G
proof:
:= by
  have h : (extendByZeroToPushforward U G).hom =
      sheafifyMap (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (extendByZeroPresheafι U G) ≫
        ((sheafificationAdjunction (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).counit.app
          ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} (Opens.inclusion' U)).obj G)).hom := rfl
  erw [h, sheafificationAdjunction_counit_app_val, ← toSheafify_naturality_assoc, toSheafify_sheafifyLift,
    Category.comp_id]

name: TopCat.Sheaf.extendByZeroDesc_comp_restrictUnit
statement:
theorem extendByZeroDesc_comp_restrictUnit (α : G ⟶ TopCat.Sheaf.restrict F U) :
    extendByZeroDesc U α ≫ restrictUnit U F =
      extendByZeroToPushforward U G ≫
        (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} (Opens.inclusion' U)).map α
proof:
:= by
  apply CategoryTheory.Sheaf.hom_ext
  refine sheafify_hom_ext (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (P := extendByZeroPresheaf U G) _ _
    ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} (Opens.inclusion' U)).obj
      (TopCat.Sheaf.restrict F U)).property ?_
  have h1 : toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (extendByZeroPresheaf U G) ≫
      (extendByZeroDesc U α ≫ restrictUnit U F).hom =
      extendByZeroDescPresheaf U α ≫ (restrictUnit U F).hom := by
    have e : (extendByZeroDesc U α ≫ restrictUnit U F).hom =
        (extendByZeroDesc U α).hom ≫ (restrictUnit U F).hom := rfl
    erw [e, ← Category.assoc, toSheafify_extendByZeroDesc_val]
  have h2 : toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (extendByZeroPresheaf U G) ≫
      (extendByZeroToPushforward U G ≫
        (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} (Opens.inclusion' U)).map α).hom =
      extendByZeroPresheafι U G ≫
        ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} (Opens.inclusion' U)).map α).hom := by
    have e : (extendByZeroToPushforward U G ≫
        (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} (Opens.inclusion' U)).map α).hom =
        (extendByZeroToPushforward U G).hom ≫
          ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} (Opens.inclusion' U)).map α).hom := rfl
    erw [e, ← Category.assoc, toSheafify_extendByZeroToPushforward_hom]
  erw [h1, h2]
  ext V x
  change ((restrictUnit U F).hom.app V).hom ((extendByZeroDescApp U α V).hom x) =
    (α.hom.app (op ((Opens.map (Opens.inclusion' U)).obj V.unop))).hom
      ((extendByZeroSubgroup U G V).subtype x)
  by_cases hV : V.unop ≤ U
  · rw [extendByZeroDescApp_of_le U α V hV]
    refine Eq.trans (map_comp_hom_apply F.obj _ _ _) ?_
    have hid : (homOfLE (le_functor_map_of_le U V.unop hV)).op ≫ (homOfLE (functor_map_le U V.unop)).op =
        𝟙 _ :=
      Quiver.Hom.unop_inj (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    refine Eq.trans (congrArg (fun m => (F.obj.map m).hom _) hid) ?_
    have hid2 := F.obj.map_id (op ((Opens.isOpenEmbedding U).functor.obj
      ((Opens.map (Opens.inclusion' U)).obj V.unop)))
    exact congrArg (fun m => m.hom ((α.hom.app (op ((Opens.map (Opens.inclusion' U)).obj V.unop))).hom
      ((extendByZeroSubgroup U G V).subtype x))) hid2
  · have hx : x = 0 := extendByZeroPresheaf_eq_zero_of_not_le U V hV x
    subst hx
    rw [extendByZeroDescApp_of_not_le U α V hV]
    exact (map_zero _).trans ((congrArg (α.hom.app _).hom (map_zero _)).trans (map_zero _)).symm

name: TopCat.Sheaf.extendByZeroDesc_mono_of_isIso
statement:
theorem extendByZeroDesc_mono_of_isIso (α : G ⟶ TopCat.Sheaf.restrict F U) [IsIso α] :
    Mono (extendByZeroDesc U α)
proof:
:= by
  have h := extendByZeroDesc_comp_restrictUnit U α
  have hm : Mono (extendByZeroToPushforward U G ≫
      (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} (Opens.inclusion' U)).map α) := by
    have hm1 := extendByZeroToPushforward_mono U G
    have hi : IsIso ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} (Opens.inclusion' U)).map α) :=
      ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} (Opens.inclusion' U)).mapIso
        (asIso α : G ≅ TopCat.Sheaf.restrict F U)).isIso_hom
    have hm2 : Mono ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} (Opens.inclusion' U)).map α) :=
      IsIso.mono_of_iso _
    exact @mono_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ hm1 _ hm2
  exact mono_of_mono_fac h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.quotient_range_addEquiv_appTop
statement:
theorem quotient_range_addEquiv_appTop (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) :
    Nonempty ((Γ(S.X₃, ⊤) ⧸ LinearMap.range (Hom.appTopLinear S.g)) ≃+
      (Γ(S.X₃, ⊤) ⧸ AddMonoidHom.range (S.g.app ⊤).hom))
proof:
:= by
  let p := LinearMap.range (Hom.appTopLinear S.g)
  let q : Γ(S.X₃, ⊤) →+ Γ(S.X₃, ⊤) ⧸ p := p.mkQ.toAddMonoidHom
  have hker : q.ker = AddMonoidHom.range (S.g.app ⊤).hom := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := LinearMap.mem_range.1 ((Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero p).1 hx)
      exact AddMonoidHom.mem_range.2 ⟨y, hy⟩
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := AddMonoidHom.mem_range.1 hx
      exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero p).2 (LinearMap.mem_range.2 ⟨y, hy⟩)
  exact ⟨((QuotientAddGroup.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective q (Submodule.mkQ_surjective p)).symm).trans
    (QuotientAddGroup.quotientAddEquivOfEq hker)⟩

name: TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_bijective_of_app_bijective_of_le
statement:
theorem stalkFunctor_map_bijective_of_app_bijective_of_le
    {P Q : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X} (φ : P ⟶ Q) (U : Opens X) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U)
    (h : ∀ V : Opens X, V ≤ U → Function.Bijective (φ.app (op V))) :
    Function.Bijective ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map φ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · 
    refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mpr ?_
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨V, hxV, s, rfl⟩ := P.exists_germ_eq t
    have hxV' : x ∈ V ⊓ U := ⟨hxV, hx⟩
    set s' : P.obj (op (V ⊓ U)) := P.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V ⊓ U ≤ V)).op s with hs'
    have hgerm : P.germ V x hxV s = P.germ (V ⊓ U) x hxV' s' := by
      rw [hs', P.germ_res_apply]
    rw [hgerm] at ht ⊢
    rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply] at ht
    have ht' : Q.germ (V ⊓ U) x hxV' (φ.app (op (V ⊓ U)) s') =
        Q.germ (V ⊓ U) x hxV' 0 := by
      rw [ht, map_zero]
      rfl
    obtain ⟨W, hxW, iW₁, iW₂, heq⟩ := Q.germ_eq x hxV' hxV' _ _ ht'
    rw [map_zero] at heq
    have hnat : φ.app (op W) (P.map iW₁.op s') = Q.map iW₁.op (φ.app (op (V ⊓ U)) s') := by
      have := congrArg (fun g => g (s')) (φ.naturality iW₁.op)
      simp only [ConcreteCategory.comp_apply] at this
      exact this
    have hW : W ≤ U := le_trans (leOfHom iW₁) inf_le_right
    have hzero : P.map iW₁.op s' = 0 := by
      apply (h W hW).1
      rw [hnat, heq, map_zero]
    rw [← P.germ_res_apply iW₁ x hxW s', hzero, map_zero]
    rfl
  · 
    intro t
    obtain ⟨V, hxV, s, rfl⟩ := Q.exists_germ_eq t
    have hxV' : x ∈ V ⊓ U := ⟨hxV, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := (h (V ⊓ U) inf_le_right).2 (Q.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V ⊓ U ≤ V)).op s)
    refine ⟨P.germ (V ⊓ U) x hxV' p, ?_⟩
    rw [TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply, hp, Q.germ_res_apply]

name: TopCat.Presheaf.isZero_stalk_of_subsingleton_of_le
statement:
theorem isZero_stalk_of_subsingleton_of_le (P : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X)
    (W : Opens X) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ W)
    (h : ∀ V : Opens X, x ∈ V → V ≤ W → Subsingleton (P.obj (op V))) :
    IsZero (P.stalk x)
proof:
:= by
  apply AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mpr
  constructor
  intro a b
  suffices hzero : ∀ t : P.stalk x, t = 0 by
    rw [hzero a, hzero b]
  intro t
  obtain ⟨V, hxV, s, rfl⟩ := P.exists_germ_eq t
  have hxV' : x ∈ V ⊓ W := ⟨hxV, hx⟩
  have hres : P.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V ⊓ W ≤ V)).op s = 0 :=
    (h (V ⊓ W) hxV' inf_le_right).elim _ _
  rw [← P.germ_res_apply (homOfLE (inf_le_left : V ⊓ W ≤ V)) x hxV' s, hres, map_zero]

name: TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_pushforward_stalkPushforward
statement:
theorem stalkFunctor_map_pushforward_stalkPushforward {Y : TopCat.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {G G' : TopCat.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X} (α : G ⟶ G') (x : X) :
    (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (f x)).map
        ((TopCat.Presheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} f).map α) ≫
      G'.stalkPushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} f x =
    G.stalkPushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} f x ≫
      (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map α
proof:
:= by
  apply TopCat.Presheaf.stalk_hom_ext
  intro V hxV
  have h1 : ((TopCat.Presheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} f).obj G).germ V (f x) hxV ≫
      (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (f x)).map
        ((TopCat.Presheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} f).map α) =
      ((TopCat.Presheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} f).map α).app (op V) ≫
        ((TopCat.Presheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} f).obj G').germ V (f x) hxV :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ V (f x) hxV _
  have h2 : G.germ ((Opens.map f).obj V) x hxV ≫
      (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map α =
      α.app (op ((Opens.map f).obj V)) ≫ G'.germ ((Opens.map f).obj V) x hxV :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ _ x hxV α
  erw [← Category.assoc, h1, Category.assoc, TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPushforward_germ,
    ← Category.assoc, TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPushforward_germ, h2]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.appIso_inv_map_appTop
statement:
theorem appIso_inv_map_appTop (Y : X.Opens) (V : (Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}).Opens)
    (r : Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    (Y.ι.appIso V).inv.hom
        ((Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}).presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (Y.ι.appTop.hom r)) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op r
proof:
:= by
  have h := Y.ι.appLE_appIso_inv (U := ⊤) (V := V) le_top
  have h' := congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom r) h
  simp only [Scheme.Hom.appLE] at h'
  exact h'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrict_smulEnd
statement:
theorem restrict_smulEnd (Y : X.Opens) (r : Γ(X, ⊤)) :
    (Y.restrictAb).map (M.smulEnd r) = (M.restrict Y.ι).smulEnd (Y.ι.appTop.hom r)
proof:
:= by
  refine Sheaf.hom_ext (NatTrans.ext (funext fun V => ?_))
  ext m
  change (ModuleCat.smul (M.val.obj (op (Y.ι ''ᵁ V.unop)))
      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op r)).hom m =
    (ModuleCat.smul ((M.restrict Y.ι).val.obj V)
      ((Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}).presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (Y.ι.appTop.hom r))).hom m
  have e : ModuleCat.smul ((M.restrict Y.ι).val.obj V)
      ((Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}).presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (Y.ι.appTop.hom r)) =
    ModuleCat.smul (M.val.obj (op (Y.ι ''ᵁ V.unop)))
      ((Y.ι.appIso V.unop).inv.hom
        ((Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}).presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op
          (Y.ι.appTop.hom r))) := rfl
  rw [e, appIso_inv_map_appTop]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.nonempty_E_linearEquiv_sheafCohomology_restrict
statement:
theorem nonempty_E_linearEquiv_sheafCohomology_restrict (Y : X.Opens) (q : ℕ) :
    letI : Module Γ(X, ⊤) (AlgebraicGeometry.sheafCohomology Y (M.restrict Y.ι) q)
proof:
:=
      Module.compHom _ Y.ι.appTop.hom
    Nonempty (E M Y q ≃ₗ[Γ(X, ⊤)] AlgebraicGeometry.sheafCohomology Y (M.restrict Y.ι) q) := by
  let m₂ : Module Γ(X, ⊤) (AlgebraicGeometry.sheafCohomology Y (M.restrict Y.ι) q) :=
    Module.compHom _ Y.ι.appTop.hom
  have := Y.preservesFiniteLimits_extendAb
  have := Y.preservesFiniteColimits_restrictAb
  exact ⟨(Y.extendRestrictAdjunction).extLinearEquivOfIsoLeft (A := (freeSheafFunctor X).obj Y)
    (B := Y.constantZ) (Y.freeSheafIsoExtendConstant) M.toAddCommGrpSheaf q
    (ExtAction.module Γ(X, ⊤) M.toAddCommGrpSheaf _ q) m₂
    M.smulEnd (fun r => (M.restrict Y.ι).smulEnd (Y.ι.appTop.hom r))
    (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl) (restrict_smulEnd M Y)⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.hPrime_addEquiv_H_restrict
statement:
theorem hPrime_addEquiv_H_restrict (U : X.Opens) (q : ℕ) :
    Nonempty ((M.toAddCommGrpSheaf.H' q U : AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ≃+
      CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.restrict M U.ι).toAddCommGrpSheaf q)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Module Γ(X, ⊤) (AlgebraicGeometry.sheafCohomology U (M.restrict U.ι) q) :=
    Module.compHom _ U.ι.appTop.hom
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := nonempty_E_linearEquiv_sheafCohomology_restrict M U q
  exact ⟨e.toAddEquiv⟩

name: TopCat.Sheaf.extendByZeroSubgroup_mem
statement:
theorem extendByZeroSubgroup_mem
    (G : CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology U) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    {V W : (Opens X)ᵒᵖ} (f : V ⟶ W) (x : extendByZeroSubgroup U G V) :
    ((extendByZeroPushforward U G).map f).hom ((extendByZeroSubgroup U G V).subtype x) ∈
      extendByZeroSubgroup U G W
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hW : W.unop ≤ U
  · simp only [extendByZeroSubgroup, if_pos hW, AddSubgroup.mem_top]
  · have hV : ¬ V.unop ≤ U := fun h => hW (le_trans (leOfHom f.unop) h)
    have hx : ((extendByZeroSubgroup U G V).subtype x : (extendByZeroPushforward U G).obj V) = 0 := by
      have hx' := x.2
      simp only [extendByZeroSubgroup, if_neg hV, AddSubgroup.mem_bot] at hx'
      simpa using hx'
    simp only [hx, map_zero]
    exact zero_mem _

statement:

    (G : CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology U) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    Mono (extendByZeroPresheafι U G)
proof:
:= by

name: TopCat.Sheaf.extendByZeroToPushforward_mono
statement:
theorem extendByZeroToPushforward_mono
    (G : CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology U) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    Mono (extendByZeroToPushforward U G)
proof:
:= by
  unfold extendByZeroToPushforward
  haveI := extendByZeroPresheafι_mono U G
  have h1 : Mono ((presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
      (extendByZeroPresheafι U G)) := Functor.map_mono _ _
  have h2 : Mono ((sheafificationAdjunction (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).counit.app
      ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} (Opens.inclusion' U)).obj G)) :=
    @IsIso.mono_of_iso _ _ _ _ _
      (isIso_sheafificationAdjunction_counit
        ((TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} (Opens.inclusion' U)).obj G))
  exact @mono_comp _ _ _ _ _ _ h1 _ h2

name: TopCat.Sheaf.subsingleton_extendByZero_obj_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem subsingleton_extendByZero_obj_of_disjoint
    (G : CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology U) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (W : Opens X) (hW : Disjoint (U : Set X) W) :
    Subsingleton ((TopCat.Sheaf.extendByZero U G).obj.obj (op W))
proof:
:= by
  haveI := extendByZeroToPushforward_mono U G
  have hm : Mono (extendByZeroToPushforward U G).hom :=
    Functor.map_mono (sheafToPresheaf _ _) (extendByZeroToPushforward U G)
  have happ := (NatTrans.mono_iff_mono_app _).mp hm (op W)
  rw [AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective] at happ
  have hterm : IsTerminal (G.obj.obj (op ((Opens.map (Opens.inclusion' U)).obj W))) :=
    CategoryTheory.Sheaf.isTerminalOfBotCover G _ (fun x hx => (Set.disjoint_left.mp hW x.2 hx).elim)
  have : Subsingleton (G.obj.obj (op ((Opens.map (Opens.inclusion' U)).obj W))) :=
    AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hterm.isZero
  exact @Function.Injective.subsingleton _ _ _ happ this

name: TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_restrict_extendByZero_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem isZero_restrict_extendByZero_of_disjoint
    (G : CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology U) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (V : Opens X) (hUV : Disjoint (U : Set X) V) :
    IsZero (TopCat.Sheaf.restrict (TopCat.Sheaf.extendByZero U G) V)
proof:
:= by
  have hval : IsZero (TopCat.Sheaf.restrict (TopCat.Sheaf.extendByZero U G) V).obj := by
    refine Functor.isZero _ (fun W => ?_)
    have : Subsingleton ((TopCat.Sheaf.extendByZero U G).obj.obj
        (op ((Opens.isOpenEmbedding V).functor.obj W.unop))) := by
      refine subsingleton_extendByZero_obj_of_disjoint U G _ ?_
      refine Set.disjoint_left.mpr fun x hxU hxW => ?_
      obtain ⟨y, _, rfl⟩ := hxW
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hUV hxU y.2
    exact @AddCommGrpCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _ this
  rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero] at hval ⊢
  apply (sheafToPresheaf _ _).map_injective
  rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_zero]
  exact hval

name: TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_val_obj_of_isZero
statement:
theorem isZero_val_obj_of_isZero {T : Type u} [TopologicalSpace T]
    {G : CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology T) AddCommGrpCat.{u}} (hG : IsZero G)
    (V : (Opens T)ᵒᵖ) : IsZero (G.obj.obj V)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsZero G.obj := Functor.map_isZero (sheafToPresheaf _ _) hG
  exact (Functor.isZero_iff _).mp this V

name: TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_extendByZero_of_isZero
statement:
theorem isZero_extendByZero_of_isZero
    {G : CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology U) AddCommGrpCat.{u}} (hG : IsZero G) :
    IsZero (TopCat.Sheaf.extendByZero U G)
proof:
:= by
  rw [extendByZero_eq_sheafify]
  refine Functor.map_isZero _ ?_
  rw [Functor.isZero_iff]
  intro V
  have : Subsingleton ((extendByZeroPushforward U G).obj V) :=
    AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero
      (isZero_val_obj_of_isZero hG (op ((Opens.map (Opens.inclusion' U)).obj V.unop)))
  exact @AddCommGrpCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _
    (inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (extendByZeroSubgroup U G V)))

name: TopCat.Sheaf.extendByZeroFunctor_obj
statement:
theorem extendByZeroFunctor_obj
    (G : CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology U) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    (extendByZeroFunctor U).obj G = TopCat.Sheaf.extendByZero U G
proof: := rfl

name: TopCat.Sheaf.closedComplι_isClosedEmbedding
statement: theorem closedComplι_isClosedEmbedding : Topology.IsClosedEmbedding (closedComplι U)

:=
  U.isOpen.isClosed_compl.isClosedEmbedding_subtypeVal

name: TopCat.Sheaf.notMem_range_closedComplι
statement: theorem notMem_range_closedComplι {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U) : x ∉ Set.range (closedComplι U)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
  have hzx : (z : X) = x := hz
  exact z.2 (by rw [hzx]; exact hx)

name: TopCat.Sheaf.closedComplUnit_hom
statement:
theorem closedComplUnit_hom :
    (closedComplUnit U F).hom =
      (TopCat.Presheaf.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u} (closedComplι U)).unit.app F.obj ≫
        (TopCat.Presheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} (closedComplι U)).map
          (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology (closedCompl U)) (closedComplPre U F))
proof: := rfl

name: TopCat.Sheaf.isIso_stalkFunctor_map_closedComplUnit_hom
statement:
theorem isIso_stalkFunctor_map_closedComplUnit_hom (z : closedCompl U) :
    IsIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (closedComplι U z)).map
      (closedComplUnit U F).hom)
proof:
:= by
  have hsp : IsIso (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} (closedComplι U)
      (sheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology (closedCompl U)) (closedComplPre U F)) z) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPushforward.stalkPushforward_iso_of_isInducing AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      (closedComplι_isClosedEmbedding U).isInducing _ z
  have hpb : IsIso (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPullbackHom AddCommGrpCat.{u} (closedComplι U) F.obj z) :=
    (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPullbackIso AddCommGrpCat.{u} (closedComplι U) F.obj z).isIso_hom
  have hts : IsIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} z).map
      (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology (closedCompl U)) (closedComplPre U F))) :=
    TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_unit_toSheafify_isIso z AddCommGrpCat.{u} _
  have key : (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (closedComplι U z)).map
        (closedComplUnit U F).hom ≫
      TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} (closedComplι U)
        (sheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology (closedCompl U)) (closedComplPre U F)) z =
      TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPullbackHom AddCommGrpCat.{u} (closedComplι U) F.obj z ≫
        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} z).map
          (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology (closedCompl U)) (closedComplPre U F)) := by
    have h1 : (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (closedComplι U z)).map
        (closedComplUnit U F).hom =
        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (closedComplι U z)).map
          ((TopCat.Presheaf.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u} (closedComplι U)).unit.app F.obj) ≫
        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (closedComplι U z)).map
          ((TopCat.Presheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} (closedComplι U)).map
            (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology (closedCompl U)) (closedComplPre U F))) :=
      (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (closedComplι U z)).map_comp _ _
    erw [h1, Category.assoc, TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_pushforward_stalkPushforward,
      ← Category.assoc]
  have hcomp : IsIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (closedComplι U z)).map
        (closedComplUnit U F).hom ≫
      TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} (closedComplι U)
        (sheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology (closedCompl U)) (closedComplPre U F)) z) := by
    rw [key]
    exact @IsIso.comp_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hpb hts
  exact @IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right _ _ _ _ _
    ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (closedComplι U z)).map (closedComplUnit U F).hom)
    (TopCat.Presheaf.stalkPushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} (closedComplι U)
        (sheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology (closedCompl U)) (closedComplPre U F)) z) hsp hcomp

name: TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_stalk_closedComplPush_of_mem
statement:
theorem isZero_stalk_closedComplPush_of_mem (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) :
    IsZero (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (closedComplPush U F).obj x)
proof:
:=
  TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_stalk_pushforward_of_notMem_range (closedComplι U)
    (closedComplι_isClosedEmbedding U) _ x (notMem_range_closedComplι U hx)

name: TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_closedComplPush_obj_of_le
statement:
theorem isZero_closedComplPush_obj_of_le {V : (Opens X)ᵒᵖ} (hV : V.unop ≤ U) :
    IsZero ((closedComplPush U F).obj.obj V)
proof:
:= by
  have hbot : (Opens.map (closedComplι U)).obj V.unop = ⊥ := by
    ext z
    exact ⟨fun hz => (z.2 (hV hz)).elim, fun h => h.elim⟩
  exact (TopCat.Sheaf.isTerminalOfEqEmpty
    ((presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (closedCompl U)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
      (closedComplPre U F)) hbot).isZero

name: TopCat.Sheaf.extendByZeroCounitPresheaf_comp_closedComplUnit_hom
statement:
theorem extendByZeroCounitPresheaf_comp_closedComplUnit_hom :
    extendByZeroCounitPresheaf U F ≫ (closedComplUnit U F).hom = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext V
  rw [NatTrans.comp_app, NatTrans.app_zero]
  by_cases hV : V.unop ≤ U
  · exact (isZero_closedComplPush_obj_of_le U F hV).eq_zero_of_tgt _
  · exact (isZero_extendByZeroPresheaf_obj_of_not_le U _ hV).eq_zero_of_src _

name: TopCat.Sheaf.extendByZeroCounit_comp_closedComplUnit
statement:
theorem extendByZeroCounit_comp_closedComplUnit :
    extendByZeroCounit U F ≫ closedComplUnit U F = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply CategoryTheory.Sheaf.hom_ext
  change (extendByZeroCounit U F).hom ≫ (closedComplUnit U F).hom = 0
  refine CategoryTheory.sheafify_hom_ext (J := Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
    (P := extendByZeroPresheaf U (TopCat.Sheaf.restrict F U)) (Q := (closedComplPush U F).obj)
    ((extendByZeroCounit U F).hom ≫ (closedComplUnit U F).hom) 0 (closedComplPush U F).property ?_
  rw [comp_zero, ← Category.assoc, toSheafify_comp_extendByZeroCounit_hom]
  exact extendByZeroCounitPresheaf_comp_closedComplUnit_hom U F

name: TopCat.Sheaf.shortExact_extendByZero_restrict
statement:
theorem TopCat.Sheaf.shortExact_extendByZero_restrict {X : TopCat.{u}}
    (F : CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (U : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) :
    ∃ S : CategoryTheory.ShortComplex
        (CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}),
      S.ShortExact ∧ Nonempty (S.X₂ ≅ F) ∧
      Nonempty (S.X₁ ≅ TopCat.Sheaf.extendByZero U (TopCat.Sheaf.restrict F U)) ∧
      Nonempty (S.X₃ ≅ TopCat.Sheaf.pushforwardClosed (Uᶜ : Set X) (TopCat.Sheaf.restrictClosed F (Uᶜ : Set X)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  let S : CategoryTheory.ShortComplex (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X) :=
    CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.mk (TopCat.Sheaf.extendByZeroCounit U F)
      (TopCat.Sheaf.closedComplUnit U F) (TopCat.Sheaf.extendByZeroCounit_comp_closedComplUnit U F)
  
  have hε_iso : ∀ x : X, x ∈ U → IsIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map
      (TopCat.Sheaf.extendByZeroCounit U F).hom) :=
    fun x hx => TopCat.Sheaf.isIso_stalkFunctor_map_extendByZeroCounit_hom_of_mem U F x hx
  have hX₁_zero : ∀ x : X, x ∉ U → IsZero ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).obj
      ((presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
        (TopCat.Sheaf.extendByZeroPresheaf U (TopCat.Sheaf.restrict F U))).obj) :=
    fun x hx => TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_stalk_extendByZero_of_notMem U (TopCat.Sheaf.restrict F U) x hx
  have hg_iso : ∀ x : X, x ∉ U → IsIso ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map
      (TopCat.Sheaf.closedComplUnit U F).hom) :=
    fun x hx => TopCat.Sheaf.isIso_stalkFunctor_map_closedComplUnit_hom U F ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hX₃_zero : ∀ x : X, x ∈ U → IsZero ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).obj
      (TopCat.Sheaf.closedComplPush U F).obj) :=
    fun x hx => TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_stalk_closedComplPush_of_mem U F x hx
  
  have hexact : S.Exact := by
    refine (TopCat.Sheaf.exact_iff_stalkFunctor_map_exact S).mpr (fun x => ?_)
    by_cases hx : x ∈ U
    · have hg0 : (S.map (TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u} X ⋙
          TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x)).g = 0 :=
        (hX₃_zero x hx).eq_zero_of_tgt _
      refine (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.exact_iff_epi _ hg0).mpr ?_
      exact @IsIso.epi_of_iso _ _ _ _ _ (hε_iso x hx)
    · have hf0 : (S.map (TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u} X ⋙
          TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x)).f = 0 :=
        (hX₁_zero x hx).eq_zero_of_src _
      refine (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.exact_iff_mono _ hf0).mpr ?_
      exact @IsIso.mono_of_iso _ _ _ _ _ (hg_iso x hx)
  have hmono : Mono S.f := by
    refine (TopCat.Presheaf.mono_iff_stalk_mono S.f).mpr (fun x => ?_)
    by_cases hx : x ∈ U
    · exact @IsIso.mono_of_iso _ _ _ _ _ (hε_iso x hx)
    · exact ⟨fun a b _ => (hX₁_zero x hx).eq_of_tgt a b⟩
  have hepi : Epi S.g := by
    have hls : TopCat.Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective (TopCat.Sheaf.closedComplUnit U F).hom := by
      refine (TopCat.Presheaf.locally_surjective_iff_surjective_on_stalks _).mpr (fun x => ?_)
      by_cases hx : x ∈ U
      · intro y
        exact ⟨0, (AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (hX₃_zero x hx)).elim _ _⟩
      · exact (@ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (hg_iso x hx)).2
    exact (CategoryTheory.Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi' _ (TopCat.Sheaf.closedComplUnit U F)).mp hls
  have hS : S.ShortExact := { exact := hexact, mono_f := hmono, epi_g := hepi }
  exact ⟨S, hS, ⟨Iso.refl F⟩,
    ⟨eqToIso (TopCat.Sheaf.extendByZero_eq_sheafify U (TopCat.Sheaf.restrict F U)).symm⟩,
    ⟨TopCat.Sheaf.closedComplPushIso U F⟩⟩

name: TopCat.Sheaf.genSubι_mono
statement:
theorem genSubι_mono {t : ℕ} {V : Fin t → Opens X} (ψ : ∀ i, extendByZeroConstant (V i) ⟶ K)
    (n : Fin t → ℕ) (k : ℕ) : Mono (genSubι ψ n k)
proof:
:=
  inferInstanceAs (Mono (image.ι (genSubDesc ψ n k)))

name: TopCat.Sheaf.ι_genSubDesc
statement:
theorem ι_genSubDesc {t : ℕ} {V : Fin t → Opens X} (ψ : ∀ i, extendByZeroConstant (V i) ⟶ K)
    (n : Fin t → ℕ) (k : ℕ) (i : {i : Fin t // n i ≤ k}) :
    biproduct.ι (fun i : {i : Fin t // n i ≤ k} => extendByZeroConstant (V i.1)) i ≫ genSubDesc ψ n k =
      ψ i.1
proof:
:= by
  simp [genSubDesc]

name: TopCat.Sheaf.genSubBiprodMap_desc
statement:
theorem genSubBiprodMap_desc {t : ℕ} {V : Fin t → Opens X} (ψ : ∀ i, extendByZeroConstant (V i) ⟶ K)
    (n : Fin t → ℕ) (k : ℕ) :
    genSubBiprodMap V n k ≫ genSubDesc ψ n (k + 1) = genSubDesc ψ n k
proof:
:= by
  apply biproduct.hom_ext'
  intro i
  simp [genSubBiprodMap, genSubDesc]

name: TopCat.Sheaf.genSubT_ι
statement:
theorem genSubT_ι {t : ℕ} {V : Fin t → Opens X} (ψ : ∀ i, extendByZeroConstant (V i) ⟶ K)
    (n : Fin t → ℕ) (k : ℕ) : genSubT ψ n k ≫ genSubι ψ n (k + 1) = genSubι ψ n k
proof:
:=
  image.lift_fac
    { I := genSub ψ n (k + 1)
      m := genSubι ψ n (k + 1)
      e := genSubBiprodMap V n k ≫ factorThruImage (genSubDesc ψ n (k + 1))
      m_mono := genSubι_mono ψ n (k + 1)
      fac := by
        show (genSubBiprodMap V n k ≫ factorThruImage (genSubDesc ψ n (k + 1))) ≫
          image.ι (genSubDesc ψ n (k + 1)) = genSubDesc ψ n k
        rw [Category.assoc, image.fac]
        exact genSubBiprodMap_desc ψ n k }

name: TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_genSub_zero
statement:
theorem isZero_genSub_zero {t : ℕ} {V : Fin t → Opens X} (ψ : ∀ i, extendByZeroConstant (V i) ⟶ K)
    (n : Fin t → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) : IsZero (genSub ψ n 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hempty : IsEmpty {i : Fin t // n i ≤ 0} :=
    ⟨fun i => (Nat.not_succ_le_zero _ ((hn i.1).trans_le i.2)).elim⟩
  have hdesc : genSubDesc ψ n 0 = 0 := by
    apply biproduct.hom_ext'
    intro i
    exact (IsEmpty.false i).elim
  have hι : genSubι ψ n 0 = 0 := image.ι_zero' hdesc
  have := genSubι_mono ψ n 0
  exact IsZero.of_mono_eq_zero (genSubι ψ n 0) hι

name: TopCat.Sheaf.isIso_genSubι_of_le
statement:
theorem isIso_genSubι_of_le {t : ℕ} {V : Fin t → Opens X} (ψ : ∀ i, extendByZeroConstant (V i) ⟶ K)
    (hgen : IsJointlyEpi ψ) (n : Fin t → ℕ) (N : ℕ) (hN : ∀ i, n i ≤ N) : IsIso (genSubι ψ n N)
proof:
:= by
  have hepi : Epi (genSubDesc ψ n N) := by
    refine ⟨fun {T} g h hgh => hgen g h fun i => ?_⟩
    have := congrArg (fun f => biproduct.ι (fun i : {i : Fin t // n i ≤ N} => extendByZeroConstant (V i.1))
      ⟨i, hN i⟩ ≫ f) hgh
    simpa [genSubDesc] using this
  have : Epi (genSubι ψ n N) := by
    rw [genSubι]
    exact epi_of_epi_fac (image.fac (genSubDesc ψ n N))
  have := genSubι_mono ψ n N
  exact isIso_of_mono_of_epi _

name: TopCat.Sheaf.epi_gradedQuotientMap
statement:
theorem epi_gradedQuotientMap [Mono m] (hψ : ∀ i, ψ i ≫ m = ((n i : ℤ) • constantInclusion (V i)))
    (q : extendByZeroConstant (gradedOpen V n k) ⟶ genSub ψ n (k + 1))
    (hq : q ≫ genSubι ψ n (k + 1) ≫ m = (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) • constantInclusion (gradedOpen V n k))) :
    Epi (gradedQuotientMap ψ n k q)
proof:
:= by
  have hmι := genSubι_mono ψ n (k + 1)
  have hmιm := mono_genSubι_comp ψ n (k + 1) m
  have he : Epi (factorThruImage (genSubDesc ψ n (k + 1))) := inferInstance
  constructor
  intro T g h hgh
  have hπ : cokernel.π (genSubT ψ n k) ≫ g = cokernel.π (genSubT ψ n k) ≫ h := by
    rw [← cancel_epi (factorThruImage (genSubDesc ψ n (k + 1)))]
    apply biproduct.hom_ext'
    intro j
    by_cases hj : n j.1 ≤ k
    · have hfac : biproduct.ι (fun i : {i : Fin t // n i ≤ k + 1} => extendByZeroConstant (V i.1)) j ≫
          factorThruImage (genSubDesc ψ n (k + 1)) = genSubIn ψ n k j.1 hj ≫ genSubT ψ n k := by
        rw [← cancel_mono (genSubι ψ n (k + 1)), Category.assoc, Category.assoc, genSubT_ι, genSubIn_comp_genSubι]
        exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (genSubIn_comp_genSubι ψ n (k + 1) j.1 j.2)
      have hz : ∀ f : cokernel (genSubT ψ n k) ⟶ T,
          biproduct.ι (fun i : {i : Fin t // n i ≤ k + 1} => extendByZeroConstant (V i.1)) j ≫
            factorThruImage (genSubDesc ψ n (k + 1)) ≫ cokernel.π (genSubT ψ n k) ≫ f = 0 := by
        intro f
        rw [← Category.assoc, hfac, Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc (genSubT ψ n k), cokernel.condition,
          zero_comp, comp_zero]
      rw [hz g, hz h]
    · have hj' : n j.1 = k + 1 := le_antisymm j.2 (Nat.succ_le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hj))
      have hfac : biproduct.ι (fun i : {i : Fin t // n i ≤ k + 1} => extendByZeroConstant (V i.1)) j ≫
          factorThruImage (genSubDesc ψ n (k + 1)) = extendByZeroConstantRestrict (le_gradedOpen V n k hj') ≫ q := by
        rw [← cancel_mono (genSubι ψ n (k + 1) ≫ m), Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hq, Preadditive.comp_zsmul,
          extendByZeroConstantRestrict_comp_constantInclusion]
        have h1 : biproduct.ι (fun i : {i : Fin t // n i ≤ k + 1} => extendByZeroConstant (V i.1)) j ≫
            factorThruImage (genSubDesc ψ n (k + 1)) ≫ genSubι ψ n (k + 1) ≫ m = ψ j.1 ≫ m := by
          rw [← Category.assoc]
          exact genSubIn_comp_genSubι_comp ψ n (k + 1) j.1 j.2 m
        rw [h1, hψ, hj']
      have hz : ∀ f : cokernel (genSubT ψ n k) ⟶ T,
          biproduct.ι (fun i : {i : Fin t // n i ≤ k + 1} => extendByZeroConstant (V i.1)) j ≫
            factorThruImage (genSubDesc ψ n (k + 1)) ≫ cokernel.π (genSubT ψ n k) ≫ f =
          extendByZeroConstantRestrict (le_gradedOpen V n k hj') ≫ q ≫ cokernel.π (genSubT ψ n k) ≫ f := by
        intro f
        rw [← Category.assoc, hfac, Category.assoc]
      rw [hz g, hz h]
      have := congrArg (fun f => extendByZeroConstantRestrict (le_gradedOpen V n k hj') ≫ f) hgh
      simp only [gradedQuotientMap, Category.assoc] at this
      exact this
  exact (cancel_epi (cokernel.π (genSubT ψ n k))).mp hπ

name: TopCat.Sheaf.restrict_comp_gradedQuotientMap
statement:
theorem restrict_comp_gradedQuotientMap [Mono m] (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (hψ : ∀ i, ψ i ≫ m = ((n i : ℤ) • constantInclusion (V i)))
    (hgcd : ∀ (x : X) (J : Finset (Fin t)), J.Nonempty → (∀ j ∈ J, x ∈ V j) → ∃ i, x ∈ V i ∧ n i = J.gcd n)
    (q : extendByZeroConstant (gradedOpen V n k) ⟶ genSub ψ n (k + 1))
    (hq : q ≫ genSubι ψ n (k + 1) ≫ m = (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) • constantInclusion (gradedOpen V n k))) :
    extendByZeroConstantRestrict (gradedOpenInter_le V n k) ≫ gradedQuotientMap ψ n k q = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmιm := mono_genSubι_comp ψ n (k + 1) m
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_gradedSectionLow ψ n k m hn hψ hgcd
  have hfac : extendByZeroConstantRestrict (gradedOpenInter_le V n k) ≫ q = r ≫ genSubT ψ n k := by
    rw [← cancel_mono (genSubι ψ n (k + 1) ≫ m), Category.assoc, hq, Preadditive.comp_zsmul,
      extendByZeroConstantRestrict_comp_constantInclusion, Category.assoc r, ← Category.assoc (genSubT ψ n k),
      genSubT_ι, hr]
  unfold gradedQuotientMap
  rw [← Category.assoc, hfac, Category.assoc, cokernel.condition, comp_zero]

name: TopCat.Sheaf.mono_nsmul_constantInclusion
statement:
theorem mono_nsmul_constantInclusion (U : Opens X) (a : ℕ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    Mono (((a : ℕ) : ℤ) • constantInclusion U)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((a : ℕ) : ℤ) • constantInclusion U = constantInclusion U ≫ (((a : ℕ) : ℤ) • 𝟙 _) := by
    rw [Preadditive.comp_zsmul, Category.comp_id]
  rw [h]
  have := constantInclusion_mono U
  have := mono_zsmul_id_constantSheaf (X := X) ((a : ℕ) : ℤ) (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr ha)
  exact mono_comp _ _

name: TopCat.Sheaf.isIso_kernelLift_gradedQuotientMap
statement:
theorem isIso_kernelLift_gradedQuotientMap [Mono m]
    (q : extendByZeroConstant (gradedOpen V n k) ⟶ genSub ψ n (k + 1))
    (hq : q ≫ genSubι ψ n (k + 1) ≫ m = (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) • constantInclusion (gradedOpen V n k)))
    (hρ : extendByZeroConstantRestrict (gradedOpenInter_le V n k) ≫ gradedQuotientMap ψ n k q = 0) :
    IsIso (kernel.lift (gradedQuotientMap ψ n k q) (extendByZeroConstantRestrict (gradedOpenInter_le V n k)) hρ)
proof:
:= by
  have hmρ := extendByZeroConstantRestrict_mono (gradedOpenInter_le V n k)
  have hmlift : Mono (kernel.lift (gradedQuotientMap ψ n k q) (extendByZeroConstantRestrict (gradedOpenInter_le V n k))
      hρ) := mono_of_mono_fac (kernel.lift_ι _ _ hρ)
  have key : ∀ x : X, IsIso ((stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map
      (kernel.lift (gradedQuotientMap ψ n k q) (extendByZeroConstantRestrict (gradedOpenInter_le V n k)) hρ).hom) := by
    intro x
    rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
    have hmκ : Mono (kernel.ι (gradedQuotientMap ψ n k q)) := inferInstance
    have hκ : Function.Injective ((stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (kernel.ι (gradedQuotientMap ψ n k q)).hom) :=
      (AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp ((mono_iff_stalk_mono _).mp hmκ x)
    have hlifκ : (stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (kernel.lift (gradedQuotientMap ψ n k q)
        (extendByZeroConstantRestrict (gradedOpenInter_le V n k)) hρ).hom ≫
        (stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (kernel.ι (gradedQuotientMap ψ n k q)).hom =
        (stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (extendByZeroConstantRestrict (gradedOpenInter_le V n k)).hom := by
      rw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
      exact congrArg (fun f => (stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map f.hom) (kernel.lift_ι _ _ hρ)
    refine ⟨(AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp ((mono_iff_stalk_mono _).mp hmlift x), fun b => ?_⟩
    by_cases hx : x ∈ gradedOpenInter V n k
    · have hiso := isIso_stalkFunctor_map_extendByZeroConstantRestrict_hom_of_mem (gradedOpenInter_le V n k) x hx
      obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
        ((stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (extendByZeroConstantRestrict (gradedOpenInter_le V n k)).hom)).2
        ((stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (kernel.ι (gradedQuotientMap ψ n k q)).hom b)
      refine ⟨a', hκ ?_⟩
      rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, hlifκ]
      exact ha'
    · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      rw [map_zero]
      apply hκ
      rw [map_zero]
      
      have hpa : (stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (gradedQuotientMap ψ n k q).hom
          ((stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (kernel.ι (gradedQuotientMap ψ n k q)).hom b) = 0 := by
        rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
        have h0 : (kernel.ι (gradedQuotientMap ψ n k q)).hom ≫ (gradedQuotientMap ψ n k q).hom = 0 := by
          have := congrArg (fun f => (sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map f)
            (kernel.condition (gradedQuotientMap ψ n k q))
          rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_zero] at this
          exact this
        rw [h0, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_zero]
        rfl
      by_cases hxV : x ∈ gradedOpen V n k
      · have hnot : ∀ j, n j ≤ k → x ∉ V j := fun j hj hxj =>
          hx ⟨hxV, (mem_gradedOpenLow V n k).mpr ⟨j, hj, hxj⟩⟩
        have hK := isZero_stalk_genSub_of_forall_notMem ψ n k x hnot
        
        let S₀ : ShortComplex (TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X) :=
          ShortComplex.mk (genSubT ψ n k) (cokernel.π (genSubT ψ n k)) (cokernel.condition _)
        have hS₀ : S₀.Exact := ShortComplex.exact_of_g_is_cokernel S₀ (cokernelIsCokernel _)
        have hS₀x := (ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff _).mp ((exact_iff_stalkFunctor_map_exact S₀).mp hS₀ x)
        have hqa : (stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map q.hom
            ((stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (kernel.ι (gradedQuotientMap ψ n k q)).hom b) = 0 := by
          obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hS₀x ((stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map q.hom
            ((stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (kernel.ι (gradedQuotientMap ψ n k q)).hom b)) (by
              change (stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (cokernel.π (genSubT ψ n k)).hom
                ((stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map q.hom _) = 0
              rw [← ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
              exact hpa)
          have hz0 : z = 0 := (AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp hK).elim z 0
          rw [← hz, hz0]
          exact map_zero _
        have hc : (stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map ((((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) • constantInclusion (gradedOpen V n k)).hom)
            ((stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (kernel.ι (gradedQuotientMap ψ n k q)).hom b) = 0 := by
          rw [← hq]
          change (stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (q.hom ≫ (genSubι ψ n (k + 1) ≫ m).hom) _ = 0
          rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, ConcreteCategory.comp_apply, hqa, map_zero]
        have hmono := mono_nsmul_constantInclusion (gradedOpen V n k) (k + 1) (Nat.succ_ne_zero k)
        apply (AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp ((mono_iff_stalk_mono _).mp hmono x)
        rw [map_zero]
        exact hc.symm
      · exact (AddCommGrpCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp
          (isZero_stalk_extendByZeroConstant_of_notMem (gradedOpen V n k) x hxV)).elim _ _
  exact isIso_of_stalkFunctor_map_iso _

name: TopCat.Sheaf.exists_shortExact_genSub_quotient
statement:
theorem exists_shortExact_genSub_quotient [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (K : CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (m : K ⟶ (CategoryTheory.constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
      (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))) [CategoryTheory.Mono m]
    {t : ℕ} (V : Fin t → Opens X) (hV : ∀ i, IsCompact ((V i : Opens X) : Set X))
    (n : Fin t → ℕ) (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i) (ψ : ∀ i, extendByZeroConstant (V i) ⟶ K)
    (hψ : ∀ i, ψ i ≫ m = ((n i : ℤ) • constantInclusion (V i)))
    (hgcd : ∀ (x : X) (J : Finset (Fin t)), J.Nonempty → (∀ j ∈ J, x ∈ V j) →
      ∃ i, x ∈ V i ∧ n i = J.gcd n)
    (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ (V' W' : Opens X), IsCompact (V' : Set X) ∧ IsCompact (W' : Set X) ∧
      ∃ S : CategoryTheory.ShortComplex
          (CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}),
        S.ShortExact ∧
        Nonempty (S.X₁ ≅ extendByZeroConstant W') ∧
        Nonempty (S.X₂ ≅ extendByZeroConstant V') ∧
        Nonempty (S.X₃ ≅ CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel (genSubT ψ n k))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_gradedSection ψ n k m hψ
  have hρ := restrict_comp_gradedQuotientMap ψ n k m hn hψ hgcd q hq
  have hepi := epi_gradedQuotientMap ψ n k m hψ q hq
  have hiso := isIso_kernelLift_gradedQuotientMap ψ n k m q hq hρ
  refine ⟨gradedOpen V n k, gradedOpenInter V n k, isCompact_gradedOpen V n k hV,
    isCompact_gradedOpenInter V n k hV,
    ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι (gradedQuotientMap ψ n k q)) (gradedQuotientMap ψ n k q) (kernel.condition _),
    ?_, ⟨(asIso (kernel.lift (gradedQuotientMap ψ n k q) _ hρ)).symm⟩, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩
  exact { exact := ShortComplex.exact_of_f_is_kernel _ (kernelIsKernel (gradedQuotientMap ψ n k q))
          mono_f := inferInstance
          epi_g := hepi }

name: TopCat.Sheaf.mem_finset_inf_iff
statement:
theorem mem_finset_inf_iff {ι : Type*} (K : Finset ι) (V : ι → Opens X) (x : X) :
    x ∈ K.inf V ↔ ∀ k ∈ K, x ∈ V k
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ ((K.inf V : Opens X) : Set X) ↔ _
  rw [Opens.coe_finset_inf, Finset.inf_set_eq_iInter, Set.mem_iInter₂]
  rfl

name: TopCat.Sheaf.mem_finset_sup_iff
statement:
theorem mem_finset_sup_iff {ι : Type*} (K : Finset ι) (V : ι → Opens X) (x : X) :
    x ∈ K.sup V ↔ ∃ k ∈ K, x ∈ V k
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ ((K.sup V : Opens X) : Set X) ↔ _
  rw [Opens.coe_finset_sup, Finset.sup_set_eq_biUnion, Set.mem_iUnion₂]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, exists_prop, SetLike.mem_coe]

name: TopCat.Sheaf.exists_levelSets
statement:
theorem exists_levelSets (U : Opens X) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (f : extendByZeroConstant U ⟶ constZ X) :
    ∃ (ι : Type u) (_ : Fintype ι) (L : ι → Opens X) (hL : ∀ i, L i ≤ U) (z : ι → ℤ),
      (∀ i, IsCompact ((L i : Opens X) : Set X)) ∧ U ≤ iSup L ∧
      ∀ i, restrictExtend U (hL i) ≫ f = z i • constantInclusion (L i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set s : (constZ X).obj.obj (op U) := (f.hom.app (op U)).hom (unitSection U) with hs
  
  have hloc := fun q : U => exists_locally_constSec (T := X) U s q.1 q.2
  choose W hWU hqW z hz using hloc
  
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hU.elim_finite_subcover (fun q : U => ((W q : Opens X) : Set X)) (fun q => (W q).isOpen)
    (fun x hx => Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hqW ⟨x, hx⟩⟩)
  
  have hsep : ∀ a b : U, ∀ x : X, x ∈ W a → x ∈ W b → z a = z b := by
    intro a b x hxa hxb
    have h1 : ((constZ X).obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W a ⊓ W b ≤ W a)).op).hom
        (((constZ X).obj.map (homOfLE (hWU a)).op).hom s) = constSec (W a ⊓ W b) (z a) := by
      rw [hz a, constSec_res]
    have h2 : ((constZ X).obj.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : W a ⊓ W b ≤ W b)).op).hom
        (((constZ X).obj.map (homOfLE (hWU b)).op).hom s) = constSec (W a ⊓ W b) (z b) := by
      rw [hz b, constSec_res]
    rw [map_comp_hom_apply] at h1 h2
    have h12 : (homOfLE (hWU a)).op ≫ (homOfLE (inf_le_left : W a ⊓ W b ≤ W a)).op =
        (homOfLE (hWU b)).op ≫ (homOfLE (inf_le_right : W a ⊓ W b ≤ W b)).op :=
      Quiver.Hom.unop_inj (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    rw [h12, h2] at h1
    exact (constSec_injective (W a ⊓ W b) ⟨x, hxa, hxb⟩ h1).symm
  
  let ι := {q : U // q ∈ t}
  let L : ι → Opens X := fun q => (t.filter (fun q' => z q' = z q.1)).sup W
  have hL : ∀ q, L q ≤ U := fun q => Finset.sup_le fun q' _ => hWU q'
  have hmemL : ∀ (q : ι) (x : X), x ∈ L q ↔ ∃ q' ∈ t, z q' = z q.1 ∧ x ∈ W q' := by
    intro q x
    rw [mem_finset_sup_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨q', hq', hx⟩
      exact ⟨q', (Finset.mem_filter.1 hq').1, (Finset.mem_filter.1 hq').2, hx⟩
    · rintro ⟨q', hq't, hzq', hx⟩
      exact ⟨q', Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hq't, hzq'⟩, hx⟩
  have hcover : U ≤ iSup L := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨q, hqt, hxq⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (ht hx)
    rw [Opens.mem_iSup]
    exact ⟨⟨q, hqt⟩, (hmemL ⟨q, hqt⟩ x).2 ⟨q, hqt, rfl, hxq⟩⟩
  
  have hresL : ∀ q : ι, ((constZ X).obj.map (homOfLE (hL q)).op).hom s = constSec (L q) (z q.1) := by
    intro q
    refine TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' (constZ X)
      (fun q' : {q' : U // q' ∈ t.filter (fun q' => z q' = z q.1)} => W q'.1) (L q)
      (fun q' => homOfLE (Finset.le_sup q'.2)) (Finset.sup_le fun q' hq' => le_iSup_of_le ⟨q', hq'⟩ le_rfl) _ _
      fun q' => ?_
    rw [map_comp_hom_apply, constSec_res]
    have h12 : (homOfLE (hL q)).op ≫ (homOfLE (Finset.le_sup q'.2 : W q'.1 ≤ L q)).op =
        (homOfLE (hWU q'.1)).op :=
      Quiver.Hom.unop_inj (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    rw [h12, hz q'.1]
    congr 1
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.1 q'.2).2
  
  have hcompact : ∀ q : ι, IsCompact ((L q : Opens X) : Set X) := by
    intro q
    have heq : ((L q : Opens X) : Set X) =
        (U : Set X) ∩ (⋃ q' ∈ t.filter (fun q' => z q' ≠ z q.1), ((W q' : Opens X) : Set X))ᶜ := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · intro hx
        refine ⟨hL q hx, ?_⟩
        rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_iUnion₂]
        rintro ⟨q', hq', hxq'⟩
        obtain ⟨a, _, hza, hxa⟩ := (hmemL q x).1 hx
        exact (Finset.mem_filter.1 hq').2 ((hsep q' a x hxq' hxa).trans hza)
      · rintro ⟨hxU, hx⟩
        rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_iUnion₂] at hx
        obtain ⟨a, hat, hxa⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.1 (ht hxU)
        refine (hmemL q x).2 ⟨a, hat, ?_, hxa⟩
        by_contra hne
        exact hx ⟨a, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hat, hne⟩, hxa⟩
    rw [heq]
    exact hU.inter_right (isOpen_biUnion fun q' _ => (W q').isOpen).isClosed_compl
  
  refine ⟨ι, inferInstance, L, hL, fun q => z q.1, hcompact, hcover, fun q => ?_⟩
  apply hom_ext_of_unitSection
  change (f.hom.app (op (L q))).hom (((restrictExtend U (hL q)).hom.app (op (L q))).hom (unitSection (L q))) = _
  rw [restrictExtend_unitSection, zsmul_constantInclusion_unitSection, ← hresL q]
  exact congrArg (fun g => g.hom (unitSection U)) (f.hom.naturality (homOfLE (hL q)).op)

name: TopCat.Sheaf.exists_filtration_subsheaf_constant
statement:
theorem TopCat.Sheaf.exists_filtration_subsheaf_constant {X : TopCat.{u}} [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (K : CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (m : K ⟶ (CategoryTheory.constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
      (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))) [CategoryTheory.Mono m]
    {r : ℕ} (U : Fin r → TopologicalSpace.Opens X) (hU : ∀ a, IsCompact ((U a : TopologicalSpace.Opens X) : Set X))
    (φ : ∀ a, TopCat.Sheaf.extendByZero (U a)
      ((CategoryTheory.constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology (U a)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
        (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ))) ⟶ K)
    (hgen : ∀ {T : CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}} (g h : K ⟶ T),
      (∀ a, φ a ≫ g = φ a ≫ h) → g = h) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (Fil : ℕ → CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
      (ι : ∀ i, Fil i ⟶ K) (t : ∀ i, Fil i ⟶ Fil (i + 1)),
      (∀ i, CategoryTheory.Mono (ι i)) ∧ (∀ i, t i ≫ ι (i + 1) = ι i) ∧
      CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero (Fil 0) ∧ CategoryTheory.IsIso (ι n) ∧
      ∀ i, i < n →
        ∃ (V W : TopologicalSpace.Opens X), IsCompact (V : Set X) ∧ IsCompact (W : Set X) ∧
          ∃ S : CategoryTheory.ShortComplex
              (CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}),
            S.ShortExact ∧
            Nonempty (S.X₁ ≅ TopCat.Sheaf.extendByZero W
              ((CategoryTheory.constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology W) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
                (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ)))) ∧
            Nonempty (S.X₂ ≅ TopCat.Sheaf.extendByZero V
              ((CategoryTheory.constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology V) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
                (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift ℤ)))) ∧
            Nonempty (S.X₃ ≅ CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel (t i))
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨t, V, n, ψ, hV, hn, hψgen, hψ, hgcd⟩ :=
    TopCat.Sheaf.exists_gcdClosed_constant_generators K m U hU φ hgen
  
  let N : ℕ := Finset.univ.sup n
  have hN : ∀ i, n i ≤ N := fun i => Finset.le_sup (f := n) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  refine ⟨N, TopCat.Sheaf.genSub ψ n, TopCat.Sheaf.genSubι ψ n, TopCat.Sheaf.genSubT ψ n,
    TopCat.Sheaf.genSubι_mono ψ n, TopCat.Sheaf.genSubT_ι ψ n, TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_genSub_zero ψ n hn,
    TopCat.Sheaf.isIso_genSubι_of_le ψ hψgen n N hN, fun k _ => ?_⟩
  
  exact TopCat.Sheaf.exists_shortExact_genSub_quotient K m V hV n hn ψ hψ hgcd k

name: TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_stalk_extendByZeroConstant_of_notMem
statement:
theorem isZero_stalk_extendByZeroConstant_of_notMem (U : Opens X) (x : X) (hx : x ∉ U) :
    IsZero ((stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).obj (extendByZeroConstant U).obj)
proof:
:=
  isZero_extendByZero_stalk_of_notMem U _ x hx

name: TopCat.Sheaf.isZero_stalk_cokernel_of_isIso_stalkFunctor_map
statement:
theorem isZero_stalk_cokernel_of_isIso_stalkFunctor_map
    {F G : CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}} (f : F ⟶ G) (x : X)
    (h : IsIso ((stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map f.hom)) :
    IsZero ((stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).obj (cokernel f).obj)
proof:
:= by
  have hepi : Epi ((TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u} X ⋙ stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map f) :=
    @IsIso.epi_of_iso _ _ _ _ _ h
  have e := PreservesCokernel.iso (TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u} X ⋙ stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x) f
  exact (isZero_zero _).of_iso (e ≪≫ cokernel.ofEpi _)

name: TopCat.Sheaf.constantInclusion_comp_cokernelπ_constantInclusion
statement:
theorem constantInclusion_comp_cokernelπ_constantInclusion {W V : Opens X} (h : W ≤ V) :
    constantInclusion W ≫ cokernel.π (constantInclusion V) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_zero_of_stalkFunctor_map
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ W
  · have hz := isZero_stalk_cokernel_of_isIso_stalkFunctor_map (constantInclusion V) x
      (isIso_stalkFunctor_map_constantInclusion_hom_of_mem V x (h hx))
    exact hz.eq_zero_of_tgt _
  · exact (isZero_stalk_extendByZeroConstant_of_notMem W x hx).eq_zero_of_src _

name: TopCat.Sheaf.extendByZeroConstantRestrict_comp_constantInclusion
statement:
theorem extendByZeroConstantRestrict_comp_constantInclusion {W V : Opens X} (h : W ≤ V) :
    extendByZeroConstantRestrict h ≫ constantInclusion V = constantInclusion W
proof:
:= by
  have := constantInclusion_mono V
  exact Fork.IsLimit.lift_ι (Abelian.monoIsKernelOfCokernel
    (CokernelCofork.ofπ (cokernel.π (constantInclusion V)) (cokernel.condition (constantInclusion V)))
    (cokernelIsCokernel (constantInclusion V)))
    (t := KernelFork.ofι (constantInclusion W) (constantInclusion_comp_cokernelπ_constantInclusion h))

name: TopCat.Sheaf.extendByZeroConstantRestrict_mono
statement:
theorem extendByZeroConstantRestrict_mono {W V : Opens X} (h : W ≤ V) :
    Mono (extendByZeroConstantRestrict h)
proof:
:= by
  have := constantInclusion_mono W
  exact mono_of_mono_fac (extendByZeroConstantRestrict_comp_constantInclusion h)

name: TopCat.Sheaf.isIso_stalkFunctor_map_extendByZeroConstantRestrict_hom_of_mem
statement:
theorem isIso_stalkFunctor_map_extendByZeroConstantRestrict_hom_of_mem {W V : Opens X} (h : W ≤ V)
    (x : X) (hx : x ∈ W) :
    IsIso ((stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (extendByZeroConstantRestrict h).hom)
proof:
:= by
  have hfac : (stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (extendByZeroConstantRestrict h).hom ≫
      (stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (constantInclusion V).hom =
      (stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (constantInclusion W).hom := by
    rw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
    exact congrArg (fun f => (stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map f.hom)
      (extendByZeroConstantRestrict_comp_constantInclusion h)
  have h1 := isIso_stalkFunctor_map_constantInclusion_hom_of_mem V x (h hx)
  have h2 := isIso_stalkFunctor_map_constantInclusion_hom_of_mem W x hx
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_fac_right hfac

name: TopCat.Sheaf.hom_ext_of_cover
statement:
theorem hom_ext_of_cover {W : Opens X} {ι : Type*} (Wc : ι → Opens X) (hle : ∀ α, Wc α ≤ W)
    (hcov : ∀ x ∈ W, ∃ α, x ∈ Wc α)
    {T : CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}}
    (f g : extendByZeroConstant W ⟶ T)
    (h : ∀ α, extendByZeroConstantRestrict (hle α) ≫ f = extendByZeroConstantRestrict (hle α) ≫ g) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext_of_stalkFunctor_map
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ W
  · obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := hcov x hx
    have hiso := isIso_stalkFunctor_map_extendByZeroConstantRestrict_hom_of_mem (hle α) x hα
    have hα' : (stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (extendByZeroConstantRestrict (hle α)).hom ≫
        (stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map f.hom =
        (stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (extendByZeroConstantRestrict (hle α)).hom ≫
          (stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map g.hom := by
      rw [← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
      exact congrArg (fun m => (stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map m.hom) (h α)
    exact (cancel_epi _).mp hα'
  · exact (isZero_stalk_extendByZeroConstant_of_notMem W x hx).eq_of_src _ _

name: TopCat.Sheaf.exists_comp_eq_of_cover
statement:
theorem exists_comp_eq_of_cover {W : Opens X} {ι : Type*} (Wc : ι → Opens X) (hle : ∀ α, Wc α ≤ W)
    (hcov : ∀ x ∈ W, ∃ α, x ∈ Wc α)
    {T K' : CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}} (μ : K' ⟶ T) [Mono μ]
    (f : extendByZeroConstant W ⟶ T) (g : ∀ α, extendByZeroConstant (Wc α) ⟶ K')
    (hg : ∀ α, g α ≫ μ = extendByZeroConstantRestrict (hle α) ≫ f) :
    ∃ q : extendByZeroConstant W ⟶ K', q ≫ μ = f
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : f ≫ cokernel.π μ = 0 := by
    apply hom_ext_of_cover Wc hle hcov
    intro α
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← hg α, Category.assoc, cokernel.condition, comp_zero, comp_zero]
  refine ⟨(Abelian.monoIsKernelOfCokernel (CokernelCofork.ofπ (cokernel.π μ) (cokernel.condition μ))
    (cokernelIsCokernel μ)).lift (KernelFork.ofι f hzero), ?_⟩
  exact Fork.IsLimit.lift_ι (Abelian.monoIsKernelOfCokernel (CokernelCofork.ofπ (cokernel.π μ) (cokernel.condition μ))
    (cokernelIsCokernel μ)) (t := KernelFork.ofι f hzero)

name: TopCat.Sheaf.le_gradedOpen
statement: theorem le_gradedOpen {i : Fin t} (hi : n i = k + 1) : V i ≤ gradedOpen V n k
proof:
:=
  le_iSup (fun i : {i : Fin t // n i = k + 1} => V i.1) ⟨i, hi⟩

name: TopCat.Sheaf.le_gradedOpenLow
statement: theorem le_gradedOpenLow {i : Fin t} (hi : n i ≤ k) : V i ≤ gradedOpenLow V n k
proof:
:=
  le_iSup (fun i : {i : Fin t // n i ≤ k} => V i.1) ⟨i, hi⟩

name: TopCat.Sheaf.mem_gradedOpen
statement: theorem mem_gradedOpen {x : X} : x ∈ gradedOpen V n k ↔ ∃ i, n i = k + 1 ∧ x ∈ V i
proof:
:= by
  unfold gradedOpen
  rw [Opens.mem_iSup]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨i, hi⟩ => ⟨i.1, i.2, hi⟩, fun ⟨i, hi, hx⟩ => ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, hx⟩⟩

name: TopCat.Sheaf.mem_gradedOpenLow
statement: theorem mem_gradedOpenLow {x : X} : x ∈ gradedOpenLow V n k ↔ ∃ i, n i ≤ k ∧ x ∈ V i
proof:
:= by
  unfold gradedOpenLow
  rw [Opens.mem_iSup]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨i, hi⟩ => ⟨i.1, i.2, hi⟩, fun ⟨i, hi, hx⟩ => ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, hx⟩⟩

name: TopCat.Sheaf.gradedOpenInter_le
statement: theorem gradedOpenInter_le : gradedOpenInter V n k ≤ gradedOpen V n k
proof: := inf_le_left

name: TopCat.Sheaf.isCompact_gradedOpen
statement:
theorem isCompact_gradedOpen (hV : ∀ i, IsCompact ((V i : Opens X) : Set X)) :
    IsCompact ((gradedOpen V n k : Opens X) : Set X)
proof:
:= by

  exact isCompact_iUnion fun i => hV i.1

name: TopCat.Sheaf.isCompact_gradedOpenLow
statement:
theorem isCompact_gradedOpenLow (hV : ∀ i, IsCompact ((V i : Opens X) : Set X)) :
    IsCompact ((gradedOpenLow V n k : Opens X) : Set X)
proof:

name: TopCat.Sheaf.isCompact_gradedOpenInter
statement:
theorem isCompact_gradedOpenInter [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (hV : ∀ i, IsCompact ((V i : Opens X) : Set X)) :
    IsCompact ((gradedOpenInter V n k : Opens X) : Set X)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gradedOpenInter
  rw [Opens.coe_inf]
  exact QuasiSeparatedSpace.inter_isCompact _ _ (gradedOpen V n k).isOpen (isCompact_gradedOpen V n k hV)
    (gradedOpenLow V n k).isOpen (isCompact_gradedOpenLow V n k hV)

name: TopCat.Sheaf.exists_gcd_index
statement:
theorem exists_gcd_index (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (hgcd : ∀ (x : X) (J : Finset (Fin t)), J.Nonempty → (∀ j ∈ J, x ∈ V j) → ∃ i, x ∈ V i ∧ n i = J.gcd n)
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ gradedOpenInter V n k) :
    ∃ i j l : Fin t, n i = k + 1 ∧ x ∈ V i ∧ n j ≤ k ∧ x ∈ V j ∧ x ∈ V l ∧ n l ∣ k + 1 ∧ n l ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := (mem_gradedOpen V n k).mp hx.1
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hxj⟩ := (mem_gradedOpenLow V n k).mp hx.2
  classical
  obtain ⟨l, hxl, hl⟩ := hgcd x {i, j} ⟨i, Finset.mem_insert_self i {j}⟩ (by
    intro a ha
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp ha with rfl | ha
    · exact hxi
    · rw [Finset.mem_singleton] at ha
      subst ha
      exact hxj)
  have hli : n l ∣ n i := hl ▸ Finset.gcd_dvd (Finset.mem_insert_self i {j})
  have hlj : n l ∣ n j := hl ▸ Finset.gcd_dvd (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self j))
  exact ⟨i, j, l, hi, hxi, hj, hxj, hxl, hi ▸ hli, le_trans (Nat.le_of_dvd (hn j) hlj) hj⟩

name: TopCat.Sheaf.genSubIn_comp_genSubι
statement: theorem genSubIn_comp_genSubι (i : Fin t) (hi : n i ≤ k) : genSubIn ψ n k i hi ≫ genSubι ψ n k = ψ i
proof:
:= by
  unfold genSubIn genSubι
  rw [Category.assoc, image.fac]
  exact ι_genSubDesc ψ n k ⟨i, hi⟩

name: TopCat.Sheaf.genSubIn_comp_genSubι_comp
statement:
theorem genSubIn_comp_genSubι_comp (i : Fin t) (hi : n i ≤ k)
    {Z : CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}} (m : K ⟶ Z) :
    genSubIn ψ n k i hi ≫ genSubι ψ n k ≫ m = ψ i ≫ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, genSubIn_comp_genSubι]

name: TopCat.Sheaf.mono_genSubι_comp
statement: theorem mono_genSubι_comp [Mono m] : Mono (genSubι ψ n k ≫ m)
proof:
:= by
  have := genSubι_mono ψ n k
  exact mono_comp _ _

name: TopCat.Sheaf.exists_gradedSection
statement:
theorem exists_gradedSection [Mono m]
    (hψ : ∀ i, ψ i ≫ m = ((n i : ℤ) • constantInclusion (V i))) :
    ∃ q : extendByZeroConstant (gradedOpen V n k) ⟶ genSub ψ n (k + 1),
      q ≫ genSubι ψ n (k + 1) ≫ m = (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) • constantInclusion (gradedOpen V n k))
proof:
:= by
  have := mono_genSubι_comp ψ n (k + 1) m
  refine exists_comp_eq_of_cover (fun i : {i : Fin t // n i = k + 1} => V i.1) (fun i => le_gradedOpen V n k i.2)
    (fun x hx => ?_) (genSubι ψ n (k + 1) ≫ m) _
    (fun i => genSubIn ψ n (k + 1) i.1 (le_of_eq i.2)) (fun i => ?_)
  · obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := (mem_gradedOpen V n k).mp hx
    exact ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, hxi⟩
  · rw [genSubIn_comp_genSubι_comp, hψ, Preadditive.comp_zsmul,
      extendByZeroConstantRestrict_comp_constantInclusion, i.2]

name: TopCat.Sheaf.exists_gradedSectionLow
statement:
theorem exists_gradedSectionLow [Mono m] (hn : ∀ i, 0 < n i)
    (hψ : ∀ i, ψ i ≫ m = ((n i : ℤ) • constantInclusion (V i)))
    (hgcd : ∀ (x : X) (J : Finset (Fin t)), J.Nonempty → (∀ j ∈ J, x ∈ V j) → ∃ i, x ∈ V i ∧ n i = J.gcd n) :
    ∃ r : extendByZeroConstant (gradedOpenInter V n k) ⟶ genSub ψ n k,
      r ≫ genSubι ψ n k ≫ m = (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) • constantInclusion (gradedOpenInter V n k))
proof:
:= by
  have := mono_genSubι_comp ψ n k m
  choose i j l hi hxi hj hxj hxl hdvd hlk using fun x : {x : X // x ∈ gradedOpenInter V n k} =>
    exists_gcd_index V n k hn hgcd x.2
  choose d hd using hdvd
  let Wc : {x : X // x ∈ gradedOpenInter V n k} → Opens X := fun x => V (i x) ⊓ V (j x) ⊓ V (l x)
  have hle : ∀ x, Wc x ≤ gradedOpenInter V n k := fun x =>
    le_inf (le_trans inf_le_left (le_trans inf_le_left (le_gradedOpen V n k (hi x))))
      (le_trans inf_le_left (le_trans inf_le_right (le_gradedOpenLow V n k (hj x))))
  have hleL : ∀ x, Wc x ≤ V (l x) := fun x => inf_le_right
  refine exists_comp_eq_of_cover Wc hle (fun x hx => ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨⟨hxi ⟨x, hx⟩, hxj ⟨x, hx⟩⟩, hxl ⟨x, hx⟩⟩⟩)
    (genSubι ψ n k ≫ m) _
    (fun x => extendByZeroConstantRestrict (hleL x) ≫ ((d x : ℤ) • genSubIn ψ n k (l x) (hlk x))) (fun x => ?_)
  rw [Category.assoc, Preadditive.zsmul_comp, genSubIn_comp_genSubι_comp, hψ, Preadditive.comp_zsmul,
    Preadditive.comp_zsmul, extendByZeroConstantRestrict_comp_constantInclusion, Preadditive.comp_zsmul,
    extendByZeroConstantRestrict_comp_constantInclusion, smul_smul, hd x, Nat.cast_mul, mul_comm]

name: TopCat.Sheaf.sheafPullbackConstruction_unit_app_hom
statement:
theorem sheafPullbackConstruction_unit_app_hom {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} D]
    (G : C ⥤ D) (A : Type u₃) [Category.{v₃} A] (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (K : GrothendieckTopology D)
    [G.IsContinuous J K] [HasWeakSheafify K A] [∀ F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A, G.op.HasLeftKanExtension F]
    (F : CategoryTheory.Sheaf J A) :
    ((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous G A J K).unit.app F).hom =
      G.op.lanUnit.app F.obj ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft G.op (toSheafify K (G.op.lan.obj F.obj))
proof:
:= by
  have h := Adjunction.map_restrictFullyFaithful_unit_app
    (((G.op.lanAdjunction A).comp (sheafificationAdjunction K A)))
    (fullyFaithfulSheafToPresheaf J A) (Functor.FullyFaithful.id _)
    (L := Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullback G A J K) (R := G.sheafPushforwardContinuous A J K)
    (Iso.refl _) (Iso.refl _) F
  refine Eq.trans h ?_
  simp only [Adjunction.comp_unit_app, Functor.lanAdjunction_unit, sheafificationAdjunction_unit_app,
    Iso.refl_hom, NatTrans.id_app, Functor.comp_obj, Functor.whiskeringLeft_obj_map]
  erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
  rfl

name: TopCat.Sheaf.toSheafify_comp_presheafToSheaf_map_preimageIso_hom
statement:
theorem toSheafify_comp_presheafToSheaf_map_preimageIso_hom {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} D] [HasWeakSheafify J D]
    {P Q : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ D} (φ : P ⟶ Q) (hQ : CategoryTheory.Presheaf.IsSheaf J Q) :
    toSheafify J P ≫ ((presheafToSheaf J D).map φ ≫
      ((fullyFaithfulSheafToPresheaf J D).preimageIso (X := (presheafToSheaf J D).obj Q) (Y := ⟨Q, hQ⟩)
        (isoSheafify J hQ).symm).hom).hom = φ
proof:
:= by
  simp [isoSheafify_inv]

name: TopCat.Sheaf.lanUnit_app_app_comp_pullbackObjIso_hom_app
statement:
theorem lanUnit_app_app_comp_pullbackObjIso_hom_app {X Y : TopCat.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : IsOpenMap f)
    (P : Y.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (V : Opens Y) :
    ((Opens.map f).op.lanUnit.app P).app (op V) ≫
        (hf.pullbackObjIso P).hom.app (op ((Opens.map f).obj V)) =
      P.map (homOfLE (show hf.functor.obj ((Opens.map f).obj V) ≤ V from
        fun x hx => by obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx; exact hy)).op
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : ((Opens.map f).op.lanUnit.app P).app (op V) =
      ((Functor.LeftExtension.mk _ ((Opens.map f).op.leftKanExtensionUnit P)).coconeAt
        (op ((Opens.map f).obj V))).ι.app (CostructuredArrow.mk (𝟙 _)) := by
    show _ = ((Opens.map f).op.leftKanExtensionUnit P).app (op V) ≫
      ((Opens.map f).op.leftKanExtension P).map (𝟙 _)
    rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
    erw [Category.comp_id]
    rfl
  rw [e1, IsOpenMap.pullbackObjIso_hom_app]
  unfold TopCat.Presheaf.pullbackObjObjOfImageOpen
  dsimp only
  refine Eq.trans (IsColimit.comp_coconePointUniqueUpToIso_hom
    ((Opens.map f).op.isPointwiseLeftKanExtensionLeftKanExtensionUnit P (op ((Opens.map f).obj V)))
    (colimitOfDiagramTerminal _ _) (CostructuredArrow.mk (𝟙 _))) ?_
  dsimp [colimitOfDiagramTerminal, coconeOfDiagramTerminal]
  exact congrArg P.map (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: TopCat.Sheaf.lanUnit_app_app_comp_pullbackIso_hom_app_app
statement:
theorem lanUnit_app_app_comp_pullbackIso_hom_app_app {X Y : TopCat.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (hf : IsOpenMap f)
    (P : Y.Presheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u}) (V : Opens Y) :
    ((Opens.map f).op.lanUnit.app P).app (op V) ≫
        (hf.pullbackIso.hom.app P).app (op ((Opens.map f).obj V)) =
      P.map (homOfLE (show hf.functor.obj ((Opens.map f).obj V) ≤ V from
        fun x hx => by obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx; exact hy)).op
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsOpenMap.pullbackIso
  simp only [NatIso.ofComponents_hom_app]
  exact lanUnit_app_app_comp_pullbackObjIso_hom_app hf P V

name: TopCat.Sheaf.restrictPushforwardAdjunction_unit_app_apply
statement:
theorem restrictPushforwardAdjunction_unit_app_apply
    (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X) (V : (Opens X)ᵒᵖ) (s : F.presheaf.obj V) :
    (((restrictPushforwardAdjunction U).unit.app F).hom.app V).hom s =
      (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE (functor_map_le U V.unop)).op).hom s
proof:
:= by
  have h : (restrictPushforwardAdjunction U).unit =
      (TopCat.Sheaf.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u} (Opens.inclusion' U)).unit ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight ((Opens.isOpenEmbedding U).sheafPullbackIso AddCommGrpCat.{u}).hom
          (TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward AddCommGrpCat.{u} (Opens.inclusion' U)) :=
    Adjunction.ofNatIsoLeft_unit _ _
  rw [h, NatTrans.comp_app, Functor.whiskerRight_app]
  unfold IsOpenEmbedding.sheafPullbackIso
  simp only [Iso.trans_hom, NatTrans.comp_app, NatIso.ofComponents_hom_app]
  rw [Functor.map_comp, ← Category.assoc]
  unfold TopCat.Sheaf.pullbackIso Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafPullbackIso
    TopCat.Sheaf.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
  erw [Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app]
  erw [ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory.comp_hom, NatTrans.comp_app]
  erw [TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward_map, TopCat.Presheaf.pushforward_map_app']
  erw [sheafPullbackConstruction_unit_app_hom]
  rw [NatTrans.comp_app, Functor.whiskerLeft_app]
  erw [Category.assoc]
  erw [← NatTrans.comp_app]
  erw [Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, toSheafify_comp_presheafToSheaf_map_preimageIso_hom]
  erw [lanUnit_app_app_comp_pullbackIso_hom_app_app]
  rfl

name: TopCat.Sheaf.restrictPushforwardAdjunction_unit_app
statement:
theorem restrictPushforwardAdjunction_unit_app
    (F : CategoryTheory.Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    (restrictPushforwardAdjunction U).unit.app F = restrictUnit U F
proof:
:= by
  apply CategoryTheory.Sheaf.hom_ext
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext V
  ext s
  exact restrictPushforwardAdjunction_unit_app_apply U F V s

name: TopCat.Sheaf.natIsoOfRightAdjointNatIso_hom_app
statement:
theorem natIsoOfRightAdjointNatIso_hom_app (A : C) :
    (Adjunction.natIsoOfRightAdjointNatIso adj1 adj2 r).hom.app A =
      ((adj1.ofNatIsoRight r).homEquiv A (F'.obj A)).symm (adj2.unit.app A)
proof:
:= by
  change ((Adjunction.leftAdjointsCoyonedaEquiv adj2 (adj1.ofNatIsoRight r)).hom.app (op A)).app (F'.obj A)
    (𝟙 _) = _
  simp [Adjunction.leftAdjointsCoyonedaEquiv, Adjunction.homEquiv_id]

name: TopCat.Sheaf.unit_natIsoOfRightAdjointNatIso_hom_app
statement:
theorem unit_natIsoOfRightAdjointNatIso_hom_app (A : C) :
    adj1.unit.app A ≫ G.map ((Adjunction.natIsoOfRightAdjointNatIso adj1 adj2 r).hom.app A) ≫
      r.hom.app (F'.obj A) = adj2.unit.app A
proof:
:= by
  have h := ((adj1.ofNatIsoRight r).homEquiv A (F'.obj A)).apply_symm_apply (adj2.unit.app A)
  rw [Adjunction.homEquiv_unit] at h
  rw [natIsoOfRightAdjointNatIso_hom_app]
  conv_rhs => rw [← h]
  simp [Adjunction.ofNatIsoRight]

name: TopCat.Sheaf.constantSheafAdj_unit_app_eq
statement:
theorem constantSheafAdj_unit_app_eq {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (D : Type u₂) [Category.{v₂} D] [HasWeakSheafify J D] {T : C} (hT : IsTerminal T) (A : D) :
    (constantSheafAdj J D hT).unit.app A = (toSheafify J ((Functor.const Cᵒᵖ).obj A)).app (op T)
proof:
:= by
  simp [constantSheafAdj, Adjunction.comp_unit_app]
  rfl

name: TopCat.Sheaf.restrictConstantSheafNatIso_hom_app_constSec
statement:
theorem restrictConstantSheafNatIso_hom_app_constSec :
    ((((restrictConstantSheafNatIso U).hom.app (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))).hom.app
        (op ((Opens.map (Opens.inclusion' U)).obj ⊤))).hom
      (constSec ((Opens.isOpenEmbedding U).functor.obj ((Opens.map (Opens.inclusion' U)).obj ⊤)) 1) : (constZ U).obj.obj (op ((Opens.map (Opens.inclusion' U)).obj ⊤))) =
    constSec ((Opens.map (Opens.inclusion' U)).obj ⊤) 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := unit_natIsoOfRightAdjointNatIso_hom_app
    ((constantSheafAdj (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u} isTerminalTop).comp
      (restrictPushforwardAdjunction U))
    (constantSheafAdj (Opens.grothendieckTopology U) AddCommGrpCat.{u} isTerminalTop)
    (Iso.refl _) (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))
  have h1 := congrArg (fun m => m.hom (⟨1⟩ : ULift.{u} ℤ)) h
  simp only [AddCommGrpCat.hom_comp, AddMonoidHom.comp_apply] at h1
  erw [Adjunction.comp_unit_app] at h1
  rw [restrictPushforwardAdjunction_unit_app] at h1
  erw [constantSheafAdj_unit_app_eq, constantSheafAdj_unit_app_eq] at h1
  have h2 := constSec_res (T := X) (functor_map_le U ⊤) 1
  rw [← h2]
  exact h1

name: TopCat.Sheaf.restrictConstantSheafIso_inv_app_constSec_top
statement:
theorem restrictConstantSheafIso_inv_app_constSec_top :
    ((restrictConstantSheafIso U (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))).inv.hom.app
        (op ((Opens.map (Opens.inclusion' U)).obj ⊤))).hom
      (constSec ((Opens.map (Opens.inclusion' U)).obj ⊤) 1) =
    constSec ((Opens.isOpenEmbedding U).functor.obj ((Opens.map (Opens.inclusion' U)).obj ⊤)) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← restrictConstantSheafNatIso_hom_app_constSec]
  have h := congrArg (fun m => (m.hom.app (op ((Opens.map (Opens.inclusion' U)).obj ⊤))).hom
      (constSec ((Opens.isOpenEmbedding U).functor.obj ((Opens.map (Opens.inclusion' U)).obj ⊤)) 1))
    (Iso.hom_inv_id (restrictConstantSheafIso U (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))))
  exact h

name: TopCat.Sheaf.restrictConstantSheafIso_inv_app_constSec
statement:
theorem restrictConstantSheafIso_inv_app_constSec (W : Opens U) :
    ((restrictConstantSheafIso U (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))).inv.hom.app (op W)).hom (constSec W 1) =
    constSec ((Opens.isOpenEmbedding U).functor.obj W) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hW : W ≤ (Opens.map (Opens.inclusion' U)).obj ⊤ := le_top
  rw [← constSec_res hW 1]
  have hnat := congrArg (fun g => g.hom (constSec ((Opens.map (Opens.inclusion' U)).obj ⊤) 1))
    ((restrictConstantSheafIso U (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))).inv.hom.naturality (homOfLE hW).op)
  refine Eq.trans hnat ?_
  change ((TopCat.Sheaf.restrict (constZ X) U).obj.map (homOfLE hW).op).hom
    (((restrictConstantSheafIso U (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))).inv.hom.app
      (op ((Opens.map (Opens.inclusion' U)).obj ⊤))).hom
        (constSec ((Opens.map (Opens.inclusion' U)).obj ⊤) 1)) = _
  rw [restrictConstantSheafIso_inv_app_constSec_top]
  exact constSec_res (T := X)
    (V := (Opens.isOpenEmbedding U).functor.obj ((Opens.map (Opens.inclusion' U)).obj ⊤))
    (W := (Opens.isOpenEmbedding U).functor.obj W) (Set.image_mono hW) 1

name: TopCat.Sheaf.constantInclusion_unitSection
statement:
theorem constantInclusion_unitSection :
    ((constantInclusion U).hom.app (op U)).hom (unitSection U) = constSec U 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold constantInclusion unitSection
  rw [extendByZeroDesc_val_app_toSheafify, extendByZeroDescApp_of_le U _ (op U) le_rfl]
  erw [restrictConstantSheafIso_inv_app_constSec]
  exact constSec_res _ 1

name: TopCat.Sheaf.constantInclusion_eq_sectionDesc
statement:
theorem constantInclusion_eq_sectionDesc :
    constantInclusion U = sectionDesc (constZ X) U (constSec U 1)
proof:
:=
  hom_ext_of_unitSection U (by rw [constantInclusion_unitSection, sectionDesc_unitSection])

name: TopCat.Sheaf.constantInclusion_extendConstSec
statement:
theorem constantInclusion_extendConstSec {V : Opens X} (hV : V ≤ U) (z : ℤ) :
    ((constantInclusion U).hom.app (op V)).hom (extendConstSec U hV z) = constSec V z
proof:
:= by
  rw [constantInclusion_eq_sectionDesc, sectionDesc_extendConstSec, constSec_res, zsmul_constSec_one]

name: TopCat.Sheaf.restrictExtend_comp_constantInclusion
statement:
theorem restrictExtend_comp_constantInclusion {W : Opens X} (h : W ≤ U) :
    restrictExtend U h ≫ constantInclusion U = constantInclusion W
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext_of_unitSection
  change ((constantInclusion U).hom.app (op W)).hom (((restrictExtend U h).hom.app (op W)).hom (unitSection W)) = _
  rw [restrictExtend_unitSection, unitSection_eq, extendConstSec_res, constantInclusion_extendConstSec,
    constantInclusion_unitSection]

name: TopCat.Sheaf.zsmul_constantInclusion_unitSection
statement:
theorem zsmul_constantInclusion_unitSection (V : Opens X) (z : ℤ) :
    ((z • constantInclusion V).hom.app (op V)).hom (unitSection V) = constSec V z
proof:
:= by
  change z • ((constantInclusion V).hom.app (op V)).hom (unitSection V) = _
  rw [constantInclusion_unitSection, zsmul_constSec_one]

name: TopCat.Sheaf.constZ_obj_eq
statement: theorem constZ_obj_eq : (constZ T).obj = sheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology T) (constZPresheafOn T)
proof: := rfl

name: TopCat.Sheaf.constSec_res
statement:
theorem constSec_res {V W : Opens T} (h : W ≤ V) (z : ℤ) :
    ((constZ T).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom (constSec V z) = constSec W z
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (fun g => g.hom (⟨z⟩ : ULift.{u} ℤ))
    ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology T) (constZPresheafOn T)).naturality (homOfLE h).op)
  exact this.symm

name: TopCat.Sheaf.constSec_add
statement: theorem constSec_add (V : Opens T) (z z' : ℤ) : constSec V (z + z') = constSec V z + constSec V z'
proof:
:= by
  unfold constSec
  rw [← map_add]
  rfl

name: TopCat.Sheaf.constSec_zero
statement: theorem constSec_zero (V : Opens T) : constSec V 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold constSec
  rw [← map_zero (constSecHom V).hom]
  rfl

name: TopCat.Sheaf.constSec_neg
statement: theorem constSec_neg (V : Opens T) (z : ℤ) : constSec V (-z) = -constSec V z
proof:
:= by
