name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffCartier.idealIota_map
statement:
theorem idealIota_map (I : X.IdealSheafData) {W' W : X.Opens} (i : W' ⟶ W) (x : Γ(I.toModules, W)) :
    idealIota I W' (I.toModules.presheaf.map i.op x) = X.presheaf.map i.op (idealIota I W x)
proof:
:=
  PresheafOfModules.naturality_apply (idealIncl I).val i.op x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffCartier.idealIota_injective
statement:
theorem idealIota_injective (I : X.IdealSheafData) (W : X.Opens) :
    Function.Injective (idealIota I W)
proof:
:= by
  have : Mono ((SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op W)).map (idealIncl I)) := inferInstance
  exact (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffCartier.range_idealIota
statement:
theorem range_idealIota (I : X.IdealSheafData) (U : X.affineOpens) :
    Set.range (idealIota I U.1) = (I.ideal U : Set Γ(X, U))
proof:
:=
  I.range_toModules_ι_app U

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffCartier.dualPair_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem dualPair_one (D : X.EffCartier) {V : X.Opens} (x : Γ(D.ideal.toModules, V)) :
    Modules.dualPair D.one (le_top : V ≤ ⊤) x = idealIota D.ideal V x
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffCartier.dualPair_res_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem dualPair_res_one (D : X.EffCartier) {U V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ U)
    (x : Γ(D.ideal.toModules, V)) :
    Modules.dualPair (D.sheaf.res (le_top : U ≤ ⊤) D.one) h x = idealIota D.ideal V x
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffCartier.one_isRegularSection
statement: theorem one_isRegularSection (D : X.EffCartier) : Modules.IsRegularSection D.sheaf D.one
proof:
:= by
  intro U r hr
  have key : ∀ p : U, ∃ (W : X.Opens) (i : W ⟶ U), p.1 ∈ W ∧
      X.presheaf.map i.op r = X.presheaf.map i.op 0 := by
    rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
    obtain ⟨V, hpV, a, ha, hI⟩ := D.exists_localEquation p
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : Γ(D.ideal.toModules, V.1), idealIota D.ideal V.1 x = a := by
      have : a ∈ Set.range (idealIota D.ideal V.1) := by
        rw [range_idealIota, hI]; exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
      exact this
    have hW : U ⊓ V.1 ≤ V.1 := inf_le_right
    refine ⟨U ⊓ V.1, homOfLE inf_le_left, ⟨hp, hpV⟩, ?_⟩
    
    have h0 : Modules.dualPair (r • D.sheaf.res (le_top : U ≤ ⊤) D.one) (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V.1 ≤ U)
        (D.ideal.toModules.res hW x) =
        Modules.dualPair (0 : Γ(D.sheaf, U)) (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V.1 ≤ U)
          (D.ideal.toModules.res hW x) := by rw [hr]
    have hz : Modules.dualPair (0 : Γ(D.sheaf, U)) (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V.1 ≤ U)
        (D.ideal.toModules.res hW x) = 0 := rfl
    rw [hz, Modules.dualPair_smul, dualPair_res_one, idealIota_map D.ideal (homOfLE hW) x, hx] at h0
    rw [map_zero]
    exact (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right.mp (V.2.res_mem_nonZeroDivisors ha hW)) _ h0
  choose W i hpW hW using key
  exact X.sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' W U i
    (fun p hp => TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, hpW _⟩) r 0 hW

name: AlgebraicGeometry.stacks0ag8_exists_map_le_span_of_fg
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.stacks0ag8_exists_map_le_span_of_fg {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (M : Submonoid R) (S : Type v) [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [IsLocalization M S]
    (J : Ideal R) (hJ : J.FG) (a : R)
    (h : J.map (algebraMap R S) ≤ Ideal.span {algebraMap R S a}) :
    ∃ s ∈ M, ∀ {T : Type w} [CommRing T] (f : R →+* T), IsUnit (f s) →
      J.map f ≤ Ideal.span {f a}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := hJ
  have key : ∀ g ∈ G, ∃ s ∈ M, ∃ b : R, s * g = a * b := by
    intro g hg
    have hgJ : g ∈ J := hG ▸ Ideal.subset_span hg
    have hmem : algebraMap R S g ∈ Ideal.span {algebraMap R S a} :=
      h (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hgJ)
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton'.mp hmem
    obtain ⟨⟨b, u⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective M y
    have h1 : algebraMap R S (g * u) = algebraMap R S (b * a) := by
      rw [map_mul, map_mul, ← hy, mul_comm (IsLocalization.mk' S b u) _, mul_assoc,
        IsLocalization.mk'_spec, mul_comm]
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (IsLocalization.eq_iff_exists M S).mp h1
    refine ⟨(c : R) * u, M.mul_mem c.2 u.2, (c : R) * b, ?_⟩
    calc (c : R) * u * g = c * (g * u) := by ring
      _ = c * (b * a) := hc
      _ = a * (c * b) := by ring
  choose! sg hsg bg hbg using key
  refine ⟨∏ g ∈ G, sg g, M.prod_mem (fun g hg => hsg g hg), ?_⟩
  intro T _ f hf
  rw [← hG, Ideal.map_span, Ideal.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
  have hu : IsUnit (f (sg g)) := by
    refine isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left (y := f (∏ x ∈ G.erase g, sg x)) ?_
    rw [← map_mul, Finset.mul_prod_erase G sg hg]
    exact hf
  obtain ⟨u, hu'⟩ := hu
  have hrel : f (sg g) * f g = f a * f (bg g) := by
    rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, hbg g hg]
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Ideal.mem_span_singleton']
  refine ⟨↑u⁻¹ * f (bg g), ?_⟩
  calc ↑u⁻¹ * f (bg g) * f a = ↑u⁻¹ * (f a * f (bg g)) := by ring
    _ = ↑u⁻¹ * (f (sg g) * f g) := by rw [hrel]
    _ = f g := by rw [← hu', ← mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, one_mul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.effectiveCartier_of_locally_principal_nzd
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.effectiveCartier_of_locally_principal_nzd {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    [AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocallyNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ I.support, ∃ (U : X.affineOpens) (hx : x ∈ (U : X.Opens)) (t : Γ(X, (U : X.Opens))),
      (I.ideal U).map (X.presheaf.germ (U : X.Opens) x hx).hom
        = Ideal.span {(X.presheaf.germ (U : X.Opens) x hx).hom t} ∧
      (X.presheaf.germ (U : X.Opens) x hx).hom t ∈ nonZeroDivisors (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    ∃ D : AlgebraicGeometry.EffectiveCartierDivisor X, D.idealSheaf = I
proof:
:= by
  suffices hinv : MiyaokaMori.Statement.IsInvertibleIdeal I from ⟨⟨I, hinv⟩, rfl⟩
  intro y
  by_cases hy : y ∈ I.support
  · obtain ⟨U, hyU, t, hspan, hnzd⟩ := h y hy
    classical
    have : IsNoetherianRing Γ(X, (U : X.Opens)) :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian U
    set 𝔭 : Ideal Γ(X, (U : X.Opens)) := (U.2.primeIdealOf ⟨y, hyU⟩).asIdeal with h𝔭
    let _ : Algebra Γ(X, (U : X.Opens)) (X.presheaf.stalk y) :=
      X.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨y, hyU⟩
    have hloc : IsLocalization.AtPrime (X.presheaf.stalk y) 𝔭 := U.2.isLocalization_stalk ⟨y, hyU⟩
    have hgerm : algebraMap Γ(X, (U : X.Opens)) (X.presheaf.stalk y)
        = (X.presheaf.germ (U : X.Opens) y hyU).hom := rfl
    
    obtain ⟨s₁, hs₁, hspread⟩ := AlgebraicGeometry.stacks0ag8_exists_map_le_span_of_fg
      𝔭.primeCompl (X.presheaf.stalk y) (I.ideal U) (IsNoetherian.noetherian _) t
      (by rw [hgerm, hspan])
    
    have ht : algebraMap Γ(X, (U : X.Opens)) (X.presheaf.stalk y) t
        ∈ (I.ideal U).map (algebraMap Γ(X, (U : X.Opens)) (X.presheaf.stalk y)) := by
      rw [hgerm, hspan]; exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
    obtain ⟨⟨⟨a, ha⟩, u⟩, hau⟩ := (IsLocalization.mem_map_algebraMap_iff 𝔭.primeCompl _).mp ht
    rw [← map_mul] at hau
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (IsLocalization.eq_iff_exists 𝔭.primeCompl (X.presheaf.stalk y)).mp hau
    
    set K : Ideal Γ(X, (U : X.Opens)) := LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.mulLeft Γ(X, (U : X.Opens)) t) with hK
    obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := IsNoetherian.noetherian K
    have hann : ∀ g ∈ G, ∃ m ∈ 𝔭.primeCompl, m * g = 0 := by
      intro g hg
      have hgK : t * g = 0 := by
        have : g ∈ K := hG ▸ Ideal.subset_span hg
        simpa [hK, LinearMap.mem_ker] using this
      have h0 : algebraMap Γ(X, (U : X.Opens)) (X.presheaf.stalk y) g = 0 := by
        apply (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff.mp hnzd).1
        rw [← hgerm, ← map_mul, hgK, map_zero]
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (IsLocalization.map_eq_zero_iff 𝔭.primeCompl (X.presheaf.stalk y) g).mp h0
      exact ⟨m, m.2, hm⟩
    choose! cg hcg hcg0 using hann
    set s₂ : Γ(X, (U : X.Opens)) := ∏ g ∈ G, cg g with hs₂
    have hs₂K : ∀ k ∈ K, s₂ * k = 0 := by
      intro k hk
      have : K ≤ LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.mulLeft Γ(X, (U : X.Opens)) s₂) := by
        rw [← hG, Ideal.span_le]
        intro g hg
        rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply, hs₂,
          ← Finset.mul_prod_erase G cg hg, mul_assoc, mul_comm (∏ x ∈ G.erase g, cg x), ← mul_assoc,
          hcg0 g hg, zero_mul]
      simpa [LinearMap.mem_ker] using this hk
    
    set s : Γ(X, (U : X.Opens)) := s₁ * ((c : Γ(X, (U : X.Opens))) * u) * s₂ with hs
    have hs𝔭 : s ∈ 𝔭.primeCompl :=
      𝔭.primeCompl.mul_mem (𝔭.primeCompl.mul_mem hs₁ (𝔭.primeCompl.mul_mem c.2 u.2))
        (𝔭.primeCompl.prod_mem (fun g hg => hcg g hg))
    have hyW : y ∈ X.basicOpen s :=
      (X.mem_basicOpen s y hyU).mpr
        ((IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_to_map_iff (X.presheaf.stalk y) 𝔭 s).mpr hs𝔭)
    let res : Γ(X, (U : X.Opens)) ⟶ Γ(X, X.basicOpen s) :=
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (X.basicOpen_le s)).op
    have hres_s : IsUnit (res.hom s) := AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.isUnit_res_basicOpen _ s
    have hres_s₁ : IsUnit (res.hom s₁) := by
      refine isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left (y := res.hom ((c : Γ(X, (U : X.Opens))) * u * s₂)) ?_
      have e : s₁ * ((c : Γ(X, (U : X.Opens))) * u * s₂) = s := by rw [hs]; ring
      rw [← map_mul, e]; exact hres_s
    have hres_cu : IsUnit (res.hom ((c : Γ(X, (U : X.Opens))) * u)) := by
      refine isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_left (y := res.hom (s₁ * s₂)) ?_
      have e : (c : Γ(X, (U : X.Opens))) * u * (s₁ * s₂) = s := by rw [hs]; ring
      rw [← map_mul, e]; exact hres_s
    have hIW : I.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen (U := U) s) = Ideal.span {res.hom t} := by
      rw [← I.map_ideal_basicOpen U s]
      refine le_antisymm (hspread res.hom hres_s₁) (Ideal.span_le.mpr ?_)
      rintro _ rfl
      rw [SetLike.mem_coe, ← Ideal.mul_unit_mem_iff_mem _ hres_cu, ← map_mul]
      have hrel : t * ((c : Γ(X, (U : X.Opens))) * u) = c * a := by
        rw [← hc]; ring
      rw [hrel, map_mul]
      exact Ideal.mul_mem_left _ _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ ha)
    
    have hnzdW : ∀ r : Γ(X, X.basicOpen s), res.hom t * r = 0 → r = 0 := by
      have := U.2.isLocalization_basicOpen s
      intro r hr
      change algebraMap Γ(X, (U : X.Opens)) Γ(X, X.basicOpen s) t * r = 0 at hr
      obtain ⟨⟨b, m⟩, rfl⟩ := IsLocalization.mk'_surjective (Submonoid.powers s) r
      rw [IsLocalization.mul_mk'_eq_mk'_of_mul, IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff] at hr
      obtain ⟨⟨_, k, rfl⟩, hk⟩ := hr
      rw [IsLocalization.mk'_eq_zero_iff]
      refine ⟨⟨s ^ (k + 1), pow_mem (Submonoid.mem_powers s) _⟩, ?_⟩
      have hkK : s ^ k * b ∈ K := by
        rw [hK, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.mulLeft_apply]
        rw [← hk]; ring
      have := hs₂K _ hkK
      change s ^ (k + 1) * b = 0
      calc s ^ (k + 1) * b = (s₁ * ((c : Γ(X, (U : X.Opens))) * u)) * (s₂ * (s ^ k * b)) := by
            rw [hs]; ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [this, mul_zero]
    exact ⟨X.affineBasicOpen (U := U) s, hyW, res.hom t, hnzdW, hIW⟩
  · 
    obtain ⟨U, hyU⟩ : ∃ U : X.affineOpens, y ∈ (U : X.Opens) := by
      obtain ⟨_, ⟨U, hU, rfl⟩, hyU, -⟩ :=
        X.isBasis_affineOpens.exists_subset_of_mem_open (Set.mem_univ y) isOpen_univ
      exact ⟨⟨U, hU⟩, hyU⟩
    rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.mem_support_iff_of_mem hyU,
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.mem_zeroLocus_iff] at hy
    push Not at hy
    obtain ⟨s, hsI, hys⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨X.affineBasicOpen (U := U) s, hys, 1, fun r hr => by simpa using hr, ?_⟩
    rw [Ideal.span_singleton_one, ← I.map_ideal_basicOpen U s]
    exact Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem _ (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem _ hsI)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.isUnit_res_basicOpen _ s)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isFrame_ideal_of_span
statement:
theorem isFrame_ideal_of_span (I : X.IdealSheafData) (W : X.affineOpens) {a : Γ(X, W.1)}
    (ha : a ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(X, W.1)) (hI : I.ideal W = Ideal.span {a})
    (x : Γ(I.toModules, W.1)) (hx : EffCartier.idealIota I W.1 x = a) :
    IsFrame I.toModules W.1 x
proof:
:= by
  have hiota : ∀ {W' : X.Opens} (h : W' ≤ W.1),
      EffCartier.idealIota I W' (I.toModules.res h x) = X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op a := by
    intro W' h
    rw [← hx]
    exact EffCartier.idealIota_map I (homOfLE h) x
  intro W' h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r r' hrr
    have hrr' : r • I.toModules.res h x = r' • I.toModules.res h x := hrr
    have h1 := congrArg (EffCartier.idealIota I W') hrr'
    rw [_root_.map_smul, _root_.map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, hiota h] at h1
    have hnzd := W.2.res_mem_nonZeroDivisors ha h
    have h2 : (r - r') * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op a = 0 := by rw [sub_mul, h1, sub_self]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right.mp hnzd _ h2)
  · intro y
    have hb : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op a ∣ EffCartier.idealIota I W' y := by
      refine W.2.dvd_of_locally_dvd ha h _ fun q ↦ ?_
      obtain ⟨f, hfW, hqf⟩ := W.2.exists_basicOpen_le q (h q.2)
      have hBW : (X.affineBasicOpen f).1 ≤ W' := hfW
      refine ⟨(X.affineBasicOpen f).1, hBW, hqf, ?_⟩
      have hmem : EffCartier.idealIota I (X.affineBasicOpen f).1 (I.toModules.res hBW y) ∈
          I.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen f) := by
        have hrange : EffCartier.idealIota I (X.affineBasicOpen f).1 (I.toModules.res hBW y) ∈
            Set.range (EffCartier.idealIota I (X.affineBasicOpen f).1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
        rw [EffCartier.range_idealIota] at hrange
        exact hrange
      rw [← I.map_ideal_basicOpen W f, hI, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at hmem
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hmem
      exact ⟨c, (EffCartier.idealIota_map I (homOfLE hBW) y).symm.trans hc⟩
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hb
    refine ⟨r, EffCartier.idealIota_injective I W' ?_⟩
    show EffCartier.idealIota I W' (r • I.toModules.res h x) = EffCartier.idealIota I W' y
    rw [_root_.map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hiota h, hr, mul_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isInvertibleIdeal_of_isZeroIdeal
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  obtain ⟨W, hW, -, hp, e, he⟩ := exists_affine_frame_le L (U := ⊤) (p := p) trivial
  refine ⟨⟨W, hW⟩, hp, he.coord le_rfl (L.res le_top σ), fun r hr => ?_, hI ⟨W, hW⟩ e he⟩
  exact (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right.mp (hreg.coord_mem_nonZeroDivisors he)) r (by rwa [mul_comm])

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.EffCartier.Presentation.exists_chart
statement: theorem exists_chart (p : X) : ∃ c : Chart P, p ∈ c.W.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW, -, hp, e, he⟩ := exists_affine_frame_le P.bundle (U := ⊤) (p := p) trivial
  have hmem : he.coord le_rfl (P.bundle.res le_top P.sec) ∈
      Set.range (EffCartier.idealIota D.ideal W) := by
    rw [EffCartier.range_idealIota D.ideal ⟨W, hW⟩, P.isZeroIdeal ⟨W, hW⟩ e he]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hmem
  exact ⟨⟨⟨W, hW⟩, e, he, x, hx⟩, hp⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.EffCartier.Presentation.Chart.sec_eq
statement:
theorem sec_eq (c : Chart P) {V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ c.W.1) :
    P.bundle.res (le_top : V ≤ ⊤) P.sec =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (c.he.coord le_rfl (P.bundle.res le_top P.sec)) •
        P.bundle.res h c.e
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := c.he.coord_smul_frame le_rfl (P.bundle.res le_top P.sec)
  rw [res_self] at h1
  have h2 := congrArg (P.bundle.res h) h1
  rw [res_smul, res_res] at h2
  exact h2.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.EffCartier.Presentation.Chart.iota_res
statement:
theorem iota_res (c : Chart P) {V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ c.W.1) :
    EffCartier.idealIota D.ideal V (D.ideal.toModules.res h c.x) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (c.he.coord le_rfl (P.bundle.res le_top P.sec))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← c.hx]
  exact EffCartier.idealIota_map D.ideal (homOfLE h) c.x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.EffCartier.Presentation.Chart.isFrame
statement: theorem isFrame (c : Chart P) : IsFrame D.ideal.toModules c.W.1 c.x
proof:
:=
  isFrame_ideal_of_span D.ideal c.W (hreg.coord_mem_nonZeroDivisors c.he)
    (P.isZeroIdeal c.W c.e c.he) c.x c.hx

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.EffCartier.Presentation.Chart.iota_smul
statement:
theorem iota_smul (c : Chart P) {V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ c.W.1)
    (y : Γ(D.ideal.toModules, V)) (t : Γ(P.bundle, V)) :
    EffCartier.idealIota D.ideal V y • t =
      ((c.isFrame hreg).coord h y * c.he.coord h t) • P.bundle.res (le_top : V ≤ ⊤) P.sec
proof:
:= by
  have hy := (c.isFrame hreg).coord_smul_frame h y
  have ht := c.he.coord_smul_frame h t
  rw [c.sec_eq h]
  conv_lhs => rw [← hy, ← ht]
  rw [_root_.map_smul, smul_eq_mul, c.iota_res h, smul_smul, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  ring

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.EffCartier.Presentation.exists_smul_sec_eq
statement:
theorem exists_smul_sec_eq (V : X.Opens) (y : Γ(D.ideal.toModules, V)) (t : Γ(P.bundle, V)) :
    ∃ r : Γ(X, V), r • P.bundle.res (le_top : V ≤ ⊤) P.sec = EffCartier.idealIota D.ideal V y • t
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ p : V, ∃ (O : X.Opens) (hO : O ≤ V), p.1 ∈ O ∧ ∃ r : Γ(X, O),
      r • P.bundle.res (le_top : O ≤ ⊤) P.sec =
        EffCartier.idealIota D.ideal O (D.ideal.toModules.res hO y) • P.bundle.res hO t := by
    rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hpW⟩ := exists_chart P p
    exact ⟨V ⊓ c.W.1, inf_le_left, ⟨hp, hpW⟩, _, (c.iota_smul hreg inf_le_right _ _).symm⟩
  choose O hO hpO r hr using key
  have hcover : V ≤ iSup O := fun p hp ↦ Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, hpO _⟩
  
  have hres : ∀ (p : V) {O' : X.Opens} (h' : O' ≤ O p),
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h').op (r p) • P.bundle.res (le_top : O' ≤ ⊤) P.sec =
        EffCartier.idealIota D.ideal O' (D.ideal.toModules.res (h'.trans (hO p)) y) •
          P.bundle.res (h'.trans (hO p)) t := by
    intro p O' h'
    have := congrArg (P.bundle.res h') (hr p)
    rw [res_smul, res_res, res_smul, res_res] at this
    rw [this, EffCartier.idealIota_map, EffCartier.idealIota_map, Scheme.presheaf_map_map]
  have hcompat : TopCat.Presheaf.IsCompatible X.presheaf O r := by
    intro p q
    apply (isRegularSection_iff_injective P.bundle P.sec).mp hreg (O p ⊓ O q)
    show X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : O p ⊓ O q ≤ O p)).op (r p) •
        P.bundle.res le_top P.sec =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : O p ⊓ O q ≤ O q)).op (r q) • P.bundle.res le_top P.sec
    rw [hres p inf_le_left, hres q inf_le_right]
  obtain ⟨s', hs, -⟩ := X.sheaf.existsUnique_gluing' O V (fun p ↦ homOfLE (hO p)) hcover r hcompat
  let s : Γ(X, V) := s'
  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
  refine TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq' ⟨P.bundle.presheaf, P.bundle.isSheaf⟩ O V
    (fun p ↦ homOfLE (hO p)) hcover _ _ fun p ↦ ?_
  have hs' : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hO p)).op s = r p := hs p
  show P.bundle.res (hO p) (s • P.bundle.res le_top P.sec) =
    P.bundle.res (hO p) (EffCartier.idealIota D.ideal V y • t)
  rw [res_smul P.bundle (hO p) s, res_res, hs', hr p,
    res_smul P.bundle (hO p) (EffCartier.idealIota D.ideal V y) t, EffCartier.idealIota_map]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.EffCartier.Presentation.divide_spec
statement:
theorem divide_spec {V : X.Opens} (y : Γ(D.ideal.toModules, V)) (t : Γ(P.bundle, V)) :
    divide P hreg y t • P.bundle.res (le_top : V ≤ ⊤) P.sec = EffCartier.idealIota D.ideal V y • t
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (exists_smul_sec_eq P hreg V y t)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.EffCartier.Presentation.divide_unique
proof:
:=
  (isRegularSection_iff_injective P.bundle P.sec).mp hreg V ((divide_spec P hreg y t).trans hr.symm)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.EffCartier.Presentation.divide_add_left
statement:
theorem divide_add_left {V : X.Opens} (y y' : Γ(D.ideal.toModules, V)) (t : Γ(P.bundle, V)) :
    divide P hreg (y + y') t = divide P hreg y t + divide P hreg y' t
proof:
:= by
  apply divide_unique
  rw [add_smul, divide_spec, divide_spec, map_add, add_smul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.EffCartier.Presentation.divide_smul_left
statement:
theorem divide_smul_left {V : X.Opens} (c : Γ(X, V)) (y : Γ(D.ideal.toModules, V)) (t : Γ(P.bundle, V)) :
    divide P hreg (c • y) t = c * divide P hreg y t
proof:
:= by
  apply divide_unique
  rw [mul_smul, divide_spec, _root_.map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.EffCartier.Presentation.divide_add_right
statement:
theorem divide_add_right {V : X.Opens} (y : Γ(D.ideal.toModules, V)) (t t' : Γ(P.bundle, V)) :
    divide P hreg y (t + t') = divide P hreg y t + divide P hreg y t'
proof:
:= by
  apply divide_unique
  rw [add_smul, divide_spec, divide_spec, smul_add]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.EffCartier.Presentation.divide_smul_right
statement:
theorem divide_smul_right {V : X.Opens} (y : Γ(D.ideal.toModules, V)) (c : Γ(X, V)) (t : Γ(P.bundle, V)) :
    divide P hreg y (c • t) = c * divide P hreg y t
proof:
:= by
  apply divide_unique
  rw [mul_smul, divide_spec, smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.EffCartier.Presentation.divide_res
statement:
theorem divide_res {V' V : X.Opens} (h : V' ≤ V) (y : Γ(D.ideal.toModules, V)) (t : Γ(P.bundle, V)) :
    divide P hreg (D.ideal.toModules.res h y) (P.bundle.res h t) =
      X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op (divide P hreg y t)
proof:
:= by
  apply divide_unique
  have := congrArg (P.bundle.res h) (divide_spec P hreg y t)
  rw [res_smul, res_res, res_smul] at this
  rw [EffCartier.idealIota_map]
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.EffCartier.Presentation.divide_chart
statement:
theorem divide_chart (c : Chart P) {V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ c.W.1)
    (y : Γ(D.ideal.toModules, V)) (t : Γ(P.bundle, V)) :
    divide P hreg y t = (c.isFrame hreg).coord h y * c.he.coord h t
proof:
:=
  divide_unique P hreg (c.iota_smul hreg h y t).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.EffCartier.Presentation.dualPair_toDualSections
statement:
@[simp] theorem dualPair_toDualSections {U : X.Opens} (t : Γ(P.bundle, U)) {V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ U)
    (y : Γ(D.ideal.toModules, V)) :
    dualPair (toDualSections P hreg U t) h y = divide P hreg y (P.bundle.res h t)
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.EffCartier.Presentation.res_toDualSections
statement:
theorem res_toDualSections {U V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ U) (t : Γ(P.bundle, U)) :
    (dualSheaf D.ideal.toModules).res h (toDualSections P hreg U t) =
      toDualSections P hreg V (P.bundle.res h t)
proof:
:= by
  apply dualSheaf_ext
  intro V' h'
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  rw [dualPair_res_left, dualPair_toDualSections, dualPair_toDualSections, res_res]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.EffCartier.Presentation.toDualHom_app
statement:
theorem toDualHom_app (U : X.Opens) (t : Γ(P.bundle, U)) :
    (toDualHom P hreg).app U t = toDualSections P hreg U t
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.EffCartier.Presentation.toDualSections_bijective
statement:
theorem toDualSections_bijective (c : Chart P) {V : X.Opens} (h : V ≤ c.W.1) :
    Function.Bijective (toDualSections P hreg V)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro t t' htt
    have h1 := congrArg (fun φ => dualPair φ le_rfl (D.ideal.toModules.res h c.x)) htt
    simp only [dualPair_toDualSections, res_self] at h1
    rw [divide_chart P hreg c h, divide_chart P hreg c h, (c.isFrame hreg).coord_frame h, one_mul,
      one_mul] at h1
    exact (c.he.coordEquiv h).injective h1
  · intro ψ
    refine ⟨dualPair ψ le_rfl (D.ideal.toModules.res h c.x) • P.bundle.res h c.e, ?_⟩
    apply dualSheaf_ext
    intro V' h'
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro y
    rw [dualPair_toDualSections, divide_chart P hreg c (h'.trans h), res_smul, c.he.coord_smul, res_res,
      c.he.coord_frame, mul_one]
    have hy := (c.isFrame hreg).coord_smul_frame (h'.trans h) y
    have h2 : dualPair ψ h' y =
        (c.isFrame hreg).coord (h'.trans h) y *
          X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h').op (dualPair ψ le_rfl (D.ideal.toModules.res h c.x)) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← hy]
      rw [_root_.map_smul, smul_eq_mul, ← res_res D.ideal.toModules h' h c.x]
      congr 1
      exact dualPair_res ψ h' le_rfl _
    exact h2.symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.EffCartier.Presentation.toDualHom_isIso
statement: theorem toDualHom_isIso : IsIso (toDualHom P hreg)
proof:
:= by
  apply AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.moduleHom_isIso_of_locally_isIso
  intro p
  obtain ⟨c, hp⟩ := exists_chart P p
  refine ⟨c.W.1, hp, ?_⟩
  apply isIso_of_bijective
  intro O
  show Function.Bijective (fun s : Γ(P.bundle, c.W.1.ι ''ᵁ O) => (toDualHom P hreg).app (c.W.1.ι ''ᵁ O) s)
  exact toDualSections_bijective P hreg c (image_ι_le c.W.1 O)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.EffectiveCartierDivisor.exists_stalkIdeal_eq_span_singleton
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.EffectiveCartierDivisor.exists_stalkIdeal_eq_span_singleton
    {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} [AlgebraicGeometry.IsIntegral X]
    (D : AlgebraicGeometry.EffectiveCartierDivisor X) (x : X) :
    ∃ d : X.presheaf.stalk x, d ≠ 0 ∧ D.idealSheaf.stalkIdeal x = Ideal.span {d}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hxU, a, ha, hI⟩ := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffCartier.exists_localEquation D x
  refine ⟨X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hxU a, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h0
    have hinj := AlgebraicGeometry.germ_injective_of_isIntegral (X := X) (U := U.1) x hxU
    have hnt : Nontrivial Γ(X, U.1) := (X.presheaf.germ U.1 x hxU).hom.domain_nontrivial
    have ha0 : a = 0 := hinj (by rw [h0, map_zero])
    exact nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero ha ha0
  · rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.stalkIdeal_eq_map_germ D.idealSheaf x U hxU, hI,
      Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.mem_genericPoints_of_isMax
statement:
theorem mem_genericPoints_of_isMax (Z : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}) {z' : Z} (h : IsMax z') :
    z' ∈ genericPoints Z
proof:
:= by
  show closure ({z'} : Set Z) ∈ irreducibleComponents Z
  obtain ⟨w', hw'⟩ := QuasiSober.sober (isIrreducible_irreducibleComponent (x := z'))
    isClosed_irreducibleComponent
  have hmem : z' ∈ closure ({w'} : Set Z) := by
    rw [hw'.def]; exact mem_irreducibleComponent
  have hle : z' ≤ w' := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr
    (specializes_iff_mem_closure.mpr hmem)
  have heq : w' = z' :=
    ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp (h hle)).antisymm
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hle)).eq.symm
  rw [← heq, hw'.def]
  exact irreducibleComponent_mem_irreducibleComponents z'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.isMax_of_coheight_eq_one_of_notMem_range
proof:
:= by
  intro w' hw'
  by_contra hne
  have hlt : z' < w' := lt_of_le_not_ge hw' hne
  have hlt' : ι.base z' < ι.base w' := (ι.lt_iff_of_isClosedImmersion _ _).mpr hlt
  have h1 := Order.coheight_add_one_le hlt'
  rw [hz] at h1
  have h0 : Order.coheight (ι.base w') = 0 := by
    have hnt : Order.coheight (ι.base w') ≠ ⊤ := by
      intro ht
      rw [ht, top_add] at h1
      simp at h1
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := ENat.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hnt
    rw [← hm] at h1 ⊢
    norm_cast at h1 ⊢
    omega
  have hmax : IsMax (ι.base w') := Order.coheight_eq_zero.mp h0
  have hle : ι.base w' ≤ genericPoint X :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mpr (genericPoint_specializes _)
  exact hη ⟨w', ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp (hmax hle)).antisymm
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.le_iff_specializes.mp hle)).eq⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.genericPoint_notMem_idealSheafOfSection_support
statement:
theorem genericPoint_notMem_idealSheafOfSection_support {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    [AlgebraicGeometry.IsIntegral X] (L : X.Modules) [L.IsLineBundle]
    (σ : (L.val.obj (Opposite.op ⊤) : Type u))
    (hση : L.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint X) trivial (show Γ(L, ⊤) from σ) ≠ 0) :
    genericPoint X ∉ (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.idealSheafOfSection L σ).support
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_idealSheafOfSection_support_iff]
  intro hmem
  let _ : Field (X.presheaf.stalk (genericPoint X)) := inferInstanceAs (Field X.functionField)
  rw [IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal_eq_bot, Submodule.bot_smul] at hmem
  exact hση ((Submodule.mem_bot _).mp hmem)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ord_algebraMap_eq_of_ord_eq
statement:
theorem ord_algebraMap_eq_of_ord_eq {W : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} [AlgebraicGeometry.IsIntegral W]
    [AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocallyNoetherian W] (z : W) (hz : Order.coheight z = 1)
    {f : W.presheaf.stalk z} (hf : f ≠ 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : Ring.ord (W.presheaf.stalk z) f = n) :
    W.ord (algebraMap (W.presheaf.stalk z) W.functionField f) z = n
proof:
:= by
  have : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (W.presheaf.stalk z) := AlgebraicGeometry.krullDimLE_of_coheight_le hz.le
  have hne : algebraMap (W.presheaf.stalk z) W.functionField f ≠ 0 :=
    (map_ne_zero_iff _ (IsFractionRing.injective _ _)).mpr hf
  apply (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ord_eq_iff hz hne).2
  change Ring.ordFrac (W.presheaf.stalk z) _ = _
  rw [Ring.ordFrac_eq_ord _ hf]
  exact Ring.ordMonoidWithZeroHom_eq_coe _ (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hf) hn

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.idealSheafOfSection_cycle_apply_of_coheight_eq_one
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.idealSheafOfSection_cycle_apply_of_coheight_eq_one
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    [AlgebraicGeometry.IsIntegral X] [AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsLineBundle] (σ : (L.val.obj (Opposite.op ⊤) : Type u)) (hσ : σ ≠ 0)
    (d : ℕ) (hX : X.dimension = d + 1) (z : X) (hz : Order.coheight z = 1) :
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.idealSheafOfSection L σ).cycle d z =
      L.rationalSectionOrd
        (L.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint X) trivial (show Γ(L, ⊤) from σ)) z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set I := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.idealSheafOfSection L σ with hI
  have hση : L.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint X) trivial (show Γ(L, ⊤) from σ) ≠ 0 :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.germ_genericPoint_ne_zero L σ hσ
  by_cases hzZ : z ∈ I.support
  swap
  · rw [I.cycle_apply_of_notMem_support d hzZ,
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.rationalSectionOrd_germ_eq_zero_of_notMem_support L σ hzZ]
  have hzZ' : z ∈ Set.range I.subschemeι.base := by
    rw [I.range_subschemeι]; exact hzZ
  obtain ⟨z', rfl⟩ := hzZ'
  have : AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocallyNoetherian I.subscheme :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian I.subschemeι
  rw [I.cycle_apply_subschemeι d z']
  
  obtain ⟨W, hW, -, hzW, e, hf⟩ := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.exists_affine_frame_le L
    (U := ⊤) (p := I.subschemeι.base z') trivial
  set σW : Γ(L, W) := L.res (le_top : W ≤ ⊤) (show Γ(L, ⊤) from σ) with hσW
  set c := hf.coord le_rfl σW with hcdef
  have hc : c • L.res le_rfl e = σW := hf.coord_smul_frame le_rfl σW
  have hIW : I.ideal ⟨W, hW⟩ = Ideal.span {c} :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.idealSheafOfSection_ideal_eq_span_coord L σ hW hf
  set f := X.presheaf.germ W (I.subschemeι.base z') hzW c with hfdef
  set ez := L.presheaf.germ W (I.subschemeι.base z') hzW e with hezdef
  have hez := hf.span_germ_eq_top hzW
  have hgerm : L.presheaf.germ ⊤ (I.subschemeι.base z') trivial (show Γ(L, ⊤) from σ) = f • ez := by
    have h1 : L.presheaf.germ ⊤ (I.subschemeι.base z') trivial (show Γ(L, ⊤) from σ) =
        L.presheaf.germ W (I.subschemeι.base z') hzW σW :=
      (TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply L.presheaf (CategoryTheory.homOfLE (le_top : W ≤ ⊤)) _ hzW
        _).symm
    rw [h1, ← hc, AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.germ_smul',
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.res_self]
  have hj := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.moduleStalkToGenericFiber_germ_top L σ (I.subschemeι.base z')
  have hf0 : f ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hση
    rw [← hj, hgerm, h0, zero_smul, map_zero]
  
  have hRHS : L.rationalSectionOrd (L.presheaf.germ ⊤ (genericPoint X) trivial (show Γ(L, ⊤) from σ))
      (I.subschemeι.base z') =
      X.ord (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk (I.subschemeι.base z')) X.functionField f)
        (I.subschemeι.base z') := by
    refine AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.rationalSectionOrd_eq_ord_of_generator L _ ez hez _ _
      hση ?_
    rw [← hj, hgerm, map_smulₛₗ]
  rw [hRHS]
  have : Ring.KrullDimLE 1 (X.presheaf.stalk (I.subschemeι.base z')) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.krullDimLE_of_coheight_le hz.le
  have hord_ne : Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk (I.subschemeι.base z')) f ≠ ⊤ :=
    Ring.ord_ne_top (mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_ne_zero hf0)
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, Ring.ord (X.presheaf.stalk (I.subschemeι.base z')) f = n :=
    ⟨_, (ENat.natCast_toNat_eq_self.mpr hord_ne).symm⟩
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ord_algebraMap_eq_of_ord_eq _ hz hf0 hn]
  
  have hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = ((d + 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    have hne : topologicalKrullDim X ≠ ⊥ := by
      unfold topologicalKrullDim
      have : Nonempty (TopologicalSpace.IrreducibleCloseds X) :=
        ⟨⟨Set.univ, (IrreducibleSpace.isIrreducible_univ X), isClosed_univ⟩⟩
      exact Order.krullDim_ne_bot_iff.mpr inferInstance
    have hnt : topologicalKrullDim X ≠ ⊤ := by
      intro h
      unfold AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.dimension at hX
      rw [h] at hX
      have : (WithBot.unbotD 0 (⊤ : WithBot ℕ∞)).toNat = 0 := by
        show (⊤ : ℕ∞).toNat = 0
        exact ENat.toNat_top
      omega
    rw [X.dimension_spec hne hnt, hX]
  have hht : Order.height (I.subschemeι.base z') = (d : ℕ∞) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.height_eq_of_coheight_eq_one
      (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) hdim hz
  have hpcd : AlgebraicGeometry.Intersection.pointClosureDimension I.subscheme z' = (d : WithBot ℕ∞) := by
    rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Intersection.pointClosureDimension_eq_height,
      ← I.subschemeι.height_of_isClosedImmersion z', hht]
    rfl
  
  have hη : genericPoint X ∉ Set.range I.subschemeι.base := by
    rw [I.range_subschemeι]
    exact AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.genericPoint_notMem_idealSheafOfSection_support L σ hση
  have hgen : z' ∈ genericPoints I.subscheme :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.mem_genericPoints_of_isMax _
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.isMax_of_coheight_eq_one_of_notMem_range I.subschemeι hz hη)
  
  have hmult : AlgebraicGeometry.Intersection.fundamentalMultiplicity I.subscheme z' = (n : ℕ∞) := by
    rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Intersection.fundamentalMultiplicity_of_generic _ _ hgen,
      ← AlgebraicGeometry.Intersection.closedSubschemeStalkLength_eq I.subschemeι z',
      I.closedSubschemeStalkLength_subschemeι_eq ⟨W, hW⟩ z' hzW, hIW, Ideal.map_span,
      Set.image_singleton]
    exact hn
  show (if AlgebraicGeometry.Intersection.pointClosureDimension I.subscheme z' = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)
    then AlgebraicGeometry.Intersection.integralFundamentalMultiplicity I.subscheme z' else 0) = (n : ℤ)
  rw [if_pos hpcd]
  have h1 := AlgebraicGeometry.Intersection.integralFundamentalMultiplicity_toNat I.subscheme z'
  rw [hmult] at h1
  have h2 : (AlgebraicGeometry.Intersection.integralFundamentalMultiplicity I.subscheme z').toNat = n :=
    Nat.cast_injective h1
  rw [← h2, Int.toNat_of_nonneg (AlgebraicGeometry.Intersection.integralFundamentalMultiplicity_nonneg _ _)]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffCartier.exists_frame_ideal
statement:
theorem exists_frame_ideal (D : X.EffCartier) (p : X) :
    ∃ (W : X.Opens) (_ : p ∈ W) (e : Γ(D.ideal.toModules, W)),
      Modules.IsFrame D.ideal.toModules W e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V, hpV, a, ha, hI⟩ := D.exists_localEquation p
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x : Γ(D.ideal.toModules, V.1), idealIota D.ideal V.1 x = a := by
    have : a ∈ Set.range (idealIota D.ideal V.1) := by
      rw [range_idealIota, hI]; exact Ideal.subset_span rfl
    exact this
  have hiota : ∀ {W' : X.Opens} (h : W' ≤ V.1),
      idealIota D.ideal W' (D.ideal.toModules.res h x) = X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op a := by
    intro W' h
    rw [← hx]
    exact idealIota_map D.ideal (homOfLE h) x
  refine ⟨V.1, hpV, x, fun W' h ↦ ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro r r' hrr
    have hrr' : r • D.ideal.toModules.res h x = r' • D.ideal.toModules.res h x := hrr
    have h1 := congrArg (idealIota D.ideal W') hrr'
    rw [map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, hiota h] at h1
    have hnzd := V.2.res_mem_nonZeroDivisors ha h
    have h2 : (r - r') * X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op a = 0 := by rw [sub_mul, h1, sub_self]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right.mp hnzd _ h2)
  · intro y
    have hb : X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op a ∣ idealIota D.ideal W' y := by
      refine V.2.dvd_of_locally_dvd ha h _ fun q ↦ ?_
      obtain ⟨f, hfW, hqf⟩ := V.2.exists_basicOpen_le q (h q.2)
      have hBW : (X.affineBasicOpen f).1 ≤ W' := hfW
      refine ⟨(X.affineBasicOpen f).1, hBW, hqf, ?_⟩
      have hmem : idealIota D.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen f).1 (D.ideal.toModules.res hBW y) ∈
          D.ideal.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen f) := by
        have hrange : idealIota D.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen f).1 (D.ideal.toModules.res hBW y) ∈
            Set.range (idealIota D.ideal (X.affineBasicOpen f).1) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
        rw [range_idealIota] at hrange
        exact hrange
      rw [← D.ideal.map_ideal_basicOpen V f, hI, Ideal.map_span, Set.image_singleton] at hmem
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_singleton.mp hmem
      exact ⟨c, (idealIota_map D.ideal (homOfLE hBW) y).symm.trans hc⟩
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hb
    refine ⟨r, idealIota_injective D.ideal W' ?_⟩
    show idealIota D.ideal W' (r • D.ideal.toModules.res h x) = idealIota D.ideal W' y
    rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, hiota h, hr, mul_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffCartier.lineBundle_toModules
statement: @[simp] theorem lineBundle_toModules (D : X.EffCartier) : D.lineBundle.toModules = D.sheaf
proof: := rfl

name: CategoryTheory.Adjunction.projFormulaHom_tensorUnit_right_unit_compat
statement:
theorem projFormulaHom_tensorUnit_right_unit_compat (M : C) :
    (M ◁ (adj.unit.app (𝟙_ C) ≫ G.map (η F))) ≫ adj.projFormulaHom M (𝟙_ D) ≫
        G.map (ρ_ (F.obj M)).hom =
      (ρ_ M).hom ≫ adj.unit.app M
proof:
:= by
  apply (adj.homEquiv _ _).symm.injective
  rw [homEquiv_naturality_left_symm, homEquiv_naturality_right_symm,
    homEquiv_symm_projFormulaHom, homEquiv_naturality_left_symm, homEquiv_symm_unit, comp_id,
    assoc, ← δ_natural_right_assoc, ← whiskerLeft_comp_assoc, F.map_comp, assoc]
  dsimp only [Functor.id_obj, Functor.comp_obj]
  rw [adj.counit_naturality, adj.left_triangle_components_assoc]
  have h : δ F M (𝟙_ C) ≫ F.obj M ◁ η F = F.map (ρ_ M).hom ≫ (ρ_ (F.obj M)).inv := by
    rw [oplax_right_unitality F M, ← F.map_comp_assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id, F.map_id, id_comp]
  rw [← assoc, h, assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, comp_id]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.unitTensorMonoidalIso_hom_eq
statement:
theorem unitTensorMonoidalIso_hom_eq (M : X.Modules) :
    (Scheme.Modules.unitTensorMonoidalIso M).hom = (λ_ M).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Scheme.Modules.unitTensorMonoidalIso, Scheme.Modules.unitTensorIso, Iso.trans_hom,
    Iso.symm_hom, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
  erw [whiskerRightIso_hom, eqToIso.hom]
  have : eqToHom (Scheme.Modules.unit_eq_tensorUnit X) = 𝟙 _ := by with_unfolding_all rfl
  erw [this, id_whiskerRight, id_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit_eq_unit_comp
statement:
theorem unitToPushforwardObjUnit_eq_unit_comp {Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) :
    SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit i.toRingCatSheafHom =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).unit.app (𝟙_ X.Modules) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).map (η (Scheme.Modules.pullback i))
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).homEquiv _ _
      (η (Scheme.Modules.pullback i)) =
        SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit i.toRingCatSheafHom := by
    have : (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u} i.toRingCatSheafHom).IsRightAdjoint :=
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).isRightAdjoint
    rw [Scheme.Modules.pullback_η]
    exact SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction_homEquiv_pullbackObjUnitToUnit _
  exact h.symm.trans ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction i).homEquiv_unit _ _ _)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.EffectiveCartierDivisor.exists_pushforwardUnit_tensor_iso_compat
statement:
theorem EffectiveCartierDivisor.exists_pushforwardUnit_tensor_iso_compat
    (D : EffectiveCartierDivisor X) (M : X.Modules) [M.IsLineBundle] :
    ∃ e : (MonoidalCategoryStruct.tensorObj (C := X.Modules)
            ((SheafOfModules.pushforward (Scheme.Hom.toRingCatSheafHom D.idealSheaf.subschemeι)).obj
              (SheafOfModules.unit D.idealSheaf.subscheme.ringCatSheaf)) M
          ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward D.idealSheaf.subschemeι).obj
              ((Scheme.Modules.pullback D.idealSheaf.subschemeι).obj M)),
      (MonoidalCategoryStruct.whiskerRight (C := X.Modules)
          (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
            (Scheme.Hom.toRingCatSheafHom D.idealSheaf.subschemeι)) M) ≫ e.hom
        = (Scheme.Modules.unitTensorMonoidalIso M).hom ≫
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction D.idealSheaf.subschemeι).unit.app M
proof:
:= by
  have key : (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction D.idealSheaf.subschemeι).unit.app
          (𝟙_ X.Modules) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward D.idealSheaf.subschemeι).map
          (η (Scheme.Modules.pullback D.idealSheaf.subschemeι))) ▷ M) ≫
      (β_ ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward D.idealSheaf.subschemeι).obj
        (𝟙_ D.idealSheaf.subscheme.Modules)) M).hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction D.idealSheaf.subschemeι).projFormulaHom M
        (𝟙_ D.idealSheaf.subscheme.Modules) ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward D.idealSheaf.subschemeι).map
        (ρ_ ((Scheme.Modules.pullback D.idealSheaf.subschemeι).obj M)).hom =
      (λ_ M).hom ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction D.idealSheaf.subschemeι).unit.app M := by
    rw [BraidedCategory.braiding_naturality_left_assoc, ← braiding_rightUnitor, assoc]
    congr 1
    exact (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
      D.idealSheaf.subschemeι).projFormulaHom_tensorUnit_right_unit_compat M
  refine ⟨β_ _ M ≪≫
    Scheme.Modules.projectionFormulaIso D.idealSheaf.subschemeι M (𝟙_ _) ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforward D.idealSheaf.subschemeι).mapIso (ρ_ _), ?_⟩
  rw [Scheme.Modules.unitTensorMonoidalIso_hom_eq,
    Scheme.Modules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit_eq_unit_comp]
  exact key

name: AlgebraicGeometry.EffectiveCartierDivisor.exists_shortExact_restriction
statement:
theorem EffectiveCartierDivisor.exists_shortExact_restriction {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (D : EffectiveCartierDivisor X) (M : X.Modules) [M.IsLineBundle] :
    ∃ (f : Scheme.Modules.tensor M (Scheme.Modules.dual D.lineBundle) ⟶ M)
      (w : f ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction D.idealSheaf.subschemeι).unit.app M = 0),
      (ShortComplex.mk f
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction D.idealSheaf.subschemeι).unit.app M) w).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  
  have hS := Scheme.IdealSheafData.shortExact_kernel_unit D.idealSheaf
  
  obtain ⟨T, e₁, e₂, e₃, h₁, h₂, hT⟩ :=
    Scheme.Modules.shortExact_tensor_lineBundle M _ hS
  
  have : (Scheme.IdealSheafData.toModules D.idealSheaf).IsLineBundle := D.isLineBundle
  obtain ⟨dd⟩ := Scheme.Modules.dual_dual (Scheme.IdealSheafData.toModules D.idealSheaf)
  
  
  let dd' : Scheme.IdealSheafData.toModules D.idealSheaf ≅ Scheme.Modules.dual D.lineBundle :=
    dd.symm ≪≫ (Scheme.Modules.dualDualSheafIsoOld
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.toModules D.idealSheaf)).symm
  let a₁ : T.X₁ ≅ Scheme.Modules.tensor M (Scheme.Modules.dual D.lineBundle) :=
    e₁ ≪≫ β_ _ _ ≪≫ whiskerLeftIso M dd' ≪≫ (Scheme.Modules.tensorIsoTensorObj M _).symm
  
  let a₂ : T.X₂ ≅ M := e₂ ≪≫ Scheme.Modules.unitTensorMonoidalIso M
  
  obtain ⟨ee, hee⟩ := EffectiveCartierDivisor.exists_pushforwardUnit_tensor_iso_compat D M
  let a₃ : T.X₃ ≅ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward D.idealSheaf.subschemeι).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback D.idealSheaf.subschemeι).obj M) := e₃ ≪≫ ee
  
  have hcomm : a₂.hom ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction D.idealSheaf.subschemeι).unit.app M
        = T.g ≫ a₃.hom := by
    dsimp only [a₂, a₃, Iso.trans_hom]
    rw [Category.assoc, ← hee, ← Category.assoc, ← h₂, Category.assoc]
  refine ⟨a₁.inv ≫ T.f ≫ a₂.hom, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hcomm, ← Category.assoc T.f T.g, T.zero,
      Limits.zero_comp, Limits.comp_zero]
  · refine ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso (ShortComplex.isoMk a₁ a₂ a₃ ?_ ?_) hT
    · exact a₁.hom_inv_id_assoc _
    · exact hcomm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.idealSheafOfSection_isZeroIdeal
proof:
:= by
  intro W e he
  show Ideal.span (Set.range fun φ : Γ(L, W.1) →ₗ[Γ(X, W.1)] Γ(X, W.1) =>
      φ (L.presheaf.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE le_top).op σ)) =
    Ideal.span {he.coord le_rfl (L.res le_top σ)}
  have h1 := he.coord_smul_frame le_rfl (L.res le_top σ)
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.res_self] at h1
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Ideal.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨φ, rfl⟩
    have h2 : φ (L.res le_top σ) = he.coord le_rfl (L.res le_top σ) * φ e := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← h1]
      rw [_root_.map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    show φ (L.res le_top σ) ∈ Ideal.span {he.coord le_rfl (L.res le_top σ)}
    rw [h2]
    exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ _ (Ideal.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  · rw [Ideal.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
    exact Ideal.subset_span ⟨(he.coordEquiv le_rfl).toLinearMap, rfl⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_effectiveCartierDivisor_of_regular_section
statement:
theorem AlgebraicGeometry.exists_effectiveCartierDivisor_of_regular_section
    {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsLineBundle] (σ : (L.val.obj (Opposite.op ⊤) : Type u))
                                                                                                        
                                                                              
    (hσ : ∀ U : X.Opens, Function.Injective (fun r : Γ(X, U) =>
        r • ((L.presheaf.map (CategoryTheory.homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op).hom σ : Γ(L, U)))) :
    ∃ D : AlgebraicGeometry.EffectiveCartierDivisor X,
      D.idealSheaf = AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.idealSheafOfSection L σ ∧
      Nonempty (AlgebraicGeometry.EffectiveCartierDivisor.lineBundle D ≅ L)
proof:
:= by
  have hreg : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.IsRegularSection L σ :=
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isRegularSection_iff_injective L σ).mpr hσ
  have hZ := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.idealSheafOfSection_isZeroIdeal L σ
  let D : X.EffCartier :=
    ⟨AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.idealSheafOfSection L σ,
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isInvertibleIdeal_of_isZeroIdeal hreg hZ⟩
  let P : D.Presentation := { bundle := L, sec := σ, isZeroIdeal := hZ }
  exact ⟨D, rfl, ⟨AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.EffCartier.Presentation.sheafIso P hreg⟩⟩

name: MiyaokaMori.EffCartierPairing.idealIota_frame_ne_zero
statement:
theorem idealIota_frame_ne_zero (D : X.toScheme.EffCartier) {W : X.toScheme.Opens} [Nonempty W]
    {e : Γ(D.ideal.toModules, W)} (he : IsFrame D.ideal.toModules W e) :
    EffCartier.idealIota D.ideal W e ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  have h1 : (1 : Γ(X.toScheme, W)) • D.ideal.toModules.res le_rfl e =
      (0 : Γ(X.toScheme, W)) • D.ideal.toModules.res le_rfl e := by
    apply EffCartier.idealIota_injective
    rw [_root_.map_smul, _root_.map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul, res_self, h0, mul_zero, mul_zero]
  exact one_ne_zero ((he W le_rfl).1 h1)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffCartier.exists_cartierDivisor_nonneg_variety
statement:
theorem _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffCartier.exists_cartierDivisor_nonneg_variety
    (X : Variety k) (D : X.toScheme.EffCartier) :
    ∃ D' : CartierDivisor X,
      (∀ p : X.toScheme, 0 ≤ (CartierDivisor.weilCycle X D' :
        AlgebraicGeometry.AlgebraicCycle X.toScheme ℤ) p) ∧
      Nonempty (lineBundleModules D' ≅ D.sheaf)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose W hpW e he using D.exists_frame_ideal
  have hne : ∀ p, Nonempty (W p) := fun p => ⟨⟨p, hpW p⟩⟩
  let a : ∀ p : X.toScheme, Γ(X.toScheme, W p) := fun p => EffCartier.idealIota D.ideal (W p) (e p)
  have ha : ∀ p, a p ≠ 0 := fun p => by
    have := hne p
    exact idealIota_frame_ne_zero D (he p)
  have hga : ∀ p, (have := hne p; (X.toScheme.germToFunctionField (W p)).hom (a p)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro p h0
    have := hne p
    exact ha p (X.toScheme.germToFunctionField_injective (W p) (h0.trans (map_zero _).symm))
  let f : X.toScheme → (X.toScheme.functionField)ˣ := fun p =>
    have := hne p
    Units.mk0 ((X.toScheme.germToFunctionField (W p)).hom (a p)) (hga p)
  have hf : ∀ p, (have := hne p; (f p : X.toScheme.functionField)) =
      (have := hne p; (X.toScheme.germToFunctionField (W p)).hom (a p)) := fun p => rfl
  have hcover : (⨆ p, W p) = ⊤ :=
    top_le_iff.mp fun x _ => Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨x, hpW x⟩
  
  have hratio : ∀ i j : X.toScheme, ∀ x ∈ W i ⊓ W j,
      ((f i / f j : (X.toScheme.functionField)ˣ) : X.toScheme.functionField) ∈
        Set.range (fun v : (X.toScheme.presheaf.stalk x)ˣ =>
          algebraMap (X.toScheme.presheaf.stalk x) X.toScheme.functionField v) := by
    intro i j x hx
    have := hne i
    have := hne j
    have hWij : Nonempty (W i ⊓ W j : X.toScheme.Opens) := ⟨⟨x, hx⟩⟩
    have hij₁ : (W i ⊓ W j : X.toScheme.Opens) ≤ W i := inf_le_left
    have hij₂ : (W i ⊓ W j : X.toScheme.Opens) ≤ W j := inf_le_right
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := ((he j).restrict hij₂).exists_unit ((he i).restrict hij₁)
    
    have hau : X.toScheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hij₁).op (a i) =
        (u : Γ(X.toScheme, W i ⊓ W j)) * X.toScheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hij₂).op (a j) := by
      have h1 : EffCartier.idealIota D.ideal (W i ⊓ W j) (D.ideal.toModules.res hij₁ (e i)) =
          X.toScheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hij₁).op (a i) :=
        EffCartier.idealIota_map D.ideal (homOfLE hij₁) (e i)
      have h2 : EffCartier.idealIota D.ideal (W i ⊓ W j) (D.ideal.toModules.res hij₂ (e j)) =
          X.toScheme.presheaf.map (homOfLE hij₂).op (a j) :=
        EffCartier.idealIota_map D.ideal (homOfLE hij₂) (e j)
      have h3 := congrArg (EffCartier.idealIota D.ideal (W i ⊓ W j)) hu
      rw [_root_.map_smul, smul_eq_mul, h1, h2] at h3
      exact h3.symm
    
    have hK : (f i : X.toScheme.functionField) =
        (X.toScheme.germToFunctionField (W i ⊓ W j)).hom (u : Γ(X.toScheme, W i ⊓ W j)) *
          (f j : X.toScheme.functionField) := by
      have h1 := congrArg (X.toScheme.germToFunctionField (W i ⊓ W j)).hom hau
      rw [map_mul] at h1
      rw [hf i, hf j]
      refine Eq.trans ?_ (h1.trans ?_)
      · exact (X.toScheme.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hij₁) (genericPoint X.toScheme) _ (a i)).symm
      · congr 1
        exact X.toScheme.presheaf.germ_res_apply (homOfLE hij₂) (genericPoint X.toScheme) _ (a j)
    refine ⟨Units.map (X.toScheme.presheaf.germ (W i ⊓ W j) x hx).hom u, ?_⟩
    change algebraMap (X.toScheme.presheaf.stalk x) X.toScheme.functionField
      ((X.toScheme.presheaf.germ (W i ⊓ W j) x hx).hom (u : Γ(X.toScheme, W i ⊓ W j))) = _
    rw [Units.val_div_eq_div_val, hK, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ (Units.ne_zero (f j))]
    exact Scheme.algebraMap_germ_eq_germToFunctionField X.toScheme hx (u : Γ(X.toScheme, W i ⊓ W j))
  have hUf : CartierDivisor.IsLocalData W f :=
    ⟨hcover, fun i j x hx => ⟨hratio i j x hx, hratio j i x ⟨hx.2, hx.1⟩⟩⟩
  refine ⟨CartierDivisor.ofLocalData W f, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro p
    rw [CartierDivisor.weilCycle_ofLocalData X W f hUf p p (hpW p)]
    have := hne p
    rw [hf p]
    exact ord_nonneg_of_regular (hpW p) (ha p)
  · 
    have hrel : HasLocalPairs D (CartierDivisor.ofLocalData W f) := by
      intro p
      have := hne p
      obtain ⟨t, hval, hloc⟩ :=
        CartierToWeilLocalSection.local_section_ofLocalData W f hUf p p (hpW p)
      refine ⟨W p, hpW p, ⟨⟨e p, he p, t, hloc, ?_⟩⟩⟩
      apply X.toScheme.rationalSectionToFunctionField_injective (W p)
      have h1 : (X.toScheme.rationalSectionToFunctionField (W p)).hom (unitVal t) =
          (f p : X.toScheme.functionField) := congrArg Units.val hval
      have h2 : (X.toScheme.rationalSectionToFunctionField (W p)).hom
          ((X.toScheme.toRationalFunctionsSheaf.hom.app (op (W p))).hom (a p)) =
          (X.toScheme.germToFunctionField (W p)).hom (a p) :=
        congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom (a p))
          (X.toScheme.toRationalFunctionsSheaf_rationalSectionToFunctionField (W p))
      rw [h1, h2, hf p]
    exact ⟨lineBundleModulesIsoSheaf hrel⟩

name: EffectiveCartierDivisor.exists_cartierDivisor_nonneg
statement:
theorem EffectiveCartierDivisor.exists_cartierDivisor_nonneg {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (C : SmoothProjectiveCurve k) (D : AlgebraicGeometry.EffectiveCartierDivisor C.toScheme) :
    ∃ D' : CartierDivisor C.toVariety,
      (∀ p : C.toScheme, 0 ≤ (CartierDivisor.weilCycle C.toVariety D' :
        AlgebraicGeometry.AlgebraicCycle C.toVariety.toScheme ℤ) p) ∧
      Nonempty ((CartierDivisor.lineBundle D').toModules ≅
        AlgebraicGeometry.EffectiveCartierDivisor.lineBundle D)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D', hD', hiso⟩ :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffCartier.exists_cartierDivisor_nonneg_variety C.toVariety D
  exact ⟨D', hD', hiso⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.MonoidalPowToUnitMonoAux.mpFrame_zero
statement:
theorem mpFrame_zero (L : X.Modules) {W : X.Opens} (e : Γ(L, W)) :
    mpFrame L e 0 =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.monoidalUnitIso X).inv.app W (1 : Γ(X, W))
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.MonoidalPowToUnitMonoAux.mpFrame_succ
statement:
theorem mpFrame_succ (L : X.Modules) {W : X.Opens} (e : Γ(L, W)) (n : ℕ) :
    mpFrame L e (n + 1) = AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.monoidalPow L n) L W (mpFrame L e n) e
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.MonoidalPowToUnitMonoAux.unit_res_one
statement:
theorem unit_res_one {W W' : X.Opens} (h : W' ≤ W) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.res (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf : X.Modules) h
      (1 : Γ(X, W)) = (1 : Γ(X, W'))
proof:
:= by
  change (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom (1 : Γ(X, W)) = 1
  exact map_one _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.MonoidalPowToUnitMonoAux.mpFrame_res
statement:
theorem mpFrame_res (L : X.Modules) {W W' : X.Opens} (h : W' ≤ W) (e : Γ(L, W)) (n : ℕ) :
    (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.monoidalPow L n).res h (mpFrame L e n) =
      mpFrame L (L.res h e) n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [mpFrame_zero, mpFrame_zero]
    have := (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.GenAux.app_map_res
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.monoidalUnitIso X).inv h (1 : Γ(X, W))).symm
    change (𝟙_ X.Modules).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.monoidalUnitIso X).inv.app W (1 : Γ(X, W))) = _
    rw [this]
    exact congrArg _ (unit_res_one h)
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [mpFrame_succ, mpFrame_succ]
    change (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.monoidalPow L n ⊗ L).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections _ L W (mpFrame L e n) e) = _
    rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.GenAux.tensorSections_map h]
    exact congrArg (fun z => AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections _ L W' z _) ih

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.MonoidalPowToUnitMonoAux.tensorHom_app_tensorSections'
statement:

    (U : Y.Opens) (a : Γ(A, U)) (b : Γ(B, U)) :

proof:
:=
  AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorHom_tensorSections φ ψ U a b

statement:
theorem monoidalUnitIso_hom_app_inv_app (U : Y.Opens) (x : Γ(Y, U)) :
    (ε).hom.app U ((ε).inv.app U x) = x

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.MonoidalPowToUnitMonoAux.monoidalPowToUnit_app_mpFrame
statement:
theorem monoidalPowToUnit_app_mpFrame (J : Y.IdealSheafData) {W : Y.Opens}
    (e : Γ(J.toModules, W)) (n : ℕ) :
    ((J.monoidalPowToUnit n).app W (mpFrame J.toModules e n) : Γ(Y, W)) =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffCartier.idealIota J W e) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.monoidalPowToUnit_zero, mpFrame_zero, pow_zero]
    exact monoidalUnitIso_hom_app_inv_app W 1
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [mpFrame_succ, pow_succ]
    set ι := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffCartier.idealIncl J with hι
    set a := mpFrame J.toModules e n with ha
    
    have e1 : (J.monoidalPowToUnit (n + 1)).app W
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.monoidalPow J.toModules n) J.toModules W a e) =
        (ε).hom.app W ((λ_ (𝟙_ Y.Modules)).hom.app W
          ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.unitPowCollapse Y n ▷ 𝟙_ Y.Modules).app W
            ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.monoidalPowMap ι n ⊗ₘ ι).app W
              (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections
                (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.monoidalPow J.toModules n) J.toModules W a e)))) := rfl
    
    have e2 := tensorHom_app_tensorSections' (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.monoidalPowMap ι n) ι W a e
    
    set a' := (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.monoidalPowMap ι n).app W a with ha'
    set b' := ι.app W e with hb'
    have e3 : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.unitPowCollapse Y n ▷ 𝟙_ Y.Modules).app W
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.monoidalPow (𝟙_ Y.Modules) n) (𝟙_ Y.Modules) W a' b') =
        AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (𝟙_ Y.Modules) (𝟙_ Y.Modules) W
          ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.unitPowCollapse Y n).app W a') b' :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.GenAux.whiskerRight_app_tensorSections
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.unitPowCollapse Y n) W a' b'
    set r := (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.unitPowCollapse Y n).app W a' with hr
    
    have e4 : (λ_ (𝟙_ Y.Modules)).hom.app W
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (𝟙_ Y.Modules) (𝟙_ Y.Modules) W r b') =
        r • b' :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.leftUnitor_app_tensorSections (𝟙_ Y.Modules) W r b'
    
    have e5 : ((ε).hom.app W (r • b') : Γ(Y, W)) =
        (show Γ(Y, W) from r) * (show Γ(Y, W) from b') :=
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.monoidalUnitIso_hom_app W (r • b')).trans
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.smul_monoidalUnit_eq_mul W r b')
    
    have e6 : (show Γ(Y, W) from r) = (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffCartier.idealIota J W e) ^ n := by
      rw [← ih]
      exact (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.monoidalUnitIso_hom_app W r).symm
    have e7 : (show Γ(Y, W) from b') = AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.EffCartier.idealIota J W e := rfl
    rw [e1, e2]
    change (ε).hom.app W ((λ_ (𝟙_ Y.Modules)).hom.app W
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.unitPowCollapse Y n ▷ 𝟙_ Y.Modules).app W
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.monoidalPow (𝟙_ Y.Modules) n) (𝟙_ Y.Modules) W a' b'))) = _
    rw [e3, e4, e5, e6, e7]

statement:

    (((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.monoidalUnitIso X).inv.app U x : Γ(𝟙_ X.Modules, U)) :
