name: splitWeightedAlgebraOf_isLocallyWeightedPolynomial
statement:
theorem splitWeightedAlgebraOf_isLocallyWeightedPolynomial {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {C : SmoothProjectiveCurve k} {r : ℕ}
    {E : AlgebraicGeometry.VectorBundle C.toVariety}
    (F : SubbundleFiltration E r) (jetOrder : ℕ) :
    (splitWeightedAlgebraOf F jetOrder).IsLocallyWeightedPolynomial
      (fun iq : ULift.{u} (Fin r × Fin jetOrder) => ((iq.down.2 : ℕ) + 1))
      (fun _ => Nat.succ_pos _)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ i : Fin r, (F.lineQuotient i).toModules.IsLocallyFree :=
    fun i => (F.lineQuotient i).locallyFree
  have h2 : ∀ i : Fin r, (F.lineQuotient i).toModules.IsFiniteType :=
    fun i => (F.lineQuotient i).isFiniteType
  have hrank : ∀ (_ : Fin jetOrder) (x : C.toScheme),
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.rankAtStalk
        (CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct (fun i : Fin r => (F.lineQuotient i).toModules)) x = r :=
    fun _ x => splitWeightedAlgebra_lineQuotientBiproduct_rankAtStalk F x
  exact (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra_isLocallyWeightedPolynomial
    (fun _ : Fin jetOrder =>
      CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct (fun i : Fin r => (F.lineQuotient i).toModules)) hrank).1

name: deformationFamily_fiber_zero
statement:
theorem deformationFamily_fiber_zero {k : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k] {C : SmoothProjectiveCurve k}
    (Z : CategoryTheory.Over C.toScheme) [AlgebraicGeometry.IsAffineHom Z.hom] (sec : C.toScheme ⟶ Z.left)
    (hs : sec ≫ Z.hom = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id _) [AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion sec]
    (Zx : Z.left.Opens) (hsZx : ∀ c, sec.base c ∈ Zx) (n r : ℕ)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SmoothOfRelativeDimension (n + 1) (Zx.ι ≫ Z.hom)]
    (E : AlgebraicGeometry.VectorBundle C.toVariety) (hE : E.rank = n + 1)
    (hEZ : Nonempty (E.toModules ≅ coneTangentBundle Z.hom sec hs))
    (hloc : ((jetGradedAlgebra (k := k) Z sec hs r).1).IsLocallyWeightedPolynomial
      (fun iq : ULift.{u} (Fin (n + 1) × Fin r) => ((iq.down.2 : ℕ) + 1)) (fun _ => Nat.succ_pos _)) :
    ∃ e : (((deformationFamily Z sec hs r).hom ≫
        AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.affineLineOver.toLine (k := k) C.toScheme).fiber (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.affineLineOver.point k 0) ≅ (@AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedProjBundle _ r (fun _ : Fin r => E.toModules) (fun _ => E.locallyFree) (fun _ => E.isFiniteType)).left),
      e.hom ≫ (@AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedProjBundle _ r (fun _ : Fin r => E.toModules) (fun _ => E.locallyFree) (fun _ => E.isFiniteType)).hom =
          ((deformationFamily Z sec hs r).hom ≫
        AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.affineLineOver.toLine (k := k) C.toScheme).fiberι (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.affineLineOver.point k 0) ≫ (deformationFamily Z sec hs r).hom ≫
          AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.affineLineOver.toBase C.toScheme ∧
      ∀ m : ℤ, Nonempty ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback (((deformationFamily Z sec hs r).hom ≫
        AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.affineLineOver.toLine (k := k) C.toScheme).fiberι (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.affineLineOver.point k 0))).obj
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist (deformedJetAlgebra Z sec hs r) m) ≅
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback e.hom).obj
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist ((@AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra _ r (fun _ : Fin r => E.toModules) (fun _ => E.locallyFree) (fun _ => E.isFiniteType))) m))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, -, ⟨φ⟩⟩ := deformedJetAlgebra_spec Z sec hs Zx hsZx n r E hE hEZ hloc
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεtw⟩ := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj_fiber_over_line (X := C.toScheme)
    (deformedJetAlgebra Z sec hs r) (0 : k)
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ, hψtw⟩ := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.exists_iso_of_algebra_iso φ
  refine ⟨ε ≪≫ ψ, ?_, fun m => ?_⟩
  · show (ε ≪≫ ψ).hom ≫ (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj
        (@AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.weightedSymAlgebra _ r (fun _ : Fin r => E.toModules)
          (fun _ => E.locallyFree) (fun _ => E.isFiniteType))).hom = _
    rw [Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc, hψ]
    exact hε
  · obtain ⟨a⟩ := hεtw m
    obtain ⟨b⟩ := hψtw m
    exact ⟨a ≪≫ (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback ε.hom).mapIso b ≪≫
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp ε.hom ψ.hom).app _⟩

name: splitTautologicalClass_eq_of_dvd
statement:
theorem splitTautologicalClass_eq_of_dvd {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {C : SmoothProjectiveCurve k} {r : ℕ} {E : AlgebraicGeometry.VectorBundle C.toVariety}
    (F : SubbundleFiltration E r) (jetOrder m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hdiv : ∀ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 jetOrder, q ∣ m)
    [(AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist (splitWeightedAlgebraOf F jetOrder) (m : ℤ)).IsLineBundle] (d : ℕ) :
    splitTautologicalClass F jetOrder m hm d =
      (m : ℚ)⁻¹ • (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist (splitWeightedAlgebraOf F jetOrder) (m : ℤ)) d).ratExtend
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have firstChernClass_tensor_any {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
      (L M : X.Modules) [L.IsLineBundle] [M.IsLineBundle]
      [(AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensor L M).IsLineBundle] (e : ℕ) :
      AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensor L M) e =
        AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L e + AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass M e := by
    by_cases h : ∃ (_ : AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocallyNoetherian X),
        X.IsLocallyOfFiniteTypeOverField
    · obtain ⟨_, ⟨K, hK, π, hπ⟩⟩ := h
      let _ : Field K := hK
      let _ : X.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := ⟨π⟩
      let _ : AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType
          (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := hπ
      exact AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass_tensor (k := K) L M e
    · rw [AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass_eq_zero_of_not _ e h,
        AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass_eq_zero_of_not L e h,
        AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass_eq_zero_of_not M e h, add_zero]
  have firstChernClass_tensorPow {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
      (L : X.Modules) [L.IsLineBundle] (n e : ℕ) :
      AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorPow L n) (e + 1) =
        n • AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L (e + 1) := by
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        change AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass
          (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) (e + 1) = _
        rw [AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass_one]
        simp
    | succ n ih =>
        change AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass
            (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensor
              (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorPow L n) L) (e + 1) = _
        rw [firstChernClass_tensor_any, ih]
        simp [succ_nsmul]
  have ratExtend_nsmul {A B : Type u} [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B]
      (f : A →+ B) (n : ℕ) :
      (n • f).ratExtend = (n : ℚ) • f.ratExtend := by
    ext x
    simpa [AddMonoidHom.ratExtend] using
      (Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℚ n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] f x)).symm
  have ratExtend_zero {A B : Type u} [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B] :
      (0 : A →+ B).ratExtend = 0 := by
    unfold AddMonoidHom.ratExtend
    rw [show (0 : A →+ B).toIntLinearMap = 0 by rfl, LinearMap.baseChange_zero]
  have normalizedFirstChernClass_indep {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
      (S : X.GradedQCAlgebra) (a b : ℕ) (ha : S.SufficientlyDivisible a)
      (hb : S.SufficientlyDivisible b) (e : ℕ) :
      haveI := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.isLineBundle_twist S a ha
      haveI := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.isLineBundle_twist S b hb
      (a : ℚ)⁻¹ • (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist S (a : ℤ)) e).ratExtend =
        (b : ℚ)⁻¹ • (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist S (b : ℤ)) e).ratExtend := by
    cases e with
    | zero => simp [AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass, ratExtend_zero]
    | succ e =>
        let L := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist S (a : ℤ)
        let L' := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist S (b : ℤ)
        have : L.IsLineBundle :=
          AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.isLineBundle_twist S a ha
        have : L'.IsLineBundle :=
          AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.isLineBundle_twist S b hb
        have ha0 : (a : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt ha.1
        have hb0 : (b : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hb.1
        have iso : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorPow L b ≅
            AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorPow L' a :=
          AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twistPowIso S a b ha ≪≫
            CategoryTheory.eqToIso (by simp [Nat.mul_comm]) ≪≫
            (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twistPowIso S b a hb).symm
        have hcross :
            b • AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L (e + 1) =
              a • AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L' (e + 1) := by
          calc
            b • AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L (e + 1) =
                AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass
                  (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorPow L b) (e + 1) :=
              (firstChernClass_tensorPow L b e).symm
            _ = AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass
                  (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorPow L' a) (e + 1) :=
              AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass_congr _ _ iso e
            _ = a • AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L' (e + 1) :=
              firstChernClass_tensorPow L' a e
        have hcrossRat :
            (b : ℚ) • (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L (e + 1)).ratExtend =
              (a : ℚ) • (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L' (e + 1)).ratExtend := by
          rw [← ratExtend_nsmul, ← ratExtend_nsmul, hcross]
        change (a : ℚ)⁻¹ • (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L (e + 1)).ratExtend =
          (b : ℚ)⁻¹ • (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L' (e + 1)).ratExtend
        rw [inv_smul_eq_iff₀ ha0, smul_smul]
        rw [show (a : ℚ) * (b : ℚ)⁻¹ = (b : ℚ)⁻¹ * a by ring, ← smul_smul]
        exact (eq_inv_smul_iff₀ hb0).2 hcrossRat
  let S := splitWeightedAlgebraOf F jetOrder
  let M := m * jetOrder.factorial
  have hMpos : 0 < M := Nat.mul_pos hm (Nat.factorial_pos _)
  have hMdiv : ∀ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 jetOrder, q ∣ M := by
    intro q hq
    exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (hdiv q hq) _
  have hmS : S.SufficientlyDivisible m :=
    splitWeightedAlgebra_sufficientlyDivisible_of_dvd F jetOrder m hm hdiv
  have hMS : S.SufficientlyDivisible M :=
    splitWeightedAlgebra_sufficientlyDivisible_of_dvd F jetOrder M hMpos hMdiv
  have hML : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist S (M : ℤ)).IsLineBundle :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.isLineBundle_twist S M hMS
  unfold splitTautologicalClass
  dsimp only
  change (if h : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist S (M : ℤ)).IsLineBundle then
      haveI := h
      (M : ℚ)⁻¹ • (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist S (M : ℤ)) d).ratExtend
    else 0) = _
  rw [dif_pos hML]
  exact normalizedFirstChernClass_indep S M m hMS hmS d

name: splitTautologicalClass_indep
statement:
theorem splitTautologicalClass_indep {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {C : SmoothProjectiveCurve k} {r : ℕ} {E : AlgebraicGeometry.VectorBundle C.toVariety}
    (F : SubbundleFiltration E r) (jetOrder m m' : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hm' : 0 < m') (d : ℕ) :
    splitTautologicalClass F jetOrder m hm d = splitTautologicalClass F jetOrder m' hm' d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have firstChernClass_tensor_any {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
      (L M : X.Modules) [L.IsLineBundle] [M.IsLineBundle]
      [(AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensor L M).IsLineBundle] (e : ℕ) :
      AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensor L M) e =
        AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L e + AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass M e := by
    by_cases h : ∃ (_ : AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocallyNoetherian X),
        X.IsLocallyOfFiniteTypeOverField
    · obtain ⟨_, ⟨K, hK, π, hπ⟩⟩ := h
      let _ : Field K := hK
      let _ : X.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := ⟨π⟩
      let _ : AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType
          (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := hπ
      exact AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass_tensor (k := K) L M e
    · rw [AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass_eq_zero_of_not _ e h,
        AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass_eq_zero_of_not L e h,
        AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass_eq_zero_of_not M e h, add_zero]
  have firstChernClass_tensorPow {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
      (L : X.Modules) [L.IsLineBundle] (n e : ℕ) :
      AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorPow L n) (e + 1) =
        n • AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L (e + 1) := by
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        change AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass
          (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) (e + 1) = _
        rw [AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass_one]
        simp
    | succ n ih =>
        change AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass
            (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensor
              (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorPow L n) L) (e + 1) = _
        rw [firstChernClass_tensor_any, ih]
        simp [succ_nsmul]
  have ratExtend_nsmul {A B : Type u} [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B]
      (f : A →+ B) (n : ℕ) :
      (n • f).ratExtend = (n : ℚ) • f.ratExtend := by
    ext x
    simpa [AddMonoidHom.ratExtend] using
      (Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℚ n ((1 : ℚ) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] f x)).symm
  have ratExtend_zero {A B : Type u} [AddCommGroup A] [AddCommGroup B] :
      (0 : A →+ B).ratExtend = 0 := by
    unfold AddMonoidHom.ratExtend
    rw [show (0 : A →+ B).toIntLinearMap = 0 by rfl, LinearMap.baseChange_zero]
  have normalizedFirstChernClass_indep {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
      (S : X.GradedQCAlgebra) (a b : ℕ) (ha : S.SufficientlyDivisible a)
      (hb : S.SufficientlyDivisible b) (e : ℕ) :
      haveI := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.isLineBundle_twist S a ha
      haveI := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.isLineBundle_twist S b hb
      (a : ℚ)⁻¹ • (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist S (a : ℤ)) e).ratExtend =
        (b : ℚ)⁻¹ • (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist S (b : ℤ)) e).ratExtend := by
    cases e with
    | zero => simp [AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass, ratExtend_zero]
    | succ e =>
        let L := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist S (a : ℤ)
        let L' := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist S (b : ℤ)
        have : L.IsLineBundle :=
          AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.isLineBundle_twist S a ha
        have : L'.IsLineBundle :=
          AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.isLineBundle_twist S b hb
        have ha0 : (a : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt ha.1
        have hb0 : (b : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hb.1
        have iso : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorPow L b ≅
            AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorPow L' a :=
          AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twistPowIso S a b ha ≪≫
            CategoryTheory.eqToIso (by simp [Nat.mul_comm]) ≪≫
            (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twistPowIso S b a hb).symm
        have hcross :
            b • AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L (e + 1) =
              a • AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L' (e + 1) := by
          calc
            b • AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L (e + 1) =
                AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass
                  (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorPow L b) (e + 1) :=
              (firstChernClass_tensorPow L b e).symm
            _ = AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass
                  (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorPow L' a) (e + 1) :=
              AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass_congr _ _ iso e
            _ = a • AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L' (e + 1) :=
              firstChernClass_tensorPow L' a e
        have hcrossRat :
            (b : ℚ) • (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L (e + 1)).ratExtend =
              (a : ℚ) • (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L' (e + 1)).ratExtend := by
          rw [← ratExtend_nsmul, ← ratExtend_nsmul, hcross]
        change (a : ℚ)⁻¹ • (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L (e + 1)).ratExtend =
          (b : ℚ)⁻¹ • (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L' (e + 1)).ratExtend
        rw [inv_smul_eq_iff₀ ha0, smul_smul]
        rw [show (a : ℚ) * (b : ℚ)⁻¹ = (b : ℚ)⁻¹ * a by ring, ← smul_smul]
        exact (eq_inv_smul_iff₀ hb0).2 hcrossRat
  let S := splitWeightedAlgebraOf F jetOrder
  let M := m * jetOrder.factorial
  let M' := m' * jetOrder.factorial
  have hMpos : 0 < M := Nat.mul_pos hm (Nat.factorial_pos _)
  have hMpos' : 0 < M' := Nat.mul_pos hm' (Nat.factorial_pos _)
  have hMdiv : ∀ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 jetOrder, q ∣ M := by
    intro q hq
    exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (Nat.dvd_factorial (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hq).1
      (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hq).2) _
  have hMdiv' : ∀ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 jetOrder, q ∣ M' := by
    intro q hq
    exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right (Nat.dvd_factorial (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hq).1
      (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hq).2) _
  have hMS : S.SufficientlyDivisible M :=
    splitWeightedAlgebra_sufficientlyDivisible_of_dvd F jetOrder M hMpos hMdiv
  have hMS' : S.SufficientlyDivisible M' :=
    splitWeightedAlgebra_sufficientlyDivisible_of_dvd F jetOrder M' hMpos' hMdiv'
  have hML : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist S (M : ℤ)).IsLineBundle :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.isLineBundle_twist S M hMS
  have hML' : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist S (M' : ℤ)).IsLineBundle :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.isLineBundle_twist S M' hMS'
  unfold splitTautologicalClass
  dsimp only
  change (if h : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist S (M : ℤ)).IsLineBundle then
      haveI := h
      (M : ℚ)⁻¹ • (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist S (M : ℤ)) d).ratExtend
    else 0) =
    (if h : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist S (M' : ℤ)).IsLineBundle then
      haveI := h
      (M' : ℚ)⁻¹ • (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist S (M' : ℤ)) d).ratExtend
    else 0)
  rw [dif_pos hML, dif_pos hML']
  exact normalizedFirstChernClass_indep S M M' hMS hMS' d

name: ReesAlgebra.irrelevant_pow_isHomogeneous
statement: theorem irrelevant_pow_isHomogeneous (p : ℕ) : (irrelevant 𝒜 ^ p).IsHomogeneous 𝒜
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, Ideal.one_eq_top]; exact Ideal.IsHomogeneous.top 𝒜
  | succ p ih => rw [pow_succ]; exact Ideal.IsHomogeneous.mul ih (HomogeneousIdeal.irrelevant 𝒜).isHomogeneous

name: ReesAlgebra.decompose_zero_of_mem_irrelevant
statement:
theorem decompose_zero_of_mem_irrelevant {a : A} (ha : a ∈ irrelevant 𝒜) :
    (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 a 0 : A) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := (HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_iff 𝒜 a).1 ha
  rwa [GradedRing.proj_apply] at h

name: ReesAlgebra.irrPow_succ_le
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hx1, hx2⟩ := (mem_irrPow 𝒜).1 hx
  rw [pow_succ'] at hx1
  have hhom := irrelevant_pow_isHomogeneous 𝒜 p
  have key : ∀ z ∈ irrelevant 𝒜 * irrelevant 𝒜 ^ p, (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 z j : A) ∈ N j := by
    intro z hz
    refine Submodule.mul_induction_on hz ?_ ?_
    · intro a ha b hb
      rw [DirectSum.decompose_mul, DirectSum.coe_mul_apply_eq_sum_antidiagonal]
      refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun ij hij => ?_
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos ij.1 with h0 | hpos
      · rw [h0, decompose_zero_of_mem_irrelevant 𝒜 ha, zero_mul]
        exact zero_mem _
      · rw [← Finset.mem_antidiagonal.1 hij]
        exact hN _ _ hpos _ (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 a ij.1).2 _
          ⟨hhom ij.2 hb, (DirectSum.decompose 𝒜 b ij.2).2⟩
    · intro x y hx hy
      rw [DirectSum.decompose_add, DirectSum.add_apply, Submodule.coe_add]
      exact add_mem hx hy
  have := key x hx1
  rwa [DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same 𝒜 hx2] at this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.ofPiece_sectionsGMul_lwp
statement:
private theorem ofPiece_sectionsGMul_lwp (U : X.Opens) {m n : ℕ} (a : S.sectionsPiece U m) (b : S.sectionsPiece U n) :
    S.ofPiece U (m + n) (S.sectionsGMul U a b) = S.ofPiece U m a * S.ofPiece U n b
proof:
:=
  (DirectSum.of_mul_of (A := S.sectionsPiece U) a b).symm

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.ofPiece_eqToHom_app
statement:
private theorem ofPiece_eqToHom_app (U : X.Opens) {m n : ℕ} (e : m = n) (x : S.sectionsPiece U m) :
    S.ofPiece U n ((CategoryTheory.eqToHom (congrArg S.part e)).app U x) = S.ofPiece U m x
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.of_eq_of_gradedMonoid_eq (S.mk_eqToHom_app U e x)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.whiskerLeft_comp_mul_app_tensorSections
statement:
private theorem whiskerLeft_comp_mul_app_tensorSections (U : X.Opens) {A : X.Modules} {d m : ℕ} (f : A ⟶ S.part m)
    (s : Γ(S.part d, U)) (t : Γ(A, U)) :
    ((S.part d ◁ f) ≫ S.mul d m).app U (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (S.part d) A U s t) =
      S.sectionsGMul U s (f.app U t)
proof:
:= by
  show (S.mul d m).app U ((S.part d ◁ f).app U _) = _
  rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.DualZigzag.whiskerLeft_app_tensorSections']
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.ofPiece_irrelevantPow_app_mem_irrPow
statement:
theorem ofPiece_irrelevantPow_app_mem_irrPow (U : X.AffineZariskiSite) :
    ∀ (p j : ℕ) (y : Γ((S.irrelevantPow p j).1, U.toOpens)),
      (S.ofPiece U.toOpens j ((S.irrelevantPow p j).2.app U.toOpens y) :
          S.toGradedAffineAlgebra.toAffineAlgebra.sections U) ∈
        ReesAlgebra.irrPow (S.toGradedAffineAlgebra.gradingSubmodule U) p j
  | 0, j, y => by
    rw [ReesAlgebra.irrPow_zero]
    exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
  | p + 1, j, y => by
    classical
    set g
proof:
:= irrelevantPow.gen S p j with hg
    
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective ((CategoryTheory.Limits.factorThruImage g).app U.toOpens) := by
      have hqc1 : (CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct
          (fun a : Fin j => S.part (a.1 + 1) ⊗ (S.irrelevantPow p (j - (a.1 + 1))).1)).IsQuasicoherent := by
        refine AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_biproduct _ fun a => ?_
        have := S.irrelevantPow_isQuasicoherent p (j - (a.1 + 1))
        have := S.quasicoherent (a.1 + 1)
        exact AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_tensorObj _ _
      have hqc2 : (CategoryTheory.Limits.image g).IsQuasicoherent := S.irrelevantPow_isQuasicoherent (p + 1) j
      have hqc3 : (0 : X.Modules).IsQuasicoherent := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.isQuasicoherent_zero _
      let C : CategoryTheory.ShortComplex X.Modules :=
        CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.mk (CategoryTheory.Limits.factorThruImage g)
          (0 : CategoryTheory.Limits.image g ⟶ 0) CategoryTheory.Limits.comp_zero
      have hC : C.Exact := (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.exact_iff_epi C rfl).mpr inferInstance
      have hex := (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.gammaAffine_exact_iff C).mp hC ⟨U.toOpens, U.2⟩
      intro y
      have h0 : (C.g.app U.toOpens).hom y = 0 := by
        show ((0 : CategoryTheory.Limits.image g ⟶ 0).app U.toOpens).hom y = 0
        rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.Hom.zero_app, AddCommGrpCat.hom_zero, AddMonoidHom.zero_apply]
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (hex y).mp h0
      exact ⟨x, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hsurj y
    have hfac : (S.irrelevantPow (p + 1) j).2.app U.toOpens ((CategoryTheory.Limits.factorThruImage g).app U.toOpens z) =
        g.app U.toOpens z :=
      congrArg (fun ψ : _ ⟶ S.part j => ψ.app U.toOpens z) (CategoryTheory.Limits.image.fac g)
    
    let Q : AddSubgroup Γ(S.part j, U.toOpens) :=
      AddSubgroup.comap (DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U.toOpens) j)
        (ReesAlgebra.irrPow (S.toGradedAffineAlgebra.gradingSubmodule U) (p + 1) j).toAddSubgroup
    show (S.irrelevantPow (p + 1) j).2.app U.toOpens ((CategoryTheory.Limits.factorThruImage g).app U.toOpens z) ∈ Q
    rw [hfac]
    
    rw [AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.biproduct_sections_total _ U.toOpens z, map_sum]
    refine AddSubgroup.sum_mem _ fun a _ => ?_
    
    set za := (CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.π
      (fun a : Fin j => S.part (a.1 + 1) ⊗ (S.irrelevantPow p (j - (a.1 + 1))).1) a).app U.toOpens z
    have hcomp : ∀ w, g.app U.toOpens ((CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι
        (fun a : Fin j => S.part (a.1 + 1) ⊗ (S.irrelevantPow p (j - (a.1 + 1))).1) a).app U.toOpens w) =
        ((S.part (a.1 + 1) ◁ (S.irrelevantPow p (j - (a.1 + 1))).2) ≫ S.mul _ _ ≫
          CategoryTheory.eqToHom (congrArg S.part (by have := a.2; omega))).app U.toOpens w := fun w =>
      congrArg (fun ψ : _ ⟶ S.part j => ψ.app U.toOpens w) (S.ι_gen p j a)
    have hIsQc : (S.irrelevantPow p (j - (a.1 + 1))).1.IsQuasicoherent := S.irrelevantPow_isQuasicoherent _ _
    have hSqc := S.quasicoherent (a.1 + 1)
    clear_value za
    
    let F₀ : TensorProduct Γ(X, U.toOpens) Γ(S.part (a.1 + 1), U.toOpens) Γ((S.irrelevantPow p (j - (a.1 + 1))).1, U.toOpens) →+
        Γ(S.part (a.1 + 1) ⊗ (S.irrelevantPow p (j - (a.1 + 1))).1, U.toOpens) :=
      { toFun := fun t => (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSectionsHom (S.part (a.1 + 1))
          (S.irrelevantPow p (j - (a.1 + 1))).1).app (op U.toOpens) t
        map_zero' := map_zero _
        map_add' := fun x y => map_add _ x y }
    have hF₀ : Function.Surjective F₀ := (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSectionsHom_app_bijective_of_isAffineOpen
      (S.part (a.1 + 1)) (S.irrelevantPow p (j - (a.1 + 1))).1 U.2).2
    have hF₀tmul : ∀ (s : Γ(S.part (a.1 + 1), U.toOpens)) (t : Γ((S.irrelevantPow p (j - (a.1 + 1))).1, U.toOpens)),
        F₀ (s ⊗ₜ t) = AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (S.part (a.1 + 1))
          (S.irrelevantPow p (j - (a.1 + 1))).1 U.toOpens s t := fun s t =>
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSectionsHom_app _ _ U.toOpens s t
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hF₀ za
    induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero, map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
    | tmul s t =>
      rw [hF₀tmul]
      erw [hcomp]
      have e : a.1 + 1 + (j - (a.1 + 1)) = j := by have := a.2; omega
      have hval : S.ofPiece U.toOpens j ((CategoryTheory.eqToHom (congrArg S.part e)).app U.toOpens
          (((S.part (a.1 + 1) ◁ (S.irrelevantPow p (j - (a.1 + 1))).2) ≫ S.mul _ _).app U.toOpens
            (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (S.part (a.1 + 1))
              (S.irrelevantPow p (j - (a.1 + 1))).1 U.toOpens s t))) =
          S.ofPiece U.toOpens (a.1 + 1) s *
            S.ofPiece U.toOpens (j - (a.1 + 1)) ((S.irrelevantPow p (j - (a.1 + 1))).2.app U.toOpens t) :=
        (ofPiece_eqToHom_app S U.toOpens e _).trans
          ((congrArg (S.ofPiece U.toOpens _) (whiskerLeft_comp_mul_app_tensorSections S U.toOpens _ s t)).trans
            (ofPiece_sectionsGMul_lwp S U.toOpens s _))
      have h2 : S.ofPiece U.toOpens (a.1 + 1) s *
          S.ofPiece U.toOpens (j - (a.1 + 1)) ((S.irrelevantPow p (j - (a.1 + 1))).2.app U.toOpens t) ∈
            ReesAlgebra.irrelevant (S.toGradedAffineAlgebra.gradingSubmodule U) *
              ReesAlgebra.irrelevant (S.toGradedAffineAlgebra.gradingSubmodule U) ^ p :=
        Ideal.mul_mem_mul
          (HomogeneousIdeal.mem_irrelevant_of_mem (S.toGradedAffineAlgebra.gradingSubmodule U) (Nat.succ_pos a.1)
            ⟨s, rfl⟩)
          (ofPiece_irrelevantPow_app_mem_irrPow U p _ t).1
      rw [← pow_succ'] at h2
      show S.ofPiece U.toOpens j _ ∈ ReesAlgebra.irrPow (S.toGradedAffineAlgebra.gradingSubmodule U) (p + 1) j
      refine (ReesAlgebra.mem_irrPow (S.toGradedAffineAlgebra.gradingSubmodule U)).2 ⟨?_, ⟨_, rfl⟩⟩
      erw [hval]
      exact h2

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.exists_irrelevantPow_app_eq_of_mem_irrPow
statement:
theorem exists_irrelevantPow_app_eq_of_mem_irrPow (U : X.AffineZariskiSite) :
    ∀ (p j : ℕ) (x : S.sectionsPiece U.toOpens j),
      (S.ofPiece U.toOpens j x : S.toGradedAffineAlgebra.toAffineAlgebra.sections U) ∈
        ReesAlgebra.irrPow (S.toGradedAffineAlgebra.gradingSubmodule U) p j →
      ∃ y, (S.irrelevantPow p j).2.app U.toOpens y = x
  | 0, j, x, _ => ⟨x, rfl⟩
  | p + 1, j, x, hx => by
    let N : ℕ → AddSubgroup (S.sectionsRing U.toOpens)
proof:
:= fun n =>
      (AddMonoidHom.range ((S.irrelevantPow (p + 1) n).2.app U.toOpens).hom).map
        (DirectSum.of (S.sectionsPiece U.toOpens) n)
    have key := ReesAlgebra.irrPow_succ_le (S.toGradedAffineAlgebra.gradingSubmodule U) p N ?_ j hx
    · obtain ⟨_, ⟨y, rfl⟩, hxy⟩ := key
      exact ⟨y, DirectSum.of_injective j hxy⟩
    intro d e hd a ha b hb
    obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨t', rfl⟩ := hb.2
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := exists_irrelevantPow_app_eq_of_mem_irrPow U p e t' hb
    have hl := S.landsIn_whiskerLeft_irrelevantPow_mul_succ p d e (d + e) hd rfl
    rw [eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id] at hl
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := (S.landsIn_iff_exists _ _).1 hl
    refine ⟨_, ⟨g.app U.toOpens (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorSections (S.part d) _ U.toOpens s t), rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    refine Eq.trans ?_ (ofPiece_sectionsGMul_lwp S U.toOpens s ((S.irrelevantPow p e).2.app U.toOpens t))
    apply congrArg
    show (g ≫ (S.irrelevantPow (p + 1) (d + e)).2).app U.toOpens _ = S.sectionsGMul U.toOpens s _
    rw [← hg]
    exact whiskerLeft_comp_mul_app_tensorSections S U.toOpens _ s t

name: CategoryTheory.heq_comp_eqToHom_of_heq
statement:
theorem CategoryTheory.heq_comp_eqToHom_of_heq {C : Type*} [Category C] {A₁ B₁ B'₁ A₂ B₂ B'₂ : C}
    (f : A₁ ⟶ B₁) (g : A₂ ⟶ B₂) (h : B₁ = B'₁) (h' : B₂ = B'₂)
    (hA : A₁ = A₂) (hB : B₁ = B₂) (hB' : B'₁ = B'₂) (hfg : HEq f g) :
    HEq (f ≫ eqToHom h) (g ≫ eqToHom h')
proof:
:= by
  subst hA hB hB'
  obtain rfl := eq_of_heq hfg
  rfl

name: splitTwistMul_index_eq
statement:
theorem splitTwistMul_index_eq {K : Type u} [Field K] {C : SmoothProjectiveCurve K}
    {n : ℕ} {E : AlgebraicGeometry.VectorBundle C.toVariety} (F : SubbundleFiltration E (n + 1)) (kk : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (q m : ℕ) (hqm : q ∣ m) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensor
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist (splitWeightedAlgebraOf F kk) ((q * (m / q) : ℕ) : ℤ))
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj (splitWeightedAlgebraOf F kk)).hom).obj
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (F.lineQuotient i).toModules (m / q))) =
      AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensor
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist (splitWeightedAlgebraOf F kk) (m : ℤ))
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj (splitWeightedAlgebraOf F kk)).hom).obj
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (F.lineQuotient i).toModules (m / q)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel' hqm]

name: splitTwistMul_eq_twistPullbackPow
statement:
theorem splitTwistMul_eq_twistPullbackPow {K : Type u} [Field K] {C : SmoothProjectiveCurve K}
    {n : ℕ} {E : AlgebraicGeometry.VectorBundle C.toVariety} (F : SubbundleFiltration E (n + 1)) (kk : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (q m : ℕ) (hqm : q ∣ m)
    (x : ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorPow
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensor
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist (splitWeightedAlgebraOf F kk) (q : ℤ))
          ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback
            (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj (splitWeightedAlgebraOf F kk)).hom).obj
            (F.lineQuotient i).toModules)) (m / q)).val.obj (Opposite.op ⊤) : Type u)) :
    splitTwistMul F kk i q m hqm x =
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twistPullbackPow (splitWeightedAlgebraOf F kk) q
          (F.lineQuotient i).toModules (m / q) ≫
        CategoryTheory.eqToHom (splitTwistMul_index_eq F kk i q m hqm)).val.app (Opposite.op ⊤)).hom x
proof:
:= by
  have hf : splitTwistMul F kk i q m hqm = fun y =>
      ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twistPullbackPow (splitWeightedAlgebraOf F kk) q
          (F.lineQuotient i).toModules (m / q) ≫
        CategoryTheory.eqToHom (splitTwistMul_index_eq F kk i q m hqm)).val.app (Opposite.op ⊤)).hom y := by
    delta splitTwistMul
    funext y
    refine congrArg
      (fun φ : ((_ : (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj (splitWeightedAlgebraOf F kk)).left.Modules) ⟶ _) =>
        (φ.val.app (Opposite.op ⊤)).hom y) ?_
    refine eq_of_heq (CategoryTheory.heq_comp_eqToHom_of_heq _ _ _ _ rfl rfl rfl ?_)
    delta splitWeightedProjectivization
    exact heq_of_eq (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twistPullbackPow_rec_apply _ _ _ _)
  exact congrFun hf x

name: splitTwistMul_add_exists_iso
statement:
theorem splitTwistMul_add_exists_iso {K : Type u} [Field K] {C : SmoothProjectiveCurve K} {n kk : ℕ}
    {E : AlgebraicGeometry.VectorBundle C.toVariety} (F : SubbundleFiltration E (n + 1))
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (q : ℕ) (hq : q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 kk) (m m' : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hm' : 0 < m')
    (hdiv : ∀ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 kk, q ∣ m) (hdiv' : ∀ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 kk, q ∣ m') :
    ∃ Φ : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensor
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist (splitWeightedAlgebraOf F kk) (m : ℤ)).tensor
          ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback (splitWeightedProjectivization F kk).hom).obj
            (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (F.lineQuotient i).toModules (m / q))))
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist (splitWeightedAlgebraOf F kk) (m' : ℤ)).tensor
          ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback (splitWeightedProjectivization F kk).hom).obj
            (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (F.lineQuotient i).toModules (m' / q)))) ≅
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twist (splitWeightedAlgebraOf F kk) ((m + m' : ℕ) : ℤ)).tensor
        ((AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.pullback (splitWeightedProjectivization F kk).hom).obj
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorPow (F.lineQuotient i).toModules ((m + m') / q))),
      Φ.hom.app ⊤ (sectionTensor
        (splitTwistMul F kk i q m (hdiv q hq)
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorPowSection (splitWeightedCoord F i q hq) (m / q)))
        (splitTwistMul F kk i q m' (hdiv' q hq)
          (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorPowSection (splitWeightedCoord F i q hq) (m' / q)))) =
      splitTwistMul F kk i q (m + m') (dvd_add (hdiv q hq) (hdiv' q hq))
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.tensorPowSection (splitWeightedCoord F i q hq) ((m + m') / q))
proof:
:= by
  have hd : m / q + m' / q = (m + m') / q := (Nat.add_div_of_dvd_right (hdiv q hq)).symm
  have : CategoryTheory.IsIso (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twistMul (splitWeightedAlgebraOf F kk)
      ((q * (m / q) : ℕ) : ℤ) ((q * (m' / q) : ℕ) : ℤ)) :=
    AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twistMul_isIso_of_dvd (splitWeightedAlgebraOf F kk) m
      (splitWeightedAlgebra_sufficientlyDivisible_of_dvd F kk m hm hdiv) _ _
      (by rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel' (hdiv q hq)])
  delta splitWeightedProjectivization
  rw [splitTwistMul_eq_twistPullbackPow F kk i q m (hdiv q hq),
    splitTwistMul_eq_twistPullbackPow F kk i q m' (hdiv' q hq),
    splitTwistMul_eq_twistPullbackPow F kk i q (m + m') (dvd_add (hdiv q hq) (hdiv' q hq))]
  exact AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.relativeProj.twistPullbackPow_mul_exists_iso_transport
    (splitWeightedAlgebraOf F kk) q (F.lineQuotient i).toModules (m / q) (m' / q) ((m + m') / q) hd _ _ _
    (splitWeightedCoord F i q hq)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.landsIn_irrelevantPow_succ
statement: theorem landsIn_irrelevantPow_succ (p n : ℕ) : S.LandsIn (S.irrelevantPow (p + 1) n).2 p
proof:
:= by
  show S.LandsIn (CategoryTheory.Limits.image.ι (irrelevantPow.gen S p n)) p
  apply S.landsIn_of_epi (CategoryTheory.Limits.factorThruImage (irrelevantPow.gen S p n))
  rw [CategoryTheory.Limits.image.fac]
  apply S.landsIn_biproduct
  intro c
  rw [S.ι_gen]
  exact S.landsIn_comp_eqToHom (by have := c.2; omega)
    (S.landsIn_whiskerLeft_mul p (S.landsIn_self p _) (c.1 + 1))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.irrelevantPow.stepHom_comp
statement:
theorem irrelevantPow.stepHom_comp (p n : ℕ) :
    irrelevantPow.stepHom S p n ≫ (S.irrelevantPow p n).2 = (S.irrelevantPow (p + 1) n).2
proof:
:=
  haveI := S.mono_irrelevantPow p n
  CategoryTheory.Abelian.monoLift_comp _ _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.irrelevantPow_isZero_of_lt
statement:
theorem irrelevantPow_isZero_of_lt : ∀ (p j : ℕ), j < p → CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero (S.irrelevantPow p j).1
  | 0, j, h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero j)
  | p + 1, j, h => by
    have hsrc : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero (CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct
        (fun a : Fin j => S.part (a.1 + 1) ⊗ (S.irrelevantPow p (j - (a.1 + 1))).1))
proof:
:= by
      rw [CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero]
      apply CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.hom_ext
      intro a
      have hz : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero (S.irrelevantPow p (j - (a.1 + 1))).1 :=
        irrelevantPow_isZero_of_lt p (j - (a.1 + 1)) (by have := a.2; omega)
      have h1 : 𝟙 (S.part (a.1 + 1) ⊗ (S.irrelevantPow p (j - (a.1 + 1))).1) = 0 := by
        rw [← CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_id, hz.eq_of_src (𝟙 _) 0,
          AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules.whiskerLeft_zero']
      rw [Category.id_comp, zero_comp, ← Category.comp_id (CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.π _ a), h1, comp_zero]
    have hgen : irrelevantPow.gen S p j = 0 := hsrc.eq_of_src _ _
    show CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero (CategoryTheory.Limits.image (irrelevantPow.gen S p j))
    exact CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero.of_iso (CategoryTheory.Limits.isZero_zero _)
      (CategoryTheory.Limits.imageZero' hgen)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.irrelevantPow_snd_eq_zero_of_lt
statement: theorem irrelevantPow_snd_eq_zero_of_lt (p j : ℕ) (h : j < p) : (S.irrelevantPow p j).2 = 0
proof:
:=
  (S.irrelevantPow_isZero_of_lt p j h).eq_of_src _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.reesDeformation.syzygyLam_zero
statement: theorem syzygyLam_zero (j : ℕ) (h : 0 < j + 1) : syzygyLam S j ⟨0, h⟩ = 0
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.reesDeformation.syzygyLam_succ
statement:
theorem syzygyLam_succ (j e' : ℕ) (h : e' + 1 < j + 1) :
    syzygyLam S j ⟨e' + 1, h⟩ =
      affineLineOver.mulCoordPow 1 _ ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun m => (Modules.pullback (affineLineOver.toBase X)).obj (S.irrelevantPow m j).1)
          (by omega : j - (e' + 1) + 1 = j - e')) ≫
        CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι (fun e : Fin (j + 1) => (Modules.pullback (affineLineOver.toBase X)).obj (S.irrelevantPow (j - e.1) j).1) (⟨e', by omega⟩ : Fin (j + 1))
proof: := rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.reesDeformation.ι_syzygy
statement:
theorem ι_syzygy (j : ℕ) (e : Fin (j + 1)) :
    CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι _ e ≫ syzygy S j =
      (Modules.pullback (affineLineOver.toBase X)).map (irrelevantPow.stepHom S (j - e.1) j) ≫
          CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι (fun e : Fin (j + 1) => (Modules.pullback (affineLineOver.toBase X)).obj (S.irrelevantPow (j - e.1) j).1) e -
        syzygyLam S j e
proof:
:=
  CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι_desc _ e

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.reesDeformation.eqToHom_comp_pullMap_irrelevantPow_snd
statement:
theorem eqToHom_comp_pullMap_irrelevantPow_snd (j : ℕ) {a b : ℕ} (h : a = b) :
    eqToHom (congrArg (fun m => (Modules.pullback (affineLineOver.toBase X)).obj (S.irrelevantPow m j).1) h) ≫
        pullMap S (S.irrelevantPow b j).2 = pullMap S (S.irrelevantPow a j).2
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  simp

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.reesDeformation.pullback_map_stepHom_comp_pullMap
statement:
theorem pullback_map_stepHom_comp_pullMap (p j : ℕ) :
    (Modules.pullback (affineLineOver.toBase X)).map (irrelevantPow.stepHom S p j) ≫
      pullMap S (S.irrelevantPow p j).2 = pullMap S (S.irrelevantPow (p + 1) j).2
proof:
:= by
  show (Modules.pullback (affineLineOver.toBase X)).map (irrelevantPow.stepHom S p j) ≫
    (Modules.pullback (affineLineOver.toBase X)).map (S.irrelevantPow p j).2 =
    (Modules.pullback (affineLineOver.toBase X)).map (S.irrelevantPow (p + 1) j).2
  rw [← Functor.map_comp, irrelevantPow.stepHom_comp]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.reesDeformation.mulCoordPow_comm
statement:
theorem mulCoordPow_comm (a b : ℕ) (M : (affineLineOver X).Modules) :
    affineLineOver.mulCoordPow a M ≫ affineLineOver.mulCoordPow b M =
      affineLineOver.mulCoordPow b M ≫ affineLineOver.mulCoordPow a M
proof:
:= by
  rw [← affineLineOver.mulCoordPow_add, ← affineLineOver.mulCoordPow_add, Nat.add_comm]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.reesDeformation.syzygy_comp_gen
statement: theorem syzygy_comp_gen (j : ℕ) : syzygy S j ≫ gen S j = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.hom_ext'
  rintro ⟨e, he⟩
  rw [← Category.assoc, ι_syzygy, Preadditive.sub_comp, Category.assoc, ι_gen, comp_zero,
    ← Category.assoc]
  simp only [Fin.val_mk]
  rw [pullback_map_stepHom_comp_pullMap]
  cases e with
  | zero =>
    rw [syzygyLam_zero, zero_comp, sub_zero]
    show pullMap S (S.irrelevantPow (j - 0 + 1) j).2 ≫ affineLineOver.mulCoordPow 0 _ = 0
    rw [S.irrelevantPow_snd_eq_zero_of_lt (j - 0 + 1) j (by omega)]
    show (Modules.pullback (affineLineOver.toBase X)).map 0 ≫ affineLineOver.mulCoordPow 0 _ = 0
    rw [Functor.map_zero, zero_comp]
  | succ e' =>
    rw [syzygyLam_succ, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ι_gen]
    simp only [Fin.val_mk]
    rw [← Category.assoc (eqToHom _),
      eqToHom_comp_pullMap_irrelevantPow_snd S j (by omega : j - (e' + 1) + 1 = j - e'), ← Category.assoc,
      affineLineOver.mulCoordPow_naturality, Category.assoc, ← affineLineOver.mulCoordPow_add,
      Nat.add_comm 1 e', sub_self]

name: ReesSyzygyAux.revSum_invariant
statement:
theorem revSum_invariant (j : ℕ) (lam : ℕ → G →+ G) (hlam : ∀ a y, lam a (lam 1 y) = lam (a + 1) y)
    (ab : ℕ → G) : ∀ m, m ≤ j + 1 →
    (∑ f ∈ Finset.range (j + 1 - m), lam f (ab f)) + lam (j + 1 - m) (revSum j (lam 1) ab m) =
      ∑ f ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), lam f (ab f)
  | 0, _ => by simp [revSum]
  | m + 1, hm => by
    have h1 : j + 1 - (m + 1) = j - m
proof:
:= by omega
    have h2 : j + 1 - m = (j - m) + 1 := by omega
    have ih := revSum_invariant j lam hlam ab m (by omega)
    rw [h1, revSum, map_add, hlam, ← h2, ← ih, h2, Finset.sum_range_succ, add_assoc]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.landsIn_irrelevantPow_of_le
statement:
theorem landsIn_irrelevantPow_of_le {p p' : ℕ} (h : p ≤ p') (j : ℕ) :
    S.LandsIn (S.irrelevantPow p' j).2 p
proof:
:= by
  induction p', h using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact S.landsIn_self p j
  | succ p' _ ih =>
    exact (irrelevantPow.stepHom_comp S p' j) ▸ S.landsIn_comp (irrelevantPow.stepHom S p' j) ih

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.reesDeformation.InPullbackIrrelevantPow.zero
statement:
theorem InPullbackIrrelevantPow.zero (j p : ℕ) (V : (affineLineOver X).Opens) :
    InPullbackIrrelevantPow S j p V 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨0, Modules.Hom.app_zero' _ V⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.reesDeformation.InPullbackIrrelevantPow.add
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨z', rfl⟩ := h'
  exact ⟨z + z', Modules.Hom.app_add' _ V z z'⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.reesDeformation.InPullbackIrrelevantPow.neg
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := h
  exact ⟨-z, Modules.Hom.app_neg' _ V z⟩

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.reesDeformation.InPullbackIrrelevantPow.sum
statement:
theorem InPullbackIrrelevantPow.sum {j p : ℕ} {V : (affineLineOver X).Opens} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → Γ((S.pullback (affineLineOver.toBase X)).part j, V))
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, InPullbackIrrelevantPow S j p V (f i)) :
    InPullbackIrrelevantPow S j p V (∑ i ∈ s, f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using InPullbackIrrelevantPow.zero (S := S) j p V
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
    exact (h a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)).add (ih fun i hi => h i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi))

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.reesDeformation.InPullbackIrrelevantPow.mulCoordPow
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := h
  refine ⟨(affineLineOver.mulCoordPow e _).app V z, ?_⟩
  have := congrArg (fun φ : (Modules.pullback (affineLineOver.toBase X)).obj (S.irrelevantPow p j).1 ⟶
      (S.pullback (affineLineOver.toBase X)).part j => φ.app V z)
    (affineLineOver.mulCoordPow_naturality e (pullMap S (S.irrelevantPow p j).2))
  simp only [Modules.Hom.comp_app] at this
  exact this

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.reesDeformation.InPullbackIrrelevantPow.of_le
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := (S.landsIn_iff_exists _ p).1 (S.landsIn_irrelevantPow_of_le hpp j)
  refine ⟨((Modules.pullback (affineLineOver.toBase X)).map g).app V z, ?_⟩
  have : pullMap S (S.irrelevantPow p' j).2 =
      (Modules.pullback (affineLineOver.toBase X)).map g ≫ pullMap S (S.irrelevantPow p j).2 := by
    show (Modules.pullback (affineLineOver.toBase X)).map (S.irrelevantPow p' j).2 =
      (Modules.pullback (affineLineOver.toBase X)).map g ≫
        (Modules.pullback (affineLineOver.toBase X)).map (S.irrelevantPow p j).2
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, ← hg]
  rw [this]
  rfl

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.reesDeformation.InPullbackIrrelevantPow.of_mulCoordPow
statement:
theorem InPullbackIrrelevantPow.of_mulCoordPow {j p : ℕ} {V : (affineLineOver X).Opens}
    {y : Γ((S.pullback (affineLineOver.toBase X)).part j, V)} (e : ℕ)
    (h : InPullbackIrrelevantPow S j p V
      ((affineLineOver.mulCoordPow e ((S.pullback (affineLineOver.toBase X)).part j)).app V y)) :
    InPullbackIrrelevantPow S j p V y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h
  haveI := S.mono_irrelevantPow p j
  haveI := S.irrelevantPow_isQuasicoherent p j
  haveI := S.quasicoherent j
  exact affineLineOver.exists_pullback_toBase_map_app_eq_of_mulCoordPow (S.irrelevantPow p j).2 V e y z hz

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.reesDeformation.pullMap_irrelevantPow_app_injective
statement:
theorem pullMap_irrelevantPow_app_injective (p j : ℕ) (V : (affineLineOver X).Opens) :
    Function.Injective ((pullMap S (S.irrelevantPow p j).2).app V)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := S.mono_irrelevantPow p j
  haveI := S.irrelevantPow_isQuasicoherent p j
  haveI := S.quasicoherent j
  exact @Modules.app_injective_of_mono _ _ _ (pullMap S (S.irrelevantPow p j).2)
    (affineLineOver.mono_pullback_toBase_map (X := X) (S.irrelevantPow p j).2) V

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.reesDeformation.ι_syzygy_π_pullMap
statement:
theorem ι_syzygy_π_pullMap (j : ℕ) (e e' : Fin (j + 1)) :
    CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι (fun e : Fin (j + 1) =>
        (Modules.pullback (affineLineOver.toBase X)).obj (S.irrelevantPow (j - e.1 + 1) j).1) e ≫
      syzygy S j ≫
      CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.π (fun e : Fin (j + 1) =>
        (Modules.pullback (affineLineOver.toBase X)).obj (S.irrelevantPow (j - e.1) j).1) e' ≫
      pullMap S (S.irrelevantPow (j - e'.1) j).2 =
    (if e = e' then pullMap S (S.irrelevantPow (j - e.1 + 1) j).2 else 0) -
    (if e.1 = e'.1 + 1 then
      affineLineOver.mulCoordPow 1 _ ≫ pullMap S (S.irrelevantPow (j - e.1 + 1) j).2 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, ι_syzygy, Preadditive.sub_comp]
  congr 1
  · rw [Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc (CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι _ e),
      CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι_π]
    split_ifs with h
    · subst h
      rw [eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp]
      exact pullback_map_stepHom_comp_pullMap S (j - e.1) j
    · rw [zero_comp, comp_zero]
  · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := e
    cases e with
    | zero =>
      rw [syzygyLam_zero, zero_comp, if_neg]
      exact fun h => Nat.succ_ne_zero _ h.symm
    | succ e'' =>
      rw [syzygyLam_succ, Category.assoc, Category.assoc,
        ← Category.assoc (CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι _ _), CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι_π]
      by_cases h : (⟨e'', by omega⟩ : Fin (j + 1)) = e'
      · subst h
        rw [dif_pos rfl, eqToHom_refl, Category.id_comp, if_pos rfl,
          eqToHom_comp_pullMap_irrelevantPow_snd S j (by omega : j - (e'' + 1) + 1 = j - e'')]
      · rw [dif_neg h, zero_comp, comp_zero, comp_zero, if_neg]
        intro h'
        apply h
        exact Fin.ext (Nat.succ_injective h')

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.reesDeformation.exact_syzygy_gen
statement:
theorem exact_syzygy_gen (j : ℕ) :
    (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.mk (syzygy S j) (gen S j) (syzygy_comp_gen S j)).Exact
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Modules.exact_iff_locally_lift_sections]
  intro V x hx p hp
  refine ⟨V, le_rfl, hp, ?_⟩
  let P := Modules.pullback (affineLineOver.toBase X)
  let Bf : Fin (j + 1) → (affineLineOver X).Modules := fun e => P.obj (S.irrelevantPow (j - e.1) j).1
  let Af : Fin (j + 1) → (affineLineOver X).Modules := fun e => P.obj (S.irrelevantPow (j - e.1 + 1) j).1
  let T : (affineLineOver X).Modules := (S.pullback (affineLineOver.toBase X)).part j
  let lam : ℕ → Γ(T, V) →+ Γ(T, V) := fun a => ((affineLineOver.mulCoordPow a T).app V).hom
  have hlam : ∀ a y, lam a (lam 1 y) = lam (a + 1) y := by
    intro a y
    have := congrArg (fun φ : T ⟶ T => φ.app V y) (affineLineOver.mulCoordPow_add 1 a T)
    simp only [Modules.Hom.comp_app] at this
    rw [Nat.add_comm] at this
    exact this.symm
  let a : ∀ e : Fin (j + 1), Γ(Bf e, V) := fun e => (CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.π Bf e).app V x
  let abar : Fin (j + 1) → Γ(T, V) := fun e => (pullMap S (S.irrelevantPow (j - e.1) j).2).app V (a e)
  let ab : ℕ → Γ(T, V) := fun f => if h : f < j + 1 then abar ⟨f, h⟩ else 0
  have hab : ∀ e : Fin (j + 1), ab e.1 = abar e := fun e => dif_pos e.2
  
  have hsum : ∑ f ∈ Finset.range (j + 1), lam f (ab f) = 0 := by
    rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun f => lam f (ab f)) (j + 1)]
    have hx' : (gen S j).app V x = 0 := hx
    rw [Modules.biproduct_sections_total Bf V x, Modules.Hom.app_sum] at hx'
    refine Eq.trans ?_ hx'
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
    have := congrArg (fun φ : Bf e ⟶ T => φ.app V (a e)) (ι_gen S j e)
    simp only [Modules.Hom.comp_app] at this
    rw [hab e]
    exact this.symm
  
  let c : ℕ → Γ(T, V) := fun e => ReesSyzygyAux.revSum j (lam 1) ab (j + 1 - e)
  have hc_step : ∀ e, e ≤ j → c e = ab e + lam 1 (c (e + 1)) := by
    intro e he
    have h1 : j + 1 - e = (j - e) + 1 := by omega
    have h2 : j + 1 - (e + 1) = j - e := by omega
    have h3 : j - (j - e) = e := by omega
    simp only [c, h1, h2, ReesSyzygyAux.revSum, h3]
  have hinv : ∀ e, e ≤ j + 1 → (∑ f ∈ Finset.range e, lam f (ab f)) + lam e (c e) = 0 := by
    intro e he
    have := ReesSyzygyAux.revSum_invariant j lam hlam ab (j + 1 - e) (by omega)
    have h1 : j + 1 - (j + 1 - e) = e := by omega
    rw [h1] at this
    exact this.trans hsum
  
  have hT : ∀ e, e ≤ j →
      InPullbackIrrelevantPow S j (j - e + 1) V (∑ f ∈ Finset.range e, lam f (ab f)) := by
    intro e he
    refine InPullbackIrrelevantPow.sum _ _ fun f hf => ?_
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hf
    have hfj : f < j + 1 := by omega
    have : ab f = abar ⟨f, hfj⟩ := dif_pos hfj
    rw [this]
    exact InPullbackIrrelevantPow.mulCoordPow
      (InPullbackIrrelevantPow.of_le (show j - e + 1 ≤ j - f by omega) ⟨a ⟨f, hfj⟩, rfl⟩) f
  
  have hc_mem : ∀ e : Fin (j + 1), InPullbackIrrelevantPow S j (j - e.1 + 1) V (c e.1) := by
    intro e
    have h2 : lam e.1 (c e.1) = -(∑ f ∈ Finset.range e.1, lam f (ab f)) :=
      eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right (hinv e.1 (by omega))
    have hmem : InPullbackIrrelevantPow S j (j - e.1 + 1) V (lam e.1 (c e.1)) :=
      h2 ▸ (hT e.1 (by omega)).neg
    exact InPullbackIrrelevantPow.of_mulCoordPow e.1 hmem
  choose z hz using hc_mem
  refine ⟨∑ e : Fin (j + 1), (CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι Af e).app V (z e), ?_⟩
  have hres : (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.mk (syzygy S j) (gen S j) (syzygy_comp_gen S j)).X₂.presheaf.map
      (homOfLE (le_refl V)).op x = x := by
    have hid : (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.mk (syzygy S j) (gen S j) (syzygy_comp_gen S j)).X₂.presheaf.map
        (homOfLE (le_refl V)).op = 𝟙 _ :=
      (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.mk (syzygy S j) (gen S j) (syzygy_comp_gen S j)).X₂.presheaf.map_id (op V)
    rw [hid]
    rfl
  rw [hres]
  
  apply (Modules.biproduct_sections_bijective Bf V).1
  funext e'
  show (CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.π Bf e').app V
    ((syzygy S j).app V (∑ e : Fin (j + 1), (CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι Af e).app V (z e))) = a e'
  apply pullMap_irrelevantPow_app_injective (S := S) (j - e'.1) j V
  rw [Modules.Hom.app_sum, Modules.Hom.app_sum, Modules.Hom.app_sum]
  have hterm : ∀ e : Fin (j + 1), (pullMap S (S.irrelevantPow (j - e'.1) j).2).app V
      ((CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.π Bf e').app V
        ((syzygy S j).app V ((CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.ι Af e).app V (z e)))) =
      (if e = e' then c e.1 else 0) - (if e.1 = e'.1 + 1 then lam 1 (c e.1) else 0) := by
    intro e
    have := congrArg (fun φ : Af e ⟶ T => φ.app V (z e)) (ι_syzygy_π_pullMap S j e e')
    simp only [Modules.Hom.comp_app] at this
    refine this.trans ?_
    rw [Modules.Hom.sub_app_apply]
    congr 1
    · split_ifs with h
      · exact hz e
      · rfl
    · split_ifs with h
      · rw [affineLineOver.mulCoordPow_naturality 1 (pullMap S (S.irrelevantPow (j - e.1 + 1) j).2)]
        simp only [Modules.Hom.comp_app]
        show lam 1 ((pullMap S (S.irrelevantPow (j - e.1 + 1) j).2).app V (z e)) = _
        rw [hz e]
      · rfl
  simp only [hterm]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq', if_pos (Finset.mem_univ e')]
  have hsecond : (∑ e : Fin (j + 1), if e.1 = e'.1 + 1 then lam 1 (c e.1) else 0) = lam 1 (c (e'.1 + 1)) := by
    by_cases h : e'.1 + 1 < j + 1
    · have : ∀ e : Fin (j + 1), (if e.1 = e'.1 + 1 then lam 1 (c e.1) else 0) =
          (if e = ⟨e'.1 + 1, h⟩ then lam 1 (c e.1) else 0) := by
        intro e
        congr 1
        exact propext ⟨fun h' => Fin.ext h', fun h' => congrArg Fin.val h'⟩
      simp only [this]
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq', if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]
    · have hj : e'.1 = j := by have := e'.2; omega
      have hz0 : c (e'.1 + 1) = 0 := by simp [c, hj, ReesSyzygyAux.revSum]
      rw [hz0, map_zero]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun e _ => ?_
      rw [if_neg]
      have := e.2
      omega
  rw [hsecond, ← sub_eq_zero, hc_step e'.1 (by have := e'.2; omega), hab e']
  abel

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.reesDeformation.epi_kernel_lift_syzygy
statement:
theorem epi_kernel_lift_syzygy (j : ℕ) :
    Epi (CategoryTheory.Limits.kernel.lift (gen S j) (syzygy S j) (syzygy_comp_gen S j))
proof:
:=
  (CategoryTheory.ShortComplex.exact_iff_epi_kernel_lift _).1 (exact_syzygy_gen S j)

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.mul_one'
statement:
theorem mul_one' (m : ℕ) :
    (S.part m ◁ S.one) ≫ S.mul m 0 =
      (ρ_ (S.part m)).hom ≫ eqToHom (congrArg S.part (Nat.add_zero m).symm)
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : S.mul m 0 = (β_ (S.part m) (S.part 0)).hom ≫ S.mul 0 m ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg S.part (Nat.add_comm 0 m)) := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, S.mul_comm m 0, Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id]
  rw [h3, ← Category.assoc, BraidedCategory.braiding_naturality_right, Category.assoc,
    ← Category.assoc (S.one ▷ S.part m), S.one_mul m]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc, braiding_leftUnitor, eqToHom_trans]

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.landsIn_id_one
statement: theorem landsIn_id_one (j : ℕ) (hj : 0 < j) : S.LandsIn (𝟙 (S.part j)) 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := S.landsIn_whiskerLeft_irrelevantPow_mul_succ 0 j 0 j hj (Nat.add_zero j)
  have h' := S.landsIn_comp ((ρ_ (S.part j)).inv ≫ (S.part j ◁ S.one)) h
  have e : 𝟙 (S.part j) = ((ρ_ (S.part j)).inv ≫ (S.part j ◁ S.one)) ≫
      ((S.part j ◁ (S.irrelevantPow 0 0).2) ≫ S.mul j 0 ≫ eqToHom (congrArg S.part (Nat.add_zero j))) := by
    show 𝟙 (S.part j) = ((ρ_ (S.part j)).inv ≫ (S.part j ◁ S.one)) ≫
      ((S.part j ◁ 𝟙 (S.part 0)) ≫ S.mul j 0 ≫ eqToHom (congrArg S.part (Nat.add_zero j)))
    rw [MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_id, Category.id_comp, Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc (S.part j ◁ S.one),
      S.mul_one' j, Category.assoc, eqToHom_trans, eqToHom_refl, Category.comp_id, Iso.inv_hom_id]
  rw [e]
  exact h'

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.epi_irrelevantPow_one_snd
statement: theorem epi_irrelevantPow_one_snd (j : ℕ) (hj : 0 < j) : Epi (S.irrelevantPow 1 j).2
proof:
:= by
  apply CategoryTheory.Abelian.epi_of_cokernel_π_eq_zero
  have h := S.landsIn_id_one j hj
  unfold LandsIn at h
  rwa [Category.id_comp] at h

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.isIso_irrelevantPow_one_snd
statement: theorem isIso_irrelevantPow_one_snd (j : ℕ) (hj : 0 < j) : IsIso (S.irrelevantPow 1 j).2
proof:
:=
  haveI := S.mono_irrelevantPow 1 j
  haveI := S.epi_irrelevantPow_one_snd j hj
  isIso_of_mono_of_epi _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.irrelevantPowOneIso_hom

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.π_comp_linearPieceIso_hom
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem π_comp_linearPieceIso_hom (j : ℕ) (hj : 0 < j) :
    cokernel.π (irrelevantPow.stepHom S 1 j) ≫ (S.linearPieceIso j hj).hom =
      (S.irrelevantPow 1 j).2 ≫ cokernel.π (S.irrelevantPow 2 j).2
proof:
:= by

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.stepHom_self_eq_zero
statement: theorem stepHom_self_eq_zero (j : ℕ) : irrelevantPow.stepHom S j j = 0

:=
  (S.irrelevantPow_isZero_of_lt (j + 1) j (Nat.lt_succ_self j)).eq_of_src _ _

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.π_comp_topPieceIso_hom
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem π_comp_topPieceIso_hom (j : ℕ) :
    cokernel.π (irrelevantPow.stepHom S j j) ≫ (S.topPieceIso j).hom = 𝟙 _
proof:

name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.GradedQCAlgebra.π_comp_zerothPieceIso_hom
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem π_comp_zerothPieceIso_hom :
    cokernel.π (irrelevantPow.stepHom S 0 0) ≫ S.zerothPieceIso.hom = 𝟙 (S.part 0)
proof:
:=
  S.π_comp_topPieceIso_hom 0

name: lineBundle_ratDivisorOp_comm
statement:
private theorem lineBundle_ratDivisorOp_comm {K : Type u} [Field K]
    {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    [AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    (L L' : X.Modules) [L.IsLineBundle] [L'.IsLineBundle] (d : ℕ) :
    (AlgebraicGeometry.ratDivisorOpOfLineBundle L d).comp
        (AlgebraicGeometry.ratDivisorOpOfLineBundle L' (d + 1)) =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.ratDivisorOpOfLineBundle L' d).comp
        (AlgebraicGeometry.ratDivisorOpOfLineBundle L (d + 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold AlgebraicGeometry.ratDivisorOpOfLineBundle AddMonoidHom.ratExtend
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  change
    ((LinearMap.baseChange ℚ
      (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L (d + 1)).toIntLinearMap).comp
      (LinearMap.baseChange ℚ
        (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L' (d + 2)).toIntLinearMap)) z =
    ((LinearMap.baseChange ℚ
      (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L' (d + 1)).toIntLinearMap).comp
      (LinearMap.baseChange ℚ
        (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L (d + 2)).toIntLinearMap)) z
  rw [← LinearMap.baseChange_comp, ← LinearMap.baseChange_comp]
  have hcomp :
      (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L (d + 1)).toIntLinearMap.comp
          (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L' (d + 2)).toIntLinearMap =
        (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L' (d + 1)).toIntLinearMap.comp
          (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass L (d + 2)).toIntLinearMap := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    exact congrArg (fun f => f x)
      (AlgebraicGeometry.firstChernClass_comm (k := K) (X := X) L L' d)
  rw [hcomp]

name: lineBundle_toEnd_comm
statement:
private theorem lineBundle_toEnd_comm {K : Type u} [Field K]
    {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    [AlgebraicGeometry.LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    (L L' : X.Modules) [L.IsLineBundle] [L'.IsLineBundle] :
    Commute
      (AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd
        (AlgebraicGeometry.ratDivisorOpOfLineBundle L))
      (AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd
        (AlgebraicGeometry.ratDivisorOpOfLineBundle L'))
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  refine DirectSum.induction_on z ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, map_zero]
  · intro j x
    cases j with
    | zero =>
        change
          AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd
              (AlgebraicGeometry.ratDivisorOpOfLineBundle L)
            (AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd
              (AlgebraicGeometry.ratDivisorOpOfLineBundle L')
              (DirectSum.of _ 0 x)) =
          AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd
              (AlgebraicGeometry.ratDivisorOpOfLineBundle L')
            (AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd
              (AlgebraicGeometry.ratDivisorOpOfLineBundle L)
              (DirectSum.of _ 0 x))
        rw [AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd_of_zero,
          AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd_of_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
    | succ d =>
        cases d with
        | zero =>
            change
              AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd
                  (AlgebraicGeometry.ratDivisorOpOfLineBundle L)
                (AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd
                  (AlgebraicGeometry.ratDivisorOpOfLineBundle L')
                  (DirectSum.of _ 1 x)) =
              AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd
                  (AlgebraicGeometry.ratDivisorOpOfLineBundle L')
                (AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd
                  (AlgebraicGeometry.ratDivisorOpOfLineBundle L)
                  (DirectSum.of _ 1 x))
            rw [AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd_of,
              AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd_of,
              AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd_of_zero,
              AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd_of_zero]
        | succ e =>
            change
              AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd
                  (AlgebraicGeometry.ratDivisorOpOfLineBundle L)
                (AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd
                  (AlgebraicGeometry.ratDivisorOpOfLineBundle L')
                  (DirectSum.of _ (e + 2) x)) =
              AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd
                  (AlgebraicGeometry.ratDivisorOpOfLineBundle L')
                (AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd
                  (AlgebraicGeometry.ratDivisorOpOfLineBundle L)
                  (DirectSum.of _ (e + 2) x))
            rw [AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd_of,
              AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd_of,
              AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd_of,
              AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd_of]
            exact congrArg (DirectSum.of _ e) (congrArg (fun f => f x)
              (lineBundle_ratDivisorOp_comm (K := K) (X := X) L L' e))
  · intro x y hx hy
    simpa only [Module.End.mul_apply, map_add] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hx hy

name: commute_add_smul
statement:
private theorem commute_add_smul {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℚ M]
    (A B C : Module.End ℚ M) (c d : ℚ)
    (hAB : Commute A B) (hAC : Commute A C) (hBC : Commute B C) :
    Commute (A + c • B) (A + d • C)
proof:
:= by
  change (A + c • B) * (A + d • C) = (A + d • C) * (A + c • B)
  simp only [add_mul, mul_add, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm]
  rw [hAB.eq, hAC.eq, hBC.eq]
  module

name: component_of
statement:
private theorem component_of {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} (i j : ℕ)
    (x : AlgebraicGeometry.ChowGroupRat X j) :
    DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.ChowGroupRat X d) i
        (DirectSum.of _ j x) = if h : j = i then Eq.recOn h x else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← DirectSum.lof_eq_of ℚ ℕ (fun d => AlgebraicGeometry.ChowGroupRat X d) j x]
  exact DirectSum.component.of (R := ℚ) i j x

name: component_zero_toEnd_toEnd
statement:
private theorem component_zero_toEnd_toEnd {X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}}
    (D E : AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp X) (z : AlgebraicGeometry.ChowRat X) :
    DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ (fun j => AlgebraicGeometry.ChowGroupRat X j) 0
        (AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd D
          (AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd E z)) =
      D 0 (E 1 (DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ
        (fun j => AlgebraicGeometry.ChowGroupRat X j) 2 z))
proof:
:= by
  refine DirectSum.induction_on z ?_ ?_ ?_
  · simp
  · intro j x
    rcases j with _ | _ | j
    · rw [AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd_of_zero,
        map_zero]
      simp [component_of]
    · rw [AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd_of,
        AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd_of_zero]
      simp [component_of]
    · rcases j with _ | j
      · rw [AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd_of,
          AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd_of]
        simp [component_of]
      · rw [AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd_of,
          AlgebraicGeometry.RatDivisorOp.toEnd_of]
        simp [component_of]
  · intro x y hx hy
    simpa only [map_add] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hx hy

      (AlgebraicGeometry.ChowGroupRat.congr X h α)

  cases h
